अ.en: 1. अ the first letter of the alphabet · the first short vowel inherent in consonants.… · 2. अ (प्रगृह्य, q.v.), a vocative particle [अ अनन्त, O Vइṣṇउ], T.… · interjection of pity, Ah!… · 3. अ (before a vowel अन्, exc. अ-ऋणिन्), a prefix corresponding to Gk. ἀ, ἀν, Lat. in, Goth. and Germ. un, Eng. in or un, and having a negative or privative or contrary sense (अन्-एक not one; अन्-अन्त endless; अ-सत् not good; अ-पश्यत् not seeing)… · rarely prefixed to Inf. (अ-स्वप्तुम् not to sleep, TāṇḍyaBr.) and even to forms of the finite verb (अ-स्पृहयन्ति they do not desire, BhP.; Śiś.) and to pronouns (अ-सः not he, Śiś.; अ-तद् not that, BhP.)… · occasionally denoting comparison (अ-ब्राह्मण like a भ्रह्मन्, T.)… · sometimes disparagement (अ-यज्ञ a miserable sacrifice)… · sometimes diminutiveness (cf. अ/-कर्ण, अन्-उदरा)…

अग्निमुख.en: अग्नि/—मुख mfn. (अग्नि-) having आग्नि for the mouth, ŚBr. · अग्नि/—मुख m. a deity, a भ्र्āह्मṇअ, a tonic medicine, L. <pb n="5,3"/>… · Semecarpus Anacardium… · Plumbago Zeylanica, L.… · N. of a bug, Pañcat.…

अग्निरहस्य.en: अग्नि—रहस्य n. ‘mystery of आग्नि’, title of the tenth book of the Śअतपत्ह-भ्र्āह्मṇअ.

अग्निरूप.en: अग्नि/—रूप (अग्नि/-), mfn. fire-shaped, RV. x, 84, 1 · अग्नि—रू/प n. (अग्नि-रू/प) a shape of fire, ŚBr.…

अग्निलोक.en: अग्नि—लोक m. the world of आग्नि, KauṣUp.

अग्निवत्.en: अग्नि—व/त् mfn. being near the fire, RV. vii, 104, 2 (= -म/त्, q.v.) · ‘joined to (another) fire’, N. of आग्नि, TS.…

अग्निष्टोम.en: अग्नि—ष्टोम/ m. ‘praise of आग्नि’, N. of a protracted ceremony or sacrifice (forming one of the chief modifications, [संस्थास्] of the झ्योतिṣṭओम offered by one who is desirous of obtaining heaven; the performer is a भ्रह्मन् who maintains the sacred fire, the offering is the शोम, the deities to whom, the offering is made are ईन्द्र &c., the number of priests required is 16, the ceremonies continue for five, days) · a mantra or kalpa connected with the आग्निṣṭओम, L.…

अग्निष्वात्त.en: अग्नि—ष्वात्त/ m. pl. [in Epic and later texts -स्वात्त] ‘tasted by the funeral fire’, the Manes, RV. x, 15, 11; VS.; ŚBr. · in later texts N. of a class of Manes (who on earth neglected the sacrificial fire), <pb n="6,1"/> MBh. &c.…

अग्निहोतृ.en: अग्नि/—होतृ (अग्नि/) m. having आग्नि for a priest, RV. x, 66, 8.

अग्निहोत्र.en: 1. अग्नि/—होत्र mfn. (अग्नि/-) sacrificing to आग्नि, AV. vi, 97, 1 · 2. अग्नि—होत्र/ n., AV. &c. oblation to आग्नि (chiefly of milk, oil, and sour gruel; there are two kinds of आग्निहोत्र, one is नित्य i.e. of constant obligation, the other काम्य i.e. optional)… · the sacred fire, Mn.; Yājñ. &c.…

अग्निहोत्री.en: अग्नि—होत्री f. the cow destined for the आग्निहोत्र, ŚBr.; AitBr.

अग्निहोत्राहुति.en: agni—˚hotrAhuti/ f. a libation or offering at the आग्निहोत्र [ŚBr. cf. आहुति]

अग्निहोत्रिन्.en: अग्नि—होत्रि/न् mfn. practising the आग्निहोत्र, maintaining the sacrificial fire, ŚBr. &c.

अग्नीन्धन.en: agnInDana n. kindling or feeding the fire, Mn. &c.

अग्न्यर्चि.en: अग्—˚न्य्-अर्चि m. the flame of fire, JaimUp.

अग्न्युद्धरण.en: अग्न्य्-उद्धरण n. taking the sacred fire from its usual place (previous to a sacrifice).

अग्निक.en: m. a plant, probably Semecarpus Anacardium · a kind of serpent, Suśr.… · an insect of scarlet colour, Coccinella… · n. the Acajou-nut, Suśr.…

(fr. √ अङ्ग्, Uṇ.), foremost, anterior, first, prominent, projecting, chief, best, L.<listinfo n="sup"/> · supernumerary, L.… · अ/ग्र n. foremost point or part… · tip… · front… · uppermost part, top, summit, surface… · point… · and hence, figuratively, sharpness… · the nearest end, the beginning… · the climax or best part… · goal, aim… · multitude, L.… · a weight, equal to a pala, L.… · a measure of food given as alms, L.… · (in astron.) the sun's amplitude… · n. (also) rest, remainder, Līl.…

अग्रा.en: अ/ग्रा f. [scil. रेखा] measure of amplitude (i.e. the distance from the extremity of the gnomon-shadow to the line of the equinoctial shadow), Sūryas.

अग्रम्.en: अ/ग्रम् ind. in front, before, ahead of

अग्रेण.en: अ/ग्रेण ind. in front, before (without or with acc.), ŚBr.

अग्रे.en: अ/ग्रे ind. in front, ahead of, in the beginning, first · further on, subsequently, below (in a book)… · from — up to (आ), ŚBr., before (in time), AitUp. &c. [cf. Gk. ἄκρον].… · अ/ग्रे ind. (loc.) See अ/ग्र.…

अग्रज.en: अग्र—ज mfn. (cf. जा/) born first or earlier · अग्र—ज m. the first-born, an elder brother, Mn. &c.… · a भ्रह्मन्, VarBṛS. &c.…

अग्रजा.en: अग्र—जा f. an elder sister. · अग्र—जा/ mfn. first-born, RV. ix, 5, 9.…

अग्रवत्.en: अ/ग्र—वत् (अ/ग्र-) mfn. being at the top, TS.

अग्र्य.en: / mf(आ)n. foremost, topmost, principal, best · proficient, well versed in (with loc.)… · intent, closely attentive… · / m. an elder or eldest brother, L.… · / n. roof, L.…

अग्रहण.en: अ-ग्रहण n. not meaning, Paribh. · अ/-ग्रहण mfn. not afflicted by disease, MaitrS.…

अग्राह्य.en: अ-ग्राह्य mfn. not to be conceived or perceived or obtained or admitted or trusted, to be rejected.

अग्रस्त.en: अ-ग्रस्त mfn. not swallowed (said of sounds), ChUp.

अग्रू.en: / f. a virgin, RV.; AV. · nom. pl. अग्रु/वस्, poetical N. of the ten fingers, RV.… · अ/ग्रू and also of the seven rivers, RV. i, 191, 14 and iv, 19, 7… · अग्रु cf. Zend aghru.…

अघ.en: / mfn. bad, dangerous, RV. · sinful, impure, BhP.… · / m. N. of an आसुर, BhP.… · / n. evil, mishap, RV.; AV.… · sin, impurity, Mn. &c.… · pain, suffering, L.…

अघा.en: / (आ/स्), f. pl. the constellation usually called ंअग्ह्ā, RV. x, 85, 13.

अघवत्.en: अघ—वत् mfn. sinful · [voc. अघवन् or अघोस्, q.v.]…

अघय.en: Nom. P. ˚यति, to do evil, sin, Dhātup.

अघायु.en: / mfn. intending to injure, malicious, RV. &c.

अघन.en: अ-घन mfn. not dense or solid.

अघात.en: अ/-घात m. no injury, no damage, TBr.

अङ्क.en: / m. a hook, RV. i, 162, 13, &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · part of a chariot (used in the dual), TS.; TBr.… · a curve… · the curve in the human, especially the female, figure above the hip (where infants sitting astride are carried by mothers, hence often = ‘breast’ or ‘lap’)… · the side or flank… · the body… · proximity, place… · the bend in the arm… · any hook or crooked instrument… · a curved line… · a numerical figure, cipher, a figure or mark branded on an animal, &c.… · any mark, line, stroke, ornament, stigma… · a number… · the numbers one and nine… · a co-efficient… · an act of a drama… · a drama… · a military show or sham-fight… · a misdeed, a sin, L.… · a kind of regnal year (used in Orissa and usually spoken of as Onko year; the peculiarity of it is that in counting the years of the reign of a king certain numbers are omitted, thus, accord. to one system, the numbers ending with 6 or 0, excepting 10, are dropped, so that the sequence of the years would be-1, 2, 3, 4, 5, <pb n="1309,2"/> 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 19, 21 &c.)…

अङ्कु.en: du. a partic. part of a chariot, Gobh.

अङ्कुर.en: 1. अङ्कुर m. a sprout, shoot, blade, a swelling, a tumour, Suśr. · a hair, L.… · blood, L.… · water, L.… · 2. अङ्कुर Nom. P. ˚रति, to shoot, sprout, bud, Pārv.…

अङ्कुरय.en: Nom. P. ˚यति, to cause to sprout or bud, effect, produce, Subh.

(√ अम्, Uṇ.), a limb of the body… · a limb, member… · the body… · a subordinate division or department, especially of a science, as the six Vएद्āṅगs… · hence the number six… · N. of the chief sacred texts of the झइनs… · a limb or subdivision of ंअन्त्र or counsel (said to be five, viz. 1. karmaRAm AramBopAyaH, means of commencing operations; 2. पुरुष-द्रव्य-सम्पद्, providing men and materials; 3. देश-काल-विभाग, distribution of place and time; 4. विपत्ति-प्रतीकार, counter-action of disaster; 5. कार्य-सिद्धि, successful accomplishment; whence मन्त्र is said to be paYcANga)…

अङ्गी.en: (for अङ्ग in comp. with √ 1. कृ and its derivatives). · See 1. अङ्ग.…

अङ्गीकरण.en: अङ्गी—करण n. act of taking the side of, assenting, agreeing, promising.

अङ्गीकृ.en: अङ्गी 1. √ कृ to take the side of; <div n="to"/>to agree to, assent, promise, confess.

अङ्गज.en: अङ्ग—ज mfn. produced from or on the body, ornamental, L. · produced by a supplementary ceremony… · अङ्ग—ज m. a son, L.… · hair of the head, L.… · the god of love, L.… · intoxicating passion, L.… · drunkenness, L.… · a disease, L.… · अङ्ग—ज n. blood.…

अङ्गाङ्गि.en: aNgANgi ind. jointly or reciprocally, related as one limb to another or to the body.

अङ्गु.en: m. or f. (?) a limb of the body, L.<listinfo n="sup"/> · a bird, L.…

अङ्गभ.en: m. a kind of rice, L.

(√ अग् or अङ्ग्, Uṇ. cf. अग्नि), charcoal, either heated or not heated · अ/ङ्गार m. the planet Mars… · N. of a prince of the ंअरुत्s, Hariv.… · the plant ःइत्āवल्ī… · अ/ङ्गार m. pl. अङ्गारावक्षयण.en: aNgArAvakza/yaRa n. an instrument for extinguishing coals, ŚBr. xiv.

अङ्गुष्ठ.en: अङ्गु/ष्ठ m. the thumb · the great toe… · a thumb's breadth, usually regarded as equal to an अङ्गुल.…

अचतुर.en: अ-चतुर mfn. destitute of four, having less than four · not cunning, not dexterous.…

अचर.en: अ-चर or अ/-चरत् [RV.], mfn. immovable. · अ-चर, (also) impassable, Hariv.…

अचरण.en: अ/-चरण n. improper conduct, ŚBr.; mf(आ)n.

अचरम.en: अ/-चरम mfn. not last, not least · said of the ंअरुत्s, RV. v, 58, 5.…

अचल.en: अ-चल mf(आ)n. not moving, immovable · अ-चल m. a mountain, rock… · a bolt or pin… · the number seven… · N. of Śइव and of the first of the nine deified persons, called ‘white भलs’ among the झइनs… · of a धेवर्ṣइ, VP.…

अचित्त.en: अ-चि/त्त mfn. unnoticed, unexpected · not an object of thought… · inconceivable, RV.… · destitute of intellect or sense.…

अचित.en: 1. अ/-चित mfn. not heaped up. · 2. अचित mfn. (√ अच्), gone, L.…

अचिन्त्यरूप.en: अ-चिन्त्य—रूप mfn. having an inconceivable form.

अचिर.en: अ-चिर mfn. not of long duration, brief · instantaneous, recent…

अचिरेण.en: अ-चिरेण ind. not long, not for long; not long ago; soon, speedily

अचिरा.en: अ-चिरा f. the mother of the झइन saint Śāन्ति.

अचेतन.en: अ-चेतन mfn. without consciousness, inanimate · unconscious, insensible, senseless, fainting, &c.…

अच्छेद्य.en: अ-च्छेद्य mfn. improper or impossible to be cut, indivisible.

अच्युत.en: अ/-च्युत or अ-च्युत/, mfn. not fallen · firm, solid… · imperishable, permanent… · not leaking or dripping… · (अस्), m. N. of Vइṣṇउ… · of ख्ṛṣṇअ… · of a physician, the plant Morinda Tinctoria… · N. of a gift to आग्नि, ŚBr.…

अजक.en: m. N. of a descendant of फुर्ūरवस् · of a king of ंअगद्ह…

अति.en: अ/ति ind. [probably neut. of an obsolete adj. अतिन्, passing, going, beyond; see √ अत्, and cf. Old Germ. anti, unti, inti, unde, indi, &c.; Eng. and; Germ. und; Gk. ἔτι, ἀντί, Lat. ante; Lith. ant; Arm. ti; Zend aitì]. · As a prefix to verbs and their derivatives, expresses beyond, over, and, if not standing by itself, leaves the accent on the verb or its derivative; as, अति-क्रम् (√ क्रम्), to overstep, Ved. Inf. अति-क्र/मे, (fit) to be walked on, to be passed, RV. i, 105, 16, अति-क्र/मण n. See s.v. When prefixed to nouns, not derived from verbs, it expresses beyond, surpassing, as, अति-कश, past the whip, अति-मानुष, superhuman, &c. See s.v.… · As a separable adverb or preposition (with acc.), Ved. beyond (with gen.) over, at the top of RV.; AV.… · is often prefixed to nouns and adjectives, and rarely to verbs, in the sense excessive, extraordinary, intense;…

(as a prefix to nouns and verbs, expresses) away, off, back (opposed to उ/प, अ/नु, सम्, प्र) · down (opposed to उद्).… · When prefixed to nouns, it may sometimes = the neg. particle अ, e.g. अप-भी, fearless; or may express deterioration, inferiority, &c. अपतिव्रता.en: अ-पति—व्रता f. an unfaithful or unchaste wife.

अपत्य.en: अ/पत्य n. (fr. अ/प), offspring, child, descendant · a patronymical affix, Sāh.…

अपथ.en: अ/-पथ n. not a way, absence of a road, pathless state, AV. &c., wrong way, deviation · heresy, heterodoxy, L.… · अ/-पथ mf(आ)n., pathless, roadless, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 30, Sch.…

अपद.en: अ/-पद n. no place, no abode, AV. · the wrong place or time, Kathās. &c.… · अ/-पद mfn. footless, Pañcat.…

अपदिष्ट.en: अप-दिष्ट mfn. assigned as a reason or pretext.

अपदेश.en: अप-देश m. assigning, pointing out, KātyŚr. · pretence, feint, pretext, disguise, contrivance… · the second step in a syllogism (i.e. statement of the reason)… · a butt or mark, L.… · place, quarter, L.…

अपधा.en: 1. अप-√ धा (Imper. -दधातु; aor. Pass. -धायि) to take off, place aside, RV. iv, 28, 2; vi, 20, 5 and x, 164, 3. · 2. अप-धा/ f. hiding, shutting up, RV. ii, 12, 3.…

अपनम्.en: अप-√ नम् (with abl.) bend away from, give way to [NBD.], to bow down before [Gmn.], RV. vi, 17, 9.

अपनिह्नु.en: अप-नि-√ ह्नु to deny, conceal, ChUp. &c.

अपनी.en: अप-√ नी to lead away or off; <div n="to"/>to rob, steal, take or drag away; <div n="to"/>to remove, frighten away; <div n="to"/>to put off or away (as garments, ornaments, or fetters); <div n="to"/>to extract, take from; <div n="to"/>to deny Comm. on Mn. viii, 53, 59; <div n="to"/>to except, exclude from a rule Comm. on RPrāt. : <div n="vp"/>Desid. -निनीषति, to wish to remove Comm. on Mn. i, 27.

अपनय.en: अप-नय m. leading away, taking away · bad policy, bad or wicked conduct.…

अपनयन.en: अप-नयन n. taking away, withdrawing · destroying, healing… · acquittance of a debt.…

अपनीत.en: अप-नीत mfn. led away from · taken away, removed… · paid, discharged… · contradictory, badly executed, spoiled… · अप-नीत n. imprudent or bad behaviour.…

अपनेतृ.en: अप-नेतृ m. a remover, taking away.

अपनु.en: अप-√ 3. नु to put aside, ŚāṅkhGṛ.

अपनुद.en: अप-नुद mfn. (ifc. e.g. SokApanuda, q.v.) removing driving away.

अपप.en: m. (with Buddhists) a partic. cold hell, Dharmas. 122.

अपम.en: / mfn. (fr. अ/प), the most distant, the last, RV. x, 39, 3; AV. x, 4, 1 · / m. (in astron.) the declination of a planet.…

अपमर्द.en: अप-मर्द m. (√ मृद्), what is swept away, dirt.

अपमा.en: अप-√ 3. मा (ind.p. -मा/य; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 4, 69) to measure off, measure, AV. xix, 57, 6.

अपमान.en: अप-मान m. (or n.), (√ मन्), disrespect, contempt, disgrace.

अपमृत्यु.en: अप-मृत्यु m. sudden or accidental death · a great danger or illness (from which a person recovers).…

अपमे.en: अप-√ मे cl. 1. Ā. -मयते (ind.p. -मित्य, or -माय) to be in debt to, owe, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 19, Sch.

अपया.en: अप-√ या to go away, depart, retire from (abl.).; <div n="to"/>to fall off: <div n="vp"/>Caus. -यापयति, to carry away by violence, BhP.

अपयु.en: अप-√ 1. यु -युयोति (Imper. 2. sg. -युयोधि, 2. pl. -युयोतन) to repel, disjoin, RV.

अपर.en: 1. अ-पर mfn. having nothing beyond or after, having no rival or superior. · 2. अ/पर mf(आ)n. (fr. अ/प), posterior, later, latter (opposed to पू/र्व; often in comp.)<listinfo n="sup"/>… · following… · western… · inferior, lower (opposed to प/र)… · other, another (opposed to स्व/)… · different (with abl.)… · being in the west of… · distant, opposite. Sometimes अपर is used as a conjunction to connect words or sentences, e.g. अपरं-च, moreover… · अ/पर (अस्), m. the hind foot of an elephant, Śiś.… · also (ए), m. pl. others (= अन्ये, used to indicate a various reading), ःāल, Sch.… · / (अ/म्)/ [RV. vi, 33, 5], n. the future, RV.; ŚBr.… · [cf. Goth. and Old Germ. afar, and the Mod. Germ. aber, in such words as Aber-mal, Aber-witz].…

अपरस्पर.en: 1. अ-पर—स्-पर mfn. ‘not reciprocal, not one (by) the other’, only in comp. with -सम्भूत mfn. not produced one by the other, Bhag. · 2. अपर—स्-पर mfn. pl. one after the other, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 144.… · अ-परस्पर See 1. अ-पर.… · अपरस्-पर See 2. अ/पर.…

अपरा.en: अ/परा f. the west, L. · the hind quarter of an elephant, L.… · the womb, L.… · f. (with विद्या) the exoteric Vएद्āन्त doctrine (as opp. to परा व्˚, ‘the esoteric’), IndSt.…

अपरम्.en: (अ/परम् [AV.] or अपर/म् [RV.]), ind. in future, for the future · (अपरम्) again, moreover, PārGṛ.; Pañcat.… · in the west of (abl.), KātyŚr.…

अपरेण.en: अ/परेण ind. (with acc.) behind, west, to the west of KātyŚr.

अपरकाल.en: अपर—काल m. a later period, KātyŚr.

अपरपक्ष.en: अपर—पक्ष/ m. the latter half of the month, ŚBr. · the other or opposing side, the defendant.…

अपरभाव.en: अपर—भाव m. after-existence, succession, continuation, Nir.

अपरान्त.en: aparAnta mfn. living at the western border · aparAnta m. the western extremity, the country or the inhabitants of the western border… · the extreme end or term… · ‘the latter end’, death.…

अपरान्तक.en: aparAntaka mf(इका)n. living at the western border, VarBṛS. &c. · aparAntaka n. N. of a song, Yājñ.…

अपराह्ण.en: aparAhRa/ m. afternoon, the last watch of the day.

अपराग.en: अप-राग m. aversion, antipathy, Mn. vii, 154.

अपरत.en: अप-रत mfn. (√ रम्), turned off from, unfavourable to (abl.), Nir. · resting, BhP.…

अपराजिता.en: अ/-पराजिता f. (with दिश्) the northeast quarter, AitBr. &c. · धुर्ग्ā… · several plants, Clitoria Ternatea, Marsilea Quadrifolia, Sesbania Aegyptiaca… · a species of the Śअर्कर्ī metre (of four lines, each containing fourteen syllables).…

अपराजिष्णु.en: अ/-पराजिष्णु mfn. unconquerable, invincible, ŚBr. xiv.

अपराद्ध.en: अप-राद्ध mfn. having missed · having offended, sinned… · criminal, guilty… · erring.…

अपराध.en: अप-राध m. offence, transgression, fault · mistake… · ं √ 1. कृ, to offend any one (gen.)…

अपरिग्रह.en: अ-परिग्रह m. not including Comm. on TPrāt. · non-acceptance, renouncing (of any possession besides the necessary utensils of ascetics), Jain.… · deprivation, destitution, poverty… · अ-परिग्रह mfn. destitute of possession… · destitute of attendants or of a wife, Kum. i, 54.…

अपरिच्छिन्न.en: अ-परिच्छिन्न mfn. without interval or division, uninterrupted, continuous · connected… · unlimited… · undistinguished.…

अपरिमाण.en: अ/-परिमाण mfn. without measure, immeasurable, immense · अ/-परिमाण n. immeasurableness.…

अपरिमित.en: अ/-परिमित mfn. unmeasured, either indefinite or unlimited, AV.; ŚBr. &c.

अपरिलुप्त.en: अ-परिलुप्त mfn. not invalidated, RPrāt., Sch.

अपरिसमाप्तिक.en: अ-परिसमाप्तिक mfn. not ending, endless Comm. on BṛĀrUp.

अपरिस्थान.en: अ-परिस्थान mfn. improper · अ-परिस्थान n. impropriety, Mālatīm.…

अपरोध.en: अप-रोध m. exclusion, prohibition (अन्- neg.), KātyŚr.

अपरोक्षात्.en: अ/-परोक्षात् ind. perceptibly, manifestly, ŚBr. xiv.

अपर्यन्त.en: अ-पर्यन्त/ mfn. unbounded, unlimited, ŚBr. x, xiv, &c.

अपर्याप्त.en: अ-पर्याप्त mfn. (√ आप्), incomplete · unable, incompetent, insufficient… · not enough… · unlimited, unbounded, L.…

अपल.en: 1. अपल n. a pin or bolt, L. · 2. अ-पल mfn. fleshless.…

अपवाद.en: अप-वाद m. evil speaking, reviling, blaming, speaking ill of (gen.)<listinfo n="sup"/> · denial, refutation, contradiction… · a special rule setting aside a general one, exception (opposed to उत्सर्ग, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 94, Sch.), RPrāt.; Pāṇ., Sch.… · order, command, Kir.… · a peculiar noise made by hunters to entice deer, Śiś. vi, 9.… · (also) the withdrawal of the अध्यारोप or superimposed attribute (in the Vएद्āन्त).… · अप-वाद &c. See अप-√ वद्.<listinfo n="sup"/>…

अपवादक.en: अप-वादक mfn. reviling, blaming, defaming · opposing, objecting to, excepting, excluding Comm. on TPrāt.…

अपवरक.en: अप-वरक &c. See अप- √ 1. वृ. · अप-वरक m. an inner apartment, lying-in chamber, Kathās.…

अपवर्ग.en: अप-वर्ग &c. See अप-√ वृज्. · अप-वर्ग m. completion, end (e.g. paYcApavarga, coming to an end in five days), KātyŚr. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/>… · the emancipation of the soul from bodily existence, exemption from further transmigration… · opp. to स्वर्ग (in phil.)… · final beatitude, BhP. &c.… · gift, donation, ĀśvŚr.… · restriction (of a rule), Suśr.; Śulb.… · shooting off (an arrow), Kir.…

अपवर्ण.en: अप-वर्ण mfn. faulty or incorrect as to sound, Śikṣ.

अपोढ.en: apoQa See s.v., p. 56, col. 3. · apoQa mfn. (√ वह्), carried off, removed, taken away.…

अपवा.en: अप-√ वा -वा/ति, to exhale, perspire, RV. i, 162, 10, (Imper. -वातु) to blow off, RV. viii, 18, 10.

अपविद्ध.en: अप-विद्ध See अप-√ व्यध्. · अप-विद्ध mfn. pierced… · thrown away, rejected, dismissed, removed.…

अपवी.en: अप-√ वी -वेति, to turn away from, be unfavourable to, RV. v, 61, 18 and x, 43, 2.

अपवृ.en: अप-√ 1. वृ (impf. 2. sg. a/pAvfRos, 3. sg. a/pAvfRot; Subj. -वरत्; aor. 2. and 3. sg. -आवर् [Padap. -अवर्], 3. sg. Ā. -अवृत; aor. Subj. 1. sg. -वम् [for वर्म्, RV. x, 28, 7], 3. sg. -वर्, 3. pl. -व्रन्, Imper. 2. sg. [in RV.] once अ/प वृधि and five times अ/पा वृधि [cf. अपा- √ 1. वृ and ib. अ/पा-वृत]; perf. 2. sg. -वव/र्थ, 3. sg. -ववार) <div n="to"/>to open, uncover, exhibit, RV.; <div n="vp"/> (ind.p. -वृत्य), ŚBr. xiv; <div n="vp"/> (cf. अपा- √ 1. वृ) : <div n="vp"/>Caus. -वारयति, ‘to hide, conceal’, see अप-वारित.

अपव्याख्या.en: अप-व्याख्या f. false explanation, KātyŚr., Sch.

अपशब्द.en: अप-शब्द m. bad or vulgar speech<listinfo n="sup"/> · any form of language not Sanskṛt… · ungrammatical language… · (अप-भ्रंश.)… · ungrammatical language (compared to a deer as grammar to a lion), Subh.…

अपश्य.en: अ-पश्य/ mfn. not seeing, RV. i, 148, 5.

अपश्यत्.en: अ/-पश्यत् mfn. id., RV. x, 135, 3 · (in astron.) not being in view of VarBṛ.… · not noticing… · not considering, not caring for, Yājñ. ii, 3.…

अपश्रय.en: अप-श्रय/ m. a bolster, AV. xv, 3, 8.

अपष्ठ.en: अप-ष्ठ m. n. (√ स्था), the end or point of the hook for driving an elephant, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 97 (cf. अपाष्ठ/.)

अपस्.en: 1. अ/पस् n. (fr. 1. अ/प्), work, action, especially sacred act, sacrificial act, RV.[Lat. opus.] · 2. अप/स् mfn. active, skilful in any art, RV.… · अप/स् (अ/सस्), f. pl. N. of the hands and fingers (when employed in kindling the sacred fire and in performing the sacrifices), RV.… · of the three goddesses of sacred speech, RV.; VS.… · of the active or running waters, RV.; AV.… · 3. अप/स् mfn. (fr. 2. अ/प्), watery. (So some passages of the Ṛग्-वेद [i, 95, 4, &c.] may (according to NBD. and others) be translated where the word is applied to the running waters See 2. अप/स् at end and अप/स्-तम.)…

अपस्य.en: 1. अपस्य Nom. P. (Subj. ˚स्या/त्) to be active, RV. i, 121, 7. · 2. अपस्य^ mf(सी/)n. watery, melting, dispersing, RV. x, 89, 2; VS. x, 7… · , अपस्यु/. See अपस्.…

अपस्या.en: 1. अपस्या/ f. activity, RV. v, 44, 8; vii, 45, 2 (cf. स्व्-अपस्या/; for 2. अपस्या^, see 2. अपस्य^ below.) · 2. अपस्या^ f. a kind of brick (twenty are used in building the sacrificial altar), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.…

अपसर्जन.en: अप-सर्जन n. (√ सृज्), abandonment, L. · gift or donation, L.… · final emancipation of the soul, L. (cf. अप-√ वृज्.)…

अपसृ.en: अप-√ सृ (impf. -सरत्) to slip off from (abl.), RV. iv, 30, 10; <div n="to"/>to go away, retreat: <div n="vp"/>Caus. -सारयति, to make or let go away, remove.

अपसार.en: अप-सार m. a way for going out, escape, Mṛcch.; Pañcat.

अपसर्प.en: अप-सर्प m. a secret emissary or agent, spy, Bālar.

अपस्कर.en: अप-स्कर m. any part of a carriage, a wheel, &c., Pāṇ. vi, 1, 149 · faeces (cf. अवस्कर), Vet.… · anus, L.… · vulva, L.…

अपस्पृ.en: अप-√ स्पृ Ā. (impf. 3. pl. -स्पृण्वत) to extricate from, deliver from, KauṣBr.; <div n="to"/> (3. pl. -स्पृण्वते/) to refresh [Gmn.; ‘to alienate’, BR.], RV. viii, 2, 5.

अपह.en: अप-ह mfn. ifc. keeping back, repelling, removing, destroying (e.g. SokApaha, q.v.)

अपहत.en: अ/प-हत mfn. destroyed, warded off, killed.

अपहतपाप्मन्.en: अ/प-हत—पाप्मन् (अ/पहत-) mfn. having the evil warded off, free from evil, ŚBr.

अपहन्तृ.en: अप-हन्तृ/ mf(त्री, Ragh.)n. beating off, destroying, ŚBr. &c.

अपहर.en: अप-हर &c. See अप-√ हृ. · अप-हर mfn. (ifc.) carrying off, Bhām.…

अपहास.en: अप-हास m. id., L. · a mocking laugh, R.…

अपहा.en: 1. अप-√ 2. हा Ā. -जिहीते (aor. 3. pl. -अहासत Subj. 1. pl. -हास्महि), to run away from (abl.) or off, RV. · 2. अप-√ 3. हा Ā. (aor. Subj. 2. sg. -हास्थाः) to remain behind, fall short, not reach the desired end, AV. xviii, 3, 73 : <div n="vp"/>Pass. -हीयते, to grow less, decrease (in strength, बलम्), Suśr.…

अपहाय.en: अप-हाय ind. ind.p. quitting, MBh. &c. · leaving, avoiding, Hariv.… · leaving out of view, Śāk. &c.… · excepting, except, Ragh.…

अपहि.en: अप-√ हि to throw off, disengage or deliver one's self from (acc.), BhP.

अपहित.en: mfn. entrusted, L.<listinfo n="sup"/> · charged (with a crime), L.…

अपहृ.en: अप-√ हृ to snatch away, carry off, plunder; <div n="to"/>to remove, throw away: <div n="vp"/>Caus. -हारयति See अप-हारित below.<listinfo n="sup"/> · (also) to captivate, Divyāv.…

अपहरण.en: अप-हरण n. taking away, carrying off<listinfo n="sup"/> · stealing, Mn.… · keeping off all contrarieties, Jātakam.…

अपहार.en: अप-हार m. taking away, stealing<listinfo n="sup"/> · spending another person's property… · secreting, concealment, e.g. AtmApahAraM √ 1. कृ, to conceal one's real character, Śāk.… · a thief, L.… · a shark or a crocodile, L.…

अपहृत.en: अप-हृत mfn. taken away, carried off, stolen, &c.

अपह्नु.en: अप-√ ह्नु Ā. (1. sg. -ह्नुवे/) to refuse, RV. i, 138, 4; <div n="to"/>to conceal, disguise, deny, Kāṭh. &c.; <div n="to"/>to excuse one's self, give satisfaction to, ŚBr.; TBr.

अपह्नुवान.en: अप-ह्नुवान mfn. pr. p. Ā. concealing, denying (any one dat.), Naiṣ.

अपाक.en: 2. अ-पाक mfn. (√ पच्), immature, raw, unripe (said of fruits and of sores) · अ-पाक m. immaturity… · indigestion, Suśr.… · 1. अ/पाक mfn. coming from a distant place, distant, RV.; VS.…

अपाकृ.en: apA-√ 1. कृ to remove, drive away, (Ved. Inf. apA/kartoH), MaitrS.; <div n="to"/>to cast off, reject, desist from, MBh. &c.; <div n="to"/>to select for a present, PBr.; KātyŚr.; <div n="to"/>to reject (an opinion).

अपाकरण.en: apA-karaRa n. driving away, removal, KātyŚr. · payment, liquidation.…

अपाकृत.en: apA-kfta mfn. taken away, removed, destroyed, void of · paid.…

अपात्र.en: अ-पात्र n. a worthless or common utensil, an undeserving or worthless object, unfit recipient, unworthy, to receive gifts, Bhag.; Kathās.

अपाद.en: अ-पाद mfn. not divided into फ्āदs not metrical.

अपाद्य.en: अ/-पाद्य mf(आ)n. (or a/pAdya?), N. of certain ईṣṭइs (performed with the चवन वैश्वसृज), TBr. · apAdya m. N. of AV. iv, 33, 1 &c., Kauś.…

अपादा.en: apA-√ 1. दा Ā. to take off or away, ŚBr.; Kauś.

अपात्त.en: अ/पात्त mfn. (fr. apA-√ 1. दा) taken off or away, ŚBr.

अपादान.en: apA-dAna n. taking away, removal, ablation · a thing from which another thing is removed… · hence the sense of the fifth or ablative case, Pāṇ.…

अपान्.en: apAn (√ अन्), apAniti, or apAnati [AV. xi, 4, 14] to breathe out, expire, ŚBr. xiv; ChUp.; <div n="vp"/> pr. p. apAna/t mf(ती/)n. breathing out, RV. x, 189, 2; AV.

अपान.en: apAna/ m. (opposed to prARa/), that of the five vital airs which goes downwards and out at the anus · the anus, MBh. (in this sense also (अम्) n., L.)… · N. of a श्āमन्, PBr.… · ventris crepitus, L.…

अपानवायु.en: apAna—vAyu m. the air आप्āन, L. · ventris crepitus, L.…

अपापविद्ध.en: अ/-पाप—विद्ध (अ/-पाप-), mfn. not afflicted with evil, VS. xl, 8.

अपाय.en: apAya See ape. · apAya m. going away, departure… · destruction, death, annihilation… · injury, loss… · misfortune, evil, calamity.…

अपार.en: अ-पार/ mfn. not having an opposite shore, TS.<listinfo n="sup"/> · not having a shore, unbounded, boundless (applied to the earth, or to heaven and earth, [रो/दसी], &c.), RV. &c.… · difficult to be got at, R.… · अ-पार/ (अस्), m. ‘not the opposite bank’, the bank on this side (of a river), MBh. viii, 2381… · अ-पार/ (अम्), n. (in श्āṅक्ह्य phil.) ‘a bad shore’, ‘the reverse of पार’, a kind of mental indifference or acquiescence… · the reverse of mental acquiescence, L.… · the boundless sea.…

अपार्जित.en: apArjita mfn. (√ ऋज् with अप), flung away, L.

अपाला.en: अ-पाला/ f. N. of a daughter of आत्रि, RV. viii, 91, 7, &c.

अपावृ.en: अपा-√ 1. वृ (अपा = अप cf. अप- √ 1. वृ), -वृणोति, to open, uncover, reveal, Lāṭy.; Up. &c.

अपावृत.en: अ/पा-वृत mfn. open, laid open, RV. i, 57, 1, &c. · covered, L.… · unrestrained, self willed, L.…

अपाश्रय.en: 1. apASraya mfn. helpless, destitute. · 2. apA-Sraya m. the upper portion of a bed or couch on which the head rests, Daś.… · refuge, recourse, the person or thing to which recourse is had for refuge… · an awning spread over a court or yard, R. v, 11, 19.…

अपाश्रि.en: apA-√ Sri P. Ā. -श्रयति, ˚ते, to resort to, to use, practise.

अपास्.en: 1. a/pAs (√ 1. अस्), ‘to be absent from, not to participate in’, see apa-pare. · 2. apAs (√ 2. अस्), to fling away, throw away or off, discard, to scare, drive away; <div n="to"/>to leave behind; <div n="to"/>to take no notice of, disregard.…

अपासन.en: apAsana n. throwing away, placing aside, KātyŚr. · killing, slaughter, L.…

अपासित.en: apAsita mfn. thrown down, injured, destroyed, L.

अपास्त.en: apAsta mfn. thrown off, set aside · driven away… · carried off or away, abandoned, discarded… · disregarded… · contemned.…

अपास्य.en: apAsya ind.p. having thrown away or discarded · having left having disregarded… · having excepted.…

अपासि.en: apAsi mfn. having a bad or no sword.

अपि.en: अ/पि or sometimes पि (see पि-दृभ्, पि-धा, पि-नह्), expresses placing near or over, uniting to, annexing, reaching to, proximity, &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · [cf. Gk. ἐπί; Zend api; Germ. and Eng. prefix be]… · in later Sanskṛt its place seems frequently supplied by अभि.… · (As a separable adv.) and, also, moreover, besides, assuredly, surely… · suppose that, perhaps, Jātakam.… · अपि or अपि-च, as well as… · na vApi or न अपिवा or na nacApi, neither, nor, cApi, (and at the beginning of a sentence) अपि-च, moreover.… · is often used to express emphasis, in the sense of even, also, very… · e.g. अन्यद् अपि, also another, something more… · adyApi, this very day, even now… · taTApi, even thus, notwithstanding… · यद्य् अपि, even if, although… · yadyapi taTApi, although, nevertheless…

अपित्व.en: अपि-त्व/ n. having part, share, AV.; ŚBr. (cf. अप-पित्व/.)

अपिगृह्य.en: 1. अपि-गृ/ह्य ind.p. closing the mouth, TS. · 2. अपि-गृह्य [Ved. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 118] or अपि-ग्राह्य [ib. Comm.], अम्, n. impers. (with abl.) the mouth to be closed before (a bad smell, &c.)…

अपितृ.en: अ/-पितृ ता, m. not a father, ŚBr. xiv.

अपिधा.en: अपि-√ धा Ved. to place upon or into, put to, give; <div n="vp"/> chiefly Ved. to shut, close, cover, conceal (in later texts more usually पि-√ धा, q.v.)

अपिधान.en: अपि-धा/न n. placing upon covering, KātyŚr. · a cover, a cloth for covering, RV. &c.… · a lid, BhP.… · a bar, Kum.…

अपिहित.en: अ/पि-हित mfn. put to, placed into, RV. · shut, covered, concealed, RV. &c. (cf. पि-हित)… · अ/पि-हित &c. See अपि-√ ध.…

अपिनी.en: अपि-√ नी to lead towards or to, bring to a state or condition, TS.; ŚBr.; AitBr.

अपिपास.en: अ-पिपास/ mfn. free from thirst or desire, ŚBr. xiv; ChUp.

अपी.en: 1. अ/पी See अ/प्य. · 2. apI (√ इ), (Ved.) अ/प्य्-एति to go in or near; <div n="to"/>to enter into or upon; <div n="to"/>to come near, approach (also in copulation, RV. ii, 43, 2 ind.p. apI/tyA); <div n="to"/>to partake, have a share in; <div n="to"/>to join to pour out (as a river).…

अपियत्.en: अपि-य/त् mfn. entering the other world, dying, RV. i, 162, 20 · dissolving, disappearing, BhP.…

अपीत.en: 1. a/pIta mfn. gone into, entered, ŚBr. x (used for the etym. of स्वपिति), ChUp. (cf. svApyayA.) · 2. अ-पीत mfn. not drunk… · not having drunk, MBh. ii, 1902.…

अपीति.en: a/pIti f. entering into, RV. i, 121, 10, dissolving, dissolution, ŚBr.; Up.

अप्यय.en: अप्य्-अय m. joint, juncture, Kauś.; Śulb. · pouring out (of a river), PBr.; entering into, vanishing (the contrary of प्रभव or उत्पत्ति), Up. &c. (cf. svApyaya/.)… · अप्य्-अय See 2. apI.…

अपुत्र.en: अ/-पुत्र m. not a son, ŚBr. xiv · अ-पु/त्र mf(आ)n. sonless, ŚBr. &c.…

अपुनरुक्त.en: अ-पुनर्—उक्त, n. or अ-पुनर्—उक्ति, f. no (superfluous) repetition.

अपुरुष.en: अ-पुरुष mfn. unmanly.<listinfo n="sup"/> · a cruel man or servant (of ञम), Jātakam.…

अपुरुषार्थ.en: a-puruzArTa m. a rite which is not for the benefit of the sacrificer · not the chief object of the soul.…

अपूत.en: अ/-पूत mfn. impure, ŚBr.; KātyŚr. · not purified (by purificatory rites), Mn.; Gaut.…

अपूर.en: अ-पूर mfn. not to be filled or satisfied, not to be quenched (as thirst), BhP.

अपूरण.en: अ-पूरण mf(ई)n. insatiable, MBh. · अ-पूरण (ifc.) not completing, defective, BhP.…

अपूर्ण.en: अ-पूर्ण mfn. not full or entire, incomplete, deficient · अ-पूर्ण n. an incomplete number, a fraction.…

अपूर्यमाण.en: अ-पूर्यमाण mfn. not getting full, KātyŚr.

अपूर्व.en: अ-पूर्व/ mf(आ)n. unpreceded, unprecedented, ŚBr. xiv, &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · not having existed before, quite new… · unparalleled, incomparable, extraordinary… · not married before, Āpast.… · not first… · preceded by अ, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 17… · अ-पूर्व/ (अस्), m. N. of a sacrifice (offered to फ्रज्āपति), PBr.; Vait.… · अ-पूर्व m. a novice, Kir. vi, 39… · अ-पूर्व/ (अम्), n. the remote or unforeseen consequence of an act (as heaven of religious rites), Nyāyam.… · a consequence not immediately preceded by its cause…

अपूर्वेण.en: अ-पूर्वे/ण ind. never before, AV. x, 8, 33.

अपृथक्.en: अ-पृथक् ind. not separately, with, together with, collectively.

अपे.en: ape (√ इ) P. Ā. apEti, a/pAyati (impf. Ā. a/pAyata, RV. x, 72, 6) to go away, withdraw, retire, run away, escape; <div n="to"/>to vanish, disappear.

अपेत.en: apeta mfn. escaped, departed, gone, having retired from, free from (abl. or in comp.)

अपेक्ष्.en: apekz (√ ईक्ष्) to look away, to look round, AV.; ŚBr.; <div n="to"/>to have some design; <div n="vp"/> to have regard to, to respect; <div n="to"/>to look for, wait for; <div n="to"/>to expect, hope; <div n="to"/>to require, have an eye to, Sāh.; <div n="vp"/> with न, not to like, Kathās.

अपेक्षण.en: apekzaRa n. = apekzA, L.<listinfo n="sup"/> · apekzaRa mfn. not looking at (comp.), Subh. (conj.).…

अपेक्षणीय.en: apekzaRIya mfn. to be considered or regarded · to be looked for or expected… · to be wished or required… · desirable.…

अपेक्षा.en: apekzA f. looking round or about, consideration of, reference, regard to (in comp.; rarely loc.) · dependence on, connection of cause with effect or of individual with species… · looking for, expectation, hope, need, requirement…

अपेक्षया.en: apekzayA ind. with regard to (in comp.)

अपेक्षित.en: apekzita mfn. considered · referred to… · looked for, expected… · wished, required.…

अपेक्ष्य.en: 1. apekzya = apekzaRIya. · 2. apekzya ind.p. with regard or reference to.…

अपेय.en: अ-पेय mf(आ)n. unfit for drinking, not to be drunk, Mn. &c.

अपोदि.en: apod-i (√ इ) to go away altogether, withdraw from (abl.), AV.; ŚBr.; AitBr.

अपोह्.en: apoh (√ 1. ऊह्), -ऊहति (impf. a/pOhat) to strip off, push away, frighten away, RV. &c., to remove or heal (diseases), Suśr.; <div n="to"/> Ā. to keep away from one's self, avoid, Mn.; <div n="to"/>to give up, Ragh.; <div n="to"/> (in disputation) to object, deny, Sāh.

अपोह.en: apoha m. pushing away, removing · (in disputation) reasoning, arguing, denying.…

अप्तु.en: / mfn. small, tender [Comm.; but perhaps connected with अप्तु/र् above, because also, applied to the शोम] MaitrS.; TS.; ŚBr. · / m. body, Uṇ.…

अप्यस्.en: अप्य्-√ 1. अस् -अस्ति (1. pl. -ष्मसि; Imper. -अस्तु; Opt. -ष्यात्), Ved. (with loc. or local adv.) <div n="to"/>to be in, be closely connected with, RV. &c.; <div n="to"/>to belong to (as a share), RV.; ŚBr. · अप्य्-√ 2. अस् (Subj. Ā. 2. sg. -अस्या-थाः) to insert, AitBr.…

अप्रकर.en: अ-प्रकर mfn. not acting excellently, L.

अप्रकरण.en: अ-प्रकरण n. not the principal topic, not relevant to the main subject.

अप्रकृत.en: अ-प्रकृत mfn. not principal, not relevant to the main topic under discussion, not chief<listinfo n="sup"/> · occasional or incidental… · not natural.… · not being in question, not belonging to the matter, KātyŚr.…

अप्रकृति.en: अ-प्रकृति f. not an inherent or inseparable property, accidental property or nature.

अप्रकाश.en: अ-प्रकाश mf(आ)n. not shining, dark · not visible, hidden, secret, Mn.… · not manifest or evident… · अ-प्रकाश m. indistinctness, darkness, Ragh. i, 68.…

अप्रकाशम्.en: अ-प्रकाशम् ind. in secret, Mn. viii, 351

अप्रकाशक.en: अ-प्रकाशक mf(इका)n. not rendering bright, making dark.

अप्रकाश्य.en: अ-प्रकाश्य mfn. not to be manifested.

अप्रगल्भ.en: अ-प्रगल्भ mf(आ)n. not arrogant, modest · timid.…

अप्रच्युत.en: अ/-प्रच्युत mfn. unmoved, RV. ii, 28, 8 · (with abl.) not fallen or deviating from, observing, following, Mn. xii, 116.…

अप्रच्युति.en: अ/-प्रच्युति f. not decaying, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.

अप्रज.en: अ/-प्रज mf(आ)n. (√ जन्), without progeny, childless, RV. i, 21, 5; Mn. &c.

अप्रजा.en: अ/-प्रजा f. not bearing, unprolific, MBh. i, 4491.

अप्रणोद्य.en: अ-प्रणोद्य mfn. (√ नुद्), not to be turned away (as a guest), Mn. iii, 105; Gaut.

अप्रतर्क्य.en: अ-प्रतर्क्य mfn. not to be discussed, L. · incomprehensible by reason, undefinable, Mn. i, 5 & xii, 29; BhP. &c.…

अप्रति.en: अ-प्रति/ mfn. without opponents, irresistible, RV.; BhP. · अ-प्रति/ (इ/), n. irresistibly, RV. vii, 83, 4 and 99, 5; AV.…

अप्रतिरूप.en: 1. अ-प्रति—रूप mf(आ)n. of unequalled form, incomparable, R. &c. [cf. 2. अ-प्रतिरूप, p. 58]. · 2. अ/-प्रतिरूप mf(आ)n. not corresponding with, unfit, ŚBr. xiv… · odious, disagreeable, R. &c. (For 1. See अ-प्रति/.)…

अप्रतिगृह्य.en: अ-प्रतिगृह्य/ mfn. one from whom one must not accept anything, ŚBr. xiv.

अप्रतिघ.en: अ-प्रतिघ mfn. (√ हन्), not to be kept off, not to be vanquished, Mn. xii, 28, &c.

अप्रतिपत्ति.en: अ-प्रतिपत्ति f. non-ascertainment · not understanding, Nyāyad.… · the state of being undecided or confused, Sāh. &c.… · non-performance, failure.…

अप्रतिबन्ध.en: अ-प्रतिबन्ध m. absence of obstruction · अ-प्रतिबन्ध mfn. unimpeded, undisputed, direct (inheritance), not collateral or presumptive.…

अप्रतिबोध.en: अ-प्रतिबोध mfn. without consciousness, Ragh. viii, 57.

अप्रतिम.en: अ-प्रतिम mf(आ)n. unequalled, incomparable, without a match.

अप्रतिषेध.en: अ-प्रतिषेध m. ‘non-prohibition’, non-negation, an invalid objection, Nyāyad.

अप्रतिष्ठ.en: अ-प्रतिष्ठ mfn. having no solid ground, no value, fluctuating, unsafe, MBh.; Mn. iii, 180 &c. · अ-प्रतिष्ठ m. N. of a hell, VP.…

अप्रतिष्ठान.en: अ-प्रतिष्ठान/ mfn. having no solid ground, AV. xi, 3, 49.

अप्रतिष्ठित.en: अ/-प्रतिष्ठित mfn. id., ŚBr.; AitBr.; TBr. · unlimited, BhP.; Jain.…

अप्रतिसंख्या.en: अ-प्रतिसंख्या f. ‘not observing’, in comp. with<listinfo n="sup"/> · inconsiderateness, Jātakam.…

अप्रतिसंख्यानिरोध.en: अ-प्रतिसंख्या—निरोध m. the unobserved annihilation of an object, Buddh.

अप्रतिहत.en: अ-प्रतिहत mfn. uninterrupted, unobstructed, irresistible · unaffected, unimpaired, indestructible, uninjured, not passed away, PārGṛ.…

अप्रतीत.en: a/-pratIta mfn. unapproached, unattackable, RV.; AV. vii, 25, 1 · not understood, uncommon (as an expression), Sāh. &c.… · not merry, sad, R.…

अप्रतीति.en: a-pratIti f. the state of not being understood · mistrust, want of confidence.…

अप्रत्यक्ष.en: अ-प्रत्यक्ष mfn. not present to the sight, invisible, imperceptible.

अप्रत्यय.en: अ-प्रत्यय m. distrust, disbelief, doubt · not an affix, Pāṇ. i, 1, 69… · अ-प्रत्यय mfn. distrustful (with loc.), Śāk.… · causing distrust… · having no affix.…

अप्रधान.en: अ-प्रधान mfn. not principal, subordinate, secondary, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 19, &c.

अप्रमत्त.en: अ/-प्रमत्त mfn. not careless, careful, attentive, vigilant, ŚBr. &c.

अप्रमाद.en: अ-प्रमाद m. care, vigilance, MBh. &c. · अ-प्रमाद mfn. ‘careful, cautious’, see -ता below…

अप्रमय.en: अ-प्र/मय mfn. imperishable, ŚBr. xiv (cf. अ-प्रामि-सत्य.)

अप्रमा.en: अ-प्रमा f. a rule which is no authority (see अ-प्रमाण) · incorrect knowledge.…

अप्रमाण.en: अ-प्रमाण n. a rule which is no standard of action, MBh.; Śāk. &c. · (in discussion) a statement of no importance or authority.…

अप्रमेय.en: अ-प्रमेय mfn. immeasurable, unlimited, unfathomable, Mn. i, 3 and xii, 94, &c. · not to be proved.…

अप्रयत्न.en: अ-प्रयत्न m. absence of effort, indifference · अ-प्रयत्न mfn. indifferent, apathetic in (loc.), Mn. vi, 26.…

अप्रयुक्त.en: अ/-प्रयुक्त mfn. not used or applied, MaitrS. · (of words) not in use, Pat.… · unsuitable, Pañcat.…

अप्रयोग.en: अ-प्रयोग m. non-application · the not being in use (of words), Pat.…

अप्रयोजक.en: अ-प्रयोजक mf(इका)n. not causing or effecting, aimless.

अप्रवर्तक.en: अ-प्रवर्तक mf(इका)n. abstaining from action, inert · not exciting to action.…

अप्रवृत्त.en: अ-प्रवृत्त mfn. not acting, not engaged in<listinfo n="sup"/> · not commenced, not instigated.… · not due, unjust (as taxes), Bcar. ii, 44.…

अप्रवृत्ति.en: अ-प्रवृत्ति f. not proceeding<listinfo n="sup"/> · no further effect or applicability of a precept, KātyŚr.… · abstaining from action, inertion; non-excitement;… · want of news about (gen.), R.… · (in med.) suppression of the natural evacuations, constipation, ischury, &c.… · अ-प्रवृत्ति mfn. inactive, KauṣUp.…

अप्रसङ्ग.en: अ-प्रसङ्ग m. (in ङ्य्āय phil.) want of connection with · non-applicability, KātyŚr.…

अप्रसव.en: 1. अ-प्रसव m. (√ 3. सु), not preparing the शोम juice, KātyŚr. · 2. अ-प्रसव mfn. (√ 4. सु), not being prolific… · अ-प्रसव m. non-propagation.…

अप्रसह्य.en: अ-प्रसह्य mfn. intolerable, MBh. · irresistible, ib.…

अप्रसिद्ध.en: अ-प्रसिद्ध mfn. not settled, unestablished · unknown, uncelebrated… · unusual, uncommon, of no real existence, not current, not generally known.…

अप्रसूत.en: अ/-प्रसूत mfn. (√ 1. सू), not allowed, ŚāṅkhŚr. (of persons), ŚBr. (of things).

अप्राकृत.en: अ-प्राकृत mfn. not principal · not original… · special, particular… · not vulgar, extraordinary, Mcar.…

अप्राण.en: 1. a/-prARa m. no breath, MaitrUp. · 2. a-prARa/ mfn. inanimate, lifeless, AV.; ŚBr.…

अप्राप्त.en: a/-prApta mfn. unobtained · unarrived… · not accomplished, Yājñ. ii, 243… · not yet full-grown, Mn. ix, 88… · not resulting (from any rule), Pāṇ. viii, 2, 33, Sch.…

अप्राप्तकाल.en: a-prApta—kAla mfn. out of season, inopportune, ill-timed · under age… · a-prApta—kAla n. an irregular debate, Nyāyad.…

अप्राप्य.en: 1. a-prApya mfn. unobtainable, MBh. &c. · superl.… · 2. a-prApya ind.p. not having obtained… · not reaching.…

अप्रामाण्य.en: अ-प्रामाण्य n. absence or insufficiency of proof or authority.

अप्रिय.en: अ/-प्रिय mfn. disagreeable, disliked · unkind, unfriendly… · अ/-प्रिय m. a foe, an enemy, Mn.… · N. of a ञक्ṣअ, Buddh.…

अप्रिया.en: अ/-प्रिया f. a sort of skeat fish, Silurus Pungentissimus.

अप्लव.en: अ/-प्लव mf(आ)n. without a ship, AV. xix, 50, 31, &c. · not swimming.…

अप्सुयोनि.en: अप्सु/—योनि (अप्सु/-) mfn. born from the waters, TS.; ŚBr.

अफल.en: अ-फल/ mf(आ/)n. unfruitful, barren, RV. x, 97, 15, &c. · vain, unproductive, RV. x, 71, 5, &c.… · deprived of virility, R. i, 49, 1 & 11… · अ-फल/ m. Tamarix Indica…

अफला.en: अ-फला f. the Aloe (Aloes Perfoliata) · Flacourtia Cataphracta.…

अफलप्रेप्सु.en: a-Pala—prepsu mfn. one who desires no recompense, Bhag.

अबद्ध.en: अ/-बद्ध mfn. unbound, unrestrained, at liberty, TS. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · unmeaning, nonsensical, N.… · not yet appeared or visible, Ragh. xviii, 47.…

अबन्धक.en: अ-बन्धक mfn. not binding · अ-बन्धक m. N. of a man, and (m. pl.) his descendants, (g. upakAdi.)…

अबन्धन.en: अ-बन्धन/ mfn. without fetters, free, RV. iii, 55, 6.

अबल.en: अ-बल/ mf(आ/)n. weak, feeble, RV. v, 30, 9, &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · अ-बल m. a wife's elder brother, L.… · अ-बल/ (अस्), m. the plant Tapia Crataeva… · a king of ंअगद्ह, VP.… · अ-बल/ (अम्), n. want of strength, weakness.…

अबला.en: अ-बला/ (आ), f. a woman, Śāk. &c. · N. of a woman, Kathās.… · (= अचला) one of the ten <ns>Buddhist</ns> earths…

अबल्य.en: अ-बल्य^ [ŚBr.] or अ/-बल्य [ŚBr. xiv], n. weakness, sickness.

अबाध.en: अ-बाध mfn. unobstructed, unrestrained · free from pain…

अबाधा.en: अ-बाधा f. freedom from pain, MārkP. · = अ-बधा, q.v.…

अबाधित.en: अ/-बाधित mfn. unimpeded, unobstructed, RV. x, 92, 8, &c. · unrefuted… · not forbidden Comm. on Mn. iv, 5.…

अबाह्य.en: अ-बाह्य/ mfn. not exterior, internal, Ragh. xiv, 50 · without an exterior, ŚBr. xiv.…

अबीज.en: अ-बीज mfn. seedless · impotent, Mn. ix, 79.…

अबुद्ध.en: अ-बुद्ध mfn. unwise, foolish · not seen or noticed, KauṣBr.; R.…

अभि.en: 1. अभि/ ind. (a prefix to verbs and nouns, expressing) to, towards, into, over, upon. (As a prefix to verbs of motion) it expresses the notion of moving or going towards, approaching, &c. (As a prefix to nouns not derived from verbs) it expresses superiority, intensity, &c.; e.g. अभि-ताम्र, अभि-नव, q.v. · (As a separate adverb or preposition) it expresses (with acc.) to, towards, in the direction of, against… · into, ŚBr. & KātyŚr.… · for, for the sake of… · on account of… · on, upon, with regard to, by, before, in front of… · over. It may even express one after the other, severally, Pāṇ. i, 4, 91, e.g. वृक्षं वृक्षम् अभि, tree after tree… · [cf. Gk. ἀμϕί; Lat. ob; Zend aibi, aiwi; Goth. bi; Old High Germ. bī].… · 2. अ-भि mfn. fearless, MBh.…

अरुणि.en: m. N. of a ंउनि, BhP. (cf. आरुणि).

अरूपक.en: अ-रूपक mfn. shapeless, immaterial, MBh. iii, 12984 · (in rhetoric) without figure or metaphor, literal.…

अरे.en: ind. interjection of calling, VS.; ŚBr. &c. (cf. अररे, अरेरे, and रे).

अरोक.en: अ-रोक mfn. (√ रुच्), not bright, darkened, L.

अरोगा.en: अ-रोगा f. N. of ध्āक्ṣāयṇī in Vअइद्यन्āत्ह, MatsyaP.

अरोपण.en: अ-रोपण n. (√ रुह्), not planting or fixing.

अर्ग.en: m. N. of a Ṛṣइ of the SV. (with the patron. आउरव).

अर्गल.en: mfn. a wooden bolt or pin for fastening a door or the cover of a vessel, Ragh. &c. · a bar, check, impediment, ib.… · a wave, L.… · m. n. N. of a hell, PadmaP. v.…

अर्चन.en: mf(ई)n. ifc. honouring, praising, Nir. · nf. (अम्, A) homage paid to deities and to superiors, MBh. &c. (cf. vibuDArcana and surArcana).…

अर्जित.en: mfn. acquired, gained, earned (cf. svArjita and स्वयम् अर्जित.)

अर्जुन.en: अ/र्जुन mfn. अर्जुनस.en: mfn. overgrown with आर्जुन plants, (g. tfRAdi, q.v.)

अर्णव.en: / mfn. agitated, foaming, restless, RV.; VS.; AV. · / (अ/स्), m. a wave, flood, RV.… · the foaming sea, RV.; VS.… · the ocean of air (sometimes personified as a demon with the epithet महा/न् or तनयित्नु/स्), RV.; AV.… · / (अस्, rarely अम् [MBh. xiii, 7362]), m. n. the sea… · (hence) the number, ‘four’, Sūryas.… · N. of two metres (cf. अ/र्ण, m.), N. of wk. on jurisprudence.…

अर्ति.en: f. = आर्ति, pain, Suśr.; Kathās. · = अर्त्नी, the end of a bow, L.…

अर्थ.en: अ/र्थ m. n. [in RV. i-ix only n.; <pb n="90,3"/> in RV. x, six times n. and thrice m.; in later Sanskṛt only m.] aim, purpose (very often अर्थम्, अर्थेन, अर्थाय, and अर्थे ifc. or with gen. ‘for the sake of, on account of, in behalf of, for’) · cause, motive, reason, Mn. ii, 213, &c.… · advantage, use, utility (generally named with क्āम and द्हर्म See त्रि-वर्ग; used in wishing well to another dat. or gen. Pāṇ. ii, 3, 73)… · thing, object (said of the membrum virile, ŚBr. xiv)… · object of the senses, VarBṛS.… · (hence) the number ‘five’, Sūryas.… · substance, wealth, property, opulence, money… · (hence in astron.) N. of the second mansion, the mansion of wealth (cf. धन), VarBṛS.… · personified as the son of ध्हर्म and भुद्द्हि, BhP.… · affair, concern (Ved. often acc. अ/र्थम् with √ इ, or गम्, to go to one's business, take up one's work, RV. &c.)…

अर्थग्रहण.en: अर्थ—ग्रहण n. abstraction, of money · (in Gr.) apprehension of meaning… · signification.…

अर्थचिन्तक.en: अर्थ—चिन्तक mfn. knowing or considering what is useful, Vātsy. (cf. sarvArTa-c˚.)

अर्थजात.en: अर्थ—जात n. sg. and pl. collection of goods, money, Mṛcch. · things, objects, Śak.; Daś.…

अर्थज्ञ.en: अर्थ—ज्ञ mfn. = -कोविद above, R. iii, 71, 1 · understanding the sense (of a word), Nir. &c.…

अर्थभेद.en: अर्थ—भेद m. distinction or difference of meaning.

अर्थवश.en: अर्थ—वश cause and effect, Sukh. i

अर्थवैकल्य.en: अर्थ—वैकल्य n. incongruity in the facts, deviation from truth, Mn. viii, 95.

अर्थव्यक्ति.en: अर्थ—व्यक्ति f. clearness of the sense, Sāh.; Kpr. &c.

अर्थव्यवहार.en: अर्थ—व्यवहार m. a pecuniary suit, Yājñ., Sch.

अर्थैकत्व.en: arTEka-tva n. congruity or harmony of the purpose (with the thing), Jaim.

अर्थनीय.en: mfn. to be requested, asked for.

अर्थित.en: mfn. asked, desired, requested · (अम्), n. desire, L.…

अर्थित्व.en: अर्थि—त्व n. condition of a suppliant, Megh. · request, Mālav.; Kathās.…

अर्थीय.en: mfn. ifc. destined for, Mn. xii, 16 · relating to (cf. एवम्-अर्थीय and तद्-अर्थीय).…

अर्धे.en: (ए), loc. ind. in the middle, Śāk. (अर्ध in comp. with a subst. means ‘the half part of anything’ [cf. Pāṇ. ii, 2, 2], with an adj. or past Pass. p. [cf. Pāṇ. v, 4, 5] ‘half’; also with an adj. indicating measure [cf. Pāṇ. vii, 3, 26 and 27]; a peculiar kind of compound is formed with ordinals [cf. Pāṇ. i, 1, 23 Comm.] e.g. अर्ध-तृतीय, containing a half for its third, i.e. two and a half; अर्ध-चतुर्थ, having a half for its fourth, three and a half.)

अर्म.en: अ/र्म m. pl. ruins, rubbish, VS. xxx, 11; TS. &c., often ifc. in names of old villages half or entirely gone to ruin (e.g. guptArma, kukkuwArma, बृहद्-अर्म, &c., qq.vv.), Pāṇ. vi, 2, 90 seq. and viii, 2, 2, Sch. · = अर्मन्, q.v., Uṇ.…

अर्य.en: 1. अर्य/ mfn. (2, once 3 RV. iv, 1, 7) (√ ऋ) kind, favourable, RV. · attached to, true, devoted, dear, RV.… · excellent, L.… · ^ (अ/स्), m. a master, lord, Naigh.; Pāṇ. iii, 1, 103 (cf. 3. अ/र्य.)… · 2. अर्य^ mf(आ^)n. (= 1. अर्य/) kind, favourable, RV. i, 123, 1.… · 3. अ/र्य m. (= 1. अर्य/) ‘master, lord’, a Vअइśय, VS. &c., Pāṇ. iii, 1, 103…

अर्यपति.en: अर्य/—पति (अर्य/-) mf(पत्नी)n. (said of the dawns and of the waters) having kind or favourable lords (?), RV. vii, 6, 5 and x, 43, 8.

अर्या.en: अ/र्या f. a woman of the third caste, the wife of a Vअइśय, VS. &c., Pāṇ. iv, 1, 49 Comm.

अर्यक.en: m. N. of a demon causing disease, Hariv.

अर्यमन्.en: अर्यम/न् m. a bosom friend, play-fellow, companion, (especially) a friend who asks a woman in marriage for another, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; TBr. · N. of an Āदित्य (who is commonly invoked together with Vअरुṇअ and ंइत्र, also with भ्हग, भ्ṛहस्पति, and others; he is supposed to be the chief of the Manes, Bhag. &c., the milky way is called his path [अर्यम्ण/ः प/न्थाः, TBr.]; he presides over the ङक्ṣअत्र ऊत्तरप्हल्गुन्ī, VarBṛS.; his name is used to form different male names, Pāṇ. v, 3, 84), RV. &c.… · the sun, Śiś. ii, 39… · the Asclepias plant, L.…

अर्याणी.en: f. a mistress, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 49; Siddh. · a woman of the third or Vअइśय caste, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 49 Comm.…

अर्वश.en: अ/र्वश or अर्वश/ mfn. running, quick (said of ईन्द्र and of the gods), RV. x, 92, 6.

अर्वाक्.en: अर्वा/क् (आ/क्), ind. (g. स्वर्-आदि, q.v.) hither, (opposite to प/राक्, पर/स्, परस्तात्), RV.; AV.; ŚBr. · (with abl. ŚBr. &c.; with instr. RV. x, 129, 6; AV.) on this side, from a certain point, before, after… · on the lower side, ChUp.… · (with loc.) within, near, Sāh. (v.l.)…

अर्वाग्बिल.en: अर्वा/ग्—बिल (अर्वा/ग्-), mfn. having the mouth downwards, ŚBr. xiv

अर्श.en: m. (√ ऋश्), ‘damage’, see अ/नर्श-राति, (for अर्शस्) hemorrhoids, piles, L.

अर्ह.en: mf(आ)n. meriting, deserving (praise or blame, cf. pUjArha, nindArha), worthy of, having a claim or being entitled to (acc. or Inf. or in comp.) · being required, obliged, allowed (with Inf.)… · becoming, proper, fit (with gen. or ifc.), Pañcat.… · worth (in money), costing, R., (cf. satArha, sahasrArha)… · m. a N. of ईन्द्र, L.… · f(आ). or (आणि) n. pl. worship, ChUp.…

अर्हण.en: mfn. having a claim to, being entitled to (in comp.), BhP. · n. deserving, meriting, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 111, worship, honour, treating any one (gen.) with respect, Mn. iii, 54; BhP.… · a present of honour, MBh. i, 130; BhP.…

अर्हणा.en: f. worship, honour, N. Ragh. &c. · अर्˚ह/णा ind. Ved. instr. according to what is due, RV. i, 127, 6; x, 63, 4 and 92, 7.…

अल.en: n. the sting in the tail of a scorpion (or a bee), L. (cf. अलि अन्द् अलिन्) · (= आल, q.v.) yellow orpiment, L.…

अलक.en: m. n. (ifc. f(आ). ) a curl, lock, Ragh. &c. · m. (= अलर्क, q.v.) a mad dog, L.… · m. pl. N. of a people, VarBṛS.… · m. of the Inhabitants of खुबेर's residence आलक्ā, MBh. iii, 11813…

अलका.en: f. (g. kzipakAdi, q.v.) a girl from eight to ten years of age, L. · N. of the capital of खुबेर (situated on a peak of the ःइम्āलय inhabited also by Śइव), Kum. vi, 37, &c.… · N. of a town in ङिṣअद्ह, Kathās.…

अलक्त.en: m. (said to be for अरक्त), red juice or lac (obtained from the red resin of certain trees and from the cochineal's red sap), L.

अलक्षण.en: अ-लक्षण n. (√ लक्ष्), a bad, inauspicious sign, Mn. iv, 156 · अ-लक्षण/ mf(आ)n. having no signs or marks, without characteristic, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Mn. i, 5, having no good marks, inauspicious, unfortunate, Ragh. xiv, 5.…

अलक्षित.en: अ/-लक्षित mfn. unseen, unperceived, unobserved, MBh. · uncharacterized, having no particular mark, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.…

अलक्ष्य.en: अ-लक्ष्य mfn. invisible, unobserved, MBh. &c., unmarked, not indicated, Sāh. · having no particular marks, insignificant in appearance (see -जन्म-ता below)… · अ-लक्ष्य m. N. of a ंअन्त्र spoken to exorcise a weapon, R. i, 30, 5.…

अलघु.en: अ-लघु mfn. not light, heavy · not short, long (as a syllable in prosody)… · not quick, slow, Mṛcch.… · weighty, significant, Daś.… · serious, solemn… · intense, violent.…

अलभ्य.en: अ-लभ्य mfn. unobtainable, Kum. v, 43, &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · unintelligible, Sāh.…

अलम्.en: अ/लम् ind. (later form of अ/रम्, q.v.), enough, sufficient, adequate, equal to, competent, able. (अलम् may govern a dat. [जी/वितवै/ (Ved. Inf. dat.) अ/लम्, AV. vi, 109, 1, or अलं जीवनाय, Mn. xi, 76, &c., sufficient for living] or Inf. [Pāṇ. ii, 4, 66; अलं विज्ञातुम् ‘able to conceive’, Nir. ii, 3] or instr. [Pāṇ. ii, 3, 27; Siddh.; अलं शङ्कया, enough i.e. away with fear!] or gen. [अलं प्रजायाः, capable of obtaining progeny, PBr.] or may be used with the fut. [अलं हनिष्यति, he will be able to kill, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 154, Sch.] or with an ind. [Pāṇ. iii, 4, 18; अलं भुक्त्वा, enough of eating i.e. do not eat more, अलं विचार्य, enough of consideration].)

अलय.en: अ-लय m. (√ ली), non-dissolution, permanence, R. iii, 71, 10 (v.l. अन्-अय) · अ-लय mfn. restless, Śiś. iv, 57.…

अलस.en: अ-लस/ mf(आ)n. inactive, without energy, lazy, idle, indolent, tired, faint, ŚBr.; AitBr. &c. · अ-लस/ (अस्), m. a sore or ulcer between the toes, Suśr.… · (= अ-लसक below) tympanitis, Bhpr.… · N. of a small poisonous animal, Suśr.… · N. of a plant, L.…

अलाक.en: m. (= अलर्क) the plant Calotropis Gigantea, Car.

अलाघव.en: अ-लाघव n. (with मनसः) no ease or relief of conscience, Mn. xi, 234.

अलाबू.en: f. (= अला/बु above) the bottle-gourd, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 66 Comm. Uṇ.

अलाभ.en: अ-लाभ m. non-acquirement, Mn. vi, 57 · want, deficiency, ĀśvGṛ. &c.… · loss (in selling goods), Mn. ix, 331… · loss (of life, prARa), Mn. xi, 80…

अलास.en: m. inflammation and abscess at the root of the tongue, Suśr.

अलि.en: 1. अलि m. (for अलिन्, fr. अल, q.v.) ‘possessed of a sting’, a (large black) bee, Ragh. &c. · a scorpion, L.… · a crow, L.… · the Indian cuckoo, L.… · spirituous liquor, L.… · 2. अलि m. (in the Apabhraṃśa dialect) for अरि, enemy (pl. अलयस् for अरयस्), Pat.… · also अल/वस् is mentioned as a corrupt pronunciation for अर/यस्, ŚBr.…

अलिक.en: m. = अलीक, the forehead, Bālar. · N. of a Prākṛt poet.…

अलिङ्ग.en: अ-लिङ्ग n. absence of marks Comm. on Nyāyad. · अ-लिङ्ग (mfn.) having no marks, Nir.; MuṇḍUp. &c.… · (in Gr.) having no gender.…

अलीक.en: अ/लीक mf(आ, Naiṣ.)n. unpleasing, disagreeable (as a serpent), AV. v, 13, 5 · untrue, false, pretended, MBh. &c. little, L.… · अ/लीक n. anything displeasing, ĀśvŚr.; R. ii, 52, 25… · falsehood, untruth, Mn. xi, 55, &c.… · the forehead (cf. अलिक), heaven, L.…

अलु.en: f. (= आलु, q.v.) a small water-pot, L.

अलुप्त.en: अ-लुप्त mfn. not cut off, undiminished.

अलुब्ध.en: अ-लुब्ध mfn. not covetous, not avaricious, Gaut.

अलूक्ष.en: अ-लूक्ष mfn. (= अ/ रूक्ष, q.v.) not harsh, soft, greasy, TUp. &c.

अले.en: or अलेले ind. (cf. अरे and अरेरे), unmeaning words in the dialect of the demons or फिśāचs (introduced in plays &c.), L.

अलेप.en: अ-लेप m. = prec. [अलून no remnant or remaining particles], IndSt. · अ-लेप mfn. unstained, clean, pure, MBh.…

अलेश.en: अ-लेश mfn. not little, much, large

अलोक.en: अ-लोक m. ‘not the world’, the end of the world, R. i, 37, 12 · the immaterial or spiritual world, Jain.… · (अ/-लोकास्), m. pl. not the people, ŚBr. xiv… · अ-लोक/ mfn. not having space, finding no place, ŚBr.…

अलोक्य.en: अ-लोक्य/ mf(आ/)n. unusual, unallowed, ŚBr.; Mn. ii, 161.

अलोक्यता.en: अ-लोक्य/—ता (अलोक्य/-), f. loss of the other world, ŚBr. xiv.

अलोचन.en: अ-लोचन mf(आ)n. without eyes · without windows (to look through), Car.…

अलौकिक.en: अ-लौकिक mf(ई)n. not current in the world, uncommon, unusual (especially said of words) · not relating to this world, supernatural.… · अ-लौकिक See अ-लोक.…

अलौकिकत्व.en: अ-लौकिक—त्व n. rare occurrence (of a word), Sāh.

अलोप.en: अ-लोप m. not dropping (as a letter or syllable), Lāṭy.; TPrāt. · dropping of the letter अ, VPrāt.…

अलोलुप.en: अ-लोलुप mfn. = अ-लोल, MBh. iii, 153 · free from desire, Āp.… · अ-लोलुप m. N. of a son of ध्ह्ṛतर्āṣṭर, MBh. i, 2738.…

अलोहित.en: अ-लोहित/ [TS.] or अ-लो/हित [ŚBr. xiv], mfn. bloodless · अ-लोहित (अम्), n. Nymphaea Rubra, L.…

अल्प.en: अ/ल्प mf(आ)n. (m. pl. ए or आस्, Pāṇ. i, 1, 33) small, minute, trifling, little, AV. &c.

अल्पम्.en: अ/ल्पम् ind. (opposed to बहु) little, Mn. ii, 149 and x, 60

अल्पेन.en: अ/ल्पेन ind. instr. (with a perf. Pass. p. Pāṇ. ii, 3, 33) ‘for little’, cheap, Daś. · easily, R. iv, 32, 7…

अल्पतर.en: अल्प—तर mfn. (compar. cf. अल्पीयस्), smaller, RPrāt.; KātyŚr. &c.

अल्पधन.en: अल्प—धन mfn. of little wealth, not affluent, Mn. iii, 66 and xi, 40.

अल्पफल.en: अल्प—फल mf(आ)n. yielding little fruit, of small results or consequences, MānGṛ.

अल्पबुद्धि.en: अल्प—बुद्धि mfn. weak-minded, unwise, silly, Mn. xii, 74.

अल्पविषय.en: अल्प—विषय mfn. of limited range or capacity, Ragh. i, 2.

अल्पक.en: mf(इका)n. small, minute, trifling, Mn. &c. · (अस्), m. the plants Hedysarum Alhagi and Premna Herbacea, L.…

अल्पीयस्.en: mfn. (Pāṇ. v, 3, 64 cf. अल्प-तर above) smaller, less, KātyŚr.; Mn.; &c., very small.

अल्ला.en: f. (voc. अल्ल), a mother, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 107, Sch.

अव.en: 1. अ/व m. favour, RV. i, 128, 5 · (cf. निरव/.)… · 2. अ/व ind. (as a prefix to verbs and verbal nouns expresses) off, away, down, RV. &c.… · (exceptionally as a preposition with abl.) down from, AV. vii, 55, 1… · (for another use of this preposition See अव-कोकिल.)… · 3. अव (only gen. du. अवो/र् with वाम्, ‘of you both’, corresponding to स/ त्व/म्, ‘thou’, &c.), this, RV. vi, 67, 11; vii, 67, 4 and (वा for वाम्), x, 132, 5… · [Zd. pron. ava; Slav. ovo; cf. also the syllable, αὐ in αὐ-τός, αὖ, αὖθι, &c.; Lat. au-t, au-tem, &c.]…

अवत्.en: अ/वत् mfn. pr. p. See √ अव्.

अवन.en: n. favour, preservation, protection, Nir.; BhP. &c. (cf. अन्-अवन)<listinfo n="sup"/> · (= तर्पण) satisfaction, L.… · joy, pleasure, L.… · (for the explan. of 2. ए/व) desire, wish, Nir.… · speed, L.… · mfn. preserving, a preserver, Dharmaś.… · See √ अव्.…

अवनी.en: f. the plant Ficus Heterophylla, L. · N. of a river, Hariv. (see अव/नि.)… · 1. अवनी f. the earth, R.; Pañcat.… · 2. अव-√ नी (fut. 2. sg. -नेष्यसि) to lead or bring down into (water), ŚBr.; <div n="to"/>to put into (loc.), Gobh.; <div n="vp"/> -नयति, Ved. to pour down or over, AV.; VS. &c.…

अवक.en: अ/वक m. a grassy plant growing in marshy land (Blyxa Octandra Rich., otherwise called Śअइव्āल), MaitrS.

अवका.en: अ/वका f. (g. kzipakAdi, q.v.) id., VS.; TS.; ŚBr. &c.

अवकाश.en: अव-काश/ m. (ifc. f(आ). ) place, space · room, occasion, opportunity, (avakAsAM √ 1. कृ or दा to make room, give way, admit, ŚBr. &c.; अवकाशं √ लभ् or आप्, to get a footing, obtain a favourable opportunity, Śak. &c.; to find scope, happen take place; अवकाशं √ रुध्, not to give way, hinder, Megh.).… · aperture, Suśr. (˚शेन instr. ind. between, PBr.)… · intermediate time, ŚBr.… · ‘a glance cast on anything’, N. of certain verses, during the recitation of which the eyes must be fixed on particular objects (which therefore are called अवकाश्य, q.v.), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.…

अवकाशद.en: अव-काश—द mfn. giving opportunity, granting the use of (in comp.), Mn. ix, 271 and 278; Yājñ. ii, 276.

अवकृ.en: अव-√ कृ (ind.p. -कृत्वा [मुखान्य्] अव) to direct downwards (as the face), BhP.

अवकृत.en: अव-कृत mfn. directed downwards as a root, Kathās.

अवक्तव्य.en: अ-वक्तव्य mfn. not to be said, indescribable, NṛsUp. &c.

अवक्र.en: अ-वक्र mfn. not crooked, straight, ĀśvŚr. &c. · upright, honest.…

अवक्रम्.en: अव-√ क्रम् (Opt., -क्रामेत्) to step down upon (acc.), TĀr.; <div n="vp"/> (aor. 3. pl. -क्रमुः [cf. Pāṇ. vi, 1, 116]; pr. p. क्रा/मत्) <div n="to"/>to tread down, overcome, RV. vi, 75, 7 and vii, 32, 27; VS.; AV.; ŚBr.; <div n="to"/>to descend (into a womb), Buddh.; Jain. : <div n="vp"/>Caus. (p. -क्रमयत्) to cause to go down, KātyŚr.

अवक्री.en: अव-√ क्री only Ā. -क्रिणीते (Pāṇ. i, 3, 18; but also P. Pot. -क्रीणीयात्, BṛĀrUp., [अप-क्रीणीयात्, ŚBr. xiv]; ind.p. -क्रीय, ŚāṅkhŚr.) to purchase for one's self hire, bribe.

अवक्षि.en: अव-√ क्षि (Pot. -क्षिणुयात्) to remove, Lāṭy.; Kauś. : <div n="vp"/>Pass. -क्षीयते, to waste away, L.

अवक्षय.en: अव-क्षय m. destruction, waste, loss, L.

अवखण्डन.en: अव-खण्डन n. breaking into pieces, Kād. · destroying Comm. on BṛĀrUp.…

अवगम्.en: अव-√ गम् -गच्छति (Subj. -ग/च्छात्; ind.p. -ग/त्य, RV. vi, 75, 5; Ved. Inf. अ/वगन्तोस्, TS.) <div n="to"/>to go down, descend to (acc. or loc.), RV.; AV.; <div n="to"/> (with acc.) to come to, visit, approach, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; <div n="to"/>to reach, obtain, TS.; AitBr.; <div n="to"/>to get power or influence, TS.; <div n="to"/>to go near, undertake, MBh. v, 740; <div n="to"/>to hit upon, think of, conceive, learn, know, understand, anticipate, assure one's self, be convinced; <div n="to"/>to recognize, consider, believe any one (acc.) to be (acc.), MBh. iii, 2483, &c. : <div n="vp"/>Caus. P. (3. pl. -गमयन्ति; Imper. 2. sg. -गमय) <div n="to"/>to bring near, procure, AV. iii, 3, 6; TS.; <div n="to"/>to cause to know, teach, Mālav. &c.

अवगत.en: अव-गत mfn. conceived, known, learnt, understood, comprehended · assented to, promised, L.…

अवगति.en: अव-गति f. conceiving, guessing, anticipating, Sāh.

अवगम.en: अव-गम m. understanding, comprehension, intelligence, Bhag. ix, 2, &c.

अवगमन.en: अव-गमन n. the making known, proclamation, L.<listinfo n="sup"/> · attachment, devotion, Kauś.…

अवगा.en: अव-√ गा (aor. Subj. -गत्) to pass away, be wanting, AV. xii, 3, 46, (aor. 2. sg. -गा/स्, 3. sg. avAgAt) to go to, join with (instr.), RV. i, 174, 4; <div n="vp"/> (acc.), KātyŚr.

अवगाह.en: अव-गाह m. plunging, bathing · a bucket, L.…

अवग्रह.en: अव-ग्रह m. separation of the component parts of a compound, or of the stem and certain suffixes and terminations (occurring in the फद text of the Vएदs), Prāt. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · the mark or the interval of such a separation, Prāt.… · the syllable or letter after which the separation occurs, VPrāt.; Pāṇ. viii, 4, 26, the chief member of a word so separated, Prāt.… · obstacle, impediment, restraint, PBr. &c.… · mark of the elision of an initial अ… · (= वर्ष प्रतिबन्ध, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 51) drought, Ragh.; Kathās.… · nature, original temperament, L.… · ‘perception with the senses’, a form of knowledge, Jain.… · an imprecation or term of abuse, L.… · an elephant's forehead, L.… · a herd of elephants, L.… · an iron hook with which elephants are driven, L.…

अवघात.en: अव-घात &c. See अव-√ हन्. · अव-घात m. a blow, Sāh. &c.… · threshing corn by bruising it with a wooden pestle in a mortar of the same material, Jaim.; Kathās. &c.… · (for अव घट्ट, q.v.) a hole in the ground, L.…

अवचन.en: अ-वचन n. absence of a special assertion, KātyŚr. &c. · अ-वचन mfn. not expressing anything, Jaim.… · not speaking, silent, Śak.…

अवचनीय.en: अ-वचनीय mfn. not to be spoken, improper, Mn. viii, 269.

अवच्छिन्न.en: अव-च्छिन्न mfn. separated, detached, Lāṭy. &c. · (in logic) predicated (i.e. separated from everything else by the properties predicated), distinguished, particularised, Sarvad. &c.…

अवच्छेद.en: अव-च्छेद m. anything cut off (as from clothes), ĀśvŚr. · part, portion (as of a recitation), ib.… · separation, discrimination… · (in logic) distinction, particularising, determining… · a predicate (the property of a thing by which it is distinguished from everything else).…

अवज्ञा.en: 1. अव-√ ज्ञा -जानाति (ind.p. -ज्ञाय; perf. Pass. -जज्ञे, Bhaṭṭ.) <div n="to"/>to disesteem, have a low opinion of, despise, treat with contempt, MBh. &c.; <div n="to"/>to excel, Kāvyād. · 2. अव-ज्ञा f. contempt, disesteem, disrespect (with loc. or gen.)…

अवज्ञान.en: अव-ज्ञान n. (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 55) = 2. अव-ज्ञा, Ragh. i, 79; Hit.

अवत.en: / m. a well, cistern, RV. (cf. अवत्क/.) · / See above s.v. अवट/.…

अवतर.en: अव-तर m. descent, entrance, Śiś. i, 43 · opportunity, Naiṣ.…

अवतार.en: अव-तार m.
