अशुश्रूषु.en: अ-शुश्रूषु mfn. not desirous of hearing or learning, GopBr.; Bhag.; Hariv. · disobedient towards (gen.), MBh. xii, 8405.…

अशुष्क.en: अ-शुष्क mf(आ)n. not dry, moist, fresh, ŚāṅkhŚr.; Gobh.; Mn. xi, 64.

अशून्य.en: अ-शून्य mf(आ)n. not empty, KātyŚr. &c. · not vain or useless, Rājat.…

अशेष.en: अ-शेष mf(आ)n. without remainder, entire, perfect, all · अ-शेष m. non-remainder, KātyŚr.…

अशेषम्.en: अ-शेषम् ind. entirely, wholly, Kum. v, 82

अशोक.en: 1. अ-शोक mf(आ)n. (√ 1. शुच्), not causing sorrow N.; Lalit. · not feeling sorrow, Nalod.… · अ-शोक m. the tree Jonesia Asoka Roxb. (a tree of moderate size belonging to the leguminous class with magnificent red flowers), MBh. &c.… · N. of a minister of king धśअरत्ह, R. i, 7, 3… · of a well-known king (in फ्āṭअलिपुत्र), MBh.; Buddh. &c.… · अ-शोक n. the blossom of the आśओक plant, Vikr., (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 3, 166; Siddh.)… · quicksilver, L.… · 2. अ/-शोक mfn. (√ 3. शुच्), without heat, ŚBr. xiv.…

अशोच्य.en: अ-शोच्य mfn. id., MBh. &c. · अ-शोच्य n. impers. id., Hariv. 6062.…

अश्न.en: 1. अ/श्न mfn. (√ 2. अश्), voracious [RV. i, 164, 1 and 173, 2] See अ/शन् at end · अ/श्न (अस्), m. N. of a demon, RV. ii, 14, 5; 20, 5; vi, 4, 3.… · 2. अश्न m. (cf. अ/शन्), a stone, RV. viii, 2, 2… · a cloud, Naigh.…

अश्नत्.en: अश्न/त् mfn. eating, consuming, RV. vii, 67, 7 & viii, 5, 31 &c.; (cf. अ/न्-अश्नत्.)

अश्मन्.en: 1. अश्मन् m. an eater, AV. xviii, 4, 54. · 2. अ/श्मन् m. (once अश्म/न्, ŚBr. iii), a stone, rock, RV. &c.… · a precious stone, RV. v, 47, 3; ŚBr. vi… · any instrument made of stone (as a hammer &c.), RV. &c.… · thunderbolt, RV. &c.… · a cloud, Naigh.… · the firmament, RV. v, 30, 8; 56, 4; vii, 88, 2… · [cf. Zd. asman; Pers. aṣmān; Lith. akmů; Slav. kamy].…

अश्म.en: 1. अश्म ifc. for 2. अ/श्मन्, a stone, Pāṇ. v, 4, 94. · 2. अश्म (in comp. for 2. अ/श्मन्).…

अश्मक.en: m. (g. fSyAdi, q.v.) N. of a son of Vअसिṣṭह and ंअदयन्त्ī, MBh.; VP. · N. of a warrior tribe, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 173; R. &c. (cf. अवन्त्य्-अश्मकास्)…

अश्मादि.en: aSmAdi a g. of Pāṇ. iv, 2, 80.

अश्र.en: 1. अश्र ifc. for अ/श्रि (q.v.) e.g. चतुरश्र, त्र्य्-अश्र, qq.vv. · 2. अश्र for अस्र (a tear, blood) q.v.…

अश्रद्दधान.en: अ/-श्रद्दधान mfn. (p. Ā. श्रद्√ धा), not trusting in (gen. Bhag. ix, 3), unbelieving, ŚBr. xii; MBh. &c.

अश्रद्ध.en: अ-श्रद्ध/ mfn. (fr. श्रद्धा/) id., RV. vii, 6, 3; AV. xii, 2, 51

अश्रद्धा.en: अ/-श्रद्धा f. want of trust, unbelief, VS.; AV.; ŚBr.; Mn.

अश्रम.en: अ-श्रम/ mfn. indefatigable, RV. vii, 69, 7 · id., RV. vi, 21, 12…

अश्रमण.en: अ-श्रमण/ mfn. indefatigable, RV. x, 94, 11 · अ/-श्रमण m. not an ascetic, ŚBr. xiv.…

अश्रान्त.en: अ/-श्रान्त mfn. unwearied, RV. x, 62, 11; AV. xix, 25, 1; Kathās.<listinfo n="sup"/> · eternal, continual, L.… · अ/-श्रान्त (अम्), n. unweariedly, Uttarar.…

अश्रवणात्.en: अ-श्रवणात् ind. abl. on account of not hearing i.e. not seeing anything declared in the sacred texts, Lāṭy.

अश्रि.en: अ/श्रि f. the sharp side of anything, corner, angle (of a room or house), edge (of a sword), ŚBr.; KātyŚr. · often ifc., e.g. azwASri, त्रिर्-अ/श्रि, च/तुर्-अश्रि, SatASri, q.v. (cf. अश्र);… · [cf. Lat. acies, acer; Lith. assmů].…

अश्री.en: 1. अश्री f. = अ/श्रि, ṢaḍvBr. · 2. अ-श्री f. ill-luck (personified as a goddess), Kathās.…

अश्रु.en: अ/श्रु n. (उस् m. only once, ŚBr. vi and once, R.) a tear, RV. x, 95, 12 and 13; AV. &c. with √ मुच्, or √ कृ [MBh. xii, 12491] or √ वृत्, Caus. [R.] to shed tears · [supposed to stand for दश्रु fr. √ दंश्: cf. Gk. δάκρυ; Lat. lacryma for dacryma; Goth. tagrs; Eng. tear; Mod. Germ. Zähre].…

अश्रुपात.en: अश्रु—पात m. = -निपात, q.v., MBh. xiv, 1638; Sāh. · N. of a particular part of a horse's head, VarBṛS.…

अश्रुत.en: अ/-श्रुत mfn. unheard, ŚBr. xiv, &c. · not heard from the teacher, not taught, Jaim.… · (hence) contrary to the Vएदs, L.… · untaught, not learned, MBh. v, 1000 and 1369… · अ/-श्रुत m. N. of a son of ख्ṛṣṇअ, Hariv. 6190… · of a son of ध्युतिमत्, VP.…

अश्रुता.en: अ/-श्रुता f. N. of the wife of आṅगिरस्, Kathās.

अश्रुति.en: अ/-श्रुति f. oblivion, ŚBr. xiii; R. · not a Vedic text, KātyŚr.…

अश्रेयस्क.en: अ-श्रेयस्क mfn. fatal, noxious, MBh. iii, 75.

अश्रोतृ.en: अ-श्रोतृ/ mfn. one who does not hear, ChUp.; MaitrUp.

अश्रोत्र.en: अ-श्रोत्र/ mfn. without ears, ŚBr. xiv.

अश्रोत्रिय.en: अ/-श्रोत्रिय mfn. not versed in the Vएद, Kāṭh.; ŚBr. &c. · performed by <ns>Brāhmans</ns> who are not versed in the Vएद, Pañcat.…

अश्व.en: 1. अ/श्व m. (2. rarely 3 RV.) (√ 1. अश्, Uṇ.) ifc. f. a horse, stallion, RV. &c. · the horse (in the game of chess)… · the number ‘seven’ (that being the number of the horses of the sun)… · the archer (in the Zodiac), VarBṛ.… · a particular kind of lover (horse-like in strength), L.… · N. of a teacher (with the patron. श्āमुद्रि), ŚBr. xiii… · of a son of छित्रक, Hariv. 1921… · of a ध्āनव, MBh. i, 2532… · [Zd. aspa; Lat. equus; Gk. ἵππος, &c.]… · 2. अश्व Nom. P. अश्वति, to behave like a horse, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 11, Sch.…

अश्वा.en: अ/श्वा f. (g. ajAdi, q.v.) a mare, RV. &c.

अश्वतर.en: अश्व—तर/ See below s.v. · / m. (Pāṇ. v, 3, 91) a mule, AV. iv, 4, 8; ŚBr. &c.… · (compar. of अश्व) a better horse, Pat.… · a male calf, L.… · one of the chiefs of the ङ्āगs, MBh.; Hariv. &c.… · N. of a घन्द्हर्व, L.…

अश्वत्थ.en: अश्व—त्थ See ss.vv. below. · / m. (त्थ = स्थ ‘under which horses stand’) the holy fig tree, Ficus Religiosa, AV.; ŚBr. &c.… · a vessel made of its wood, RV. i, 135, 8; x, 97, 5… · the upper (or male) अरणि made of its wood, AV. vi, 11, 1; ŚBr. xi; KātyŚr.… · the plant Thespesia Populneoides, L.… · N. of a ङक्ṣअत्र (also called Śरोṇā), Pāṇ. iv, 2, 5 and 22… · a N. of the sun, MBh. iii, 151… · N. of a people, VarBṛS.… · mfn. ‘relating to the ङक्ṣअत्र आśवत्त्ह’, (with मुहूर्त) the moment in which the moon enters that ङक्ṣअत्र, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 5, Sch.…

अश्वत्थामन्.en: अश्व—त्थामन् See ss.vv. below. · mfn. id., Pāṇ. iv, 1, 85; Siddh.… · m. N. of a son of ध्रोṇअ, MBh.… · of one of the seven Ṛṣइs of the period of ंअनु श्āवर्ṇइ, Hariv. 453.…

अश्वप.en: अश्व—प/ m. a groom, VS. xxx, 11.

अश्वपति.en: अ/श्व—पति m. lord of horses, RV. viii, 21, 3 (voc.; said of ईन्द्र), VS. xvi, 24 · N. of a खइकेय, ŚBr. x… · of a brother-in-law of धśअरत्ह, R. ii, 1, 2… · of an आसुर, MBh.; Hariv.… · of a king of Madras and father of श्āवित्री, MBh.…

अश्वपाल.en: अश्व—पाल m. (f(ई). g. रेवत्य्-अदि, q.v.) a groom, Ratnāv. · one who has to guard the sacrificial horse, ŚāṅkhŚr.…

अश्वमहिष.en: अश्व—महिष n. sg. a h˚ and a buffalo, ib. ii, 4, 9, Kāś.

अश्वमेध.en: 1. अश्व—मेध/ m. the horse-sacrifice (a celebrated ceremony, the antiquity of which reaches back to the Vedic period; the hymns, RV. i, 162 and 163 [= VS. xxii seqq.], referring to it, are however of comparatively late origin; in later times its efficacy was so exaggerated, that a hundred such sacrifices entitled the sacrificer to displace ईन्द्र from the dominion of श्वर्ग; kings who engaged in it spent enormous sums in gifts to the <ns>Brāhmans</ns>; it is said that the horse was sometimes not immolated, but kept bound during the ceremony), VS. xviii, 22; TS.; Ragh. &c., (cf. arkASvameDa/) · 2. अ/श्व—मेध (अ/श्व-), m. N. of a descendant of भ्हरत, RV. v, 27, 4-6.…

अश्वमेधत्व.en: अश्व—मेध—त्व/ n. the state of an आśव-मेद्ह, ŚBr. x

अश्वराज.en: अश्व—राज m. ‘king of horses’, N. of the horse ऊच्चइḥ-śरवस् (q.v.), MBh. i, 1097 · N. of Śāक्यमुनि, Lalit.…

अश्ववृष.en: अश्व—वृष/ m. a stallion, ŚBr. xiv.

अश्वादि.en: aSvAdi two गṇअs of Pāṇ. iv, 1, 110 and v, 1, 39.

अश्वारूढ.en: aSvArUQa mfn. mounted, sitting on horseback, Kathās.

अश्वतरी.en: / f. a she-mule, AV. viii, 8, 22; MBh. &c.

अश्वतराश्व.en: aSvatarASva m. N. of a man Comm. on ChUp. (cf. ASvatarASva.)

अश्वतरीरथ.en: अश्वतरी-रथ m. a car drawn by a she-mule, AitBr.; ChUp.; KātyŚr.

अश्वत्था.en: f. day of full moon in the month Āśविन (in which month the fruit of the Ficus Religiosa generally becomes ripe)

अश्वल.en: / m. N. of the ःओत्ṛ-priest of झनक king of Vअइदेह, ŚBr. xiv (cf. आश्वलायन.)

अश्वस्य.en: Nom. P. ˚स्यति, to wish for the stallion, Pāṇ. vii, 1, 51.

अश्विन्.en: अश्वि/न् mfn. possessed of horses, consisting of horses, RV. · mounted on horseback, MārkP.… · अश्वि/न् (ई/), m. a cavalier… · horse-tamer, RV.… · अश्वि/न् (इ/ना or इनौ), m. du. ‘the two charioteers’, N. of two divinities (who appear in the sky before the dawn in a golden carriage drawn by horses or birds; they bring treasures to men and avert misfortune and sickness; they are considered as the physicians of heaven), RV. &c.… · a N. of the ङक्ṣअत्र presided over by the आśविन्s, VarBṛS.… · the number, ‘two’, ib.; Sūryas.… · (for अश्वि-सुतौ) the two sons of the आśविन्s, viz. ङकुल and शहदेव, MBh. v, 1816… · अश्वि/न् (इ/), n. (= अश्व-वत् n. q.v.) richness in horses, RV. i, 53, 4.…

अश्व्य.en: 1. अ/श्व्य mfn. (3, rarely 2) (g. apUpAdi, q.v.) belonging to or coming from horses, RV.; ŚBr. xiv · consisting of horses, RV.… · अ/श्व्य n. a number of horses, possession of horses, RV.… · 2. अश्व्य/ अस्, m. (3) ‘son of आśव’, N. of Vअśअ, RV. i, 112, 10; viii, 46, 21 and 33… · N. of another man, RV. viii, 24, 14…

अष्ट.en: 1. अष्ट mfn. (√ अक्ष्; cf. निर्-√ अक्ष्) ‘marked, branded’, only in comp. with -कर्ण · 2. अष्ट fr. √ 1. अश्. See अ/-समष्ट-क्˚.… · 3. अष्ट (in comp. for अष्टन्).… · 4. अष्ट अष्ट or अष्टा with the final अ,आ blended in comp.…

अष्टत्व.en: अष्ट—त्व n. condition of eight, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 84, Sch.

अष्टधा.en: अष्ट—धा/ ind. (Pāṇ. v, 3, 42 seq.) eight-fold, in eight parts or sections, AV. xiii, 3, 19; VS. &c.

अष्टाचत्वारिंश.en: अष्टा—चत्वारिंश/ mfn. the forty-eighth, VS.; ŚBr. · consisting of forty-eight verses, N. of a श्तोम.…

अष्टादश.en: अष्टा—दश/ mfn. the eighteenth, VS.; ŚBr. · connected with an eighteen fold श्तोम, PBr.… · अष्टा—दश (in comp.) for ˚शन्)…

अष्टाक्षर.en: azwA/kzara mf(आ)n. containing eight syllables, VS.; AitBr.; ŚBr. · azwA/kzara m. N. of an author.…

अष्टाध्यायी.en: azwADyAyI f. ‘a collection of eight books or chapters’, N. of ŚBr. xi · also of फ्āṇइनि's grammar.…

अष्टक.en: अ/ष्टक mf(आ or इका)n. (Śulb.; cf. Pāṇ. vii, 3, 45 Comm.) consisting of eight parts, ŚBr.; RPrāt. &c. · one who is acquainted with the eight books of फ्āṇइनि's grammar, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 65, Sch.… · अ/ष्टक m. N. of a son of Vइśव्āमित्र (author of the hymn, RV. x, 104), AitBr.; ĀśvŚr.; MBh. &c.… · अ/ष्टक n. a whole consisting of eight parts (as each of the eight आṣṭअकs of the RV., or as, TS. i, or as फ्āṇइनि's grammar &c.)…

अष्टम.en: / mf(ई/)n. the eighth, RV. ii, 5, 2; x, 114, 9; AV. &c.; · / (अस्), m. (Pāṇ. v, 3, 51 seq.) the eighth part, Mn. x, 120… · / mfn. forming the eighth part of (gen.), Gaut.; Śulb.…

अष्टमी.en: (ई), f. (i.e. रात्रि) the eighth day (night) in a half-month, ĀśvGṛ.; Mn. iv, 128, &c.

अष्टि.en: 1. अष्टि f. N. of a metre consisting of sixty-four syllables (like that in RV. ii, 22, 1; RPrāt.) · the number, ‘sixteen’, Sūryas.… · 2. अष्टि f. (√ 1. अश्), reaching, AV. vi, 54, 1 (cf. जर/द्-अष्टि, व्य/ष्टि, स/मष्टि.)… · 3. अष्टि f. (= अस्थि, q.v.) the kernel or stone of a fruit, BhP.…

अष्ठी.en: f. the bone of the knee or elbow, L.

अष्ट्रा.en: अ/ष्ट्रा f. a prick or goad for driving cattle (regarded as the badge of the agriculturist, Kauś.), RV.; · [Zd. astrā; Lith. akstinas.]…

अस्.en: 1. अस् cl. 2. P. अ/स्ति (2. sg. अ/सि, 1. sg. अ/स्मि; pl. स्म/सि or स्म/स्, स्थ/, स/न्ति; (rarely Ā., e.g. 1. pl. स्महे, MBh. xiii, 13); Subj. अ/सत्; Imper. अस्तु, 2. sg. एधि (fr. अस्-धि cf. Pāṇ. vi, 4, 119); Pot. स्या/त्; impf. आ/सीत्, rarely आस् [only in RV. x; cf. Pāṇ. vii, 3, 97] <pb n="117,2"/>; perf. 1. and 3. sg., आ/स, 2. sg. आ/सिथ, 3. pl. आसु/ः; p. m. स/त् f. सती/) <div n="to"/>to be, live, exist, be present; <div n="to"/>to take place, happen; <div n="to"/>to abide, dwell, stay; <div n="to"/>to belong to (gen. or dat.); <div n="to"/>to fall to the share of, happen to any one (gen.); <div n="to"/>to be equal to (dat.), ŚBr. xiv; Mn. xi, 85; <div n="to"/>to turn out, tend towards any result, prove (with dat.); <div n="to"/>to become, BṛĀrUp. &c., (cf. Pāṇ. v, 4, 51-55); <div n="to"/>…

असन.en: 1. अ/सन n. (√ 2. अस्), throwing, sending, a shot, RV. i, 112, 21; 130, 4; AV. · अ/सन mfn. one who throws or discharges, L.… · 2. असन m. the tree Terminalia Tomentosa, Jain.; Suśr.… · (cf. 3. अशन.)…

असना.en: अ/सना (आ), f. a missile, an arrow, RV.

अस.en: अ-स (Pāṇ. vi, 1, 132) not he, Śiś. i, 69 (cf. अ-तद्.)

असंयत.en: अ/-संयत mfn. not kept together, TS. v · not shut (as a door), R. ii, 71, 34… · unbridled, MBh. xiii, 2261… · recited inattentively, Up.…

असंयतात्मन्.en: asaMyatAtman mfn. having the soul uncontrolled.

असंयुक्त.en: अ-संयुक्त mfn. unconnected, Jaim. · uncombined (as vowels in hiatus), RPrāt.…

असंयोग.en: अ-संयोग m. absence of union or connection, Jaim. · for अ-संत्याग, q.v., MBh. xii, 2797… · not a conjunct consonant, Pāṇ. i, 2, 5; iv, 1, 54… · अ-संयोग mfn. one with whom intercourse is forbidden, Āp.…

असंवृत.en: अ/-संवृत mfn. uncovered, unconcealed, ŚBr. xiv · bare (as the ground), R.… · अ/-संवृत n. N. of a hell, Mn. iv, 81.… · अ/-संवृत See अ-संवर.…

असंविदान.en: अ/-संविदान mfn. not agreeing together, ŚBr. x (ChUp.)

असंव्यवहार्य.en: अ-संव्यवहार्य mfn. with whom intercourse is forbidden, Kām.

असंशय.en: अ-संशय m. absence of doubt, certainty, R. v, 23, 25

असंशयम्.en: अ-संशयम् ind. without doubt, Mn.; N. &c.

असंश्लेष.en: अ-संश्लेष m. non-contact Comm. on BṛĀrUp.

असंस्कार.en: अ-संस्कार m. non-consecration, PārGṛ. · want of embellishment or care, natural state, Śak.; Kād.…

असंस्कार्य.en: अ-संस्कार्य mfn. not worthy to receive a शṃस्क्āर (q.v.), Mn. x, 68.

असंस्कृत.en: अ-संस्कृत mfn. not prepared, ŚāṅkhGṛ. · not consecrated, Mn.; Yājñ.… · unadorned, Pañcat.… · unpolished, rude (as speech).…

असंस्थित.en: अ/-संस्थित mfn. not being fixed, moving continually, AitBr.; ŚBr. · not arrayed in one place, not collected, scattered, Kām.; Hit.… · unaccomplished, AV. vi, 50, 2; ŚBr.; AitBr.…

असंहत.en: अ-संहत mfn. not coagulated (as blood), Suśr. · not formed into a ball (as faeces), Bhpr.… · unconnected, BhP.… · having no acquaintances or relations, not living in common, MBh. xiii, 5207… · disagreeing, disunited, Pañcat.… · अ-संहत m. a form of array (loose or open order of troops), Kām.…

असकृत्.en: अ-सकृत् ind. not (only) once, often, repeatedly, ChUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c. · with संवत्सरस्य, oftener than once a year, PārGṛ.…

असकौ.en: / m. f. = असौ/ (see s.v. अद/स्), only used in connection with यक/ः and यका/ (for य/ः and या/), VS. xxiii, 22 and 23 (cf. Pāṇ. vii, 2, 107.)

असक्त.en: अ-सक्त mfn. not stopped or intercepted by or at (loc.; said of arrows and of a sword), MBh. iii, 1602; xiv, 2189<listinfo n="sup"/> · (in the same sense अ-सङ्ग, Ragh. iii, 63)… · free from ties, independent, Sāṅkhyak.… · detached from worldly feelings or passions, unattached or indifferent to (loc.), Mn. ii, 13; Ragh. &c.… · eternal, continual, L.…

असक्तम्.en: अ-सक्तम् ind. without obstacle or resistance, Hariv. 9741; R. iii, 75, 6 · uninterruptedly, Kir. iv, 31; Kām.… · immediately, at once, Daś.…

असक्ति.en: अ-सक्ति f. the being detached from worldly feelings or passions, Bhag. xiii, 9.

असंख्य.en: अ-संख्य mf(आ)n. innumerable, exceedingly numerous, Mn.; Suśr. &c.

असङ्ग.en: अ/-सङ्ग or अ-सङ्ग/ mfn. free from ties, independent, ŚBr. xiv (BṛĀrUp.), NṛsUp. · moving without obstacle (as a cart, a vessel, a flag, &c.), MBh. ii, 944; Hariv. &c.… · having no attachment or inclination for or interest in… · (see also s.v. अ-सक्त)… · अ/-सङ्ग (अस्), m. non-attachment, non-inclination, Mn. vi, 75; Bh.… · N. of a son of ञुयुद्ह्āन, Hariv. 9207; VP.… · a N. of Vअसुबन्द्हु, Buddh.…

असङ्गेन.en: अ/-सङ्गेन ind. instr. ‘non-impediment’, generally without obstacle, Hariv. 10187; R.

असत्.en: अ/-सत् mf(अ/-सती)n. [in RV. seven times अ/सत् and five times आ/सत् with lengthening of the accentuated vowel] not being, not existing, unreal, RV. vii, 134, 8; AV.; Up.; Kum. iv, 12 · untrue, wrong, RV.… · bad, ŚBr.; Mn. &c.… · अ/-सत् (न्), m. ईन्द्र, L.… · अ/-सत् (त्), n. nonexistence, nonentity, RV.; AV. &c.… · untruth, falsehood, RV. vii, 104, 8… · evil, Ragh. i, 10… · अ/-सत् (न्तस्), m. pl. bad or contemptible men, MBh. &c.…

असती.en: अ/-सती (ती), f. See s.v. below · f. an unfaithful or unchaste wife, MBh.; R. &c.…

असत्कार्य.en: अ-सत्—कार्य n. bad or illicit occupation, Mn. xii, 32

असत्कृत.en: अ-सत्—कृत mfn. badly treated, MBh. iii, 2755 and 2918 · अ-सत्—कृत n. offence, ib. 2981.…

असत्त्व.en: 1. अ-सत्—त्व n. id., NṛsUp. · non-presence, absence, Nyāyam.… · 2. अ-सत्त्व mfn. strengthless, without energy, R.…

असत्य.en: अ-सत्य/ mfn. untrue, false, lying, RV. iv, 5, 5; MBh. &c. · अ-सत्य/ (अम्), n. untruth, falsehood, Mn. &c.…

असद्ग्राह.en: असद्—ग्राह mfn. = -ग्रह mfn., Hariv. 15479; R.; BhP. · असद्—ग्राह m. = -ग्रह m., ib.…

असद्भाव.en: असद्—भाव m. nonexistence, absence, Vedāntas. &c. · an evil temperament or disposition, L.…

असन्.en: 1. असन् (in comp. for असत्). · 2. अस/न् n. Ved. the base of some cases (viz. instr. अस्ना/ gen. abl. अस्न/स् gen. pl. अस्ना/म्) of अ/सृज्, q.v., AV.; VS.; MaitrS. &c.…

असनाम.en: अ-सनाम mf(आ)n. not having the same name, MBh.

असपत्न.en: अ/-सपत्न m. not a rival, AV. i, 19, 4 · अ-सपत्न/ mf(आ/)n. (chiefly Ved.) without a rival or adversary, undisturbed, RV. x, 159, 4 & 5; 174, 4 & 5; AV. &c.… · अ-सपत्न/ (अ/म्), n. undisturbed condition, peace, AV.…

असभ्य.en: अ-सभ्य mfn. unfit for an assembly, vulgar, low, Nir.; BhP. &c.

असम.en: अ-सम mfn. uneven, unequal (either by birth or in surface or number), Mn. x, 73; Kir. v, 7, &c. · odd… · अ/-सम mf(आ)n. unequalled, without a fellow or equal, RV.; AV. &c.…

असमान.en: अ/-समान mf(आ)n. unequal (by birth or in qualities), different, VS. v, 23, &c. · incomparable, Daś.… · अ/-समान n. not a similar or corresponding condition, Mṛcch.… · अ/-समान See ib.…

असमञ्ज.en: अ-समञ्ज, अस्, or असमञ्जस्, आस्, m. N. of a descendant of ईक्ṣव्āकु (a son of शगर by खेśइन्ī and father of आṃśउमत्), MBh.; Hariv. &c.

असमञ्जस.en: अ-समञ्जस mfn. unfit, unbecoming, MBh. &c. · अ-समञ्जस m. a good-for-nothing fellow, BhP.… · अ-समञ्जस n. unconformity, impropriety, unbecomingness, BhP.; Pañcat. &c.…

असमर्थ.en: अ-समर्थ mf(आ)n. unable to (Inf. dat. loc., or in comp.) · not having the intended meaning, Kpr.…

असमर्पित.en: अ-समर्पित mfn. unconsigned, not intrusted · undelivered.…

असमस्त.en: अ-समस्त mfn. uncompounded, Kāvyād. &c. · uncollected, L.… · incomplete, L.…

असंमूढ.en: अ-संमूढ mfn. not confused, deliberate, MBh.

असंमोह.en: अ-संमोह m. calmness, composure, deliberateness, R.; Suśr.

असरूप.en: अ-सरूप mfn. not having the same form, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 94.

असर्व.en: अ/-सर्व mfn. not complete, ŚBr.; AitBr.

असस्य.en: अ-सस्य mf(आ)n. not grown with corn, Hariv.

असह.en: अ-सह mfn. incapable of bearing (or producing young ones), PārGṛ. · not bearing or enduring (ifc. or with gen.), Mudr.; Kathās.… · not able to, not capable of (Inf. or in comp.), Kathās.… · intolerant, impatient, ib.… · अ-सह n. the middle of the breast, L.…

असहिष्णु.en: अ-सहिष्णु mfn. unable to endure (with acc. loc. or ifc.), Suśr.; Rājat. &c. · impatient, unenduring, envious, quarrelsome, Kathās. &c.…

असहिष्णुता.en: अ-सहिष्णु—ता, f. or अ-सहिष्णु—त्व, n. inability to endure, Suśr. &c. <div n="P"/> impatience, envy, Kathās. &c.

असहाय.en: अ-सहाय mfn. without companions, friendless, Mn. vii, 30 and 55; Śārṅg. · solitary (as a house), Pāṇ., Sch.…

असाद.en: अ-साद/ mfn. not mounted on horseback, AV. xi, 10, 24 · not becoming tired, unwearied, Rājat.…

असाधन.en: अ-साधन mfn. without means, destitute of resources or materials or instruments or implements, MBh. &c. · अ-साधन n. not a means, anything not effective of an object, Kap.…

असाधु.en: अ-साधु/ mfn. (Pāṇ. vi, 2, 160) not good, wicked, bad, ŚBr.; MBh. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · wrong Comm. on TPrāt.… · (in rhet.) not grammatically correct (as अन्य-कारक for अन्यत्-क्˚), Vām. ii, 1, 5.… · अ-साधु/ (उ/स्), m. not an honest man, a wicked man, ŚBr.; Mn. &c.… · अ-साधु/ (उ/), n. anything bad, evil, ŚBr. (साध्वसाधु/नी, ‘good and evil’), MBh. &c.… · disfavour, disgrace, only (˚उ/ना instr. ind.) disfavourably, ŚBr. ii; ChUp. (cf. 3. अ-सामन्)… · अ-साधु/ (उ), ind. (used as an interjection of disapproval) bad! shame! Rājat. &c.…

असाधुना.en: अ-साधु/ना ind., instr., disfavourably, ŚBr. ii; ChUp. (cf. 3. अ-सामन्)

असाधुत्व.en: अ-साधु—त्व n. wickedness, Kām. &c. · the not being approvable, VarBṛS.…

असाध्य.en: अ-साध्य mfn. not to be effected or completed, not proper or able to be accomplished, Yājñ. ii, 196; Hariv. &c. · incurable, irremediable, MBh. iv, 395; Suśr. &c.… · not to be overpowered or mastered, Pañcat.; Kām.… · not susceptible of proof Comm. on Yājñ. ii, 6.…

असाधारण.en: अ-साधारण mf(ई)n. not common, special, specifical, Tarkas. · quite uncommon, extraordinary, Daś.; Kathās. &c.… · अ-साधारण n. special property, L.…

असामञ्जस्य.en: अ-सामञ्जस्य n. incorrectness Comm. on Vedāntas. · impropriety, unbecomingness, Bād.…

असाम्ना.en: अ-सा˚म्ना ind. instr. (= अ-साधु/ना s.v. अ-साधु/, q.v.) in an unfriendly way, unfavourably, ChUp.

असामर्थ्य.en: अ-सामर्थ्य n. weakness, Pañcat.; Sarvad. · अ-सामर्थ्य mfn. weak, decaying (as a tree), MBh. xiii, 281.…

असामान्य.en: अ-सामान्य mfn. not common, special, Sāṅkhyak. · uncommon, peculiar, MBh. i, 5308; Kathās. &c.… · special property, L.…

असामि.en: अ/-सामि mfn. not half, entire, complete, RV. · अ/-सामि (इ), ind. completely, RV.…

असार.en: अ-सार mfn. sapless, without strength or value, without vigour, spoiled, unfit, unprofitable, Mn. viii, 203; Suśr. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · (also) faithless, L.… · अ-सार m. ‘worthlessness’, see sArAsAra… · Ricinus Communis (castor-oil tree), L.… · अ-सार n. Aloe wood, L.…

असि.en: / m. (√ 2. अस्), a sword, scimitar, knife (used for killing animals), RV.; AV. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · (also) a shark, alligator, L.… · (इस्), f. N. of a river (near <ns>Benares</ns>), VāmP. (cf. असी);… · [Lat. ensi-s.]…

अस्यसि.en: अस्य्-असि ind. sword against sword, L.

असिक.en: अ-सिक n. the part of the face between the underlip and the chin, L. · अ-सिक m. pl. N. of a people, VarBṛS. (v.l. अशिक).…

असित.en: 1. अ/-सित mfn. unbound, TS. vii; ŚBr. xiv. · 2. अ/सित mf(आ; Ved. अ/सिक्नी)n. (सित, ‘white’, appears to have been formed from this word, which is probably original, and not a compound of अ and सित; cf. असुर and सुर), dark-coloured, black, RV. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/>… · अ/सित m. the planet Saturn, VarBṛS.… · a poisonous animal (said to be a kind of mouse), L.… · N. of the lord of darkness and magic, AV.; ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr.… · of a descendant of खśयप (composer of RV. ix, 5-24), named also धेवल [RAnukr.] or आसित धेवल [MBh.; Hariv.]… · N. of a man (with the patron. Vāर्ṣअगṇअ), ŚBr. xiv… · of a son of भ्हरत, R.… · of a Ṛṣइ, Buddh.… · of a mountain, MBh. iii, 8364; Kathās.… · (अ/स्), a black snake, AV.… · a ंअन्त्र (saving from snakes), MBh. i, 2188… · (also) the dark half of a lunar month, L.…

असिता.en: अ/सिता f. a girl attending in the women's apartments (whose hair is not whitened by age), L. · the indigo plant, L.… · N. of an आप्सरस्, MBh. i, 4819; Hariv. 12472…

असिद्ध.en: अ-सिद्ध mfn. imperfect, incomplete, NṛsUp. : unaccomplished, uneffected · unproved… · (regarded as) not existing or (as) not having taken effect (as a rule or operation taught in grammar), Pāṇ.… · not possessed of magic power.…

असिद्धि.en: अ/-सिद्धि f. imperfect accomplishment, failure, TBr.; Gaut. · (in logic) want of proof, conclusion not warranted by the premises… · (in श्āṅक्ह्य phil.) incompleteness (eight forms of it are enumerated)…

असी.en: f. (= असि f. q.v.) N. of a river (near Benares), MBh. vi, 338.

असु.en: अ/सु m. (√ 1. अस्), Ved. breath, life, RV.; AV. &c. · life of the spiritual world or departed spirits, RV. x, 15, 1… · (in astron.) ‘respiration’, = four seconds of sidereal time or one minute of arc, Sūryas.… · = प्रज्ञा, Naigh.… · (in later language only अ/सवस्) the vital breaths or airs of the body, animal life, AV.; Mn. iii, 217, &c.… · n. grief, L.… · (= चित्त) the spirit, L.…

असुर.en: अ/सुर mfn. (√ 2. अस्, Uṇ.), spiritual, incorporeal, divine, RV.; AV.; VS. · अ/सुर m. a spirit, good spirit, supreme spirit (said of Vअरुṇअ), RV.; VS.… · the chief of the evil spirits, RV. ii, 30, 4 and vii, 99, 5… · an evil spirit, demon, ghost, opponent of the gods, RV. viii, 96, 9… · x; AV. &c. [these आसुरs are often regarded as the children of धिति by खśयप See दैत्य; as such they are demons of the first order in perpetual hostility with the gods, and must not be confounded with the ण्āक्ṣअसs or imps who animate dead bodies and disturb sacrifices]… · a N. of ण्āहु, VarBṛS. &c.… · the sun, L.… · a cloud, Naigh. (cf. RV. v, 83, 6)… · अ/सुर m. pl. N. of a warrior-tribe, (g. पर्श्व्-आदि, q.v.)… · अ/सुर m. of a Vedic school… · अ/सुर [In later Sanskṛt सुर has been formed from असुर, as सित from असित, q.v.]…

असुरा.en: अ/सुरा f. night, L. · a zodiacal sign, L.…

असुरी.en: अ/सुरी f. a female demon, the wife of an आसुर, KauṣBr. (cf. आसुरी and mahAsurI) · the plant Sinapis Ramosa Roxb., L.…

असुरत्व.en: असुर—त्व/ n. spirituality, divine dignity, RV. iii, 55, 1; x, 55, 4 and 99, 2 · the being an आसुर or opponent of the gods, MaitrS.; Kathās.…

असुर्य.en: 1. असुर्य^ mfn. (4) incorporeal, spiritual, divine, RV. · (Pāṇ. iv, 4, 123) demoniacal, belonging or relating to the आसुरs, AitBr.; ŚBr.… · ^ (अ^स्), m. (= अ/सुर m. q.v.) the supreme spirit, RV. ii, 35, 2.… · 2. असुर्य^ n. (3) spirituality, divine nature, RV.… · the incorporeal, the collective body of spiritual beings, RV. [Gmn. accentuates असुर्य/ in accordance with similar cases, as 2. समर्य/ (3) n. compared with 1. समर्य/ (4) mfn.]…

असुख.en: अ-सुख mf(आ)n. unhappy, sorrowful, MBh. &c. · painful, N.… · not easy to (Inf.), Kir. v, 49… · अ-सुख n. sorrow, pain, affliction, Mn.; MBh. &c.…

असुत.en: अ/-सुत mfn. (√ 3. सु), not pressed out, not ready (as the शोम juice), RV.; VS.

असुप्त.en: अ/-सुप्त mfn. not asleep, ŚBr. xiv.

असुरि.en: (prob.) m. (said to be fr. √ 2. अस्) war, battle (= संग्राम), L.

असू.en: अ-सू/ mfn. (√ 3. सू), not bringing forth, barren, RV. & AV. (acc. f. अ-स्व/म्), VS. (acc. f. असू/म्).

असूय.en: 1. असूय Nom. P. ˚यति, rarely Ā. ˚यते (pr. p. ˚य/त्, RV. x, 135, 2; ŚBr.; aor. आसूयीत्, ŚBr. iii; 3. pl. असूयिषुः, Rājat.) <div n="to"/>to murmur at, be displeased or discontented with (dat. [ŚBr.; Pāṇ. i, 4, 37, &c.] or acc. [MBh.; R. &c.]) : <div n="vp"/>Caus. (ind.p. असूययित्वा) to cause to be displeased, irritate, MBh. iii, 2624 (N.) · 2. असूय mfn. grumbling at, displeased with (loc.), MBh. xiii, 513…

असूया.en: f. displeasure, indignation (especially at the merits or the happiness of another), envy, jealousy, Nir.; Āp.; Mn. &c.

असृष्टान्न.en: asfzwAnna mfn. who does not distribute food.

असोम.en: अ-सोम m. not शोमjuice, KātyŚr. · not a शोम sacrifice, ib.… · अ-सोम mfn. without शोम juice, MBh. xiii, 1793.…

असौ.en: / (nom.) and अ/सौ (voc.); See अद/स् and अमु.

असौनामन्.en: <chg type="chg" n="1" src="mw"><old>असौ—ना/मन्</old><new>असौ ना/मन्</new></chg> mfn. having such and such a name, ŚBr. xiv (BṛĀrUp.)

अस्त.en: 1. अस्त mfn. (perf. Pass. p. √ 2. अस्), thrown, cast, Ragh. xii, 91 · (अ/न्- neg.), ŚBr. iii… · (only in comp.) thrown off, left off, set aside, given up (as grief, anger, a vow, &c.), VP.; Kathās. &c.… · 2. अ/स्त n. home, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.… · अ/स्त m. setting (as of the sun or of luminaries), VarBṛS.; Sūryas.… · ‘end, death’, see अस्त-समय below… · the western mountain (behind which the sun is supposed to set), MBh.; R. &c.… · (in astron.) the seventh lunar mansion, VarBṛ.… · अ/स्त m. अस्तम्-√ इ, अस्तं-√ गम् (also Caus. See अस्तं-गमित below), or √ prAp [Kathās.], to go to one's eternal home, cease, vanish, perish, die, ŚBr. xiv; MBh. &c.… · ं-√ नी [-नयति], to lead to setting, cause to set, MBh. iii, 17330…

अस्ता.en: / f. a missile, an arrow, AV. · अ/स्ता ind. v.l. for अ/स्तम्, SV.…

अस्तृ.en: अ/स्तृ mfn. (fut. p.) one who is about or intends to throw, RV. i, 61, 7; x, 133, 3 · अ/स्तृ ता, m. a thrower, shooter, RV.; AV.… · (with अ-प/द्), ŚBr.… · अ/स्तृ See 1. अस्त.…

अस्तम्.en: अ/स्तम् ind. at home, home, RV. &c., especially used with verbs, e.g. अ/स्तम्-√ इ [अ/स्तम् ए/ति; pr. p. अस्तं-य/त्, AV.; ŚBr.; fut. p. अस्तम्-एष्य/त्, AV.; perf. p. अ/स्तमित See below s.v.]; अ/स्तं-√ गम् [अ/स्तम् ग/च्छति, AV. &c.; perf. p. अस्तं-गत, MBh. &c., once in reversed order गत अस्तं, R. i, 33, 21] or अस्तं-√ या [pr. p. -यात्, Mn. iv, 37] to go down, set, RV.; AV. &c.

अस्तमय.en: अस्त—म्-अय/ m. setting (of the sun), ŚBr.; ChUp. &c. · disappearance, vanishing, perishing, KaṭhUp. (said of the senses), Ragh.…

अस्तमित.en: अ/स्त—म्-इत (अ/स्त्˚), set (as the sun), AV. &c. · come to an end, ceased, dead, R.; Ragh. &c.…

अस्तमिते.en: अ/स्त—म्-इते (ए), ind. loc. after sunset, ĀśvGṛ.

अस्तमन.en: n. (a corruption of अस्तम्-अ/यन, q.v.), setting, MBh.; R. &c.

अस्त्य.en: n. (v.l. for अ/स्त) a house, Naigh. · See 2. अ/स्त.…

अस्ति.en: 1. अस्ति ind. (3. sg. pr. √ 1. अस्; g. cAdi and स्वर्-आदि, q.v.) sometimes used as a mere particle at the beginning of fables, Pañcat.; Kathās. · existent, present, L.… · 2. अस्ति f. (अस्-ति = स्-ति, q.v.), N. of a sister of फ्र्āप्ति (daughter of झर्āसन्द्हस् and wife of खṃस), MBh. ii, 595; Hariv. 4955; BhP.…

अस्तिकाय.en: अस्ति—काय m. an ontological category (of which five are distinguished, viz. jIvAstikAya, ajivAst˚, DarmAst˚, aDarmAst˚, pudgalAst˚), Jain.

अस्तिता.en: अस्ति—ता f. existence, reality Comm. on Bād.; Sarvad.

अस्तिनास्ति.en: asti—nAsti ind. partly true and partly not, doubtful, L.

अस्तु.en: (3. sg. Imper.), let it be, be it so<listinfo n="sup"/> · there must be or should be (implying an order).… · existence, reality (= अस्ति-भाव), L.…

अस्तुत.en: अ/-स्तुत mfn. not praised (by a hymn), AitBr. · not recited (as a hymn), ib.… · not liked, not popular, RV. v, 61, 8; 67, 5.…

अस्तुति.en: अ-स्तुति mfn. not praising anybody, MBh. xii.

अस्तुत्य.en: अ-स्तुत्य mfn. not to be praised, Pañcat.

अस्तृत.en: अ/-स्तृत mfn. not overcome, invincible, indestructible, RV.; AV. xix, 46 · (said of the gold), KauṣUp. & ĀśvGṛ. [v.l. अ-स्रुत/, ŚBr. xiv and PārGṛ.]… · mfn. id., AV. i, 20, 4 and v, 9, 7.…

अस्तेन.en: अ/-स्तेन m. not a thief, ŚBr. xiv.

अस्तेय.en: अ-स्तेय n. not stealing, Mn.; Yājñ. &c.

अस्त्र.en: / n. (exceptionally m., Hariv. 10703, &c.), (√ 2. अस्), a missile weapon, bolt, arrow, AV. xi, 10, 16; MuṇḍUp. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · a weapon in general, L.… · a sword, L.… · a bow, L.… · the art of throwing missiles, MBh.… · N. of a ंअन्त्र (pronounced, for instance, before reading a book or while kindling a fire &c.), BhavP. &c.… · N. of the mystical syllable फत्, RāmatUp. [cf. Gk. ἄστρον and ἀστήρ] ‘that which throws out or emits rays of light’ (?)…

अस्त्री.en: अ-स्त्री f. not a woman, MBh. ii, 1694 · (with lexicographers) ‘not feminine’ i.e. the masculine and neuter genders.…

अस्थ.en: only ifc. for अ/स्थि, q.v., e.g. अन्-अस्थ/, ऊरु-अस्थ/, puruzAsTa/, q.v.

अस्थान.en: अ-स्थान n. non-permanency, inconstancy (as of a sound), Jaim.<listinfo n="sup"/> · not a (fit) place for (gen.), Kād.… · impossibility, Divyāv.… · an army which has lost its chief, L.… · अ-स्थान mfn. deep, L.…

अस्थाने.en: अ-स्थाने ind. [PBr.; R. &c.] or in comp. अस्थान- [Megh.; Daś.], in a wrong place · in wrong time, unseasonably, unsuitably, (अ-स्थाने), R.; MārkP. &c.… · (अ-स्थान-), R. iv, 32, 6; Sāh.…

अस्थि.en: अ/स्थि n. (see अस्थ/न्), a bone, AV.; VS. &c. · the kernel of a fruit, Suśr. (cf. 3. अष्टि);… · [Lat. os, ossis assimilated fr. ostis; Gk. ὀστέον]…

अस्थिर.en: अ/-स्थिर mfn. unsteady, trembling, shaking, ŚBr. &c. · not permanent, transient, R.… · uncertain, unascertained, doubtful, Mn. viii, 71; MBh. ii, 1965… · not steady (in character), changeable, not deserving confidence, R. ii, 21, 19; Pañcat.…

अस्थूल.en: अ/-स्थूल mf(आ)n. not gross or bulky, delicate, ŚBr. xiv; Pañcat. &c.

अस्नेह.en: अ-स्नेह/ mfn. without unctuousness, ŚBr. xiv; Yājñ.; Ragh. iv, 75 · without affection, unkind, L.… · अ-स्नेह/ m. want of affection, L.…

अस्पन्द.en: अ-स्पन्द mfn. not quivering or moving, fixed, ऊत्तरs, Rājat. · unvariable (as love), BhP.…

अस्पन्दमान.en: अ/-स्पन्दमान mfn. id. v.l. for अ/-स्यन्द्˚, q.v. · {{Lbody=21527}}…

अस्पर्श.en: अ-स्पर्श/ mfn. not having the faculty of perception by touch, ŚBr. xiv · intangible, Āp.; NṛsUp.… · अ-स्पर्श/ (अस्), m. non-contact with (instr.), MBh. iii, 11087.…

अस्पृष्ट.en: अ-स्पृष्ट mfn. untouched, not brought into contact, BhP.; Kāvyād. · not touched or referred to (as by a word), Kum. vi, 75… · not touched by the organs of articulation (as the vowels, the आनुस्व्āर, and the sibilants), RPrāt.; VPrāt.…

अस्म.en: (fr. अ-स्म), a pronom. base from which some forms (dat. अ/स्मै or अस्मै/, abl. अस्मा/त्, loc. अस्मि/न्) of इद/म् (q.v.) are formed · also the base of the first person plur., acc. अस्मा/न् [= ἡμᾶς], instr. अस्मा/भिस्, dat. अस्म/भ्यम्, abl. अस्म/त्, in later, language also अस्मत्-तस् [MBh. &c.], gen. अस्मा/कम् [exceptionally अस्मा/क, RV. i, 173, 10; AV.], loc. अस्मा/सु.… · dat. loc. अस्मे/ (only RV.; AV.; VS.)…

अस्मद्.en: base of the first person pl., as used in comp. · also by native grammarians considered to be the base of the cases अस्मा/न् &c. (see above).…

अस्माक.en: अस्मा/क mfn. (fr. अस्म + अञ्च्? cf. अ/पाक &c.) our, ours, RV. (cf. आस्माक/.)

अस्मरण.en: अ-स्मरण n. not remembering (with gen.), MBh. iii, 10811, &c.

अस्मृत.en: अ-स्मृत mfn. forgotten, L. · not mentioned in authoritative texts, not traditional Comm. on KātyŚr.…

अस्मृति.en: अ-स्मृति f. non-remembrance, forgetting, KātyŚr.; MBh. · want of memory, forgetfulness, MBh. xiv, 999… · the not being part of the institutes of law, L.… · अ/-स्मृति ind. inattentively, AV. vii, 106, 1.…

अस्र.en: 1. अस्र/ mfn. (√ 2. अस्), throwing, TBr. · / (अम्), n. a tear, Mn.; R. &c. (often spelt अश्र).… · 2. अस्र n. blood, Ragh. xvi, 15 (cf. अ/सृज्.)… · 3. अस्र m. hair of the head, L.…

अस्रवत्.en: अ/-स्रवत् mfn. ‘not flowing’, not leaky (as a ship), RV. x, 63, 10; VS. xxi, 7.

अस्राम.en: अ/-स्राम mf(आ)n. not lame, AV. i, 31, 3 · not withered, Gobh.…

अस्व.en: अ-स्व mfn. having no property, MBh.

अस्वतन्त्र.en: अ-स्व—तन्त्र mf(आ)n. not self-willed, dependant, subject, Mn. ix, 2; Gaut.; BhP.

अस्वता.en: अ-स्व—ता f. the having no property, L.<listinfo n="sup"/> · unselfishness, Bcar. vi, 10.…

अस्वभाव.en: अ-स्व—भाव m. unnatural or unusual character or temperament · अ-स्व—भाव mfn. of a different nature, L.…

अस्वरूप.en: अ-स्व—रूप mfn. essentially different, L. · shapeless (opposed to रूप-वत्), BhP.…

अस्वादु.en: अ-स्वादु mfn. tasteless, AitBr.; MBh. · अ-स्वादु See अ/-स्वदित.…

अस्वन.en: अ-स्वन mfn. not having a clear sound, VarBṛS.

अस्वप्न.en: अ/-स्वप्न m. sleeplessness, ŚBr. iii; ṢaḍvBr. (अम्, n.), VarBṛS. · अ-स्वप्न/ mfn. (= ἄϋπνος) not sleeping, watchful, AV.… · not dreaming, NṛsUp.… · अ-स्वप्न/ m. ‘sleepless’, a god, L.…

अस्वर.en: अ-स्वर mfn. not loud (as the voice), indistinct, R. ii, 42, 26 · having no vowel, Up.; having no accent, APrāt., Sch.… · having a bad or croaking voice, L.…

अस्वरम्.en: अ-स्वर/म् (अ/म्), ind. in low tone, indistinctly, ŚBr. xi.

अस्विन्न.en: अ-स्विन्न mfn. not thoroughly boiled, MārkP. · अ-स्विन्न n. non-application of sudorifics, Suśr.…

अह्.en: 1. अह् (defect. verb, only perf. 3. sg. आ/ह and 3. pl. आहु/ः, RV.; AV. &c., 2. sg. आत्थ, ŚBr. xiv (BṛĀrUp.), N.; Ragh. iii, 48 3. du. आहतुः, Pāṇ. viii, 2, 35) <div n="to"/>to say, speak, RV. &c.; <div n="to"/> (with lexicographers) to express, signify; <div n="to"/>to call (by name, नाम्ना), MBh. iii, 16065; <div n="to"/>to call, hold, consider, regard as (with two acc., for one of which may be substituted a phrase with इति), RV. &c.; <div n="to"/>to state or declare with reference to (acc.), BṛĀrUp.; Śak.; Megh.; <div n="to"/>to acknowledge, accept, state, AitBr.; Mn. &c.; <div n="to"/>to adjudge anything (acc.) to any one (gen.), Mn. ix, 44. · [cf. Hib. ag-all, ‘speech’; eigh-im, ‘I call’; Goth. af-aika, ‘I deny’; Lat. nego for n'-ego, ‘to say no’; ad-ag-ium, ajo, &c.]…

अह.en: 1. अ/ह ind. (as a particle implying ascertainment, affirmation, certainty, &c.) surely, certainly, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. · (as explaining, defining) namely, ŚBr.… · (as admitting, limiting, &c.) it is true, I grant, granted, indeed, at least, ŚBr. [For the rules of accentuation necessitated in a phrase by the particle अ/ह cf. Pāṇ. viii, 1, 24 seqq.]… · (also) a particle answering to ह in a preceding sentence (ह — अह = μὲν — δέ), Gaṇar.… · 2. अ/ह n. (only Ved.; nom. pl. अ/हा, RV.; AV.; gen. pl. अ/हानाम्, RV. viii, 22, 13) = अ/हर्, q.v., a day<listinfo n="sup"/>… · often ifc. m(अह/). (e.g. dvAdaSAha/, त्र्य्-अह/, षड्-अह/, &c.) or n. (e.g. puRyAha/, BadrAha/, and sudinAha)… · See also अह्न s.v.…

अहकम्.en: See अह/म्. · dimin. for अह/म्, ‘I’, Pāṇ. i, 1, 29; Pat.…

अहत.en: अ/-हत mfn. unhurt, uninjured, AV. xii, 1, 11; VS. · not beaten (as a drum), AdbhBr.… · unbeaten (as clothes in washing), unwashed, new, ŚBr. &c.… · unblemished, unsoiled, BhP.… · अ/-हत n. unwashed or new clothes.…

अहति.en: अ/-हति f. = अहत-ता, q.v., RV. ix, 96, 4.

अहन्ति.en: अ/-हन्ति f. id., VS. xvi, 18 [vv.ll. अ/-हन्त्य mfn. ‘indestructible’, TS. iv, and अ/-हन्त्व mfn. id., MaitrS.; Kāṭh.]

अहना.en: / instr. with an earlier form of accentuation for अ/ह्ना. See before.

अहीन.en: , अह्न See ss.vv. · 1. अ/हीन m. (fr. अ/हन्, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 145) ‘lasting several days’, a sacrifice lasting several days, AitBr.; ĀśvŚr. &c.… · अ/हीन n. id. Comm. on Mn. xi, 197… · अ/हीन mfn. only ifc. with numerals (cf. Pāṇ. v, 1, 87 and vi, 4, 145) e.g. त्र्य्-अहीन, द्व्यहीन, qq.vv.… · 2. अ/-हीन mfn. unimpaired, whole, entire, full, ŚBr.; AitBr. &c.… · ‘not deprived of’, not withdrawing from (instr.), Mn. ii, 183… · not defective or inferior, excellent, VarBṛS.; Ragh. xviii, 13… · अ/-हीन m. N. of a prince, VP.…

अह्न.en: See ss.vv. · only (like अह/) ifc. for अ/हन् (or अ/हर्), q.v., e.g. अत्य्-अह्न, aparAhRa/, pUrvAhRa/ &c., qq.vv.…

अहम्.en: अह/म् nom. sg., ‘I’, RV. &c. · = अहंकरण, q.v., (hence declinable gen. अहमस्, &c.), BhP.… · [Zd. azem; Gk. ἐγώ; Goth. ik; Mod. Germ. ich; Lith. asz; Slav. az].…

अहमिन्द्र.en: अहम्—इन्द्र m. N. of a divine being, Dharmaś.

अहंश्रेयस.en: अहं—श्रे/यस n. id., ŚBr. xiv (BṛĀrUp.), KauṣUp.

अहंकार.en: अहं—कार m. conception of one's individuality, self-consciousness, ChUp. &c. · the making of self, thinking of self, egotism, MBh. &c.… · pride, haughtiness, R. &c.… · (in श्āṅक्ह्य phil.) the third of the eight producers or sources of creation, viz. the conceit or conception of individuality, individualization…

अहरागम.en: अहर्—आगम m. the approach of the day, Bhag. viii, 18 seq.

अहरादि.en: अहर्—आदि a गṇअ Comm. on Pāṇ. viii, 2, 70. · अहर्—आदि m. daybreak, Śiś.…

अहर्गण.en: अहर्—गण m. a series of sacrificial days, KātyŚr. &c. · a series of days, BhP.; Jaim.… · any calculated term, L.… · a month, L.…

अहर्जरम्.en: अहर्—जरम् ind. ‘so that the days become old’, by and by, MantraBr.; TUp.

अहस्.en: अ/हस् the base of the middle cases of अ/हर् instr. pl. अ/होभिस् [RV. (twice), VS.; ŚBr. &c.] dat. abl. अ/होभ्यस् [VS. &c.] loc. अ/हस्सु [ŚBr. x; AitBr. &c.] · See ib.…

अहो.en: 1. अहो (instead of अहा [= अ/हर्] in comp. before the letter र्). · 2. अहो ind. a particle (implying joyful or painful surprise) Ah! (of enjoyment or satisfaction) Oh! (of fatigue, discontent, compassion, sorrow, regret) Alas! Ah! (of praise, cf. Pāṇ. viii, 1, 40 seq.) Bravo! (of reproach) Fie! (of calling, Kum. iii, 20) Ho! Halo! (of contempt) Pshaw! Often combined with other particles of similar signification, as अहो धिक् or धिग् अहो, अहो बत, &c.…

अहोरात्र.en: अहो—रात्र/ m. [pl. VS.; du., AV. & PBr.; sg. or pl., MBh. &c.] or n. [pl. RV. x, 190, 2; VS. &c.; du., AV.; VS. &c.; sg. or du. or pl., Mn.; MBh. &c.] = अहर्-निश (q.v.), a day and night, νυχθήμερον, (having twenty-four hours or thirty ंउह्ūर्तs); · अहो-रात्र/ See ib.…

अहोरात्रम्.en: अहो—रात्रम् (अम्), ind. day and night, continually, L.

अहर.en: अ-हर m. N. of an आसुर, MBh. i, 2660 (v.l. सु-हर), Hariv. · of a son of ंअनु, Hariv. 484 (v.l. अ-दूर).…

अहार्य.en: अ-हार्य mfn. not to be stolen, not to be removed, Mn. ix, 189 · unalterable (as a resolution or the mind &c.), MBh. v, 953; Kum. v, 8; Daś. &c.… · not to be bribed, Mn. vii, 217; MBh.… · अ-हार्य m. a mountain, L.… · N. of a king, VP.…

अहि.en: अ/हि m. (√ अंह्), a snake, RV. &c. · the serpent of the sky, the demon Vṛत्र, RV.… · (see also अ/हिर्बुध्न्य/स् below)… · a cloud, Naigh.… · water, ib.… · the sun, L.… · a N. of ण्āहु, L.… · a traveller, L.… · the navel, L.… · lead, L.… · (in arithm.) the number eight… · N. of a Ṛṣइ (with the patron. औशनस) and of another (with the patron. पैद्व).… · [Zd. aži; Lat. angui-s; Gk. ἔχι-ς, ἔχιδνα, ἔγχελυς, and ὄϕις; Lith. ungury-s; Russ. ûgorj; Armen. ôz; Germ. unc.]…

अही.en: / m. (only gen. sg. nom. and acc. pl. अह्य/स्; gen. pl. अही/नाम्) a snake, RV. ix, 77, 3; x, 139, 6 · N. of a demon conquered by ईन्द्र and his companions, RV. x, 138, 1 and 144, 4 (cf. अहीशु/व s.v.)… · / (ई/), f. a cow, Naigh.… · / (ई/), f. du. heaven and earth, Naigh.… · / See ib.…

अहिंसक.en: अ-हिंसक mfn. not hurting, harmless, innocuous, Mn. v, 45; MBh.; R.

अहिंसा.en: अ/-हिंसा f. not injuring anything, harmlessness (one of the cardinal virtues of most <ns>Hindū</ns> sects, but particularly of the <ns>Buddhists</ns> and <ns>Jain</ns>s; also personified as the wife of ध्हर्म, VāmP.), ChUp.; Nir.; Mn. &c. · security, safeness, ŚBr.; AitBr.…

अहिका.en: f. the silk-cotton tree (Salmalia Malabarica), L.

अहित.en: अ/-हित mfn. unfit, improper, RV. viii, 62, 3 · unadvantageous, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Mn. iii, 20, &c.… · noxious, hostile, Kathās.… · अ/-हित m. an enemy, Bhag. ii, 36; Ragh.… · अ/-हित n. damage, disadvantage, evil, Āp.; R. &c.…

अहिता.en: अ/-हिता f. N. of a river, MBh. vi, 328 · N. of certain veins (cf. also हिता/), Yājñ. iii, 108.…

अहुत.en: अ/-हुत mfn. unoffered, not yet offered (as a sacrificial oblation), AV. xii, 4, 53; ŚBr.; Mn. xii, 68 · one who has not received any sacrifice, AV. vii, 97, 7… · (the fire) through or in which no sacrificial oblation has been offered, Āp.… · not obtained by sacrifice, AV. vi, 71, 2… · अ/-हुत m. religious meditation, prayer (considered as one of the five great sacraments, otherwise called भ्रह्म-यज्ñअ), Mn. iii, 73 seq.…

अहुताश.en: a-hutASa m. not a fire, VarBṛS.

अहुर.en: m. the fire in the stomach, MantraBr.; Gobh.

अहृत.en: अ-हृत mfn. not captivated or carried away by (instr.), Ragh. viii, 68.

अहृदय.en: अ/-हृदय mfn. without a heart, ŚBr. xiv.

अहे.en: ind. a particle (implying reproach, rejection, separation, L.), TS. iii (only in a sacrificial formula beginning with अ/हे दैधिषव्य and reoccurring in several other texts).

अहेतु.en: अ-हेतु m. absence of cause or reason, MBh. xii, 10511 · not a real or sound argument, Nyāyad.… · (in rhetoric) a certain figure of speech.…

अहेतुत्व.en: अ-हेतु—त्व n. (in <ns>Buddhist</ns> terminology) absence of cause or necessity, Sarvad.

अहैतुक.en: अ-हैतुक mf(ई)n. id., Bhag. xviii, 22 · causeless, unexpected (as समृद्धि), BhP.… · having no motive, disinterested, BhP.…

अहैतुकम्.en: अ-हैतुकम् ind. without extraneous aid, through one's own ability or power, BhP.

अह्न्य.en: n. daily course (of the sun), PBr.; BṛĀrUp. (cf. raTAhnya/) · (see also तिरो/-अह्न्य.)…

आ.en: 1. आ the second vowel of the alphabet corresponding to the a in far. · 2. आ ind. a particle of reminiscence, Pāṇ. i, 1, 14; Pat.… · also of compassion or pain [more correctly written 1. आस्, q.v.], and of assent, L. [This particle remains unaltered in orthography even before vowels (which causes it to be sometimes confounded with 1. आस्), Pāṇ. i, 1, 14.]… · 3. आ m. N. of Śइव, L.… · grandfather, L.… · f. N. of ळक्ṣम्ī, L.… · 4. आ/ (as a prefix to verbs, especially of motion, and their derivatives) near, near to, towards (see आ-√ क्रम् &c.; in the Vएद, of course, the prefix is separable from the verb; in a few cases, RV. i, 10, 11 and v, 64, 5, a verb in the imperative is to be supplied; with roots like गम्, या, and इ, ‘to go’, and 1. दा, ‘to give’, it reverses the action; e.g. आ-गच्छति, ‘he comes’; आ-दत्ते, ‘he takes’). (As a prep. with a preceding acc.) near to, towards, to, RV.…

आकम्प.en: आ-कम्प m. trembling motion, shaking, R. iii, 62, 31; Vikr.

आकर.en: आ-कर/ , आकरिक, &c. See आ-√ कॄ. · आ-कर/ m. one who scatters, i.e. distributes abundantly, RV. iii, 51, 3; v, 34, 4; viii, 33, 5… · accumulation, plenty, multitude, R.; Suśr. &c.… · (ifc. f(आ). , MBh. iii, 1657, 16215) a mine, Mn.; Yājñ. &c.… · a rich source of anything, Sāh.… · place of origin, origin… · N. of a country (the modern Khandesh), VarBṛS.… · N. of wk. (quoted in खमल्āकर's Śūद्रद्हर्मतत्त्व)… · आ-कर/ mfn. best, excellent, L.…

आकर्णय.en: आ-कर्णय Nom. P. ˚यति, (ind.p. आ-कर्ण्य) to give ear to, listen to, hear, R.; BhP.; Śak. &c.

आकर्ष.en: आ-कर्ष ˚र्षक, &c. See आ-√ कृष्. · आ-कर्ष m. drawing towards one's self (as of a rope), BhP.<listinfo n="sup"/>… · attraction, fascination or an object used for it, KātyŚr.; MBh. v, 1541… · dragging (as of a stone), Car.… · bending (of a bow), L.… · spasm, L.… · playing with dice, MBh. ii, 2116… · a die (cf. आकर्ष-फलक below), L.… · a play-board, L.… · an organ of sense, L.… · a magnet, L.… · an instrument for collecting ashes, shovel, Kauś. (Sch.)… · a partic. part of an elephant's trunk, L.… · N. of a prince, MBh. ii, 1270, ed. Calc.… · N. of a people, ib., ed. Bomb.…

आग्रह.en: आ-ग्रह m. insisting on, strong or obstinate inclination for, obstinacy, whim, Kathās.; Śārṅg. · (= ग्रहण) seizing, taking, L.… · favour, affection, L.…

आघात.en: आ-घात m. आघ्रा.en: आ-√ घ्रा -जिघ्रति (p. -जिघ्रत्; ind.p. -घ्राय; Impv. 2. sg. -जिघ्र; impf. Ā. AjiGrata, MBh.; perf. 3. pl. -जघ्रुः, Bhaṭṭ.) <div n="to"/>to smell anything (acc.), AitUp.; ĀśvGṛ.; Mn. &c.; <div n="to"/>to smell at (acc.), VS.; MBh. &c.; <div n="to"/>to kiss, kiss on (loc.), MBh.; R. &c.: <div n="vp"/>Caus. -घ्रापयति, to cause to smell, KātyŚr.

आङ्ग.en: mfn. (in Gr.) relating to the base (अङ्ग) of a word, Pāṇ. i, 1, 63 Comm. · m. a prince of the country आṅग, (g. pElAdi, q.v.)… · n. a soft delicate form or body, L.…

आङ्गी.en: f. a princess of that country, MBh. i, 3772

आङ्गि.en: m. a descendant of आṅग, N. of ःअविर्द्ह्āन, RAnukr. · आङ्गिक. See आङ्ग.…

आङ्गार.en: n. (fr. अङ्गार), a heap of charcoal, (g. BikzAdi, q.v.)

आङ्गिरस.en: / mf(ई/)n. descended from or belonging or referring to the <ns>Aṅgirases</ns> or to आṅगिरस्, AV.; VS. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · / (अ/स्), m. a descendant of आṅगिरस् (as भ्ṛहत्स्āमन् [AV.], छ्यवन [ŚBr. iv], आय्āस्य [ŚBr. xiv], &c.), RV.; AV. &c.… · especially N. of भ्ṛहस्पति, RV.; AV. &c.… · the planet भ्ṛहस्पति i.e. Jupiter… · (also) m. a partic. magical implement, Kauś.…

आच.en: m. N. of a man, Rājat. · See आच-पराच and Acopaca ss.vv.…

आचम्.en: आ-√ चम् -चामति (Pāṇ. vii, 3, 75) to sip (water) from the palm of the hand for purification (with instr. Mn. ii, 61), ŚBr.; TBr. &c.; <div n="to"/> (perf. 3. p. -चेमुः) to lap up, lick up, absorb, cause to disappear (as the winds lick up moisture, Ragh. ix, 68; xiii, 20) : <div n="vp"/>Caus. आचमन.en: आ-चमन n. sipping water from the palm of the hand (before religious ceremonies, before meals, &c.) for purification, Āp. &c. · [it is not the custom to spit the water out again; the ceremony is often followed by touching the body in various parts]… · the water used for that ceremony, Yājñ.…

आचमनीय.en: m. a vessel used for आ-चमन, ĀśvGṛ. · n. water used for आ-चमन, ĀśvGṛ.; Kauś.; MBh. &c.…

आचम्य.en: आ-चम्य ind.p. having sipped water, Mn.; R.; BhP.

आचाम.en: आ-चाम m. id., L. · the water in which rice has been boiled, KātyŚr.; Yājñ. iii, 322… · (mentioned as drunk by <ns>Jain</ns> ascetics; Prākṛt āyāma), Jain.… · आ-चाम &c. See ib.…

आचय.en: आ-चय m. (√ 1. चि), (g. AkarzAdi, q.v.) collection, plenty, Nir.

आचरण.en: आ-च/रण n. approaching, arrival (as of the dawn), RV. i, 48, 3 · undertaking, practising, performing, Kād.; Sāh.… · conduct, behaviour, Vedāntas., (cf. स्व्-आच्˚)… · a cart, carriage, ChUp. (m. Comm.)…

आचर्य.en: आ-चर्य mfn. to be approached, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 100 Comm. · = आ-चरणीय, q.v., Pāṇ. vi, 1, 147, Sch.…

आचार.en: आ-चार m. (ifc. f(आ). , Yājñ. i, 87, &c.) conduct, manner of action, behaviour, good behaviour, good conduct, Mn.; MBh. &c. · custom, practice, usage, traditional or immemorial usage (as the foundation of law), ib.… · an established rule of conduct, ordinance, institute, precept… · a rule or line, MBh. iii, 166… · = आचारिक below, Suśr.… · (with <ns>Buddhists</ns>) agreeing with what is taught by the teacher, Sarvad.… · आ-चार &c. आचारी.en: आ-चारी f. the plant Hingtsha Repens, L.

आचार्य.en: ^ m. ‘knowing or teaching the आचार or rules’, a spiritual guide or teacher (especially one who invests the student with the sacrificial thread, and instructs him in the Vएदs, in the law of sacrifice and religious mysteries [Mn. ii, 140; 171]), AV.; ŚBr. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · a N. of ध्रोṇअ (the teacher of the फ्āṇḍअवs), Bhag. i, 2… · (also) the son of an outcast Vअइśय and a Vअइśय्ā who was before a <ns>Brāhman</ns>'s wife, Mn. x, 23 (accord. to some, read चार्य)… · ^ , आचार्यक, &c. See ib.…

आचार्या.en: (आ), f. a spiritual preceptress, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 49; Siddh. [The title आचार्य affixed to names of learned men is rather like our ‘Dr.’; e.g. rAGavAcArya, &c.]

आचार्यक.en: n. (Pāṇ. iv, 2, 104 Comm.) the office or profession of a teacher, Pañcat.; Ragh. &c. · &c. See ib.…

आच्छाद.en: आ-च्छाद m. garment, clothes, Mn. vii, 126; R.; Pañcat.

आच्छादन.en: आ-च्छादन n. covering, concealing, hiding, KātyŚr. · cloth, clothes, mantle, cloak, Pāṇ.; Āp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.… · a cover for a bed, R. vii, 37, 11… · the wooden frame of a roof, L.…

आजनि.en: A/jani f. a stick for driving, AV. iii, 25, 5.

आज.en: mfn. (fr. 1. अज/), coming from or belonging to goats, produced by goats, ĀśvGṛ.; R.; Suśr. · m. a vulture, L.… · a descendant of आज… · (अम्), n. the lunar mansion फ्ūर्व्āभ्ह्āद्रपद्ā (presided over by आज <ns>Ekapād</ns>), VarBṛS.… · clarified butter, L.…

आजीव.en: आ-जीव m. livelihood, ŚvetUp.; Mn. xi, 63; MBh. &c. · = आजीविक, q.v., L.…

आजीवन.en: आ-जीवन n. livelihood, Mn. x, 79; Pañcat.

आज्ञप्त.en: आ-ज्ञप्त mfn. ordered, commanded, Mn. ii, 245; R. &c.

आज्ञप्ति.en: आ-ज्ञप्ति f. command Comm. on AitUp.

आट्.en: ind. a croak (imitation of the sound uttered by a frog), TāṇḍyaBr.

आटि.en: f. N. of the bird Turdus Ginginianus, PārGṛ. (cf. आडि and आति.)

आटिकी.en: f. N. of the wife of ऊṣअस्ति, ChUp. [‘marriageable’ or ‘strolling about (fr. √ अट्)’ Comm.]

आडि.en: f. (= आति/, q.v.) N. of an aquatic bird, MārkP.

आढ्य.en: / mf(आ)n. (? fr. आर्ध्य, √ ऋध्; or fr. आर्थ्य, NBD.), opulent, wealthy, rich, ŚBr. ix · xiv; Mn. &c.… · rich or abounding in, richly endowed or filled or mixed with (instr. or in comp.), R.; Pañcat. &c.… · (in arithm.) augmented by (instr.)…

आणुक.en: or आणूक, n. dirt in the eye, L.

आण्ड.en: / अम्, n. (fr. अण्ड), an egg, RV.; AV. &c. · / (औ/), m. du. the testicles, AV. ix, 7, 13; VS. &c.…

आण्डज.en: आण्ड/—ज आण्ड/-), mfn. (born from an egg, ChUp.; AitUp. · आण्ड/—ज (अस्), m. a bird, Suparṇ.…

(abl. of 4. अ) afterwards, then (often used in a concluding paragraph antithetically to य/द्, यदा, य/दि. and sometimes strengthened by the particles अ/ह, इ/द्, ईम्, उ), RV.; AV. · then, further, also, and, RV.; AV. Ā. अ/यति, अयते [cf. √ अय्], (pf. इयाय [2. sg. इय/थ, AV. viii, 1, 10, and इये/थ, RV.] fut. एष्यति; aor. ऐषीत्; inf. एतुम्, ए/तवे, RV. & AV., ए/तवै/, RV. ए/तोस्, RV. इत्यै/, RV. i, 113, 6; 124, 1) <div n="to"/>to go, walk; <div n="to"/>to flow; <div n="to"/>to blow; <div n="to"/>to advance, spread, get about; <div n="to"/>to go to or towards (with acc.), come, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; MBh.; R.; Hit.; Ragh. &c.; <div n="to"/>to go away, escape, pass, retire, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; R.; <div n="to"/>to arise from, come from, RV.; ChUp.; <div n="to"/>to return (in this sense only fut.), MBh.; R.; <div n="to"/> (with पुनर्) to come back again, return, MBh.; R.; Pañcat. &c.; <div n="to"/>to succeed…

इत.en: mfn. ifc. gone · returned… · obtained (cf. अनित, उद्-इत, &c.)… · remembered, L.… · / (अ/म्), n. way, ŚBr.…

इतासु.en: itA/su mfn. one whose animal spirits have departed, TS.

इति.en: 1. इति f. इत्यै/ (dat.) See √ इ above · (for 2. इति See s.v.)… · 2. इ/ति ind. (fr. pronominal base 3. इ), in this manner, thus (in its original signification इ/ति refers to something that has been said or thought, or lays stress on what precedes; in the भ्र्āह्मṇअs it is often equivalent to ‘as you know’, reminding the hearer or reader of certain customs, conditions, &c. supposed to be known to him). In quotations of every kind इ/ति means that the preceding words are the very words which some person has or might have spoken, and placed thus at the end of a speech it serves the purpose of inverted commas (इ/त्य् उक्त्वा, having so said; इ/ति कृत्वा, having so considered, having so decided). It may often have reference merely to what is passing in the mind, e.g. bAlo 'pi nAvamantavyo manuzya i/ti BUmipaH, a king, though a child, is not to be despised, say……

इत्य.en: mfn. to be gone to or towards, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 109; Bhaṭṭ. · &c., इत्वन्, &c. See p. 163, col. 3.…

इतर.en: इ/-तर mf(आ)n. (the neuter is अद् in classical Sanskṛt, but अम् [अद्, ŚBr.] in Ved. Pāṇ. vii, 1, 25, 26; comparative form of pronom. base 3. इ; cf. Lat. iterum; Hib. iter), the other (of two), another · pl. the rest… · (with abl.) different from, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; MBh.; R.; Mn.; Ragh.; Hit. &c.… · low, vile, Kād.… · expelled, rejected, L.… · इ/-तर इतर, इतर, the one — the other, this — that. (इतर connected antithetically with a preceding word often signifies the contrary idea, e.g. विजयाय इतराय वा [MBh.], to victory or defeat; so in ध्वन्द्व compounds, suKetarezu [ŚvetUp.], in happiness and distress; it sometimes, however, forms a थत्-पुरुṣअ compound with another word to express the one idea implied in the contrary of that word, e.g. dakziRetara, the left hand.)…

इतिहासपुराण.en: itihAsa/—purARa n. the ईतिह्āसs and the फुर्āṇअs, Hir.

इत्थम्.en: इत्थ/म् ind. (fr. इद्, q.v., Pāṇ. v, 3, 24), thus, in this manner, RV.; AV.; TS.; R.; Śak.; &c.; · [cf. Lat. item.]…

इत्थम्भूत.en: इत्थम्—भूत mfn. become thus, being thus or in such manner · so circumstanced, Pāṇ.; Śak.; Megh. &c.…

इत्था.en: / ind. Ved. thus<listinfo n="sup"/> · (often used in the Ṛग्-वेद, and sometimes only to lay stress on a following word; therefore by native etymologists [Nir.] considered as a particle of affirmation.) इत्था is often connected with words expressing devotion to the gods &c. in the sense of thus, truly, really… · accord. to some also ‘here, hither’, ‘there, thither’, = Prākṛt ettha.… · especially with धी as an adjective. Hence इत्था-धी = such, i.e. true (सत्या) or real worship. Similarly, इत्था-धी/ mfn. so devout, so pious i.e. very devout… · performing such or true works [Sāy.], RV.; AV.; KaṭhUp.…

इदम्.en: 1. इद/म् अय/म्, इय/म्, इद/म् (fr. इद्, Uṇ. iv, 156; g. sarvAdi, Pāṇ. i, 1, 27; Vop.; a kind of neut. of the pronom. base 3. इ with अम् [cf. Lat. is, ea, id, and idem]; the regular forms are partly derived from the pronom. base अ; see Gr. 224; the Vएद exhibits various irregular formations, e.g. fr. pronom. base अ, an inst. एना/, अया/ [used in general adverbially], and gen. loc. du. अयो/स्, and perhaps also अवो/स्, in RV. vi, 67, 11; vii, 67, 4; x, 132, 5 [BRD.]; fr. the base इम, a gen. sing. इम/स्य, only, RV.; the RV. has in a few instances the irregular accentuation अ/स्मै, v, 39, 5, &c.; अ/स्य, iv, 15, 5, &c.; आ/भिस्, vi, 25, 2, &c. : the forms derived fr. अ are used enclitically if they take the place of the third personal pronoun, do not stand at the beginning of a verse or period, and…

इदंरूप.en: इद/ं—रूप (इद/ं˚) mfn. having this shape, ŚBr.

इदंशब्द.en: इदं—शब्द m. the word इदम् (to be used in assigning the oblation to each deity), ĀpY.

इदन्ता.en: इदन्—ता f. the being this, identity, Sarvad.

इदम्मय.en: इदम्—म/य mf(ई)n. made or consisting of this, ŚBr. xiv, 7, 2, 6.

इदहा.en: f. N. of a cow (v.l. इडा), Drāhy.

इदा.en: इ-दा/ ind. (fr. pronom. base 3. इ, Pāṇ. v, 3, 20), Ved. now, at this moment · (often connected with a gen. of अहन्, e.g. इदा/ चिद् अ/ह्नः, or अह्न इदा, this present day, ‘nowadays’; and with ह्यस्, e.g. इदा ह्यः, only yesterday), RV.…

इदानि.en: इ-दा/नि n. a measure of time (the fifteenth part of an ऐतर्हि), ŚBr. xii, 3, 2, 5.

इदानीम्.en: इ-दा/नीम् ind. now, at this moment, in this case, just, even (with gen. of अहन्, e.g. इदानीम् अह्नः, this present day, ‘nowadays’; इदानीम् एव, just now; immediately; इदानीम् अपि, in this case too; तत इदानीम्, thereupon, then), RV.; ŚBr.; Ait.; Ragh. · (in rare cases it is an expletive, affecting but slightly the sense).…

इदानींतन.en: mf(ई)n. present, modern, momentary, of the present moment, Sāh.

इद्ध.en: / इध्म/ &c. See √ इन्ध्. · / mfn. kindled, lighted, alight<listinfo n="sup"/>… · shining, glowing, blazing, RV.; Mn.; ChUp.; Ratnāv. &c.… · clean, clear, bright… · wonderful, L.… · vehement, fierce, Kir.… · / (अम्), n. sunshine, light, heat… · a wonder, L.…

इन.en: / mfn. (fr. √ इ, Uṇ. iii, 2; or fr. इन् = √ इन्व्), able, strong, energetic, determined, bold · powerful, mighty… · wild… · glorious, RV.… · / (अस्), m. a lord, master… · a king, BhP.… · N. of an Āदित्य… · the sun… · the lunar mansion ःअस्त, L.…

इनानी.en: f. N. of a plant (= Vअṭअपत्त्र्ī), L.

इनु.en: m. N. of a घन्द्हर्व, L.

इन्द्र.en: इ/न्द्र m. (for etym. as given by native authorities See Nir. x, 8; Sāy. on RV. i, 3, 4; Uṇ. ii, 28; according to BRD. fr. इन् = √ इन्व् with suff. र preceded by inserted द्, meaning ‘to subdue, conquer’ <pb n="166,2"/>; according to Muir, S. T. v, 119, for सिन्द्र fr. √ स्यन्द्, ‘to drop’; more probably from √ इन्द्, ‘to drop’ q.v., and connected with इन्दु above), the god of the atmosphere and sky · the Indian Jupiter Pluvius or lord of rain (who in Vedic mythology reigns over the deities of the intermediate region or atmosphere; he fights against and conquers with his thunder-bolt [वज्र] the demons of darkness, and is in general a symbol of generous heroism; इन्द्र was not originally lord of the gods of the sky, but his deeds were most useful to mankind, and he was therefore addressed in prayers and hymns more than any other deity, and ultimately superseded the more lofty and spiritual Vअरुṇअ; in the later mythology इन्द्र is subordinated to the triad भ्रह्मन्, Vइṣṇउ, and Śइव, but remained the chief of all other deities in the popular mind), RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; Mn.; MBh.; R. &c. &c.…

इन्द्रा.en: इ/न्द्रा f. the wife of ईन्द्र See इन्द्राणी · N. of a plant, L.…

इन्द्रगोप.en: इन्द्र—गोप mfn. or ˚पा Ved. having ईन्द्र as one's protector, RV. viii, 46, 32 · इन्द्र—गोप m. the insect cochineal of various kinds… · a fire-fly (in this sense also इन्द्र-गोपक).…

इन्द्रज.en: इन्द्र—ज m. N. of the ape Vāलिन्, L.

इन्द्रजा.en: इन्द्र—जा mfn. descended from ईन्द्र, AV. iv, 3, 7.

इन्द्रजाल.en: इन्द्र—जाल/ n. the net of ईन्द्र, AV. viii, 8, 8 · a weapon employed by आर्जुन, MBh.… · sham, illusion, delusion, magic, sorcery, jugglery… · the art of magic &c., Kathās.; Ratnāv.; Prab.; Vedāntas.; Sāh. &c.…

इन्द्रत्व.en: इन्द्र—त्व n. ईन्द्र's power and dignity · kingship.…

इन्द्रलोक.en: इन्द्र—लोक/ m. ईन्द्र's world · श्वर्ग or paradise, ŚBr.; Mn.; R. &c.…

इन्द्राभ.en: indrABa m. N. of a son of ध्ह्ṛतर्āṣṭर, MBh. · a species of fowl.…

इन्द्रक.en: n. an assembly-room, a hall, L.

इन्द्रय.en: Nom. Ā. इन्द्रयते, to behave like ईन्द्र, RV. iv, 24, 4.

इन्द्राण्य.en: इन्द्रा—˚ण्य mfn. consecrated to ईन्द्र, MānGṛ.

इन्द्रिय.en: / mfn. fit for or belonging to or agreeable to ईन्द्र, RV.; AV.; VS. · / (अस्), m. a companion of ईन्द्र (?), RV. i, 107, 2; AV. xix, 27, 1… · / (अम्), n. power, force, the quality which belongs especially to the mighty ईन्द्र, RV.; AV.; VS.; TS.; AitBr.; ŚBr.… · exhibition of power, powerful act, RV.; VS.… · bodily power, power of the senses… · virile power, AV.; VS.; ŚBr.… · semen virile, VS.; KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.… · faculty of sense, sense, organ of sense, AV.; Suśr.; Mn.; Ragh.; Kir. &c.… · the number five as symbolical of the five senses. (In addition to the five organs of perception, budDIndriyARi or jYAnendriyARi, i.e. eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin, the <ns>Hindūs</ns> enumerate five organs of action, karmendriyARi i.e. larynx, hand, foot, anus, and parts of generation; between these ten organs and the soul or आत्मन् stands मनस् or mind, considered as an eleventh organ; in the Vएद्āन्त, मनस्, बुद्धि, अहंकार, and चित्त form the four inner or internal organs, अन्तर्-इन्द्रियाणि, so that according to this reckoning the organs are fourteen in number, each being presided over by its own ruler or नियन्तृ; thus, the eye by the Sun, the ear by the Quarters of the world, the nose by …

उ.en: 1. उ the fifth letter and third short vowel of the alphabet, pronounced as the u in full. · 2. उ ind. an interjection of compassion, anger, L.… · a particle implying assent, calling, command, L.… · 3. उ ind. an enclitic copula used frequently in the Vएदs;… · (as a particle implying restriction and antithesis, generally after pronominals, prepositions, particles, and before नु and सु, equivalent to) and, also, further; on the other hand (especially in connexion with a relative, e.g. य उ, he on the contrary who &c.)… · This particle may serve to give emphasis, like इद् and एव, especially after prepositions or demonstrative pronouns, in conjunction with नु, वै, हि, चिद्, &c. (e.g. अय/म् उ वाम् पुरुत/मो … जोहवीति [RV. iii, 62, 2], this very person [your worshipper] invokes you &c.) It is especially used in the figure of speech called Anaphora, and particularly when the pronouns are repeated (e.g. त/म् उ स्तुष इ/न्द्रम् त/म् गृणीषे [RV. ii, 20, 4], him I praise, ईन्द्र, him I sing). It may be used in drawing a conclusion, like the English ‘now’ (e.g. त/द् उ त/था न/ कुर्यात् [ŚBr. v, 2, 2, 3], that now he should not do in such a manner), and is frequently found in interrogative sentences…

(fr. √ वे, q.v.), sewn, woven. · 2. उत/ ind. and, also, even, or, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; ChUp. &c.… · often used for the sake of emphasis, especially at the end of a line after इति or a verb (e.g. सर्व-भूतानि तम् पार्थ सदा परिभवन्त्य् उत, all creatures, O king, certainly always despise him, MBh. iii, 1026), MBh.; Bhag. &c. (As an interrogative particle, generally at the beginning of the second or following part of a double interrogation) or, utrum-an (e.g. कथम् निर्णीयते किं स्यान् निष्कारणो बन्धुर् उत विश्वास-घातकः, how can it be decided whether he be a friend without a motive or a violator of confidence? Hit.), Kum.; Kathās.; Bhartṛ.; Sāh. &c.… · in this sense it may be strengthened by आहो (e.g. kaccit tvam asi mAnuzI utAho surANganA, art thou a mortal woman or divine? ङल), or by आहो-स्वित् (e.g. SAlihotraH kiM nu syAd utAhosvid rAjA nalaH, can it be Śāलिहोत्र or king ङल?) Rarely किम् is repeated before उत used in this sense (e.g. kim nu svargAt prAptA tasyA rUpeRa kimutAnyAgatA, has she arrived from heaven or has another come in her form? Mṛcch.), Amar.; MBh. &c. उप.en: उ/प ind. (a preposition or prefix to verbs and nouns, expressing) towards, near to (opposed to अप, away), by the side of, with, together with, under, down (e.g. उप-√ गम्, to go near, undergo; उप-गमन, approaching; in the Vएद the verb has sometimes to be supplied from the context, and sometimes उप is placed after the verb to which it belongs, e.g. आययुर् उप = upAyayuH, they approached). (As unconnected with verbs and prefixed to nouns उप expresses) direction towards, nearness, contiguity in space, time, number, degree, resemblance, and relationship, but with the idea of subordination and inferiority (e.g. उप-कनिष्ठिका, the finger next to the little finger; उप-पुराणम्, a secondary or subordinate फुर्āṇअ; उप-दश, nearly ten) · sometimes forming with the nouns to which it is prefixed compound adverbs (e.g. उप-मूलम्, at the root; उप-पूर्व-रात्रम्, towards the beginning of night; उप-कूपे, near a well) which lose their adverbial terminations if they are again compounded with nouns (e.g. upakUpa-jalASaya, a reservoir in the neighbourhood of a well)…

उपमित.en: 1. उप-मित mfn. (for 2. See उप-√ मि) compared, illustrated by comparison, Pāṇ.; Bhartṛ. &c. · similar.… · 2. उप-मित (for 1. See above) mfn. stuck or fastened on, put into, Vait.…

उपमर्दन.en: उप-मर्दन n. the act of injuring, violation · suppression, oppression Comm. on KātyŚr.…

उपरि.en: उप/रि ind. ऋग्वेद.en: ऋग्—वेद/ अस्, m. ‘Hymn - Vएद’ or ‘Vएद of praise’, the Ṛग्-वेद, or most ancient sacred book of the <ns>Hindūs</ns> (that is, the collective body of sacred verses called Ṛचs [see below], consisting of 1017 hymns [or with the Vāलक्हिल्यs 1028] arranged in eight आṣṭअकs or in ten ंअṇḍअलs; ंअṇḍअलs 2-8 contain groups of hymns, each group ascribed to one author or to the members of one family; the ninth book contains the hymns sung at the शोम ceremonies; the first and tenth contain hymns of a different character, some comparatively modern, composed by a greater variety of individual authors; in its wider sense the term Ṛग्-वेद comprehends the भ्र्āह्मṇअs and the श्ūत्र works on the ritual connected with the hymns), AitBr.; ŚBr.; Mn. &c.

ऋच.en: ifc. = 2. ऋ/च्, verse, sacred verse (cf. त्र्यृच, &c.) · m. N. of a king, VP.…

ऋजु.en: / mf(ज्वी/)n. (√ अर्ज्, Uṇ. i, 28; probably fr. √ 2. ऋञ्ज्, col. 3 BRD.), tending in a straight direction, straight (lit. and fig.; opp. to वृजिन/), upright, honest, right, sincere, RV.; AV. xiv, 1, 34; TS. &c., Mn.; MBh. &c. · / (उ/), ind. in the right manner, correctly, RV. ii, 3, 7; v, 46, 1; x, 67, 2; AitBr. iii, 3, 10… · in a straight line, straight on Suśr. &c.… · / compar. ऋ/जीयस्, RV. vii, 104, 12; AV. v, 14, 12; viii, 4, 12, and रजीयस्, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 162… · / superl. ऋजिष्ठ, Pāṇ., and र/जिष्ठ, RV.… · / [observe that the metaphorical meaning of this word is more common in Vedic, and the literal meaning in classical literature]… · / (उस्), m. N. of a son of Vअसु-देव, BhP.… · [cf. Zd. ĕrĕzu; Gk. ὀρέγω; Lat. rectus; Goth. raihts; Eng. right.]…

ऋजुत्व.en: ऋजु—त्व n. straight direction, straightness, Kum. iv, 23 · uprightness, sincerity, honesty, Amar.; HYog.…

ऋण.en: / mfn. going, flying, fugitive (as a thief), RV. vi, 12, 5; having gone against or transgressed, guilty · [cf. Lat. reus]… · / (अम्), n. anything wanted or missed… · anything due, obligation, duty, debt (a <ns>Brāhman</ns> owes three debts or obligations, viz. 1. भ्रह्मचर्य or ‘study of the Vएदs’, to the Ṛṣइs; 2. sacrifice and worship, to the gods; 3. procreation of a son, to the Manes, TS. vi, 3, 10, 5; Mn. vi, 35, &c.; in later times also, 4. benevolence to mankind and 5. hospitality to guests are added, MBh. &c.), RV.; AV. &c., Mn.; MBh. &c.… · a debt of money, money owed, MBh.; Mn.; Yājñ.… · (ऋणं √ कृ, to get into debt, Yājñ. ii, 45; ˚म्-√ प्राप्, to become indebted, Mn. viii, 107; ˚ं-√ दा or √ नी or प्र-√ यम्, to pay a debt, MBh.; Mn. &c.; ˚ं-√ याच्, to ask for a loan, Kathās.; ˚m parIps, to call in a debt, Mn. viii, 161)…

ऋषभ.en: / अस्, m. (fr. √ 2. ऋष्, Uṇ. ii, 123), a bull (as impregnating the flock; cf. वृषभ and उक्षन्), RV.; AV.; VS.; ChUp.; BhP. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · any male animal in general, ŚBr.… · the best or most excellent of any kind or race (cf. पुरुषर्षभ, &c.), MBh.; R. &c.… · the second of the seven notes of the <ns>Hindū</ns> gamut (abbreviated into Ṛ)… · a kind of medicinal plant, Suśr.; Bhpr.… · a particular antidote, Suśr. ii, 276, 7… · a particular ऐक्āह (q.v.), KātyŚr.… · the fifteenth खल्प… · N. of several men… · of an ape… · of a ङ्āग… · of a mountain… · of a थ्īर्त्ह… · N. of one of the 24 झइन saints or झिनs… · / (आस्), m. pl. the inhabitants of ख्रउñच-द्व्īप, BhP. v, 20, 22… · N. of a people, VarBṛS.… · [cf. Zd. arshan; Gk. ἄρσην.]…

ऋषभा.en: f. a masculine (bullish) girl unfit for marriage, ĀpGṛ.

ऋषि.en: ऋ/षि m. (√ 2. ऋष् Comm. on Uṇ. iv, 119; ऋषति ज्ञानेन संसार-पारम्, T.; perhaps fr. an obsolete √ ऋष् for √ दृश्, ‘to see ?’, cf. ऋषि-कृत्), a singer of sacred hymns, an inspired poet or sage, any person who alone or with others invokes the deities in rhythmical speech or song of a sacred character (e.g. the ancient hymn-singers खुत्स, आत्रि, णेब्ह, आगस्त्य, खुśइक, Vअसिṣṭह, Vय्-अśव), RV.; AV.; VS. &c. · the Ṛṣइs were regarded by later generations as patriarchal sages or saints, occupying the same position in India history as the heroes and patriarchs of other countries, and constitute a peculiar class of beings in the early mythical system, as distinct from gods, men, आसुरs, &c., AV. x, 10, 26; ŚBr.; AitBr.; KātyŚr.; Mn. &c.… · they are the authors or rather seers of the Vedic hymns i.e. according to orthodox <ns>Hindū</ns> ideas they are the inspired personages to whom these hymns were revealed, and such an expression as ‘the Ṛṣइ says’ is equivalent to ‘so it stands in the sacred text’…

ऋषिचोदन.en: ऋषि—चो/दन mfn. animating or inspiring the Ṛṣइs, RV. viii, 51, 3.

ॠ.en: 1. ॠ the eighth vowel of the alphabet (the corresponding long vowel to ऋ and resembling the sound of ri in marine, but after labials more like ru; it generally only appears in some forms of nouns in ऋ, viz. in the gen. pl. of all genders, in the acc. pl. m. and f. and in nom. acc. and voc. pl. n.) · 2. ॠ ind. an interjection of terror, L.… · a particle implying reproach… · warding off, L.… · a particle used at the beginning of a sentence, L.… · 3. ॠ m. a भ्हइरव, L.… · a ध्āनव, L.… · f. the mother of the gods… · of the demons, L.… · recollection… · going, motion, L.… · n. a breast, L.… · 4. ॠ for 4. ऋ, q.v.…

ए.en: 1. ए the eleventh vowel of the alphabet (corresponding to the letter e as pronounced in prey, grey). · 2. ए ind. an interjection, MaitrS.… · a particle of recollection… · addressing… · censure… · contempt… · compassion, L.… · 3. ए m. Vइṣṇउ, L.… · 4. e (आ-√ इ) P. -एति, to come near or towards, go near, approach, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. &c.; <div n="to"/> (with and without पुनर्) to come back, come again to, AitBr.; MBh.; Kathās. &c.; <div n="to"/>to reach, attain, enter, come into (a state or position), Mn. xii, 125; Megh.; Prab. &c.; <div n="to"/>to submit, fall to one's share, ChUp. v, 14, 1 (आययन्ति ?), KaṭhUp. : <div n="vp"/>Intens. Ā. (3. du. -इयाते; 1. pl. -ईमहे) <div n="to"/>to hasten near, RV. vii, 39, 2; <div n="to"/>to request, VS. iv, 5.…

एकार.en: ए—कार m. the letter or sound ए, TPrāt. &c.

एत.en: 1. e/ta (for 2. See s.v.) mfn. come near, approached, RV.; Nir. &c. · 2. ए/त (for 1. See 4. e) mf(आ and ए/नी, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 39)n. (√ इ, Uṇ. iii, 86), ‘rushing’, ‘darting’… · of a variegated colour, varying the colour, shining, brilliant, RV.; AV.; TS.; VS. &c.… · ए/त m. a kind of deer or antelope, RV.… · the hide of the same, RV.… · variegated colour, T.…

एति.en: e/ti f. arrival, approach, RV. x, 91, 4; 178, 2.

एत्य.en: e/tya ind.p. having come near &c., RV. x, 66, 14; AV.; Mn.; Ragh. &c.

एक.en: ए/क mfn. (√ इ, Uṇ. iii, 43, probably fr. a base ए; cf. Zd. ae-va; Gk. οἰ-ν-ός, οἶος; Goth. ai-n-s; also Lat. aequu-s; g. sarvAdi, Pāṇ. i, 1, 27; see Gr. 200), one (एकोऽपि, or एकश्-चन, with न preceding or following, no one, nobody; the words एकया न or एकान् न are used before decade numerals to lessen them by one, e.g. एकान् न त्रिंशत्, twenty-nine), RV. &c. · (with and without एव) alone, solitary, single, happening only once, that one only (frequently ifc.; cf. DarmEka-rakza, &c.), RV. &c.… · the same, one and the same, identical, ŚBr. v; KātyŚr.; Mn. &c.… · one of two or many (एक — एक, एक — द्वितीय, the one — the other; esp. pl. एके, some, एके — अपरे some — others, &c.), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; MBh.; Hit. &c.… · (एक repeated twice, either as a compound [cf. ekEka] or uncompounded, may have the sense ‘one and one’, ‘one by one’, RV. i, 20, 7; 123, 8; v, 52, 17; R.; BhP. &c.)…

एककार्य.en: एक—कार्य n. the same business or work, MBh. · एक—कार्य mfn. executing the same work, performing the same business, Pañcat.…

एकखुर.en: एक—खुर m. a one-hoofed animal, Āp. ii, 16, 16.

एकग.en: एक—ग mfn. attentive to only one object, L.

एकगु.en: एक—गु m. a particular आग्नि-ṣṭओम (q.v.), GopBr.

एकग्रन्थ.en: एक—ग्रन्थ m. an aggregate of 32 letters, L.

एकज.en: एक—ज/ mfn. born or produced alone or single, solitary, single, alone of its kind, RV. i, 164, 15; x, 84, 3; AV.; KātyŚr. &c.

एकजातीय.en: एक—जातीय mfn. of the same species, Suśr. · of the same family, Dāyabh.…

एकप्रयत्न.en: एक—प्रयत्न m. one effort (of the voice).

एकबुद्धि.en: एक—बुद्धि mfn. of one mind, unanimous, Kathās. · ‘having only one idea’, N. of a fish, Pañcat.…

एकान्तिक.en: mfn. devoted to one aim or object or person or theory.
