एकार्थ.en: ekArTa m. one and the same object, MBh.; Rājat. · one and the same purpose… · one and the same meaning… · ekArTa mfn. having the same purpose or aim, KātyŚr.; MBh. i, iii; R. &c.… · having the same meaning, denoting the same thing, synonymous, Nir.… · (in rhet.) tautological (as a sentence), Vām. ii, 2, 11; Kāvyād.… · expressing one thing, forming only one notion (as a compound)… · ekArTa m. N. of a glossary of synonymous words…

एकार्थता.en: ekArTa—tA f. the state of having the same object or purpose, KātyŚr.; Mit. · the act of expressing only one thing or notion, Pat.…

एकार्थत्व.en: ekArTa—tva n. the state of having the same object or purpose, KātyŚr.; Mit. · the act of expressing only one thing or notion, Pat.…

एकावयव.en: ekAvayava mfn. made up of the same members or constituent parts.

एकेष.en: e/keza mfn. furnished with only one pole, RV. x, 135, 3.

एकैक.en: e/kEka mfn. one by one, single, every single one, AV. iii, 28, 1; ŚBr.; MBh.; Mn. &c.

एकैकम्.en: e/kEkam (अम्), ind. singly, one by one, R. &c.

एकोत्तर.en: e/kottara mfn. greater or more by one, increasing by one, ŚBr.; Suśr.; RPrāt. &c.

एकोदक.en: ekodaka mfn. offering water as funeral oblation to the same deceased ancestor, a kind of relative, Mn. v, 71.

एकोन.en: ekona mfn. less by one, minus one (used in comp. with विंशति and the succeeding decade numerals, thus -विंशति/ f. nineteen &c.)

एकक.en: / mf(आ, इका)n. single, alone, solitary, RV. x, 59, 9; AV. xx, 132, 1.

एकत.en: / m. N. of one of the three Āप्त्यs, VS. i, 23; ŚBr. i; Kāṭh. &c. · of a <ns>Brāhman</ns>, MBh.…

एकत्र.en: ind. in one, in one and the same, MBh.; Kathās.; Pañcat. &c. · in one place, in the same place, in a single spot (with the force of the locative), MBh.; Yājñ.; Mṛcch. &c.… · on the one side… · (the correlative is अपरत्र or sometimes अन्यस्मिन्, on the one side — on the other side, here — there)… · in one and the same place, all together, Kathās.; Suśr. &c.…

एकदा.en: ind. at the same time, at once, Sāh. · sometimes, once, one time, some time ago, MBh.; Pañcat.; Hit. &c.…

एकधा.en: / ind. simply, singly · in one way, together, at once, AV.; TS. &c., MBh. &c.…

एकधाभूय.en: एकधा—भू/य n. the becoming one or simple, ŚBr. xiv.

एकल.en: mfn. alone, solitary, ChUp.; BhP. &c. · (in mus.) a solo singer.…

एकीकृ.en: एकी—√ कृ to unite, combine, associate, R.; RāmatUp.

एकीभाव.en: एकी—भाव m. the becoming one, coalition, Vedāntas.; RPrāt. &c.

एकीभू.en: एकी—√ भू to become one, be blended or combined, ŚBr.; MBh.; RPrāt. &c.

एजत्.en: ए/जत् mfn. (pres. p. of the above) · ए/जत् (त्), n. anything moving or living, RV.; AV.…

एता.en: ए/ता f. a hind, MBh. iii, 8384

एतद्.en: एत/द् mfn. (Gr. 223; g. sarvAdi, Pāṇ. i, 1, 27) this, this here, here (especially as pointing to what is nearest to the speaker, e.g. एष बाणः, this arrow here in my hand; एष याति पन्थाः, here passes the way; एष कालः, here i.e. now, is the time; एतद्, this here i.e. this world here below) · sometimes used to give emphasis to the personal pronouns (e.g. एषोऽहम्, I, this very person here) or with omission of those pronouns (e.g. एष त्वां स्वर्गं नयामि, I standing here will convey thee to heaven; एतौ प्रविष्टौ स्वः, we two here have entered)… · as the subject of a sentence it agrees in gender and number with the predicate without reference to the noun to be supplied (e.g. एतद् एव हि मे धनम्, for this [scil. cow] is my only wealth, MBh.)… · but sometimes the neuter sing. remains (e.g. एतद् गुरुषु वृत्तिः, this is the custom among घुरुs, Mn. ii, 206)…

एतदन्त.en: एतद्—अन्त mfn. terminating with this, ending thus, Mn. i, 50.

एतदात्म्य.en: एतद्—आत्म्य n., ChUp. vi, 8, 7, misprint for ऐतदात्म्य (q.v.; cf. Śअṃकर's Comm. on the passage).

एतदादि.en: एतद्—आदि mfn. beginning with this, and so forth.

एतद्दा.en: एतद्—दा/ mfn. granting or bestowing this, ŚBr. ix.

एतद्द्वितीय.en: एतद्—द्वितीय mfn. doing this for the second time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162.

एतत्पर.en: एतत्—पर mfn. intent on or absorbed in this Comm. on Mn.

एतत्प्रथम.en: एतत्—प्रथम mfn. doing this for the first time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162.

एतन्मय.en: एतन्—म/य mf(ई)n. made or consisting of this, of such a kind, ŚBr.; AitBr.

एतर्हि.en: एत/र्हि ind. now, at this time, at present, nowadays, TS.; ŚBr.; AitBr. &c. · then (correlating to य/र्हि), ib.… · एत/र्हि (इ), n. a measure of time (fifteen ईद्āनिs, or the fifteenth part of a ख्ṣइप्र), ŚBr. xii, 3, 2, 5.…

एतावत्.en: एता/वत् mfn. so great, so much, so many, of such a measure or compass, of such extent, so far, of such quality or kind, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c. · (often in connection with a relative clause, the latter generally following; etAvAn eva puruzo yaj jAyAtmA prajA, a man is of such measure as [i.e. made complete by] his wife, himself, and his progeny, Mn. ix, 45), R.; BhP.; Hit. &c.… · एता/वत् ind. so far, thus far, so much, in such a degree, thus, RV. vii, 57, 3; ŚBr.; Hit. &c.…

एतावत्त्व.en: एतावत्—त्व n. the being so great or so much, quantity, number, size, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 15; BhP. &c. · (with following यद्, such a state or quantity &c., that.)…

एतावन्मात्र.en: एतावन्—मात्र/ mfn. of this measure, of this quantity, so great, such, ŚBr.; MBh.

एतृ.en: / m. (एत/री, Padap. एत/रि loc. Sāy.) (√ इ), one who goes or approaches (for anything) · asking, requesting, RV. v, 41, 10; vi, 12, 4… · / mfn. ifc. one who goes (cf. pa/rAparEtf &c.)…

एम.en: ए/म, अम्, ए/मन्, अ, n. course, way, RV.; VS.; <div n="P"/> [cf. Gk. οἶμος, οἴμη; Lith. eisme.] · ए/म ए/मन्. See p. 231, col. 3.…

एध.en: ए/ध m. (√ इन्ध्), fuel, RV. i, 158, 4; x, 86, 18; VS.; ŚBr.; Ragh. &c. · ए/ध mfn. ifc. kindling See अग्न्य्-एध… · [cf. Gk. αἰθός, αἶθος; Hib. aodh; O. H. G. eit; Angl.Sax. âd.]…

एन.en: 1. एन a pronom. base (used for certain cases of the 3rd personal pronoun, thus in the acc. sing. du. pl. [एनम्, एनाम्, एनद्, &c.], inst. sing. [एनेन, एनया] gen. loc. du. [एनयोस्, Ved. एनोस्]; the other cases are formed fr. the pronom. base अ See under इदम्), he, she, it · this, that, (this pronoun is enclitic and cannot begin a sentence; it is generally used alone, so that एनम् पुरुषम्, ‘that man’, would be very unusual if not incorrect. Grammarians assert that the substitution of एनम् &c. for इमम् or एतम् &c. takes place when something is referred to which has already been mentioned in a previous part of the sentence; see Gr. 223 and 836)… · [cf. Gk. ἕν, οἷος; Goth. ains; Old Pruss. ains; Lat. oinos, unus.]… · 2. एन and एना, Ved. instr. of इदम्, q.v.… · 3. एन (cf. एण), a stag. See अन्-एन.…

एना.en: {{Lbody=40113}} · / ind. here, there… · in this manner, thus… · then, at that time, RV.; AV.… · / (एना/ पर/स् ind. further on RV. x, 27, 21; 31, 8; पर/ एना/ ind. beyond here; there; beyond [with instr.] RV. x, 125, 8; य/त्र — एना/, whither — thither.)…

एर्.en: er (आ-√ ईर्), Caus. P. Ā. -ईरयति, -ते (pf. 3. pl. ए/रिरे and e/rire) to bring near, cause to obtain, procure, RV.; AV.; VS.; <div n="to"/>to procure for one's self, obtain, RV. i, 6, 4; iii, 60, 3; <div n="to"/>to raise (as the voice in singing), RV. iii, 29, 15; x, 122, 2.

एरु.en: ए/रु mfn. (fr. आ-√ ईर्) = गन्तृ, T. (?), AV. vi, 22, 3.<listinfo n="sup"/> · (accord. to some, ‘the penis’).…

एल.en: and एलद n. a particular number (Buddh.)

एला.en: 1. एला f. any species of Cardamom, Suśr.; Kathās. · N. of a metre (consisting of four lines of fifteen syllables each)… · N. of a river, Hariv.… · (v.l. अर्ला.)… · 2. एला f. sport, pastime, merriness g. कण्ड्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 27.…

एव.en: 1. एव/ ind. (in the शṃहित्ā also एवा/) (√ इ, Uṇ. i, 152; fr. pronom. base ए, BRD., probably connected with 2. ए/व), so, just so, exactly so (in the sense of the later एवम्), RV.; AV. · indeed, truly, really (often at the beginning of a verse in conjunction with other particles, as इद्, हि), RV.… · (in its most frequent use of strengthening the idea expressed by any word, एव must be variously rendered by such adverbs as) just, exactly, very, same, only, even, alone, merely, immediately on, still, already, &c. (e.g. tvam eva yantA nAnyo 'sti pfTivyAm, thou alone art a charioteer, no other is on earth, i.e. thou art the best charioteer, MBh. iii, 2825; तावतीम् एव रात्रिम्, just so long as a night; एवम् एव or taTEva, exactly so, in this manner only; in the same manner as above; tenEva mantreRa, with the same ंअन्त्र as above; apaH spfzwvEva, by merely touching water; तान् एव, these very persons; न चिराद् एव, in no long time at all; japyenEva, by sole repetition; aBuktvEva, even without having eaten; इति वदन्न् एव, at the very moment of saying so; स जीवन्न् एव, he while still living, &c.……

एवम्.en: एव/म् ind. (fr. pronom. base ए, BRD.; probably connected with 1. एव/), thus, in this way, in such a manner, such, (it is not found in the oldest hymns of the Vएद, where its place is taken by 1. एव/, but occurs in later hymns and in the भ्र्āह्मṇअs, especially in connection with √ विद्, ‘to know’, and its derivatives [e.g. य एवं वेद, he who knows so; cf. एवं-वि/द्, col. 3]; in classical Sanskṛt एवम् occurs very frequently, especially in connection with the roots वच्, ‘to speak’, and श्रु, ‘to hear’, and refers to what precedes as well as to what follows [e.g. एवम् उक्त्वा, having so said <pb n="232,3"/>; evam evEtat, this is so; एवम् अस्तु or एवम् भवतु, be it so, I assent; अस्त्य् एवम्, it is so; यद्य् एवम्, if this be so; किम् एवम्, how so? what is the meaning of it? what does this refer t…

एवंरूप.en: एवं—रूप mf(आ)n. of such a form or kind, ŚBr.; MBh. &c.

एवंविध.en: एवं—विध mfn. of such a kind, in such a form or manner, such, MBh.; R.; Suśr. &c.

एवंविषय.en: एवं—विषय mfn. having such an object, referring to that Comm. on Mn.

एवंवृत्त.en: एवं—वृत्त and एवं—वृत्ति, mfn. acting or behaving in such a manner, of such a kind, Mn.; BhP. &c.

एवंगुण.en: एवं—गुण mfn. possessing such qualities or good qualities, MBh.; BhP. &c.

एवंजातीय.en: एवं—जातीय mfn. of such a kind or nature, such, Lāṭy.; Gobh.

एवमाचार.en: एवम्—आचार mfn. behaving or acting in such a manner, Gaut.

एवमात्मक.en: एवम्—आत्मक mf(इका)n. of such a nature, so conditioned, Pat.

एवमादि.en: एवम्—आदि and एवम्—आद्य, mfn. beginning with such a one, of such qualities or kind, such, Mn.; Śak. &c.

एवार.en: एवा/र m. (etym. doubtful) N. of a kind of शोम [Sāy.], RV. viii, 45, 38.

एष.en: 1. एष/ mfn. gliding, running, hastening, RV. · 2. एष/ (nom. m. of एत/द्, q.v.)… · 3. ए/ष mfn. (fr. √ 3. इष्) ifc. seeking, ŚBr. xiii… · ए/ष m. the act of seeking or going after, RV. x, 48, 9… · (एष/), wish, option, RV. i, 180, 4, (cf. svEza/)… · [cf. Zd. aêsha; O. H. G. ērā.]…

एषण.en: 1. ezaRa f(आ)n. impulse, ardent desire, BhP. · 2. ए/षण mfn. seeking for, wishing, Nir.… · ए/षण m. an iron arrow, L.… · ए/षण n. the act of seeking, begging, solicitation, MBh.… · medical examination, probing, Suśr.…

एष्टव्य.en: ezwa/vya mfn. (see above) to be striven after, desirable, wished for, ŚBr.; MBh. &c. · to be approved, Sarvad.…

एष्य.en: 1. ezya^ mfn. (see the last) to be striven after, to be sought for, AV. xii, 2, 39; 4, 16; TāṇḍyaBr. · 2. एष्य mfn. (fr. the Caus.), to be examined medically or probed, Suśr.… · 3. एष्य mfn. (√ इ fut.), what is to come, future, Sūryas.…

एषणा.en: ए/षणा f. seeking with, desire, begging, solicitation, request, ŚBr.; Pāṇ.; Rājat. &c. · (with झइनs) right behaviour when begging food, Sarvad. 39, 9…

एषितव्य.en: mfn. to be sought Comm. on Bādar. · to be approved Comm. on Nyāyam.…

एहि.en: 1. ehi (Impv. 2. sg. of आ-√ इ), come near! · 2. एहि m. N. of a man g. SArNgaravAdi, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 73.…

ऐ.en: 1. ऐ the twelfth vowel of the alphabet and having the sound of ei in height. · 2. ऐ ind. an interjection, MaitrS.… · a particle of addressing… · summoning… · remembering, L.… · 3. ऐ m. N. of Śइव, L.…

ऐक.en: mfn. (fr. एक), belonging or relating to one (?), g. gahAdi, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 138 (not in Kāś.)

ऐकपद्य.en: n. (see the last) unity of words, the state of being one word, Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 1, 25.

ऐकरूप्य.en: n. (fr. एक-रूप), the being of one sort, identity, Sāh.

ऐकस्वर्य.en: n. (fr. एक-स्वर), the state of having but one accent (as of a compound), Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 1, 25 · sameness of tone, monotony, ŚāṅkhŚr.…

ऐकाग्र्य.en: n. (fr. ekAgra), intentness or concentration on one object, MBh.; BhP.; Vedāntas.

ऐकाङ्ग.en: m. (fr. ekANga), a soldier who acts as body-guard, Rājat.

ऐकात्म्य.en: n. (fr. ekAtman), unity of the soul, unity of being, oneness, identity, MBh.; BhP. · oneness with the Supreme Spirit, L.…

ऐकान्तिक.en: mf(ई)n. (fr. ekAnta), absolute, necessary, complete, exclusive, BhP.; Suśr.; Sāṃkhyak. &c.

ऐकायन.en: m. a descendant of ऐक g. naqAdi, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 99.

ऐकाश्रम्य.en: n. the existence of one order only, Gaut. iii, 36 Comm. on Nyāyam.

ऐक्य.en: n. (fr. एक), oneness, unity, harmony, sameness, identity, MBh.; Ragh.; Sarvad. &c. · identity of the human soul or of the universe with the Deity, MW.… · an aggregate, sum, Sūryas.… · (in math.) the product of the length and depth of excavations differing in depth.…

ऐतदात्म्य.en: n. (fr. एतद्-आत्मन्), the state of having the nature or property of this, ChUp. vi, 8, 7; 16, 3 (= Vedāntas. 200).

ऐतर.en: mfn. (fr. इतर) g. saMkalAdi, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 75.

ऐतरेय.en: m. a descendant of ईतर or ईतर्ā, N. of ंअहिद्āस (author of a भ्र्āह्मṇअ and Āरṇयक called after him) · mfn. composed by आइतरेय.…

ऐतिह्य.en: ^ अम्, n. (fr. इति-ह), traditional instruction, tradition, TĀr. i, 2, 1; MBh.; R.

ऐदंयुगीन.en: mfn. (fr. इदम्-युग; g. pratijanAdi, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 99), suitable for or belonging to this ञुग or age Comm. on ChUp. i, 9, 1.

ऐध.en: / अम्, n. (fr. 2. एधस्, Sāy.), flame, splendour · ardour, power, RV. i, 166, 1.…

ऐन.en: m. pl. N. of a people, MBh. (ed. Calc.) xiii · (v.l. ऐल.)…

ऐन्द्र.en: / mf(ई)n. (fr. इन्द्र), belonging to or sacred to ईन्द्र, coming or proceeding from ईन्द्र, similar to ईन्द्र, AV.; TS.; VS.; ŚBr.; Mn. &c. · / (अस्), m. (scil. भाग) that part of a sacrifice which is offered to ईन्द्र, R.… · / (अम्), n. the lunar mansion झ्येṣṭह्ā, VarBṛS.… · N. of several श्āमन्s… · of a country in भ्ह्āरतवर्ṣअ, VP.… · wild ginger, L.…

ऐन्द्रजालिक.en: mf(ई)n. familiar with or relating to magic, magical, Prab. · m. a juggler, magician, Kathās.; Ratnāv.…

ऐन्द्रि.en: m. a descendant of ईन्द्र · N. of झयन्त, Hariv.… · of आर्जुन, MBh.… · of the monkey-king Vāलिन्, L.… · a crow, Ragh. xii, 22.…

ऐन्द्रिय.en: mfn. (fr. इन्द्रिय), relating to the senses, sensual, BhP. Comm. on Nyāyad. · n. sensual pleasure, world of senses, BhP.…

ऐन्द्रियक.en: mfn. relating to the senses, sensual, Car.; VP.

ऐन्य.en: m. (with इन्द्रस्य), N. of a श्āमन्, ĀrṣBr.

ऐर.en: / mfn. (fr. इ/रा), relating to or consisting of water or refreshment or food, TS. ii; TāṇḍyaBr. Comm. on ChUp. viii, 5, 3 · / (अम्), n. a heap or plenty of food or refreshment… · (with मदीय) N. of a lake in भ्रह्मन्'s world, ChUp. viii, 5, 3.…

ऐरावत.en: / अस्, m. (fr. इरा-वत्), a descendant of ईर्ā-वत् · N. of a ङ्āग or mythical serpent, AV. viii, 10, 29; TāṇḍyaBr.; MBh.; Hariv. &c.… · ‘produced from the ocean’, N. of ईन्द्र's elephant (considered as the prototype of the elephant race and the supporter of the east quarter; cf. नाग, which means also elephant and serpent), MBh.; Ragh.; Megh. &c.… · a species of elephant, R. ii, 70, 23… · the tree Artocarpus Lacucha… · the orange tree, L.… · N. of a particular portion of the moon's path… · of a form of the sun, VP.; MBh.… · / (अस्, अम्), m. n. a kind of rainbow, MBh.; Ragh. &c.… · / f(ई, आ). a particular portion of the moon's path (including the lunar mansions फुनर्वसु, फुṣय, and Āśलेṣअ), VarBṛS.… · / (अम्), n. the fruit of Artocarpus Lacucha, Suśr.… · N. of a Vअर्ṣअ, MBh.…

ऐरिण.en: n. (fr. इरिण), fossil or rock salt, L. · N. of a श्āमन्.…

ऐल.en: m. (fr. इला = इडा), a descendant of ईल्ā, N. of फुर्ūरवस् (cf. 1. ऐड/), Hariv.; MBh. · N. of the planet Mars, T.… · m. pl. the descendants or family of फुर्ūरवस्, MBh. xiii… · n. plenty or abundance of food or refreshment… · a particular number (Buddh.)…

ऐला.en: f. N. of a river (v.l. एला), Hariv.

ऐश.en: mfn. (fr. ईश), relating to or coming from Śइव, Śइव-like, BhP.; AgP.; Ragh. · divine, supreme, regal.…

क.en: 1. क the first consonant of the alphabet, and the first guttural letter (corresponding in sound to k in keep or king). · 2. क/ कस्, का, किम्, interrog. pron. (see किम् and 2. कद्, and cf. the following words in which the interrogative base क appears, कतम, कतर, कति, कथम्, कदा, कर्हि, का, &c.), who? which? what? In its declension क follows the pronoun तद् except in nom. acc. sing. neut., where किम् has taken the place of कद् or कत् in classical Sanskṛt; but the old form कद् is found in the Vएद (see Gram. 227);… · [cf. Zd. ka, kô, kâ, kat; Gk. πόθεν, πῶς, (Ion. κόθεν, κῶς), τίς, τί; Lat. quis, quid; Lith. kas ká; Goth. hvas, hvô, hva, Angl.Sax. hwā, hwaet; Eng. who, what.]… · The interrogative sentence introduced by क is often terminated by इति (e.g. कस्य स पुत्र इति कथ्यताम्, let it be said, ‘whose son is he?’), but इति may be omitted and the sentence lose its direct interrogative character (e.g. कस्य स पुत्रो न ज्ञायते, it is not known whose son he is). क with or without √ 1. अस् may express ‘how is it possible that?’ ‘what power have I, you, they, &c.?’ (e.g. के मम धन्विनोऽन्ये, what can the other archers do against me? के आवाम् परित्रातुम्, what power have we to rescue you?) क is …

कतम.en: / (अस्), (आ), (अत्), mfn. (superlative of 2. क; declined as a pronom., Gram. 236), who or which of many? (e.g. कतमेन पथा यातास् ते, by which road have they gone?) · it is often a mere strengthened substitute for क, the superlative affix imparting emphasis… · hence it may occasionally be used for ‘who or which of two?’ (e.g. तयोः कतमस्मै, to which of these two?)… · it may optionally be compounded with the word to which it refers (e.g. कतमः कठः, or कतम-कठः, which खṭह out of many?)… · when followed by च and preceded यतम an indefinite expression is formed equivalent to ‘any whosoever’, ‘any whatsoever’, &c. (e.g. यतमद् एव कतमच् च विद्यात् he may know anything whatsoever). In negative sentences कतम with चन or कतम with अपि = not even one, none at all (e.g. na katamaccanAhaH, not even on a single day, on no day at all)…

कतर.en: / (अस्, आ, अत्), mfn. (comparative of 2. क; declined as a pronom., Gram. 236), who or which of two? whether of two? Analogously to कतम above कतर may occasionally be used to express ‘who or which of many?’ (e.g. कतरस्यां दिशि, in which quarter?), and may optionally be compounded with the word to which it refers (e.g. कतरः कठः or कतर-कठः) · in negative sentences कतर with चन = neither of the two (e.g. न कतरश्-चन जिग्ये), neither of the two was conquered, RV. &c.;… · [cf. Zd. katāra; Gk. πότερος, κότερος; Goth. hvathar; Eng. whether; Lat. uter; Old Germ. huedar; Slav. kotoryi.]…

कति.en: 1. क/ति (fr. 2. क declined in pl. only, Gram. 227 a; all the cases except the nom. voc. and acc. taking terminations, whereas the correlative इति has become fixed as an indeclinable adverb), how many? quot? several (e.g. कति देवाः, how many gods? कति व्यापादयति कति वा ताडयति, some he kills and some he strikes). In the sense of ‘several’, ‘some’, कति is generally followed by चिद् or अपि (e.g. कतिचिद् अहानि, for several or some days) · it may be used as an adverb with चिद् in the sense of ‘oftentimes’, ‘much’, ‘in many ways’ (e.g. कतिचित् स्तुतः, much or often praised), RV. &c.;… · [cf. Zd. caiti; Gk. πόστος; Lat. quot; cf. Sk. तति and Lat. tot.]… · 2. कति (for 1. See above) m. N. of a sage (son of Vइśव्ā-मित्र and ancestor of ख्āत्य्āयन), Hariv.…

कर्मकारक.en: कर्म—कारक mfn. one who does any act or work.

कर्मकाल.en: कर्म—काल m. the proper time for action

कर्मकृत्.en: कर्म—कृ/त् mfn. performing any work, skilful in work, AV. ii, 27, 6; VS. iii, 47; TBr. &c. (cf. तीक्ष्ण-क्˚) · one who has done any work, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 89… · कर्म—कृ/त् m. (त्) a servant, workman, labourer, Rājat.; Kām. &c.…

कर्मक्षय.en: कर्म—क्षय m. annihilation or termination of all work or activity, ŚvetUp.

कर्मचोदना.en: कर्म—चोदना f. the motive impelling to ritual acts, W.

कर्मज.en: कर्म—ज mfn. ‘act-born’, resulting or produced from any act (good or bad), Mn. xii, 3 and 101; Daś. &c. · कर्म—ज m. Ficus religiosa… · the खलियुग (q.v.)… · a god, L.…

कर्मज्ञ.en: कर्म—ज्ञ mfn. skilled in any work · acquainted with religious rites, W.…

कर्मत्व.en: कर्म—त्व n. the state or effect of action &c., Car.; Sarvad. &c. · activity… · the state of being an object Comm. on TPrāt.…

कर्मत्याग.en: कर्म—त्याग m. abandonment of worldly duties or ceremonial rites, W.

कर्मदेव.en: क/र्म—देव (क/र्म˚) m. a god through religious actions (ye 'gnihotrAdiSrOtakarmaRA devalokaM prApnuvanti te karmadevAH Comm. on ŚBr. xiv, 7, 1, 35), ŚBr.; TUp. &c.

कर्मनिबन्ध.en: कर्म—निबन्ध m. necessary consequence of works.

कर्मनिवृत्ति.en: कर्म—निवृत्ति f. the end of a rite, ĀpGṛ.

कर्मनिष्ठ.en: कर्म—निष्ठ mfn. (Ved. -निष्ठा/) diligent in religious actions, engaged in active duties, RV. x, 80, 1; Mn. iii, 134 · कर्म—निष्ठ m. a <ns>Brāhman</ns> who performs sacrifices &c., W.…

कर्मफल.en: कर्म—फल n. the fruit or recompense of actions (as pain, pleasure &c., resulting from previous acts or acts in a former life), Āp. · the fruit of Averrhoa Carambola, L.…

कर्मफलहेतु.en: कर्म—फल-हेतु mfn. one who is actuated by the (thought of the) result of his acts, Bhag.

कर्मबन्ध.en: कर्म—बन्ध m. the bonds of action (i.e. transmigration or repeated existence as a result of actions), Bhag. ii, 39.

कर्मबन्धन.en: कर्म—बन्धन n. id. · कर्म—बन्धन mfn. bound by bonds of actions (as worldly existence), Bhag.…

कर्मबीज.en: कर्म—बीज n. the seed of works.

कर्मभू.en: कर्म—भू f. tilled or cultivated ground, L.

कर्ममार्ग.en: कर्म—मार्ग m. the course of acts, activity, VP. vi, 6, 9 · the way of work (a term used by thieves for a breach in walls &c.), Mṛcch.…

कर्मयोग.en: कर्म—योग m. performance of a work or business (esp. of religious duties), Bhag.; Mn. &c. · active exertion, industry… · agriculture and commerce [Kull.], Mn. x, 115… · practical application, Sarvad.… · connection with a sacrifice, KātyŚr.; Lāṭy.; Āp.…

कर्मवत्.en: कर्म—वत् mfn. busy with or employed in any work, MBh.

कर्मवश.en: कर्म—वश m. the necessary influence of acts, fate (considered as the inevitable consequence of actions done in a former life) · कर्म—वश mfn. being in the power of or subject to former actions, MBh. xiii.…

कर्मविधि.en: कर्म—विधि m. rule of actions or observances, mode of conducting ceremonies, Mn.

कर्मविपाक.en: कर्म—विपाक m. ‘the ripening of actions’ i.e. the good or evil consequences in this life of human acts performed in previous births (eighty-six consequences are spoken of in the Śāत्āतप-स्म्ṛति), MBh.; Yājñ. &c. · N. of several works…

कर्मविशेष.en: कर्म—विशेष m. variety of acts or actions, W.

कर्मसङ्ग.en: कर्म—सङ्ग m. attachment to action, Bhag.

कर्मसङ्गिन्.en: कर्म—सङ्—˚गिन् mfn. attached to action, ib.

कर्मसाधन.en: कर्म—साधन n. implement, means · articles essential to the performance of any religious act.…

कर्मसिद्धि.en: कर्म—सिद्धि f. accomplishment of an act, success, Mālav.; Kum.

कर्मस्थ.en: कर्म—स्थ mfn. contained or being in the object.

कर्महेतु.en: कर्म—हेतु mfn. caused by acts, arising from acts.

कर्माङ्ग.en: karmANga n. part of any act, part of a sacrificial rite.<listinfo n="sup"/> · a partic. Śर्āद्द्ह, RTL. 305…

कर्मात्मन्.en: karmAtman mfn. one whose character is action, endowed with principles of action, active, acting, Mn. i, 22 & 53; Tattvas. &c.

कर्माधिकार.en: karmADikAra m. the right of action, MW.

कर्माध्यक्ष.en: karmADyakza m. overseer or superintendent of actions, ŚvetUp. vi, 11.

कर्मानुरूप.en: karmAnurUpa mfn. according to action, according to function or duty, W.

कर्मानुष्ठान.en: karmAnuzWAna n. the act of practising one's duties, discharging peculiar functions, W.

कर्मान्त.en: karmAnta m. end or accomplishment of a work, Mṛcch.; Subh. · end or conclusion of a sacred action, SāmavBr.; Karmapr.… · work, business, action, management, administration (of an office), MBh.; Mn.; Yājñ. &c.… · tilled or cultivated ground, L.…

कर्मान्तर.en: karmAntara n. interval between religious actions, suspense of such an action, MBh.; R. · another work or action, BhP. x, 9, 1; Nyāyam. &c.…

कर्माभ्यास.en: kar—˚mAByAsa m. the performance of a sacred rite, Āpast.

कर्मारम्भ.en: karmAramBa m. commencement of any act, W.

कर्माशय.en: karmASaya m. receptacle or accumulation of (good and evil) acts, Sarvad. Comm. on Bādar. · on Nyāyad. &c.…

कर्मेन्द्रिय.en: karmendriya n. an organ of action (five in number like the five organs of sense, viz. hand, foot, larynx, organ of generation, and excretion), MBh.; Mn. ii, 91; Vedāntas. 91, &c.

कर्मक.en: ifc. = कर्मन्, work, action &c. (cf. अ-क्˚, स-क्˚, &c.)

कर्मणि.en: / mfn. connected with or being in the action, ŚBr. vi, 6, 4, 9.

कर्मश.en: m. N. of a son of फुलह (= कर्म-श्रेष्ठ), VP.

कर्मार.en: कर्मा/र m. an artisan, mechanic, artificer · a blacksmith &c., RV. x, 72, 2; AV. iii, 5, 6; VS.; Mn. iv, 215 &c.… · a bamboo, L.… · Averrhoa Carambola, L.…

कर्मिन्.en: mfn. acting, active, busy · performing a religious action, engaged in any work or business, ĀśvŚr.; MBh.; BhP. &c.… · belonging or relating to any act, W.… · m. performer of an action, Sarvad.… · labourer, workman, VarBṛS.… · Butea frondosa, Nigh.…

(√ कृष्), the act of drawing, dragging, Pāṇ. · (with and without हलस्य) ploughing, agriculture, Āp.; Yājñ. ii, 217… · ‘anything scratched off’, see क्षाम-कर्ष-मिश्र/… · m. n. a weight of gold or silver (= 16 ंāṣअs = 80 <ns>Rettis</ns> = 1/4 फल = 1/400 of a थुल्ā = about 176 grains troy; in common use 8 <ns>Rettis</ns> are given to the ंāṣअ, and the खर्ṣअ is then about 280 grains troy), Suśr.; VarBṛS. &c.… · Terminalia Bellerica (also called अक्ष, q.v.), L.… · a boat, L.…

(v.l.)… · drawing out, pulling off… · tugging, pulling (cf. केश-क्˚), drawing to and fro, removing, hurting, injuring, tormenting, Mn. vii, 112; MBh.; Suśr. &c.… · drawing back, bending (a bow), Ragh. xi, 46 (cf. धनुष्-क्˚)… · prolonging (a sound), SaṃhUp.… · ploughing, cultivating the ground, Mn. iv, 5; MBh.; BhP.… · cultivated land, MBh. iii, 10082… · erroneous for कर्शन, q.v., Car.…

(etym. doubtful) indistinct, dumb, BṛĀrUp.; ChUp.<listinfo n="sup"/> · (ifc., बाष्प, or अश्रु preceding) indistinct or inarticulate (on account of tears), MBh.; R. &c.… · low, soft (as a tone), emitting a soft tone, melodious (as a voice or throat), R.; BhP.; Vikr. &c.… · a kind of faulty pronunciation of vowels, Pat.… · weak, crude, undigested, L.… · m. (scil. स्वर) a low or soft and inarticulate tone (as humming, buzzing &c.), L.… · Shorea robusta, L.… · (in poetry) time equal to four ंāत्रs or instants, W.… · m. N. of a poet, Subh.… · m. pl. a class of manes, MBh.… · n. semen virile, L.… · Zizyphus Jujuba…

(etym. doubtful) a small part of anything, any single part or portion of a whole, esp. a sixteenth part, RV. viii, 47, 17; TS.; ŚBr.; Mn. &c.… · a digit or one-sixteenth of the moon's diameter, Hit.; Kathās.… · (personified as a daughter of खर्दम and wife of ंअर्īचि, BhP.)… · a symbolical expression for the number sixteen, Hcat.… · interest on a capital (considered as a certain part of it), Śiś. ix, 32… · a division of time (said to be 1/900 of a day or 1.6 minutes, Mn. i, 64; Hariv.; or 1/1800 of a day or 0.8 minutes, Comm. on VP.; or 2 minutes and 26 54/201 seconds, Suśr.; or 1 minute and 35 205/301 seconds, or 8 seconds, BhavP.);… · the sixtieth part of one-thirtieth of a zodiacal sign, a minute of a degree, Sūryas.… · (in prosody) a syllabic instant…

कलक.en: m. a sort of fish, L. · a kind of prose, L.… · n. the root of Andropogon Muricatus, L.…

कलञ्ज.en: m. Calamus Rotang · tobacco… · a particular weight (= 10 ण्ūपकs), Bhpr.… · an animal (struck with a poisonous weapon), L.… · n. the flesh of such an animal, Nyāyam.…

कलत्र.en: n. a wife, consort, MBh.; Bhartṛ.; Hit. &c. · the female of an animal, Vikr.… · the hip and loins, L.… · pudendum muliebre, L.… · a royal citadel, a stronghold or fastness, W.… · (in astron.) the seventh lunar mansion, VarBṛ.…

कलभ.en: m. (√ 3. कल्, Uṇ. iii, 122), a young elephant (one thirty years old), Ragh.; Mṛcch.; Pañcat. &c. · a young camel, Pañcat. iv… · Datura Fastuosa (= धुस्तूर), L.…

कलम.en: m. (√ 1. कल्, Uṇ. iv, 84), a sort of rice (sown in May and June and ripening in December or January), Suśr.; Ragh. &c. · a reed for writing with;… · [cf. Lat. calamus; Gk. κάλαμος; and Arab. <arab>قلم</arab>]… · a thief, L.…

(the breasts of a woman are frequently compared to jars, cf. स्तन-क्˚ and कुम्भ) · कल/श m. a butter-tub, churn, MBh.… · a particular measure (= द्रोण), ŚārṅgS.… · a round pinnacle on the top of a temple (esp. the pinnacle crowning a <ns>Buddhist</ns> छइत्य or श्त्ūप), Kād.… · N. of a man, RV. x, 32, 9… · of a poet… · of a ङ्āग, MBh. v… · [cf. Gk. κάλιξ; Lat. calix.]…

कलह.en: 1. कलह m. (n., L.) strife, contention, quarrel, fight, MBh.; Mn. &c. · the sheath of a sword, L.… · a road, way, W.… · deceit, falsehood, W.… · violence without murderous weapons, abuse, beating, kicking, W.… · 2. कलह Nom. P. कलहति, to quarrel, MBh. xii, 5349.…

कलाप.en: kalA˚pa m. (kalApa, fr. √ आप्) ‘that which holds single parts together’, a bundle, band (cf. जटा-क्˚, मुक्ता-क्˚, रशना-क्˚), MBh.; Kum. &c. · a bundle of arrows, a quiver with arrows, quiver, MBh.; R. &c.… · (once n., MBh. iii, 11454)… · a peacock's tail, MBh.; Pañcat. &c.… · an ornament in general, Mālav.… · a zone, a string of bells (worn by women round the waist), L.… · the rope round an elephant's neck, L.… · totality, whole body or collection of a number of separate things (esp. ifc.; cf. क्रिया-क्˚, &c.)… · the moon, L.… · a clever and intelligent man, L.… · N. of a grammar also called ख्āतन्त्र (supposed to be revealed by ख्āर्त्तिकेय to Śअर्ववर्मन्)… · N. of a village (cf. कलाप-ग्राम), VP.… · a poem written in one metre, W.… · kalApa &c. See कला.…

कलाय.en: m. a sort of pea or pulse, MBh.; Suśr. &c. · a kind of plant with dark-coloured flowers, Śiś. xiii, 21…

कलाया.en: f. a species of ध्ūर्व्ā-grass, L.

कलि.en: क/लि m. (√ 1. कल् Comm. on Uṇ. iv, 117), N. of the die or side of a die marked with one dot, the losing die, AV. vii, 109, 1; ŚBr. &c. (personified as an evil genius in the episode of ङल) · symbolical expression for the number 1… · Terminalia Bellerica (the nuts of which in older times were used as dice), L.… · N. of the last and worst of the four ञुगs or ages, the present age, age of vice, AitBr.; Mn. i, 86; ix, 301 f.; MBh. &c. (the खलि age contains, inclusive of the two dawns, 1200 years of the gods or 432,000 years of men, and begins the eighteenth of February, 3102 B.C.; at the end of this ञुग the world is to be destroyed; see युग)… · strife, discord, quarrel, contention (personified as the son of क्रोध, ‘Anger’, and हिंसा, ‘Injury’, and as generating with his sister दुरुक्ति, ‘Calumny’, two children, viz. भय, ‘Fear’, and मृत्यु, ‘Death’, BhP. iv, 8, 3; 4), MBh.; Hit. &c.…

कलिङ्ग.en: m. pl. N. of a people and their country (the N. is applied in the फुर्āṇअs to several places, but especially signifies a district on the Coromandel coast, extending from below Cuttack [खṭअक] to the vicinity of Madras), MBh.; Hariv.; VP. &c. · m. an inhabitant of खलिṅग, Sāh.… · N. of a king of खलिṅग (from whom the खलिṅग people are said to have originated; he is sometimes mentioned as a son of ध्īर्ग्हतमस् and शुदेṣṇā, sometimes identified with भलि), MBh.; Hariv. &c.… · N. of a being attending on श्कन्द, MBh. (ed. Bomb.) ix, 45, 64 (v.l. कलिन्द ed. Calc.)… · N. of several authors… · the fork-tailed shrike, L.… · Caesalpina Bonducella, L.… · Wrightia antidysenterica, L.… · Acacia Sirissa, L.… · Ficus infectoria, L.… · n. the seed of Wrightia antidysenterica, Suśr.…

कलिल.en: mfn. (√ 1. कल्, Uṇ. i, 55), mixed with, Śiś. xix, 98 · full of, covered with, MBh.; BhP. &c.… · impenetrable, impervious… · n. a large heap, thicket, confusion, ŚvetUp.; Bhag. &c.…

कलुषीकृ.en: कलुषी-√ कृ to make turbid or unclean, dirty, defile, MBh.; R.; Prabh. &c.

कलुषित.en: mfn. foul, impure, W. · defiled, contaminated, W.… · wicked, W.…

कल्प.en: 1. क/ल्प mf(आ)n. (√ कॢप्), practicable, feasible, possible, ŚBr. ii, 4, 3, 3 · proper, fit, able, competent, equal to (with gen. loc., inf., or ifc.; e.g. धर्मस्य कल्पः, competent for duty; स्वकर्मणि न कल्पः, not competent for his own work; यदा न शासितुं कल्पः, if he is not able to rule), BhP.… · क/ल्प m. a sacred precept, law, rule, ordinance (= विधि, न्याय), manner of acting, proceeding, practice (esp. that prescribed by the Vएदs), RV. ix, 9, 7; AV. viii, 9, 10; xx, 128, 6-11; MBh.… · (प्रथमः कल्पः, a rule to be observed before any other rule, first duty, Mn. iii, 147; MBh. &c.; एतेन कल्पेन, in this way; cf. पशु-क्˚, &c.)… · the most complete of the six Vएद्āṅगs (that which prescribes the ritual and gives rules for ceremonial or sacrificial acts), MuṇḍUp.; Pāṇ. &c.…

कल्पम्.en: ind., may be also connected with a verb, e.g. पचति-कल्पम्, he cooks pretty well, Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 1, 57

कल्पक्षय.en: कल्प—क्षय m. the end of a खल्प, destruction of the world, Kathās.

कल्पमात्र.en: कल्प—मात्र m. N. of Śइव, MBh. xii, 10368.

कल्पादि.en: kalpAdi m. the beginning of a खल्प, W.

कल्पान्त.en: kalpAnta m. the end of a खल्प, dissolution of all things, L. (cf. प्रलय)

कार्यकारण.en: कार्य—कारण n. a particular or special cause (तत्-कार्य-कारणात्, in consequence of that), Pañcat.; Kathās.

कार्यकारणत्व.en: कार्य—कारण—त्व n. the state of both cause and effect, Sarvad.

कार्यकारणभाव.en: कार्य—कारण—भाव m. state or relation of cause and effect.

कार्यता.en: कार्य—ता f. the being an effect, the relation or state of an effect, KapS.

कार्यत्व.en: कार्य—त्व n. id., BhP.; Vedāntas.; Sāh.

कार्यार्थ.en: kAryArTa m. the object of a business or enterprise · any object or purpose… · application for employment…

कावष.en: n. (fr. कव/ष्), N. of a श्āमन्.

किम्.en: कि/म् ind. (fr. 1. कि, originally nom. and acc. sg. n. of 2. क/, q.v.), what? how? whence? wherefore? why? · is much used as a particle of interrogation like the Lat. num, an, sometimes translatable by ‘whether?’ but oftener serving only like a note of interrogation to mark a question (e.g. किं व्याधा वने ऽस्मिन् संचरन्ति, ‘do hunters roam about in this wood?’ In an interrogation the verb, if uncompounded with a preposition, generally retains its accent after किम्, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 44). To this sense may be referred the किम् expressing inferiority, deficiency, &c. at the beginning of compounds (e.g. किं-राजन्, what sort of king? i.e. a bad king, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 64; v, 4, 70)… · also the किम् prefixed to verbs with a similar meaning (e.g. kim-aDIte, he reads badly, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 44,Kāś.) किम्—उत, or किम्—उत-वा or किम्—अथवा—उत, whether—or—or, R.; Śak.; Bhartṛ. &c. Ā. कूनाति or कुनाति, कूनाते or कुनाते (perf. 3. pl. चुकुवुर्, Bhaṭṭ.), <div n="to"/>to sound, make any noise, cry out, moan, cry (as a bird), coo, hum (as a bee) &c., Bhaṭṭ. : cl. 1. क/वते, to move, Naigh. ii, 14 : <div n="vp"/>Intens. Ā. कोकूयते (Nir.; Pāṇ.), P. Ā. कोकवीति and चोकूयते (Pāṇ. vii, 4, 63, Kāś.), <div n="to"/>to cry aloud, Bhaṭṭ.; <div n="vp"/> [cf. Gk. κωκύω.] · 2. कू/ ind. (= क्व/) where? RV. v, 74, 1.… · 3. कू f. a female फिśāच or goblin, L.…

कूजित.en: mfn. uttered inarticulately, cooed, &c., Vikr. &c. · filled with monotonous sounds, &c., R. iii, 78, 27; Vet.… · n. the cry of a bird, cooing, warbling, cackling, &c., R.; Mālav.; Vikr. &c.…

कूट.en: कू/ट n. the bone of the forehead with its projections or prominences, horn, RV. x, 102, 4; AV.; ŚBr.; AitBr. · a kind of vessel or implement, Kauś. 16… · कू/ट m. n. any prominence or projection (e.g. अंस-क्˚, अक्षि-क्˚, qq.vv.)… · summit, peak or summit of a mountain, MBh. &c.… · summit, head i.e. the highest, most excellent, first, BhP. ii, 9, 19… · a heap, multitude (e.g. अभ्र-क्˚, a multitude of clouds), MBh.; R.; BhP.… · part of a plough, ploughshare, body of a plough, L.… · an iron mallet, MBh. xvi, 4, 6… · a trap for catching deer, concealed weapon (as a dagger in a wooden case, sword-stick, &c.), R.; Pañcat.… · (अस्, L.; अम्) illusion, fraud, trick, untruth, falsehood, L.… · a puzzling question, enigma, BhP. vi, 5, 10 and 29… · कू/ट m. a kind of hall (= मण्डप), Hcat.…

कूटसाक्ष्य.en: कूट—साक्ष्य n. a false testimony, HYog. ii, 54.

कूटस्थ.en: कूट—स्थ mfn. standing at the top, keeping the highest position Comm. on ŚBr. i, 4, 2, 4 · standing in a multitude of or in the midst of (in comp.), BhP. i, 11, 36… · (in phil.) immovable, uniform, unchangeable (as the soul, spirit, space, ether, sound, &c.), Up.; Pat.; Bhag. vi, xii; BhP. iii, &c. (Pāli. kūṭaṭṭha, <ns>Sāmaññaphala-sutta</ns>)… · कूट—स्थ m. n. a kind of perfume (a species of dried shell-fish, commonly Nathi), L.… · कूट—स्थ n. the soul, W.…

कूटस्थत्व.en: कूट—स्थ—त्व n. id. Comm. on KapS.

कूप.en: कू/प m. (fr. 1. कु and अ/प्?; cf. अनूप/, द्वीप/), a hole, hollow, cave, RV. i, 105, 17; AV.; ŚBr. &c. · a pit well, ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Mn.; Mṛcch. &c.… · a post to which a boat or ship is moored, L.… · a mast, L.… · a tree or rock in the midst of a river, L.… · a leather oil vessel, L.… · = मृन्-मान, L.…

कूर्च.en: / m. rarely n. (g. arDarcAdi) a bunch of anything, bundle of grass, &c. (often used as a seat), TS. vii; ŚBr. &c. · a fan, brush, NarasP.… · a handful of खुśअ grass or peacock's feathers Comm. on MBh.… · (अस्), m. (अम्, n., L.) ‘ball, roll’, N. of certain parts of the human body (as the hands, feet, neck, and the membrum virile), Suśr.… · / m. n. the upper part of the nose (the part between the eyebrows), L.… · (अस्, L.; अम्) the beard, Kād.; Rājat.; BhavP.… · (beard of a buck) Comm. on KātyŚr.… · (Prākṛt kucca), Śak.… · the tip of the thumb and middle finger brought in contact so as to pinch &c., W.… · deceit, fraud, hypocrisy, L.… · false praise, unmerited commendation either of one's self or another person, boasting, flattery, L.… · hardness, solidity, L.… · / (अस्), m. the head, L.…

कूर्म.en: / अस्, m. a tortoise, turtle, VS.; TS. &c. (ifc. f(आ). , MBh. iv, 2016) · the earth considered as a tortoise swimming on the waters (see -विभाग)… · (hence) N. of the fourteenth आद्ह्य्āय of VarBṛS.; VarYogay. ix, 4… · a particular figure or intertwining of the fingers (मुद्रा), Tantras.… · one of the outer winds of the body (causing the closing of the eyes), Vedāntas.… · N. of a deity, Rasik.… · of a serpent or ख्āद्रवेय king, MBh. i, 2549… · of a Ṛṣइ (son of घ्ṛत्स-मद, author of RV. ii, 27-29), RAnukr.… · Vइṣṇउ's second incarnation (descent in the form of a tortoise to support the mountain ंअन्दर at the churning of the ocean), NarasP. &c.… · [cf. κλέμμυς, χέλυς, χελώνη.]…

कूर्माङ्ग.en: kUrmANga n. the globe of the earth, VarYogay.

कूल.en: कू/ल n. a declivity, slope, RV. viii, 47, 11 · a shore, bank, ŚBr. xiv; Nir.; Mn. &c. (ifc. Pāṇ. vi, 2, 121; 129 & 135; f(आ). , MBh. xiv, 1163)… · a heap, mound, tope, Car.… · a pond or pool, L.… · the rear of an army, L.… · N. of a locality g. DUmAdi… · [cf. अज-कूला, अनु-कूल, उत्-क्˚ &c.; cf. also Hib. cul, ‘custody, guard, defence, back part of anything’; col, ‘an impediment’; Lat. collis?]…

कूलभू.en: कूल—भू f. a bank, land upon the bank or shore, L.

कूल्य.en: कू/ल्य mfn. belonging to a bank, VS. xvi, 42.

कृ.en: 1. कृ Ved. I) cl. 2. P. 2. sg. क/र्षि du. कृथ/स् pl. कृथ/; Ā. 2. sg. कृषे/; impf. 2. and 3. sg. अ/कर्, 3. sg. rarely अ/कत् (ŚBr. iii, xi) <pb n="301,1"/>; 3. du. अ/कर्ताम्; pl. अ/कर्म, अ/कर्त (also, BhP. ix), अ/क्रन् (aor., according to Pāṇ. iv, 2, 80, Kāś.); Ā. अ/क्रि (RV. x, 159, 4 and 174, 4), अ/कृथास् (RV. v, 30, 8), अ/कृत (RV.); अक्राताम् (ŚāṅkhŚr.), अ/क्रत (RV.; AV.) : Impv. कृधि/ (also, MBh. i, 5141 and BhP. viii), कृत/म्, कृत/; Ā. कृष्व/, कृध्व/म्; Subj. 2. and 3. sg. कर् pl. क/र्म, क/र्त and कर्तन, क्रन्; Ā. 3. sg. कृत (RV. ix, 69, 5), 3. pl. क्र/न्त (RV. i, 141, 3) : Pot. क्रियाम (RV. x, 32, 9); pr. p. P. (nom. pl.) क्र/न्तस् Ā. क्राण/. II) cl. 1. P. क/रसि, क/रति, क/रथस्, क/रतस्, क/रन्ति; Ā. क/रसे, क/रते, क/रामहे: impf. अ/करम्, अ/करस्, अ/करत् (aor., according to Pāṇ. iii, 1, 59)…

कृत्.en: 1. कृत् mfn. only ifc. (Pāṇ. vi, 1, 182) making, doing, performing, accomplishing, effecting, manufacturing, acting, one who accomplishes or performs anything, author (see सु-क्˚, कर्म-क्˚, पाप-क्˚, &c.) · m. an affix used to form nouns from roots, VPrāt.; Pāṇ. iii, 1, 93; 4, 67; vi, 1, 71; vii, 2, 8 and 11; 3, 33; viii, 4, 29… · a noun formed with that affix, Nir.; PārGṛ.; Gobh.; Pāṇ.… · 2. कृत् cl. 6. P. कृन्त/ति, ep. also Ā. ˚ते and cl. 1. P. कर्तति (perf. चकर्त, 2nd fut. कर्त्स्यति or कर्तिष्यति, 1st fut. कर्तिता, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 57 <pb n="304,3"/>; Subj. कृन्त/त्; aor. अकर्तीत्, Ved. 2. sg. अकृतस्), <div n="to"/>to cut, cut in pieces, cut off, divide, tear asunder, destroy, RV.; AV.; AitBr.; MBh. &c.: <div n="vp"/>Caus. कर्तयति id., Pañcat. : <div n="vp"/>Desid. चिकर्तिषति or चिकृत्सति, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 57; <div n="vp"/>…

कृत.en: 1. कृत/ mfn. done, made, accomplished, performed, RV.; AV. &c. · prepared, made ready, ib.… · obtained, gained, acquired, placed at hand, AV. iii, 24, 5… · well done, proper, good, ŚBr. iv… · cultivated, Mn. x, 114… · appointed (as a duty), Yājñ. ii, 186… · relating or referring to, Yājñ. ii, 210… · / (अस्), m. N. of one of the Vइśवे धेव्ās, MBh. xiii, 4356… · of a son of Vअसु-देव, BhP. ix, 24, 45… · of a son of शṃनति and pupil of ःइरṇय-न्āब्ह, Hariv. 1080; BhP. xii, 6, 80… · of a son of ख्ṛत-रत्ह and father of Vइबुद्ह, VP.… · of a son of झय and father of ःअर्यवन, BhP. ix, 17, 17… · of a son of छ्यवन and father of ऊपरि-चर, VāyuP.… · / (अम्), n. (with सह or with instr.) ‘done with’, away with, enough of, no need of, &c. (e.g. कृतं संदेहेन, away with doubt, Śak.; कृतं परिहासेन, enough of joking, ib.)…

कृते.en: / ind. on account of, for the sake of, for (with gen. or ifc., e.g. मम कृते or मत्-कृते, on my account, for me), Yājñ. i, 216; MBh.; R. &c. · loc. instr. ind. See s.v. कृत/.…

कृतेन.en: कृते/न (एन), ind. instr. id., MBh.; R. i, 76, 6 and vi, 85, 10. · loc. instr. ind. See s.v. कृत/.…

कृतकर.en: कृत—कर m. N. of Śइव, Gal.

कृतकर्तव्य.en: कृत—कर्तव्य mfn. one who has performed what was to be done, one who has done or discharged his duty, Prab.

कृतकार्य.en: कृत—कार्य n. an attained object, Śak. · कृत—कार्य mfn. one who has obtained his object, Yājñ. ii, 189; R.; Kathās.… · one who has no need of another person's aid (instr.), MBh. xiii, 3862…

कृतकाल.en: कृत—काल m. appointed time, Yājñ. ii, 184 · कृत—काल mfn. ‘fixed or settled as to time’, sent, deposited &c. for a certain time, Nār.… · one who has accomplished a certain time, who has waited a certain time, MBh. ii, 1875.…

कृतकृत्य.en: कृत—कृत्य n. what has been done and what is to be done, Up. · कृत—कृत्य mfn. one who has done his duty or accomplished a business, R.… · one who has attained any object or purpose, contented, satisfied with (loc. R. vii, 59, 3), AitUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.…

कृतकृत्यता.en: कृत—कृत्य—ता f. the full discharge of any duty or realisation of any object, accomplishment, success, Mn.; MBh.; KapS. &c.

कृतत्व.en: कृत—त्व n. the state of being effected, KātyŚr.; Jaim. iii, 4, 40.

कृतधर्म.en: कृत—धर्म m. ‘one who performs his duty’, N. of a man, VP.

कृतनिश्चय.en: कृत—निश्चय mfn. determined or resolved on (dat., loc. inf. or in comp.), R. iii, 50, 16; Bhag. ii, 37 &c. · resolute (as speech), Kād.… · one who has ascertained anything, sure, certain.…

कृतपुण्य.en: कृत—पुण्य mf(आ)n. one who has accomplished meritorious acts in a former life, happy, R.; MārkP.

कृतप्रयत्न.en: कृत—प्रयत्न mfn. one who makes effort, active, persevering, Pañcat. (= Hit.)

कृतप्रयोजन.en: कृत—प्रयोजन mfn. one who has attained his object, Kathās. xiii, 158.

कृतफल.en: कृत—फल mfn. ‘fruitful’, successful, W. · कृत—फल n. consequence of an act, result, W.… · N. of a poisonous substance, L.…

कृतबुद्धि.en: कृत—बुद्धि mfn. of formed mind, learned, wise, VarBṛS.; KapS. v, 50 · (अ-क्˚), Bhag. xviii, 16… · one who has made a resolution, resolved (with dat. [Vikr.] or inf. [Hariv.]), Mn. i, 97 (cf. MBh. v, 110) and vii, 30; Yājñ. i, 354; MBh. &c.… · informed of one's duty, one who knows how religious rites ought to be conducted, W.…

कृतवत्.en: कृत—वत् mfn. perf. p. P. √ कृ, one who has done or made anything · one who holds the stake at a game (?), Nir. v, 22…

कृतवती.en: कृत—वती (ती) f. N. of a river, VP.

कृतविद्य.en: कृत—विद्य mfn. one who has acquired knowledge, well informed, learned, MBh.; R.; Pañcat.

कृतश्रम.en: कृत—श्रम mfn. one who has made great exertions, painstaking, laborious (with loc. or ifc.), MBh.; R. &c. · कृत—श्रम m. N. of a ंउनि, MBh. ii, 109.…

कृतसंस्कार.en: कृत—संस्कार mfn. one who has performed all the purificatory rites, initiated, Mn. ix, 326; Ragh. x, 79 · prepared, adorned.…

कृताकृत.en: kftAkfta mfn. done and not done, done in part but not completed, MBh. xii, 6542 (= 9946) · prepared and not prepared, manufactured and not manufactured, MBh. xiii, 2794; Yājñ. i, 286… · optional, ĀśvŚr.; ĀśvGṛ.… · indifferent, MBh. xiii, 7612… · kftAkfta n. sg. and du. (अ/म्, ए/) what has been done and what has not been done, AV. xix, 9, 2; ŚBr. xiv, 7, 2, 27; KaṭhUp. ii, 14…

कृताग्नि.en: kftAgni m. N. of a son of खनक or ध्हनक, Hariv. 1850; BhP. ix, 23, 22.

कृताञ्जलि.en: kftAYjali mfn. one who joins the hollowed palms in reverence or to solicit a favour (holding the hollowed palms together as if to receive alms or an offering), standing in a reverent or respectful posture, Mn.; MBh.; R. · kftAYjali m. a shrub used in medicine and in magical potions, L.…

कृतातिथ्य.en: kftAtiTya mf(आ)n. one who has practised hospitality · one who has received hospitality, regaled, R. iii, 7, 1; Daś.…

कृतात्मन्.en: kftAtman mfn. one whose spirit is disciplined, MuṇḍUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.

कृताधिकार.en: kf—˚tADikAra mfn. superintending, watching over (loc.), Bcar.

कृतान्त.en: kftAnta mfn. causing an end, bringing to an end, leading to a decisive termination, BhP. ix, 6, 13 · whose end is action, W.… · kftAnta m. ‘the inevitable result of actions done in a past existence’, destiny, fate, R.; Pañcat.; Megh.; Vet.… · death personified, N. of ञम (god of death), MārkP.; Hit.… · a demonstrated conclusion, dogma, Bhag. xviii, 13… · a conclusion, MBh. xii, 218, 27… · (in Gr.) a fixed form or name (?), Pat. Introd. (on Vārtt. 1) and on Pāṇ. i, 1, 1, Vārtt. 4… · a sinful or inauspicious action, L.… · ‘closing the week’, Saturday, L.… · kftAnta &c. See कृत/.… · kftAnta kftArTa See p. 303, col. 2.…

कृताय.en: kftAya m. the die called ख्ṛत Comm. on ChUp. (in the text कृताय is dat. of ˚त).

कृतार्थ.en: kftArTa mf(आ)n. one who has attained an end or object or has accomplished a purpose or desire, successful, satisfied, contented, MuṇḍUp.; ŚvetUp.; MBh. &c. · clever Comm. on L.… · kftArTa m. v.l. for kftArGa, q.v.… · kftArTa &c. See कृत/.…

कृतार्थता.en: kftArTa—tA f. accomplishment of an object, success, Ragh. viii, 3; Gīt. v, 19; Kathās.

कृतावस्थ.en: kftAvasTa mfn. settled, received (as a guest), Āp.; Mn. viii, 60.

कृताश.en: kftASa mfn. one who forms hopes, hoping for anything [‘despairing’ Comm.] MBh. iii, 31, 37.

कृतक.en: mfn. artificial, factitious, done artificially, made, prepared, not produced spontaneously, Nir.; MBh. &c. · not natural, adopted (as a son), MBh. xiii, 2630; Megh.… · assumed, simulated, false, MBh.; Pañcat.; Ragh. xviii, 51 &c.… · m. N. of a son of Vअसु-देव, BhP. ix, 24, 47… · of a son of छ्यवन, VP.… · n. a kind of salt (= विड्-लवण), L.… · sulphate of copper, L.…

कृतकम्.en: ind. (अ- in comp.) in a simulated manner, Śiś. ix, 83; Kathās.

कृतय.en: Nom. P. ˚यति (aor. अचीकृतत् or अचक्˚, Vop.), to take the die called ख्ṛत, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 21.

कृति.en: 1. कृ/ति f. the act of doing, making, performing, manufacturing, composing, ŚBr. x; ChUp.; Pañcat., Kāś. &c. · action, activity, MBh. iii, 12480; Bhāṣāp.; Tarkas.… · creation, work, Vop.… · literary work, Mālav.; Ragh.; Pāṇ. vi, 2, 151, Kāś.… · a house of relics, Divyāv.… · ‘magic’, see -कर… · a witch (cf. कृत्या), Devīm.… · a kind of आनुṣṭउब्ह् metre (consisting of two फ्āदs of twelve syllables each and a third फ्āद of eight syllables), RPrāt.… · another metre (a stanza of four lines with twenty syllables in each), RPrāt.… · (hence) the number twenty, VarBṛ.… · a collective N. of the metres कृति, प्रक्˚, आक्˚, विक्˚, संक्˚, अभिक्˚, and उत्कृति… · a square number, VarBṛ.… · (in dram.) confirmation of any obtainment, Sāh.; Daśar.; Pratāpar.… · N. of the wife of शṃह्र्āद and mother of फñच-जन, BhP. vi, 18, 13…

कृतित्व.en: कृति-त्व n. the state of one who has attained any object, Kathās.

कृत्य.en: mfn. ‘to be done or performed’ · mfn. practicable, feasible, W.… · right, proper to be done, MBh.; R. &c.… · one who may be seduced from allegiance or alliance, who may be bribed or hired (as an assassin), Rājat. v, 247… · (in med.) to be treated or attended with (in comp.), Suśr.… · m. (scil. प्रत्यय) the class of affixes forming the fut. p. Pass. (as तव्य, अनीय, य, एलिम, &c.), Pāṇ.… · a kind of evil spirit (named either with or without the addition of यक्ष, मानुष, असुर, &c.), Buddh. (perhaps v.l. for ˚त्या below)… · (अम्), n. what ought to be done, what is proper or fit, duty, office, Mn.; R. &c.… · action, business, performance, service, Śak.; Sarvad. &c.… · purpose, end, object, motive, cause, MBh. &c.…

कृत्यम्.en: कृत्˚यम् ind. anybody (gen.) is concerned about (instr.), Mṛcch.

कृत्या.en: / (आ/), f. (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 100) action, act, deed, performance, achievement, AV. v, 9, 8; Mn. xi, 125; MBh. xii, 3837 · (with gen. रुजस्) ill usage or treatment, Mn. xi, 67… · magic, enchantment, AV. &c.… · (especially personified) a kind of female evil spirit or sorceress, RV. x, 85, 28 & 29; VS. &c.… · a female deity to whom sacrifices are offered for destructive and magical purposes, L.… · N. of a river, MBh. vi, 9, 18… · / f. of कृत्य, q.v.…

कृत्यता.en: कृत्य—ता f. seduction from allegiance or alliance, Suśr.

कृत्वन्.en: कृ/त्वन् mf(वरी)n. causing, effecting (ifc.), Lāṭy. · active, busy, RV. viii, 24, 25; ix, 65, 23; x, 144, 3… · कृ/त्वन् &c. See ib.…

कृत्वा.en: / ind.p. having done See s.v. √ 1. कृ.

क्रियमाण.en: mfn. (pr. Pass. p.) being done &c. · mfn. Pass. p. √ 1. कृ, q.v.…

कृक.en: m. the throat, larynx, L. (cf. कृ/काट) · the navel Comm. on Uṇ. i, 6.…

कृकल.en: m. (= ˚कर) a kind of partridge, R. vii, 53, 19 · one of the five vital airs…

कृकलास.en: / अस्, m. a lizard, chameleon, MaitrS.; VS.; ŚBr. &c.

क्री.en: 1. क्री cl. 9. P. Ā. क्रीणा/ति, क्रीणीते (fut. p. क्रेष्यत्, Lāṭy.; ind.p. क्रीत्वा/, AV.; Mn.), <div n="to"/>to buy, purchase (with instr. of the price, and abl. or gen. of the person from whom anything is bought, e.g. क/ इम/म् इन्द्रं दश/भिर् धेनु/भिर् म/म क्रीणाति, who will buy this ईन्द्र of me for ten cows? RV. iv, 24, 10; यम् माता-पित्रोर् अन्तिकात् [or सकाशात्] क्रीणीयात् whom he may buy from his father and mother, Mn. ix, 174; क्रीणीष्व तद् दशभिः सुवर्णैह्, buy that for ten सुवर्ṇअs) : <div n="vp"/>Caus. P. क्रापयति, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 48; · [cf. Hib. creanaim, ‘I buy, purchase’; Gk. πρίαμαι πέρνημι Lith. prekis, perku (?); Lat. pretium; Eng. hire.]… · 2. क्री See यव-क्री, सद्यः-क्री/…

क्शा.en: (Pāṇ. ii, 4, 54, Vārtt. 1) = √ ख्या, MaitrS.; Kāṭh. (see अनु-क्शाति &c.; xv, 5 : 2. du. Ā. चक्शाथे for चक्षाथे of the RV.); <div n="vp"/> accordingly √ क्शा is mentioned as forming some tenses of √ ख्या and √ चक्ष्, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 54, Kāś. (आ-क्शाता, आ-क्शातुम्, आ-क्शातव्य), Vop. ix, 37 f.

क्ष.en: 1. क्ष (fr. √ 1. or 2. क्षि) See द्युक्ष/ · m. a field, L.… · the protector or cultivator of a field, peasant, L.… · 2. क्ष mfn. (fr. √ 4. क्षि) See तुविक्ष/… · m. destruction, loss, L.… · destruction of the world, L.… · lightning, L.… · a demon or णक्ṣअस्, L.… · the fourth incarnation of Vइṣṇउ (as the man-lion or नर-सिṃह), L.…

क्षण.en: 1. क्षण m. any instantaneous point of time, instant, twinkling of an eye, moment, Nal.; Śak.; Ragh. &c. · a moment regarded as a measure of time (equal to thirty खल्ās or four minutes, L.; or (in astron.) to 48 minutes, VarBṛS. &c.; or 4/5 or 24/35 seconds, BhP. iii, 11, 7 and 8)… · a leisure moment, vacant time, leisure (e.g. क्षणं-√ कृ, to have leisure for, wait patiently for, MBh.; cf. कृत-क्षण)… · a fit or suitable moment, opportunity (क्षणं-√ कृ, to give an opportunity, MBh. iv, 666; cf. दत्त-क्षण and लब्ध-क्ष्˚)… · a festival, Megh.; Daś.; BhP. iii, 3, 21… · a certain day of the fortnight (as the full moon, change of the moon, &c.), Sarvad.… · dependence, L.… · the centre, middle, L.… · n. an instant, moment, Bhartṛ. (= Subh.)… · n. in a moment, Ragh. xii, 36; Śāntiś. (cf. तत्-क्षणम्)…

क्षणम्.en: क्ष˚णम् ind. acc. for an instant, R. vi, 92, 35; BrahmaP.; Vet. &c.

क्षणेन.en: ind. instr. in a moment, Nal.; R. &c.

क्षणात्.en: ind. abl. after an instant, immediately, at once, Mn.; R.; Śak. &c.

क्षणेषु.en: ind. immediately, at once, R. vi, 55, 19

क्षणद.en: क्षण—द m. an astrologer, L. · क्षण—द n. (= kzaRadAnDya) night-blindness, Suśr. vi, 17, 15… · water, L.…

क्षणभङ्ग.en: क्षण—भङ्ग m. (with, Buddh.) continual decay of things (denial of the continued identity of any part of nature, maintainment that the universe perishes and undergoes a new creation every instant), Sarvad.

क्षणभङ्गवाद.en: क्षण—भङ्ग—वाद m. the doctrine of the continual decay of things, Bādar. ii, 1, 18, Sch.

क्षणभङ्गुर.en: क्षण—भङ्गुर mf(आ)n. id., Bhartṛ.; Pañcat.; BhP.; Kām.; Hit.

क्षणमात्रेण.en: क्षण—मात्रेण ind. instr. in a mere moment, R. iv, 38, 36

क्षणान्तर.en: kzaRAntara n. ‘the interval of a moment’

क्षणान्तरे.en: kzaRAnta˚re ind. loc. after a little while, the next moment, thereupon, Pañcat.; Kathās.

क्षणिक.en: mf(ई)n. momentary, transient, Ragh.; Prab.; Bhāṣāp. &c. · having leisure, profiting of an opportunity, BhP. xi, 27, 44; Hit.…

क्षणिकता.en: क्षणिक—ता f. momentariness, continual decay and change of everything (cf. क्षण-भङ्ग), Bādar. ii, 2, 25, Sch.

क्षणिकवाद.en: क्षणिक—वाद m. = क्षण-भङ्ग-व्˚ (q.v.), Bādar. ii, 1, 18, Sch. (v.l.)

क्षत.en: क्षत, क्षति, क्षतिन्. See ib. · / mfn. wounded, hurt, injured, ŚBr. vi; Yājñ. &c.… · broken, torn, rent, destroyed, impaired, MBh. &c.… · diminished, trodden or broken down… · / (अम्), n. a hurt, wound, sore, contusion, MBh.; Suśr. &c.… · rupture or ulcer of the respiratory organs… · N. of the sixth astrological mansion, VarBṛ. i, 16.…

क्षत्तृ.en: / See √ क्षद्. · / त्ता, m. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 135, Vārtt. 6; vi, 4, 11) one who cuts or carves or distributes anything, RV. vi, 13, 2; AV.; ŚBr. xiii; ŚāṅkhŚr.… · an attendant, (especially) door-keeper, porter (cf. अनुक्ष्˚), AV. ix, 6, 49; VS. xxx, 13; TBr. &c.… · a chamberlain, Kathās. lii, 106 and 117… · a charioteer, coachman, VS. xvi, 26 (ŚatarUp. iv), ŚāṅkhŚr. xvi, 1, 16 (v.l. for क्षत्र)… · the son of a Śūद्र man and a ख्ṣअत्रिय woman (or the son of a ख्ṣअत्रिय man and a Śūद्र woman [called ऊग्र, Mn. x, 12] L.; or the son of a Śūद्र man and a Vअइśय woman [called Āयोगव, Mn. x, 12] Uṇ. ii, 90), Mn. x, 12-26 and 49; Yājñ. i, 94… · the son of a female slave, L.… · (hence) N. of Vइदुर (as the son of the celebrated Vय्āस by a female slave), MBh. i, 7381; iii, 246; BhP. iii, 1, 1-3…

क्षत्र.en: / अम्, n. (√ 1. क्षि?; g. arDarcAdi) sg. and pl. dominion, supremacy, power, might (whether human or supernatural, especially applied to the power of Vअरुṇअ-ंइत्र and ईन्द्र), RV.; AV.; VS.; ŚBr. ii; xi · sg. and pl. government, governing body, RV.; AV.; VS. x, 17; TBr. ii… · the military or reigning order (the members of which in the earliest times, as represented by the Vedic hymns, were generally called ण्āजन्य, not ख्ṣअत्रिय; afterwards, when the difference between भ्रह्मन् and ख्ṣअत्र or the priestly and civil authorities became more distinct, applied to the second or reigning or military caste), VS.; AV.; TS. &c.… · a member of the military or second order or caste, warrior, Mn.; MBh. &c. (fancifully derived fr. क्षतात् त्र fr. √ त्रै i.e. ‘a preserver from injury’, Ragh. ii, 53)…

क्षत्रदेव.en: क्षत्र—देव m. N. of a man (with the patr. Śअइक्हṇḍइ), MBh. vii, 955.

क्षत्रधर्म.en: क्षत्र—धर्म m. the duty of the second caste or of a ख्ṣअत्रिय, bravery, military conduct, Mn. v, 98; MBh.; R. · N. of a prince (= ˚र्मन्), VP.…

क्षत्रप.en: क्षत्र—प m. a governor, Satrap (a word found on coins and in Inscr.) (cf. महा-क्ष्˚.)

क्षत्रपति.en: क्षत्र/—पति (˚त्र/-), m. the possessor of dominion, VS. x, 17; TBr. ii; ŚBr. xi; KātyŚr.

क्षत्रविद्या.en: क्षत्र—विद्या f. (Pāṇ. iv, 2, 60; Pat.; g. fg-ayanAdi) the knowledge or science possessed by the ख्ṣअत्रिय or military order (= धनुर्-वेद Comm.), ChUp. vii, 1, 2 ff.

क्षत्रिय.en: क्षत्रि/य mfn. (Pāṇ. iv, 1, 38; g. श्रेण्यादि) governing, endowed with sovereignty, RV.; AV. iv, 22, 1; VS.; TBr. ii · क्षत्रि/य m. a member of the military or reigning order (which in later times constituted the second caste), AV.; ŚBr.; AitBr.; KātyŚr.; Mn. &c.… · क्षत्रि/य m. (ifc. f(आ). ), MBh.… · क्षत्रि/य m. N. of a धśअ-प्ūर्विन्, Jain.… · a red horse, Gal.… · N. of a people, VarBṛS. xiv, 28… · क्षत्रि/य n. the power or rank of the sovereign, RV. iv, 12, 3; v, 69, 1; vii, 104, 13; AV. vi, 76, 3.…

क्षत्रिया.en: क्षत्रि/या f. (Pāṇ. iv, 1, 49, Vārtt. 7) a woman of the military or second caste, Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. (e.g. क्ष्˚ ते, your wife that belongs to the second caste) · N. of धुर्ग्ā, Hariv. 3290…

क्षत्रियजाति.en: क्षत्रिय—जाति f. the military tribe or caste, Mn. x, 43.

क्षन्.en: 1. क्षन् (or क्षण्) cl. 8. P. क्षणो/ति (aor. अक्षणीत्, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 5; cf. अ-क्षण्वत्), <div n="to"/>to hurt, injure, wound, ŚBr. (inf. क्षणि/तोस्, xiv, 8, 14, 4), Kum. v, 54; <div n="to"/>to break (a bow), Ragh. xi, 72 : Ā. क्षणुते/ (aor. Subj. 2. sg. क्षणिष्ठास्, Pot. क्षण्वीत), to hurt one's self, be injured or wounded, AV. x, 1, 16; ŚBr. iv, 4, 3, 13 and 6, 1, 6; TBr. iii; <div n="vp"/> [cf. κτείνω καίνω ξαίνω σίνομαι for ξίνομαι?] · 2. क्षन् aor. Subj. 3. pl. √ घस्, q.v.…

क्षति.en: f. injury, hurt, wound, MBh. &c. · loss, want (of the means of living. cf. क्षत-वृत्ति), Hit.… · damage, disadvantage, MBh. &c.… · defect, fault, mistake, Sāh.… · destruction, removal of (in comp.), Kum. ii, 24; Rājat. v, 234; Śāntiś.…

क्षपण.en: 1. क्षपण m. ‘fasting’, a religious mendicant, झइन (or <ns>Buddhist</ns>) mendicant, L. · N. of a शम्āद्हि, Kāraṇḍ.… · m. pl. N. of a <ns>Buddhist</ns> school, L.… · n. abstinence, chastisement of the body [‘pause, interruption (of study), defilement, impurity’ Comm.; cf. 2. क्षपण] PārGṛ.; Gaut.; Mn. iv, 222; v, 71; MBh. xiii, 5145.… · 2. क्षपण mfn. ifc. (cf. अक्ष-क्ष्˚) one who destroys, destructive, BhP.… · m. N. of Śइव… · n. destroying, diminishing, suppressing, expelling, MBh.; Suśr.; BhP.… · ‘passing (as time), waiting, pause’ = 1. क्षपण, q.v.… · See √ 1. and √ 3. क्षप्…

क्षपणा.en: f. N. of a ञोगिन्ī, Hcat.

क्षपणक.en: m. a religious mendicant, (especially a) झइन mendicant who wears no garments, MBh. i, 789; Cāṇ.; Pañcat.; Kād. &c. · N. of an author supposed to have lived at the court of king Vइक्रम्āदित्य (perhaps the झइन astronomer शिद्द्ह-सेन).…

क्षपित.en: mfn. destroyed, ruined, diminished, suppressed, Ragh. viii, 46; BhP. iv, 31, 6.

क्षपा.en: / ind. instr. at night, RV. · 2. क्षपा/ f. (Naigh. i, 7; for 1. क्ष्˚ See 4. क्ष/प्) night, RV. iv, 53, 7 (instr. pl. ˚पा/भिस्), AitBr. i, 13; MBh. &c.… · a measure of time equivalent to a whole day of twenty-four hours, Jyot.… · turmeric, L.… · / See 4. क्ष/प्.…

क्षम्.en: 1. क्षम् cl. 1. Ā. क्ष/मते (ep. also P. ˚ति; Ved. cl. 2. P. क्षमिति, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 34; cl. 4. P. क्षाम्यति [cf. Impv. Ā. 3. sg. क्षम्यताम्, BhP. vi, 3, 30] Pāṇ. vii, 3, 74; perf. चक्षमे, MBh. &c., 3. pl. ˚मिरे, ŚBr.; 1. du. चक्षण्वहे & 1. pl. ˚ण्महे, Pāṇ. viii, 2, 65, Sch.; fut. 2nd क्षंस्यते, ˚ति, क्षमिष्यति; aor. 2. sg. अक्षंस्थास्, Bhaṭṭ.; inf. क्षन्तुम्, MBh. &c.), <div n="to"/>to be patient or composed, suppress anger, keep quiet, RV. x, 104, 6; MBh.; R. &c.; <div n="to"/>to submit to (dat.), ŚBr. iii; iv; <div n="to"/>to bear patiently, endure, put up with (acc.), suffer, MBh.; R.; Ragh.; <div n="to"/>to pardon, forgive anything (acc.) to (gen. or dat.), MBh.; R. &c. (e.g. क्षमस्व मे तद्, forgive me that, Ragh. xiv, 58); <div n="to"/>to allow, permit, suffer, Sāh. (Kuval.); <div n="vp…

क्षम.en: / mf(आ)n. (g. pacAdi) patient (said of the earth, perhaps with reference to 2. क्ष/म्), AV. xii, 1, 29 · ifc. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 1, Vārtt. 8) enduring, suffering, bearing, submissive, resisting, MBh.; Śak.; Kum. v, 40… · adequate, competent, able, fit for (loc. or inf. or in comp., e.g. वयं त्यक्तुं क्षमाः, ‘we are able to quit’, Śāntiś.), Nal.; R.; Ragh. &c.… · favourable to (gen.), R. ii, 35, 31… · bearable, tolerable, Śak.; Pañcat. (= Subh.)… · fit, appropriate, becoming, suitable, proper for (gen. dat., loc. inf. or in comp.), MBh. (e.g. क्षमं कौरवाणाम्, ‘proper for the खउरवs’, iii, 252), R. (e.g. न स क्षमः कोपयितुम्, ‘he is not a fit object, for anger’, iv, 32, 20) &c.… · / (अस्), m. ‘the patient’, N. of Śइव… · a kind of sparrow, L.… · / (अम्), n. propriety fitness, W.…

क्षमा.en: (आ), f. patience, forbearance, indulgence (one of the सामान्य-धर्मास् i.e. an obligation to all castes, Viṣṇ.), Mn.; MBh. &c. · ं √ कृ, to be indulgent to, have patience or bear with (प्रति, MBh. iii, 1027; or gen., Śāntiś.)… · ‘Patience’ (personified as a daughter of धक्ṣअ and wife of फुलह, VP.), Hariv. 14035; Prab.… · tameness (as of an antelope), R. iii, 49, 25… · resistance, Pāṇ. i, 3, 33, Sch.… · (= 2. क्ष/म्) the earth, VarBṛS.; Pañcat. &c.… · (hence) the number ‘one’… · N. of धुर्ग्ā, DevīP.… · the ख्हदिर tree (Acacia Catechu), L.… · N. of a species of the आतिजगत्ī metre… · N. of a female shepherd, BrahmaP.… · of a Śāक्त authoress of ंअन्त्रs… · of a river (= वेत्रवती), Gal.… · for क्षपा/ (night), L.… · 1. क्षमा/ (instr. of 2. क्ष/म्, q.v.), ind. on the earth, on the floor g. स्वर्-आदि…

क्षमापय.en: Nom. P. Ā. ˚यति, ˚यते, to ask any one's (acc.) pardon, BhP. iv; v, 10, 16; ix, 4, 71.

क्षा.en: / f. (derived fr. some forms of 2. क्ष/म्) the earth, ground, Naigh. i, 1; Nir. ii, 2; Sāy. · / See √ 1. क्षम्.…

क्षान्त.en: 1. क्षान्त mfn. (g. priyAdi) borne, endured (सोढ), L. · pardoned, MBh.; Pañcat.… · (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 188; Kār.) enduring, patient, Mn. v, 158; Yājñ.; R.; Ragh. (compar. -तर)… · m. (g. utkarAdi) N. of a man g. aSvAdi… · of a hunter, Hariv. 1206… · of Śइव (cf. क्षम)… · n. patience, indulgence, R. i, 34, 32 and 33.… · 2. क्षान्त mfn. ending with the letter क्ष, RāmatUp.… · See √ 1. क्षम्.…

क्षान्ति.en: f. patient waiting for anything, Vop. xxiii, 3 · patience, forbearance, endurance, indulgence, Mn. v, 107; MBh.; R. &c.… · the state of saintly abstraction, Divyāv. vi, xii, xviii… · (in music) N. of a Śरुति… · N. of a river, VP.…

क्षामि.en: क्षा/मि See s.v. 2. क्ष/म्. · क्षा/मि See s.v. 2. क्ष/म्.… · ˚मिन्. See √ क्षै.… · 2. क्षामि m. patr. fr. ˚म, Pāṇ. viii, 2, 1, Kāś.…

क्षमुद.en: m. n. (?) a particular high number, Buddh.; L.

क्षय.en: क्ष/य See √ 1. 2. and 4. क्षि. · 1. क्ष/य m. ‘dominion’, Sāy. (on, RV. vii, 46, 2).… · 2. क्ष/य mfn. dwelling, residing, RV. iii, 2, 13; viii, 64, 4… · क्ष/य m. an abode, dwelling-place, seat, house (cf. उरु- and सु-क्ष/य, र/थ-, दिविक्षय/), RV.; VS. v, 38; TS.; Pāṇ.; MBh.; R.; BhP.… · the house of ञम (cf. यम-क्ष्˚, वैवस्वत-क्ष्˚)… · abode in ञम's dominion Comm. on R. (ed. Bomb.) ii, 109, 11… · (= क्षिति/) family, race, RV. i, 123, 1.… · 3. क्षय/ (the accent is on the last syllable in the sense ‘destruction’, accord. to Pāṇ. iii, 3, 56 and vi, 1, 63.) m. (Pāṇ. vi, 1, 201) loss, waste, wane, diminution, destruction, decay, wasting or wearing away (often ifc.), Mn.; MBh. &c.… · fall (as of prices, opposed to वृद्धि, e.g. क्षयो वृद्धिश् च पण्यानाम्, ‘the fall and rise in the price of commodities’), Yājñ. ii, 258…

क्षयण.en: See √ 2. and √ 4. क्षि. · 1. क्षयण/ mfn. habitable [? m. ‘a place with tranquil water’ Comm.] VS. xvi, 43… · (क्ष/यण), TS. iv… · (क्षेण/), MaitrS.… · / (अस्), m. a bay, harbour Comm. on RPrāt.… · / (अम्), n. a dwelling place, Nir. vi, 6.… · 2. क्षयण mfn. ifc. ‘destroying, annihilating, driving away, dispersing’, see अराय-, असुर-, पिशाच-, भ्रातृव्य-, यातुधान-, सदान्वा- and सपत्न-क्ष/यण.…

क्षय्य.en: See अ-क्षय्य/. · mfn. (anything) that can be destroyed or removed, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 81… · See also अ-क्षय्य/.…

क्षर.en: mf(आ)n. (g. jvalAdi) melting away, perishable, ŚvetUp.; MBh.; Bhag. · m. a cloud, L.… · n. water, L.… · the body, MBh. xiv, 470.…

क्षरण.en: n. flowing, trickling, distilling, dropping (e.g. अङ्गुली-, perspiration of the fingers, Ragh. xix, 19), Suśr. · pouring forth, Vop.… · splashing, spattering, ib.…

क्षार.en: mf(आ)n. (g. jvalAdi) caustic, biting, corrosive, acrid, pungent, saline, converted to alkali or ashes by distillation (fr. √ क्षै?), R.; Pañcat.; BhP. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · sharp, keen (as the wind), Kāvyād. ii, 104… · m. any corrosive or acrid or saline substance (esp. an alkali such as soda or potash), caustic alkali (one species of cautery), Kāty.; Yājñ. iii, 36; MBh. &c.… · juice, essence, W.… · treacle, molasses, L.… · glass, L.… · n. any corrosive or acrid substance, Kathās. xciii, 14… · a factitious or medicinal salt (commonly black salt, विड्-लवण and कृष्ण-ल्˚), W.… · water, W.… · flowing water, flow, MānGṛ.… · , ˚रक, ˚रण, &c. See √ क्षर्.…

क्षाल.en: m. washing, washing off. · ˚लन, &c. See √ 2. क्षल्.…

क्षालन.en: mfn. washing, washing or wiping off, Pañcat. (ifc.) · n. washing, washing off, cleansing with water, MBh. ii, 1295; Pañcat.; MārkP.; Kathās. lii, 239… · sprinkling, W.…

क्षालित.en: mfn. washed, cleansed, cleaned, Suśr.; Prab. v, 24 · wiped away, removed, Rājat. v, 59.…

क्षव.en: क्ष/व , ˚वक, ˚वथु See √ 1. क्षु. · क्ष/व m. sneezing, AV. xix, 8, 5… · cough, catarrh, L.… · black mustard (Sinapis dichotoma), L.…

क्षाम.en: / See ib. · / mf(आ)n. burning to ashes, charring, MaitrS. i, 8, 9… · (Pāṇ. viii, 2, 53) scorched, singed, KātyŚr.; Jaim.… · dried up, emaciated, wasted, thin, slim, slender, Yājñ. i, 80; MBh.; R.; Megh. &c.… · weak, debilitated, infirm, slight (especially applied to the voice), R. iii, 58, 14; Suśr.; Amar.; Rājat. v, 219.…

क्षि.en: 1. क्षि cl. 1. P. क्ष/यति (2. du. क्ष/-यथस् or क्षय्˚, 2. pl. क्ष/यथा; Subj. 1. क्ष/यत् or क्षयत्, RV. vi, 23, 10 and vii, 20, 6; x, 106, 7; pr. p. क्ष/यत्), <div n="to"/>to possess, have power over, rule, govern, be master of (gen.), RV.; <div n="vp"/> [cf. गरुड.en: / m. (√ 2. गॄ, Uṇ. iv, 155, ‘devourer’, because घरुḍअ was perhaps originally identified with the all-consuming fire of the sun's rays), N. of a mythical bird (chief of the feathered race, enemy of the serpent-race [cf. RTL. p. 321], vehicle of Vइṣṇउ [cf. RTL. pp. 65; 104; 288], son of खśयप and Vइनत्ā; shortly after his birth he frightened the gods by his brilliant lustre; they supposed him to be आग्नि, and requested his protection; when they discovered that he was घरुḍअ, they praised him as the highest being, and called him fire and sun, MBh. i, 1239 ff.; आरुṇअ, the charioteer of the sun or the personified dawn, is said to be the elder [or younger, cf. RTL. p. 104] brother of घरुḍअ; श्व्āह्ā, the wife of आग्नि, takes the shape of a female घरुḍī = सुपर्णी, MBh. iii, 14307 and 14343), Suparṇ…

RTL. pp. 19; 342; 361; 403; the घ्āयत्र्ī verse is personified as a goddess, the wife of भ्रह्म्ā and mother of the four Vएदs, Hariv. 11666 ff.; it is often mentioned in connection with the आम्ṛत, both together constituting as it were the essence and type of sacred hymns in general, AV.; the घ्āयत्र्ī personified is also considered as the mother of the first three classes in their capacity of twice-born, W.; cf. RTL. pp. 200 f.; some other verse [perhaps, RV. x, 9……

च.en: 1. च the 20th letter of the alphabet, 1st of the 2nd (or palatal) class of consonants, having the sound of ch in church. · 2. च ind. and, both, also, moreover, as well as (= τε, Lat. que, placed like these particles as an enclitic after the word which it connects with what precedes; when used with a personal pronoun this must appear in its fuller accented form (e.g. त/व च म/म च [not ते च मे च], ‘both of thee and me’), when used after verbs the first of them is accented, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 58 f.; it connects whole sentences as well as parts of sentences; in RV. the double च occurs more frequently than the single (e.g. अह/ं च त्व/ं च, ‘I and thou’, viii, 62, 11); the double च may also be used somewhat redundantly in class. Sanskṛt (e.g. kva hariRakAnAM jIvitaM cAtilolaM kva ca vajra-sArAH SarAs te, ‘where is the frail existence, of fawns and where are thy adamantine arrows?’, Śak. i, 10); in later literature, however……
