तक्षन्.en: त/क्षन् m. (Ved. acc. ˚क्षणम्, class. ˚क्षणम्, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 9, Kāś.) a wood-cutter, carpenter, τέκτων RV. ix, 112, 1; AV. x, 6, 3; VS. &c. · N. of a teacher, ŚBr. ii, 3, 1, 31…

तच्छब्दत्व.en: तच्-छब्द-त्व &c. See तत्. · तच्—छब्द-त्व (शब्˚) n. = ताच्छब्द्य, TāṇḍyaBr. iv, 8, 15, Sch.…

तज्ज.en: तज्-ज &c. See ib. · तज्—ज mfn. sprung from (that i.e. from) Sanskṛt (as Prākṛt or other words), Vāgbh. ii, 2…

तट.en: m. (exceptionally n., Daśar. ii, 18/19) a slope, declivity, any part of the body which has (as it were) sloping, sides (cf. श्रोणि-, स्तन-, &c.), a shore, MBh. (said of Śइव, xii, 10381), Hariv. &c. (ifc. f(ई). , Bhartṛ.) · cf. अ-, उत्-; पुर-तटी.…

तटस्थ.en: तट—स्थ mfn. standing on a declivity or bank, Naiṣ. iii, 55 · = -स्थित, Mālatīm.; Naiṣ. iii, 55… · तट—स्थ m. an indifferent person (neither friend nor foe), W.… · तट—स्थ n. a property distinct from the nature of the body and yet that by which it is known, spiritual essence, Vedāntak.…

तटाक.en: n. (m., L.) a pool, ṢaḍvBr. v, 12; R. &c.

तडाग.en: n. (m. g. arDarcAdi) = ˚डाक, ŚāṅkhGṛ. v, 2; Mn. iv, vii ff.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c. · a trap, L.…

तण्ड.en: m. N. of a man g. gargAdi.

तण्डु.en: m. N. of an attendant of Śइव (भ्हरत's teacher in the art of dancing, cf. ताण्डव).

तण्डुल.en: / m. (g. arDarcAdi) grain (after threshing and winnowing), esp. rice, AV. x ff.; ŚBr.; AitBr. &c. · rice used as a weight, Car. vii, 12; VarBṛS.… · = ˚लीक, L.… · / m. = ˚लु, L.…

तत्.en: 1. तत् for त/द्. See col. 3. · 2. तत्, 1. तत/. See √ तन्… · 1. तत् in comp. for त/द्.… · 2. तत् mfn. ifc. See परी-… · cf. पुरी-त/त्.…

तत.en: 1. तत/ m. (cf. तात) chiefly Ved. a father (familiar expression corresponding to नना/, mother), RV. viii, 91, 5 f.; ix, 112, 3; AV.; TS. iii; TBr. &c. (voc. [like तात] also term of affection addressed to a son, AitBr. v, 14, 3; vii, 14, 8). · 2. तत/ mfn., vi, 4, 37 extended, stretched, spread, diffused, expanded, RV. &c.… · spreading over, extending to, W.… · covered over by (instr. or in comp.), Laghuj. ii, 16; Kir. v, 11; Śiś. ix, 23… · protracted, W.… · bent (a bow), MBh. i, 49, 25; iv, 5, 1… · spreading, wide, L.… · composed (a tale), i, 2455… · performed (a ceremony), RV. &c.… · / m. wind, L.… · / n. any stringed instrument, L.… · a metre of 4 × 12 syllables.…

तति.en: 1. त/ति nom. acc. pl. (Pāṇ. i, 1, 23 ff.) so many, Lat. tot AV. xii, 3. · See √ तन्.… · 2. तति f. (Pāṇ. vi, 4, 37., Kāś. v.l.; cf. तन्ति/) a mass, crowd, Śak. ii, 6; Śiś. iv, 54 &c. (cf. तमस्-)… · the whole mass (of observances, धर्म-)… · a sacrificial act, ceremony (cf. पुनस्-), ŚāṅkhŚr. vi, 1, 4… · a metre of 4 × 12 syllables, Vṛttaratn.…

तत्कर.en: तत्—कर mf(आ)n. doing that, doing any particular work, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 21. · तत्—कर L.…

तत्कर्तव्य.en: तत्—कर्तव्य mfn. proper to be done with reference to any particular circumstance (cf. इति-क्˚), Rājat. vi, 269.

तत्कर्तृ.en: तत्—कर्तृ m. ‘creator of (that i.e. of) the universe’, N. of the supreme being (with Sikhs), W.

तत्काल.en: तत्—काल mfn. happening (at that same time i.e.) immediately, KātyŚr. i, xxv · of that duration, BrahmaP.… · तत्—काल m. that time (opposed to एतत्-क्˚, ‘this time’), Vedāntas.… · the time referred to, KātyŚr. i; VarBṛ.; Laghuj.…

तत्कालीन.en: तत्—˚कालीन mfn. of that time, Daś. iii, 36 · simultaneous, BhP. x, 12, 41.…

तत्क्रिय.en: तत्—क्रिय mfn. = -कर, L.<listinfo n="sup"/> · working without wages, L.…

तत्क्षण.en: तत्—क्षण m. the same moment, L.

तत्तुल्य.en: तत्—तुल्य mfn. (said of a Prākṛt word) similar or equal to the original Sanskṛt word, Vāgbh. ii, 2.

तत्तृतीय.en: तत्—तृतीय mfn. doing that for the 3rd time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162, Kāś.

तत्त्व.en: तत्—त्व n. true or real state, truth, reality, ŚvetUp.; Mn.; Bhag. &c. · (in phil.) a true principle (in श्āṃक्ह्य phil. 25 in number, viz. अ-व्यक्त, बुद्धि, अहं-कार, the 5 थन्-म्āत्रs, the 5 ंअह्ā-ब्ह्ūतs, the 11 organs including मनस्, and, lastly, पुरुष, qq.vv.), MBh. xii, 11840; xiv, 984; R. iii, 53, 42; Tattvas.; 24 in number, MBh. xii, 11242; Hariv. 14840 (m.); 23 in number, BhP. iii, 6, 2 ff.; for other numbers cf. xi, 22, 1 ff.; RāmatUp.; with ंāहेśवरs and ळोक्āयतिकs only 5 [viz. the 5 elements] are admitted, Prab. ii, 18/19; with Buddh. 4, with झइनs 2 or 5 or 7 or 9 Sarvad. ii f.; in Vएद्āन्त phil. तत्त्व is regarded as made up of तद् and त्वम्, ‘that [art] thou’, and called महा-वाक्य, the great word by which the identity of the whole world with the one eternal भ्रह्म [तद्] is expressed)…

तत्त्वेन.en: तत्—त्वेन ind. instr. according to the true state or nature of anything, in truth, truly, really, accurately, Mn. vii, 68; MBh.; R.

तत्त्वज्ञ.en: तत्—त्व—ज्ञ mfn. ifc. knowing the truth, knowing the true nature of, knowing thoroughly, Mn. xii, 102; MBh. (अ- neg., xii, 6623), R. &c. · तत्—त्व—ज्ञ m. a <ns>Brāhman</ns>, Npr.…

तत्त्वज्ञान.en: तत्—त्व—ज्ञान n. knowledge of truth, thorough knowledge, insight into the true principles of phil. Sarvad.

तत्त्वतस्.en: तत्—त्व—तस् ind. = ˚त्त्वेन, MuṇḍUp. i, 2, 13; Mn.; MBh. &c.

तत्त्वदर्श.en: तत्—त्व—दर्श m. (= -दृश्) N. of a Ṛṣइ under ंअनु धेव-स्āवर्ṇइ, BhP. viii, 13, 32

तत्त्वनिश्चय.en: तत्—त्व—निश्चय m. ‘ascertainment of truth’, right knowledge, Sarvad. vi, 91 and 94

तत्त्वप्रकाश.en: तत्—त्व—प्रकाश m. ‘light of true principles’, N. of a Comm. Sarvad. vii

तत्त्वभाव.en: तत्—त्व—भाव m. true being or nature, KaṭhUp. vi; ŚvetUp. i

तत्त्वार्थ.en: tat—tvArTa m. the truth, Sarvad. iii

तत्त्वावबोध.en: tat—tvAvaboDa m. perception of truth, W.

तत्पद.en: तत्—पद n. the place of that, Daś. vii, 435 · the word तद्, Vedāntas.… · तत्—पद m. Ficus religiosa, Npr.…

तत्पर.en: तत्—पर mf(आ)n. following that or thereupon, Megh. · having that as one's highest object or aim, totally devoted or addicted to, attending closely to, eagerly engaged in (loc. [Pāṇ. vi, 2, 66, Kāś.; Pārśvan.] or generally in comp.), ŚvetUp. i, 7; Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.… · तत्—पर m. 1/30 of an eye's twinkle, W.…

तत्परा.en: तत्—परा f. 1/60 of a second of a circle, Āryabh. iii, 2, Sch.

तत्परता.en: तत्—पर—ता f. scope, design, intention, W. · entire devotion or addiction to (loc.), Hit.…

तत्परत्व.en: तत्—पर—त्व n. id., W. · aiming at, tending to, Daśar. iv, 38 (अ- neg.)… · ‘the state of following behind’, inferiority, KātyŚr. i, 4, 16 and 5, 5.…

तत्परायण.en: तत्—परायण mfn. having that as chief object, Bhag. · तत्—परायण mfn. addicted to, W.…

तत्पुरुष.en: तत्—पुरुष m. the original or supreme spirit (one of the 5 forms of Īśवर [also ˚ष-वक्त्र] Sarvad. vii), Kāṭh. xvii, 1; TĀr. x, 1, 5 f.; LiṅgaP. i, 13 · the servant of him, KātyŚr. vii, 1, 8… · N. of a खल्प period, MatsyaP. liii, 41… · a class of compounds (formed like the word तत्-पुरुष, ‘his servant’) in which the last member is qualified by the first without losing (as the last member of भहु-व्र्īहि compounds) its grammatical independence (whether as noun or adj. or p.)… · two subdivisions of these compounds are called खर्म-द्ह्āरय and ध्वि-गु (qq.vv.)…

तत्पूर्व.en: तत्—पूर्व mfn. (cf. Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162) happening for the first time, Mālav. iv, 8; Ragh. xiv

तत्पूर्वम्.en: तत्—पूर्वम् ind. that for the first time, Kir. vii, 11; viii, 26

तत्प्रकार.en: तत्—प्रकार mfn. of that kind, W.

तत्प्रकृत.en: तत्—प्रकृत mfn. made or consisting of that, Pāṇ. v, 4, 21

तत्प्रथम.en: तत्—प्रथम mfn. doing that for the first time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162, Kāś.

तत्प्रधान.en: तत्—प्रधान mfn. depending chiefly on that, Mn. iii, 18

तत्फल.en: तत्—फल mfn. having that as a fruit or reward, W. · having that as a result, W.… · the blue water-lily, L.… · the plant कुष्ठ, L.… · a kind of perfume, L.…

तत्सदृश.en: तत्—सदृश mfn. ‘fitting or corresponding to that’, see -स्थान.

तत्सम.en: तत्—सम mfn. = -तुल्य · ifc. synonymous with, Uṇ. i, 3, Sch.…

तत्स्थ.en: तत्—स्थ mfn. being on or in that, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 134; ii, 2, 8, Vārtt. 2 · तत्—स्थ m. a particular mode of multiplication, W.…

तज्जलान्.en: taj—ja—lAn mfn. accord. to some, taj-jAnAnIti, ‘thinking, may I know that’; ChUp. iii, 14, 1.; cf. IW. 102, 1 · taj—ja-lAn See -ज.…

तज्जातीय.en: तज्—जातीय mfn. of the same kind, (अ- neg.), Pāṇ. i, 1, 7, Vārtt. 8 & Pat.

तज्ज्ञ.en: तज्—ज्ञ mfn. knowing that, (m.) a knowing man, BhP. iii, v (अ-, q.v.), Rājat. v, 481 · ifc. familiar with, Hariv. 8427.…

तत्र.en: त/त्र ind. (also ˚त्रा, RV.) (त/-त्र, correlative of य/-त्र; g. cAdi, not in Kāś.) used for the loc. (sg. du. and pl.) of त/द् (q.v., Pāṇ. v, 3, 10; vi, 3, 35), RV.; AV.; Mn. &c. · in that place, there (in comp. Pāṇ. ii, 1, 46), RV. &c.… · thither, to that place, ib.… · in that, therein, in that case, on that occasion, under those circumstances, then, therefore, (also correlative of य/द् [vi, 57, 4; AV. xii, 1, 34; Nal. &c.], यदा [Pañcat. i, 19, 8], यदि [Mn. viii f.; Cāṇ.; Hit.], or चेद् [Mn. viii, 295; ix, 205]; तत्र मास, ‘that month’ i.e. the month that has been spoken of Kathās. xviii, 208)… · त/˚त्र तत्र used for double loc. of त/द्, Nal. v, 8… · त/˚त्र तत्र in that and that place, here and there, everywhere, Mn. vii, 87; MBh.; BhP.… · त/˚त्र तत्र to every place, MBh.…

तत्रत्य.en: तत्र—त्य mfn. (Pāṇ. iv, 2, 104; Pat.) of that place, being there, BhP.; Kathās.; Rājat. i, 117; Hit.

तत्रस्थ.en: तत्र—स्थ mfn. dwelling there, situated there, belonging to that place, MBh. iii, 2683; R. ii, iv; Kathās. vii, xxvi.

तथा.en: त/-था ind. (त/-था, correlative of य/-था, Pāṇ. v, 3, 26; g. cAdi, Kāś. & Gaṇar.) in that manner, so, thus (the correlative standing in the preceding or in the subsequent clause, e.g. यथा प्रियं, taTAstu, ‘as is agreeable, so let it be’; taTA prayatnam AtizWed yaTAtmAnaM na pIqayet, ‘he should so make effort as that he may not injure himself’, Mn. vii, 68; तथा तथा-यथा, so much that, VP. iv; also correlative of इव, Mn. iii, 181; R. i, 4, 12; of येन, Kathās. iii, 18; of यादृश, Mn. i, 42; used in forms of adjuration, e.g. yaTAham anyaM na cintaye taTAyam patatAM kzudraH parAsuH, ‘as surely as I do not think on any other man, so surely let this wretch fall dead’, Nal. xi, 36), RV. &c. · yes, so be it, so it shall be (particle of assent, agreement, or promise; generally followed by इति), AV. iii, 4, 5; ŚBr.; AitBr. &c. (taTety uktvA, having said ‘so be it’ or ‘yes’, Nal. &c.)…

तथाकृत.en: तथा—कृत mfn. thus done or made, W. · made true, VarBṛS. xxxii, 4.…

तथात्व.en: तथा—त्व n. the being so, such a state of things, such a condition, Bhāṣāp.; Sāh. vii, 8/9; Sarvad. · = -ता, Mn. x, 57, Sch.; Sāṃkhyak., Sch.…

तथाभाव.en: तथा—भाव m. the being so, TPrāt., Sch. · the being of such a nature, true nature, accomplishment, Jain.; Siṃhās.…

तथाभूत.en: तथा—भूत mfn. of such qualities or kind or nature, R. i f.; Amar.; Kathās.; Sāh.

तथारूप.en: तथा—रूप mf(आ)n. so formed, thus shaped, looking thus, Lāṭy., ix, 12; MBh. &c.

तथार्थत्व.en: taTA—˚rTa—tva n. the being real, BṛĀrUp., Sch.

तथाविध.en: त/था—विध (त/थ्˚), mf(आ)n. of such a sort or kind, being in such a condition or state, of such qualities, TBr. ii, 1, 10, 1; Mn. i, viii f. (correlative of यादृश, ix, 9), MBh. &c.

तथाविधम्.en: त/था—विधम् (अम्), ind. in this manner, Nal. vii, 15 · likewise, Bhāṣāp. 94.…

तथ्य.en: mfn. ‘being really so’, true, MBh.; R.; Pañcat. · n. truth, Śak.; Bhartṛ.…

तद्.en: त/द् (nom. and acc. sg. n. of and base in comp. for 2. त/ from which latter all the cases of this pron. are formed except nom. sg. m. स/स् or स/ & f. सा/; instr. pl. तै/स्, AV. &c.; Ved. ते/भिस्, RV.; AV. &c.) m. he f. she n. it, that, this (often correlative of य/ generally standing in the preceding clause, e.g. यस्य बुद्धिः स बलवान्, ‘of whom there is intellect he is strong’; sometimes, for the sake of emphasis, connected with the 1st and 2nd personal pronouns, with other demonstratives and with relatives, e.g. सो ऽहम्, ‘I that very person, I myself’ [तस्य = मम, Nal. xv, 10]; ताव् इमौ, ‘those very two’; तद् एतद् आख्यानम्, ‘that very tale’, AitBr. vii, 18; यत् तत् कारणम्, ‘that very reason which’, Mn. i, 11; या सा श्री, ‘that very fortune which’, MBh. vii, 427), RV. &c.

तदनन्तर.en: तद्—अनन्तर mf(आ)n. nearest to any one (gen.), Nal. xxii, 16

तदनन्तरम्.en: तद्—अनन्तरम् ind. immediately upon that, thereupon, then (corresponding to प्राक्, ‘before’, Śak. vii, 30; to प्रथमम्, ‘first’, Mn. viii, 129), MBh. &c.

तदनु.en: तद्—अनु ind. after that, afterwards, Megh.; Ratnāv.; Amar.; Śrut.; Subh.

तदन्त.en: त/द्—अन्त (त/द्-), mfn. coming to an end by that, TBr. i, 5, 9, 3; Hit.

तदन्न.en: त/द्—अन्न (त/द्-), mfn. accustomed to that food, RV. viii, 47, 16 · eating (that i.e.) the same food, R. ii, 103, 30 and 140, 13.…

तदन्य.en: तद्—अन्य mfn. other than that, L.

तदपेक्ष.en: tad—apekza mfn. having regard to that, Gaut.

तदर्थ.en: तद्—अर्थ mfn. intended for that, Āp. ii, 14, 3; Pāṇ. ii, 1, 36; i, 3, 72, Kāś. · serving for that, Jaim. i, 2, 1 (अ- neg.)… · having that or the same meaning, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 58… · तद्—अर्थ m. (its or) their meaning, Vedāntas. 200…

तदर्थम्.en: तद्—अर्थम् ind. on that account, with that object, for that end, therefore, Pāṇ. v, 1, 12; R. i, 73, 4; VarBṛS. lxxiv, Kāś.; VP. iv

तदवस्थ.en: तद्—अवस्थ mfn. so situated, thus circumstanced, in that condition, MBh. iii, 69, 31; Ratnāv. · being in the same condition (as before), undamaged, iv, 19.…

तदाकार.en: तद्—आकार mfn. having that appearance, W.

तदात्मक.en: तद्—आत्मक mfn. constituting its nature, Car. vi, 12; Sarvad. xv.

तदादि.en: तद्—आदि ind. from that time forward, Śiś. i, 45; Dharmaśarm.

तद्गत.en: तद्—गत mfn. directed towards him or her or them or that, R. i f.; Kathās. iii, 68 · ifc. intent on Vet. iv, 22… · तद्—गत m. (?) the continued multiplication of 4 or more like quantities, W.…

तद्गुण.en: तद्—गुण mfn. possessing these qualities, KātyŚr. xiv f. · तद्—गुण m. the quality of that or those, xii f.… · xvi… · xxiii f.… · the virtue of (that or) those (persons), Ragh. i, 9… · (in rhet.) transferring the qualities of one thing to another (a figure of speech), Sāh. x, 90; Kuval.; Kpr. x, 51… · also अ- neg. ‘a figure of speech in which a quality expected in any object is denied’, 52…

तद्दुःख.en: तद्—दुःख n. grief for that or of that, W.

तद्देवत.en: तद्—देवत mfn. having that deity, KātyŚr. xxiv, 6; ĀpŚr. vii; PārGṛ. iii, 11, 10.

तद्देश्य.en: तद्—देश्य mfn. coming from the same country, (m.) a fellow-countryman, MBh. xii, 168, 41; Kām. xiii, 77.

तद्द्वितीय.en: तद्—द्वितीय mfn. doing that for the 2nd time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162, Kāś.

तद्धर्म.en: तद्-धर्म mfn. having the same qualities, ĀpY.

तद्धर्मन्.en: तद्—धर्मन् mfn. practising that, iii, 2, 134 · accomplishing his business, KātyŚr. i, 6, 12; Jaim. vi, 3, 26 (cf. ताद्धर्म्य)…

तद्धर्मत्व.en: तद्—धर्˚म-त्व n. the having his or its peculiarity, KapS. i, 52 (अ- neg.)

तद्धित.en: तद्—धित n. (हित) sg. and pl. his welfare, Āp. ii; BhP. ii, 9, 7 · तद्—धित m. (scil. प्रत्यय) an affix forming nouns from other nouns (opposed to 1. कृत्), noun formed thus, derivative noun (तद्-धित mfn. ‘good for that or him’, is one of the meanings peculiar to derivative nouns, cf. मौदकिक &c.), Nir. ii, 2; Prāt.; Pāṇ.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; PārGṛ.; Gobh. ii, 8, 15 (also अ—तद्-धित neg. mfn. ‘having no थद्द्हित affix’)…

तद्बल.en: तद्—बल, m. or तद्—ब˚ला, f. a kind of arrow, L.

तद्बहु.en: तद्—बहु mfn. doing that often, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162, Kāś.

तद्भव.en: तद्—भव mfn. = तज्ज, Mn. iv, 232, Medhāt.

तद्भाव.en: तद्—भाव m. the becoming that, KātyŚr. iv, 3, 13; Bādar. iii, 4, 40 (अ- neg., ‘the becoming [not that i.e.] something else’) · his intentions, Kām. xi, 29; xviii, 3… · तद्—भाव mfn. ifc. ‘becoming’, see अ-भूत-.…

तद्भूत.en: तद्—भूत mfn. being in that, Jaim. i, 1, 25.

तद्रस.en: तद्—रस m. the spirit thereof, W.

तद्राज.en: तद्—राज m. (scil. प्रत्यय) an affix added to the N. of a race for forming the N. of its chief, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 62; iv, 1, 174; v, 3, 119.

(e.g. कुलस्य त्˚, ‘the principal action in keeping up a family i.e. propagation’, MBh. xiii, 48, 6; ifc. ‘depending on’, cf. आत्म-, स्व-, पर-, &c.)… · doctrine, rule, theory, scientific work, chapter of such a work (esp. the 1st section of a treatise on astron. दु.en: 1. दु (or दू) cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xxii, 46) दवति (pf. दुदाव; fut. दोष्यति, दोता; aor. अदावीत् or अदौषीत्, Vop.), <div n="to"/>to go: <div n="vp"/>Caus. दावयति or दवयति (see s.v.) Actually occurring only in Subj. aor. दविषाणि, RV. x, 34, 5, ‘न द्˚ एभिह्’, (?) I will not go i.e. have intercourse with them (the dice). [cf. δύω, δύνω, δεύομαι.] · 2. दु (also written दू), cl. 5. P. cl. 4. Ā. (Dhātup. xxvii, 10; xxvi, 24) दुनोति, दूयते (ep. also ˚ति; pf. दुदाव; fut. दोष्यति; aor. अदौषीत्; inf. दोतुम्), <div n="to"/>to be burnt, to be consumed with internal heat or sorrow (Pres. दुनोति, MBh. iii, 10069; BhP. iii, 2, 17; Gīt. iii, 9 <pb n="483,1"/>; but oftener दूयते, which is at once Pass.), MBh.; Suśr.; Kāv. &c.; <div n="to"/> (only दुनो/ति) to burn, consume with fire, cause internal heat, pain, or sorrow, afflict, distress, AV. ix, 4, 18; MBh.; VarBṛS.; Kāv. : <div n="vp"/>Caus. दावयति aor. अदूदुवत्: <div n="vp"/>Desid. दुदूषति: <div n="vp"/>Intens. दोदूयते, दोदोति. <div n="P"/> [cf. δαίω. for δαϝιω; δύη, pain; Lit. davyti, to torment; Sl. daviti, to worry.]…

द्रुम.en: m. a tree, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (sometimes also any plant; according to some esp. a tree of ईन्द्र's paradise = पारिजात) · N. of a prince of the खिम्-पुरुṣअs, MBh.; Hariv.… · of a son of ख्ṛṣṇअ and णुक्मिṇī, Hariv.…

द्रू.en: 1. द्रू cl. 9. P. द्रूणाति, to hurl, throw, MaitrS. (v.l. द्रुण्˚); <div n="to"/> cl. 5. P. द्रूणोति, to kill or to go, Dhātup. xxvii, 33 (v.l.) · 2. द्रू mfn. taking any shape at will, L.… · f. (?) gold, Uṇ. ii, 57.…

द्रोणा.en: द्रो/णा (आ), f. a kind of shrub, L. · N. of a daughter of शिṃह-हनु, Buddh.…

द्रोणक.en: m. pl. ‘the inhabitants of a valley’, N. of a people, VP.

द्रौपद.en: mf(ई)n. belonging to or descendant from ध्रुपद

द्रौपदी.en: f. See below. · f. patr. of ख्ṛṣṇā (wife of the फ्āṇḍउ princes), MBh.; Hariv. &c. (identified with ऊम्ā, SkandaP.)…

द्रौपदेय.en: m. pl. metron. of the 5 sons of ध्रउपद्ī (viz. of फ्रतिविन्द्ह्य, son of ञुद्हिṣṭहिर; of शुत-सोम, son of भ्ह्īम; of Śरुत-क्īर्ति or Śरुतकर्मन्, son of आर्जुन; of Śअत्āन्īक, son of ङकुल; and of Śरुत-सेन, son of शहदेव), MBh.; MārkP.

द्व.en: mfn. original stem of द्वि, q.v. (nom. acc. du. m. द्व/, or द्वौ/ fn. द्वे/; instr. dat. abl. द्वा/भ्याम् gen. loc. द्व/योस्) two, RV. &c. &c. · both (with अपि, Ragh. xii, 93)… · loc. द्वयोस् in two genders (masc. and fem.) or in two numbers (sing. and pl.), Gr.; L.… · [cf. द्वा and द्वि; Zd. dva; Gk. δύο, δύω and δι = δϝι; Lat. duō̆ and bi = द्वि; Lith. du, dvi; Slav. dǔva; Goth. tvai, tva &c.]…

Śiś. iii, 57) · / n. id.… · two things, both (e.g. तेजो-, the 2 luminaries, Śak. iv, 2), Yājñ.; MBh.; Kāv. &c. द्विलक्ष.en: द्वि—लक्ष n. a distance of 200, 000 (sc. ञोजनs), Kāv.

द्विलक्षण.en: द्वि—लक्षण mfn. twofold, of 2 kinds, Mn.

(fr. द्वि + अप्, Pāṇ. v, 4, 74; vi, 3, 97) an island, peninsula, sandbank, RV.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c.… · a division of the terrestrial world (either 7 [झम्बु, फ्लक्ṣअ or घो-मेदक, Śāल्मल्ī, खुśअ, ख्रउñच, Śāक and फुṣकर, MBh. vi, 604 &c.; Hariv.; Pur. &c.] or 4 [भ्हद्र्āśव, खेतु-म्āल, झम्बु-द्व्īप and ऊत्तर्āḥ खुरवḥ, MBh. vi, 208; Hariv.; Kāv. &c. cf. नवर.en: m. or n. N. of a partic. high number, Buddh.

नवेद.en: न/वेद (only RV. i, 165, 13) and न/वेदस् mfn. observing, cognizant (with gen.), RV. (Clearly not from the negat. न, but cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 75.)

नश.en: 1. नश See दुर्-णश, दू-णश. · 2. नश m. destruction, MW. (cf. 2. नाश).…

नशन.en: n. disappearing, escaping, L. · loss, BhP.…

नश्वर.en: mf(ई)n. perishing, perishable, transitory, Kāv.; Pur. &c. · destructive, mischievous, W.…

नष्ट.en: / mfn. lost, disappeared, perished, destroyed, lost sight of, invisible · escaped (also -वत् mfn., MBh.), run away from (abl.), fled (impers. with instr. of subj. Ratn. ii, 3), RV. &c. &c.… · spoiled, damaged, corrupted, wasted, unsuccessful, fruitless, in vain, Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.… · deprived of (instr.), R. i, 14, 18 (in comp. = ‘without’, ‘-less’, ‘un-’; see below)… · one who has lost a lawsuit, Mṛcch. ix, 4.… · See above.…

नस्.en: 1. नस् encl. form for acc. gen. dat. pl. of the 1st pers. pron. (Pāṇ. viii, 1, 21), us, of us, to us; in Vएद changeable into णस् (4, 27; 28). · , [cf. Zd. na, our; Gk. νῶϊ, νώ; Lat. nos, nos-ter; Old Lat. dat. nis.]… · 2. नस् cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. xvi, 26) न/सते (aor. Pot. नसीमहि, RV. ii, 16, 8; pf. नेसे; fut. नसिता Gr.) <div n="to"/>to approach, resort to, join, copulate (esp. as husband and wife), RV.; <div n="to"/>to be crooked or fraudulent, Dhātup.… · [cf. Gk.νέ(σ)ομαι, να(σ)ίω, νόσ-τος; Goth. ga-nizan, nas-jan; Angl.Sax. genësan; HGerm. ginësan, genesen.]… · 3. न/स् or नास् f. (the strong stem occurs only in du. ना/सा, RV. ii, 39, 6, the weak stem only in नसा/, नसि/, नसो/स् [cf. Pāṇ. vi, 1, 63] and in comp.) the nose, RV.; AV.; VS.; TS.; BhP.… · [cf. नासा, नासिका; Lat. nas-turcium, nāres; Lith. nósis; Slav. nosǔ; Germ. Nase; Angl.Sax. nosu; Eng. nose, nostril = nose-thrill, nose-hole.]…

नास्.en: {{Lbody=104829}} · 1. नास् cl. 1. Ā. नासते, to sound, Dhātup. xvi, 24.… · 2. ना/स् the strong stem of 3. न/स्, q.v.…

नस.en: m. (ifc.) the nose (cf. अपी-न्˚, उरू-ण्˚, कुम्भीन्˚ &c.)

नस्त.en: m. the nose, L. · n. a sternutatory, snuff, L.…

नस्ता.en: f. a hole bored through the septum of the n˚, L.

नस्य.en: न/स्य mfn. belonging to or being in the nose (अस् breath), ŚBr. · न/स्य n. the hairs in the n˚, VS.… · a sternutatory, errhine, MBh.; R.; Suśr.…

नस्या.en: न/स्या (आ), f. n˚-cord, Yājñ., Sch. (cf. नास्य) · the nose, L.…

नाक.en: ना/क m. (√ नम् [?]; according to Br. & Nir. fr. 2. न/ + 2. -अ/क, ‘where there is no pain’ [?]; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 75 and below mfn.) vault of heaven (with or scil. दिव/स्), firmament, sky (generally conceived as threefold, cf. त्रि-दिव, त्रि-नाक, and AV. xix, 27, 4; in VS. xvii, 67 there is a fivefold scale, viz. पृथिवी, अन्तरि-क्ष, दिव्, दिवो-नाक, and स्वर्-ज्योतिस्), RV. &c. &c. · the sun, Naigh. i, 4… · N. of a ंअउद्गल्य, ŚBr. &c.… · of a myth. weapon of आर्जुन, MBh.… · of a dynasty, VP.… · ना/क mfn. painless, ChUp. ii, 10, 5.…

नाकु.en: m. (√ नम् [?] Uṇ. i, 19) · anthill, Nalac.… · mountain, L.… · N. of a ंउनि, L.…

नाकुल.en: mf(ई)n. (fr. नक्˚) ichneumon-like g. SarkarAdi · m. patr. fr. ङकुल, RPrāt. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 1, 114, Sch.)… · m. pl. N. of a people, MBh.…

नाक्र.en: ना/क्र m. a kind of aquatic animal, VS.; TS. (cf. नक्र).

नाग.en: / m. (prob. neither fr. न-ग nor fr. नग्न) a snake, (esp.) Coluber Naga, ŚBr.; MBh. &c. · (f. ई/, Suparṇ.) a ङ्āग or serpent-demon (the race of खद्रु or शु-रस्ā inhabiting the waters or the city भ्होग-वत्ī under the earth; they are supposed to have a human face with serpent-like lower extremities [see esp. Nāg. v, 17; RTL. 233 &c.]; their kings are Śएṣअ, Vāसुकि, and थक्ṣअक, ib. 323; 7 or 8 of the ङ्āगs are particularly mentioned, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; with <ns>Buddhists</ns> they are also represented as ordinary men, MWB. 220)… · N. of the numbers 7 (Sūryas.) or 8 (Hcat.)… · a cruel man, L.… · one of the 5 airs of the human body (which is expelled by eructation), Vedāntas.… · (sg. also collect.) an elephant (f(ई). , ifc. f(आ). ), Kāv.; BhP. etc.… · the best or most excellent of any kind (ifc.), L. (cf. ऋषभ, व्याघ्र &c.)…

नागकेसर.en: नाग—केसर m. Mesua Roxburghii, Vāsant. · नाग—केसर n. its blossom, Suśr. (-चूर्णक, L.)… · a kind of steel, L.…

नागराज.en: नाग—राज m. id., ib. (also ˚जन्) · a large or noble elephant, ib.… · N. of an author (also -केशव)…

नागवत्.en: नाग—वत् mfn. consisting of serpents (MW.) or of elephants, MBh.

नागक.en: m. N. of a man, Rājat.

नागर.en: mf(ई)n. (fr. नगर) town-born, t˚-bred, relating or belonging to a t˚ or city, t˚-like, civic, MBh.; Kāv. &c. · spoken in a t˚ (said of a partic. Apabhraṃśa dialect; cf. उप-न्˚), Sāh.… · polite, civil, Śak. v, 1/2 (v.l. for ˚रिक)… · clever, dexterous, cunning, Dhūrtan.… · bad, vile, L.… · nameless, L.… · m. a citizen, MBh. &c.… · (= पौर) a prince engaged in war under partic. circumstances (opp. to यायिन् &c. and also applied to planets opposed to each other), Var.… · a husband's brother, L.… · a lecturer, L.… · an orange, L. (cf. नाग-रङ्ग)… · toil, fatigue, L.… · desire of final beatitude, L.… · denial of knowledge, L.… · n. dry ginger, Suśr.… · the root of Cyperus Pertenuis, L.… · a partic. written character, Hcat.… · a kind of coitus, L.… · N. of sev. places, L.…

नाचिक.en: m. N. of a son of Vइśव्āमित्र, MBh.

नाचिकेत.en: / mf(ई)n. relating to ङचिकेत or ङ-चिकेतस्, KaṭhUp.; TĀr. · / m. (with अग्नि) a partic. fire, ib.… · (sc. अग्नि) any fire, L. (w.r. नाचिकेतु or नाच्छिकेत)… · N. of an ancient sage (son of ऊद्द्āलकि), MBh. (cf. त्रि-णाचिकेत).…

नाट.en: m. n. (√ नट्; g. arDarcAdi) dancing, acting, a dance, L. · m. (in music) N. of a ण्āग… · of a serpent-demon, Buddh. (cf. नट)… · pl. of a people, Rājat. (= कर्णाटक, L.)…

नाडी.en: / f. (fr. नाड nom. ˚डी/स्, RV. x, 135, 7) the tubular stalk of any plant or any tubular organ (as a vein or artery of the body) · any pipe or tube, RV. &c. &c.… · a flute, RV.; Kāṭh.… · the box of a wheel, TS.; Kāṭh.… · a fistulous sore, Suśr.… · the pulse, W.… · any hole or crevice, Kathās.… · a sort of bent grass (= गण्ड-दूर्वा), L.… · a strap of leather, thong, L.… · a measure of time = 1/2 ंउह्ūर्त, Var.… · a juggling trick, deception, L.…

नाथ.en: / n. refuge, help, AV.; TBr. · / m. a protector, patron, possessor, owner, lord (often ifc., esp. in names of gods and men, e.g. गोविङ्द-, जगन्- &c.; but also mf(आ)n. possessed of occupied by, furnished with, cf. स-)… · / m. a husband (esp. in voc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · a rope passed through the nose of a draft ox, L.… · N. of sev. authors, Cat.…

नाद.en: / m. (√ नद्) a loud sound, roaring, bellowing, crying, RV. &c. &c. · any sound or tone, Prāt.; R. &c. (= शब्द, L.)… · (in the ञोग) the nasal sound represented by a semicircle and used as an abbreviation in mystical words, BhP.… · a praiser (= स्तोतृ), Naigh. iii, 16.…

नादित.en: mfn. made to resound · ifc. sounding with, reverberant, MBh. &c.… · n. sound, noise, ib.…

नादिक.en: m. N. of a country, Buddh.

नाद्य.en: / mfn. = prec. mfn., RV. ii, 35, 1 (?); TS.

नान.en: m. N. of a man (also -भट्ट), Cat.

नाना.en: 2. नाना (see नान) f. coin (= = नाणक), Hcat. · 1. ना/ना ind. (Pāṇ. v, 2, 27; g. स्वरादि) differently, variously, distinctly, separately, (often used as an adj. = various, different, distinct from [with instr., e.g. विश्वं न नाना शम्भुना, ‘the Universe is not distinct from Ś˚’, Vop.; rarely mfn., e.g. नारीषु नानासु, Pañcar.] esp. in comp.; cf. below), RV. &c. &c.… · = विना, without (with instr. abl. or acc.), Pāṇ. ii, 3, 32.…

नानात्व.en: नाना—त्व n. difference, variety, manifoldness, Br.; MBh. &c.

नानाप्रकार.en: नाना—प्रकार mfn. various, manifold, R.; Suśr.

नानारूप.en: नाना—˚रूप n. pl. v˚ forms or shapes, R. · ना/ना—˚रूप (ना/ना-), mfn. multiform, manifold, AV.; Br.; Mn. &c. (˚प/-ता f., ŚBr.)…

नानार्थ.en: nAnA˚rTa mfn. (˚nAr˚) having a different aim or object, KaṭhUp. · containing some other sense (as a new sentence), VPrāt.… · having d˚ meanings (as a word of d˚ m˚), Gr. L.…

नानावर्ण.en: नाना—वर्ण m. pl. various colours, R. · नाना—वर्ण mf(आ)n. many-coloured, variegated, Var.; Suśr.; Hcat.…

नानाविध.en: नाना—वि/ध mfn. of various sorts, multiform, manifold, Mn.; MBh. &c.

नानू.en: m. N. of a man, Cat.

नान्दन.en: / n. (√ नन्द् or नन्दन) a pleasure garden, paradise, SV.; AitUp.

नान्दी.en: f. (√ नन्द्) joy, satisfaction, pleasure, RV.; MBh. · eulogium or praise of a deity, (esp.) a kind of blessing pronounced as a prologue to a drama, Mṛcch.; Kālid.; Sāh.; Pratāp. &c.… · (in music) a partic. measure… · = द्वादश-तूर्य-निर्घोष, L.…

नान्दीमुख.en: नान्दी—मुख mf(ई)n. having a cheerful face, Siṃhās. · (-खी रात्रि, f. end of night, daybreak, Lalit.)… · नान्दी—मुख m. pl. (with or scil. पितरस्; also ˚खः पितृ-गणः) a class of deceased ancestors to whom a partic. Śर्āद्द्ह, is offered (according to some the 3 ancestors preceding the great-grandfather), GṛS.; Yājñ.; Pur. &c.… · नान्दी—मुख m. = नान्दी-पट, L.… · नान्दी—मुख n. (Hcat.) = -श्राद्ध n. a Śर्āद्द्ह offered to a class of deceased ancestors (cf. above), Cat.…

नापित.en: / m. (Uṇ. iii, 87 ना/प्˚ √ स्ना?) a barber, shaver, ŚBr.; ŚrGṛS.; Mn. &c., RTL. 374, 459

नाभ.en: mfn. ifc. = नाभि, nave, navel, central point (cf. अब्ज-नाभ, वज्र-न्˚, सु-न्˚ &c.) · m. N. of Śइव, MBh.… · of a son of Śरुत and father of शिन्द्हुद्व्īप, BhP.…

नाभि.en: ना/भि f. (prob. fr. √ 1. नभ्, ‘to burst asunder or into a hole’; ifc. f. इ or ई, Vām. v, 49) the navel (also n˚-string, cf. -कृन्तन), a navel-like cavity, RV. &c. &c. (in later language also m. and f(˚भी). ) · the nave of a wheel, ib. (also m., L., and ˚भी f.)… · centre, central point, p˚ of junction or of departure, home, origin, esp. common o˚, affinity, relationship… · a near relation or friend, ib. (m., L.)… · musk: (= मृग-न्˚), L.… · ना/भि m. or f. musk-deer, Megh. 53 (?); BhP.… · ना/भि m. a chief (= central point) of (gen.), Ragh. xviii, 19 (cf. मण्डल-नाभि-ता)… · a sovereign or lord paramount (= मुख्य-राज्), L.… · a ख्ṣअत्रिय, L.… · N. of a grandson of फ्रिय-व्रत (son of आग्न्īद्ह्र and father of Ṛṣअब्ह), Pur.… · of the father of Ṛṣअब्ह (first आर्हत् of the present आवसर्पिṇī), L.…

नाभिज.en: नाभि—ज m. ‘navel-born’ = next, L. · n˚-dirt, Gal.…

नाभिल.en: mfn. g. siDmAdi, Uṇ. iv, 125, Sch.

नाभ्य.en: mfn. sprung from or being in the navel, umbilical, BhP. · m. N. of Śइव (with नाभ), MBh.… · n. a kind of sacrifice, MānGṛ.…

नाम.en: 1. ना/म ind. (acc. of ना/मन्) by name i.e. named, called, RV. &c. &c. (also with नामतस् and नाम्ना) · indeed, certainly, really, of course, ib.… · quasi, only in appearance, Jātakam.… · however, nevertheless, ib.… · after an interr. = then, pray, e.g. किं न्˚, कथं न्˚, कदा n˚, what then? pray, what? &c., MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · after an Impv. = may it be so, no matter, e.g. Śak. v, 8… · अपि न्˚ at the beginning of a sentence = perhaps, I dare say, e.g. अप्य् एष नाम फलम् इच्छति, this man wants perhaps a reward, Mṛcch. viii, 25… · with Pot. often = would that, e.g. api nAmEvaM syAt, would that it were so, Vikr. v, 19/20… · opp. to मा न्˚ with Pot. would that not, I should think not, e.g. मा नाम अकार्यं कुर्यात्, I hope he will not do something wrong, Mṛcch. iii, 26.… · 2. नाम in comp. for नामन्, q.v. (sometimes ifc. as in सत्य-, q.v.)…

नामकरण.en: नाम—करण m. a nominal suffix, Nir. · नाम—करण n. the calling of a person (gen.) by the name of (नाम्ना), Sarvad.… · the ceremony of naming a child after birth, Kauś. &c., RTL. 370… · (˚रणं √ कृ, to perform this c˚), BhP.…

नामग्रह.en: नाम—ग्रह m. mentioning a name, naming, Amar.

नामध.en: नाम—ध/ or नाम—धा/, m. name-giver, RV.; AV.

नामधेय.en: नाम—धे/य n. a name, title, appellation (often ifc.; cf. किं-न्˚, पुं-न्˚ &c.), RV. &c. &c. <div n="1"/> the ceremony of giving a name to a child, Mn. ii, 123 (also -करण n. Gobh.)

नामनिर्देश.en: नाम—निर्देश m. pointing out by name, MW.

नाममात्र.en: नाम—मात्र mfn. = having only the name of (nom.), Pañc. i, 87 · नाम—मात्र n. the mere n˚, Śak.; Pañc.…

नामयज्ञ.en: नाम—यज्ञ m. a sacrifice only in n˚, Bhag.

नामरूप.en: नाम—रूप/ n. du. name and form, Br.; Up. &c. (˚pAtmaka mfn.) · = individual being, MWB. 102.…

नामाक्षर.en: nAmAkzara n. pl. the syllables forming a name, n˚-writing, Vikr.

नामक.en: 1. नामक mf(इका)n. ifc. = नामन्, name, Hariv.; Kāv. &c. (cf. अङ्घ्रि., कृत- &c.)

नामन्.en: ना/मन् n. (prob. neither fr. √ ज्ञा nor fr. √ म्ना [cf. Uṇ. iv, 150]; ifc. f. either = m. or ˚म्नी) a characteristic mark or sign, form, nature, kind, manner, RV.; VS.; AV. · name, appellation, RV. &c. &c.… · personal name (as opp. to गोत्रे, family n˚; cf. नम-गोत्र above), Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 2, 23 (often ifc. = named, called, e.g. विष्णु-शर्म-नामा पण्डितः, a sage named V˚)… · merely the n˚ (as opp. to reality; cf. नाम-धारक, -मात्र, -शेष &c.), a noun (as opp. to a verb), Nir.; Prāt.… · substance, essence (in the ंīम्āṃस्ā phil. opp. to गुण, accidental quality)… · a good or great name, renown, fame (only ifc.; cf. स्व-, सुम/न्तु-)… · water, Naigh. i, 11… · [cf. Zd. nāman; Gk. ὄ-νομα; Lat. nōmen; Goth. namō; Germ. namo &c.; Eng. name.]…

नाम्ना.en: ना/म्ना ind. by name (also joined with 1. नाम) · with √ कृ (Kāv.) or वि-धा (Kathās.) to call by a name… · नाम (q.v.) with √ ग्रभ् (ग्रह्) to mention or address by n˚, RV. &c. &c.… · with √ भृ, to bear or have a n˚, ib.… · with √ कृ (Br.; Mn. &c.), √ दा or धा (GṛS.), to give a n˚ call.…

नामिक.en: 1. नामिक mfn. relating to a name or to a noun, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 72.

नामित.en: mfn. (√ नम्, Caus.) bent, bowed, R.; Mṛcch.

नाम्य.en: mfn. to be bent (as a bow), bendable, pliant, MBh. &c.

नाय.en: / m. (√ नी) a leader, guide, RV. vi, 24, 10; 46, 11 (proper N. Sāy.; cf. अश्व-, गो-) · guidance, direction, L.… · policy, means, expedient, Bhaṭṭ., Sch.…

नायक.en: m. a guide, leader, chief, lord, principal, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (with or scil. सैन्यस्य, a general, commander; ifc. f(अका). cf. अ-नायक) · a husband, BhP.… · (in dram.) the lover or hero… · the central gem of a necklace (implying also ‘a general’, cf. नायकाय and महा-नायक)… · a paradigm or example (in gram.)… · N. of घउतम भुद्द्ह, Buddh.… · of a <ns>Brāhman</ns>, Rājat.… · of an author (also भट्ट-न्˚), Cat.… · m. n. a kind of musk, L. (cf. नायिका-चूर्ण)…

नार.en: / mf(ई)n. (fr. नर) relating to or proceeding from men, human, mortal, Mn.; Kāv. · spiritual (?), W.… · / m. a man, TĀr. (v.l.)… · / m. (pl.) water (also sg. n. and f(आ). , L.), Mn. i, 10 (prob. invented to explain नारायण)… · / m. = नारायण, L.… · a calf, L.… · / n. a multitude of men, L.… · dry ginger, L.…

नारी.en: / (ई), f., see नारी · ना/री f. (of ˚र/, q.v.) a woman, a wife (in older language also ना/रि), RV. &c. &c.… · a female or any object regarded as feminine, VS.; TĀr.… · sacrifice, Naigh.… · N. of a daughter of ंएरु, BhP.… · of 2 kinds of metre, Col.… · ना/री , f. See above.…

नारायण.en: / m. (patr. fr. न/र, q.v.) the son of the original Man (with whom he is generally associated, e.g. Mn. i, 10; he is identified with भ्रह्म्ā, ib. 11 with Vइṣṇउ or ख्ṛṣṇअ, TĀr.; MBh. &c.; the आप्सरस् ऊर्वśī is said to have sprung from his thigh, Hariv. 4601; elsewhere he is regarded as a खśयप or आṅगिरस, also as chief of the श्āद्ह्यs, and with झइनs as the 8th of the 9 black Vāसुदेवs) · the फुरुṣअ-hymn (RV. x, 90, said to have been composed by N˚), ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.… · (as synonym of Vइṣṇउ) N. of the 2nd month (reckoning from ंāर्गśīर्ṣअ), Var.… · a mystical N. of the letter आ, Up.… · N. of a son of आज्ā-मिल, BhP.… · of a son of भ्ह्ū-मित्र or भ्ह्ūमि-मित्र (a prince of the dynasty of the ख्āṇव्āयनs), Pur.… · of a son of ङर-हरि, Kṣitīś.… · of sev. men, authors and commentators (also with आचार्य. कवि, गार्ग्य, चक्र-चूडामणि, दैव-विद्, DarmADikArin, पण्डित, paRqita-DarmADikAriN, paRqitAcArya, परिव्राज्, भट्ट [cf. below, and भट्ट-न्˚], BawwAcArya, BawwAraqa, भारती, भिषज्, मुनि, यति, yatIvara, राय, वन्द्य, vAdISvara, विद्या-विनोद, वैष्णव-मुनि, शर्मन्, सरस्वती, सर्व-ज्ञ, सार्वभौम)…

नारिक.en: mf(ई)n. watery, aqueous, L. · spiritual, L. (cf. नार/).…

नार्य.en: / m. N. of a man, RV. · / n. the being a man, Bhadrab.…

नारक.en: ना/रक mf(ई)n. (fr. नरक) relating to hell, hellish, infernal · ना/रक m. (with लोक/) hell, AV. (also नारक/ m., VS.)… · ना/रक m. inhabitant of hell, Pur.…

नारद.en: ना/रद or नारद/ m. N. of a Ṛṣइ (a ख्āṇव or ख्āśयप, author of RV. viii, 13; ix, 104; 105; Anukr.; as a धेवर्ṣइ often associated with फर्वत and supposed to be a messenger between gods and men, MBh.; Hariv.; Kāv. &c.; among the 10 फ्रज्ā-पतिs as a son of भ्रह्म्ā, Mn. i, 35; in later mythology he is a friend of ख्ṛṣṇअ and is regarded as inventor of the Vइन्ā or lute; in ep. poetry he is called a धेव-गन्द्हर्व or a घन्द्हर्व-र्āज or simply घन्द्हर्व) · of a son of Vइśव्ā-मित्र, MBh.… · of one of the 24 mythic. भुद्द्हs, MWB. 136… · of sev. men, Lalit.; HPariś.… · of sev. authors, Cat. (cf. below)… · of a mountain, BhP.… · ना/रद mf(ई)n. relating to ङ्āरद, composed by him, Cat.…

नारदा.en: ना/रदा f. the root of sugarcane, L.

नाराच.en: m. (fr. ?) an iron arrow, any a˚, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. अर्ध-) · water-elephant (= jaleBa), L.… · a bad or cloudy day (?), L.… · n. a kind of metre, Col. (cf. नर्˚)… · a partic. medicament, Car.…

नारिकेल.en: m. id., MBh. &c. (L. also ˚लि f., or ˚ली f.)

नाल.en: mfn. (fr. नल cf. नाड) consisting or made of reeds, BhP. · m. (g. arDarcAdi) f(आ, or ई, L.). and n. a hollow stalk, (esp.) of the lotus, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · m. any tube or tubular vessel or vein &c. of the body, ib.… · m. or n. the navel-string, Gobh., Sch.… · m. N. of a poet, Cat.… · n. the urethra, Suśr.… · n. a handle (only mf(आ)n. ifc.), MBh. vii, 75… · n. a partic. ornament on a chariot, R. vi, 75, 28… · yellow orpiment, L.…

नाला.en: (आ), f. N. of a river, MBh.; VP. (v.l. नीला)

नाव.en: 1. नाव/ m. (√ 4. नु) a shout of joy or triumph, RV. · 2. नाव = नौ, a boat, a ship (in comp. cf. अर्ध-न्˚, द्वि-न्˚, Pāṇ. v, 4, 99, 100)…

नाविक.en: mf(ई)n. belonging to a ship or boat, W. · m. a helmsman, pilot, sailor (ifc. f(आ). ), MBh.; R. &c.… · n. N. of a श्āमन्.…

नाव्य.en: 1. नाव्य Nom. P. ˚यति, to wish for a ship, L. · 2. नाव्य^ mf(आ)n. navigable, accessible by a boat or ship, AV.; MBh. &c.… · ^ m. a shipman, sailor, ĀpGṛ.… · ^ n. id., Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 3, 18.… · 3. नाव्य n. (fr. 1. न/व) newness, novelty, L.…

नावर.en: m. N. of a family, Cat.

नाश.en: 1. नाश m. (√ 1. नश्) attainment (see दूण्˚). · 2. नाश m. (√ 2. नश्) the being lost, loss, disappearance, destruction, annihilation, ruin, death, Br.; Mn.; MBh. &c. नाशी.en: f. N. of a river near Benares, L.

नाशक.en: mf(इका)n. destroying, annihilating, removing (with gen. or comp.), MBh. &c. (cf. कु-न्˚, कृत-न्˚) · wasting, prodigal of (cf. अर्थ-न्˚).…

नाशन.en: mf(ई)n. destroying &c. = prec. (with gen. or ifc.), VS.; MBh. &c. · n. destruction, removal… · causing to be lost or perish, Āpast.; MBh.; R. &c.… · forgetting (aDItasya), Yājñ. iii, 228.…

नाशित.en: mfn. destroyed, ruined, lost, Yājñ. · banished, expulsed, an outcast (see next).…

नासा.en: ना/सा f. the nose (either du., e.g. AV. v, 23, 3, or sg. Mn.; MBh. &c.; ifc. f(आ). , MBh.; R. &c.) · proboscis (cf. गज-न्˚)… · = -दारु (below), L.… · Gendarussa Vulgaris, L. (cf. 3. नस् and नासिका).…

नासिका.en: ना/सिका f. a nostril · (older du.) the nose, RV. &c., &c. (ifc. f(आ or ई). , Pāṇ. iv, 1, 55)… · the proboscis of an elephant, BhP.… · = नासा-दारु, L.… · N. of आśविन्ī (mother of the two आśविन्s), L.…

नासिकाग्र.en: nAsikA˚gra (˚kAg˚) n. the point of the nose, Bhag. (-तस् ind.)

नासिक्य.en: mf(आ)n. being in or coming from the nose, ChUp.; Vait. · uttered through the n˚, nasal, Prāt.; Hcat.… · m. any nasal sound, Śikṣ.… · a partic. n˚ s˚ related to the so-called ञमs, Prāt.… · du. the two आśविन्s (= नासत्यौ), L.… · pl. N. of a people in धक्ṣइṇā-पत्ह, Var.; AVPariś.… · n. the nose (also -क), L.… · N. of a town, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 63, Vārtt. 3.…

नास्य.en: n. the nose-cord (of a draught-ox &c.), Mn. viii, 291 · (prob.) an errhine (in next).…

नासत्या.en: ना/सत्या (आ), f. the constellation आśविन्ī, L. (The derivations fr. न + असत्य, or fr. नासा + त्य or fr. ना + सत्य are very improbable.)

नाह.en: m. (√ नह्) binding, tying, L. · obstruction (cf. नासा-न्˚)… · trap or snare for catching deer, L.…

नि.en: 1. नि/ ind. down, back, in, into, within (except, AV. x, 8, 7 always prefixed either to verbs or to nouns; in the latter case it has also the meaning of negation or privation [cf. ‘down-hearted’ = heartless]; sometimes w.r. for निस्) · it may also express क्षेप, दान, उप-रम, आ-श्रय, मोक्ष &c., L.… · [cf. Zd. ni; Gk. ἐ-νί; Slav. ni-zu; Germ., ni-dar, ni-der, nieder; Angl.Sax. ni-ther, Eng. ne-ther, be-neath.]… · 2. नि (for नी) mfn. See ऋत-नि/.… · 3. नि (in music) the 7th note (for निषध).…

निः.en: for निस् (q.v.) before a sibilant and rarely before क्, ख्; प्, फ्.

निःश्रेयसकर.en: निः—श्रेयस—कर mfn. conferring final happiness or emancipation,<pb n="539,1"/> W.

निःसंशय.en: निः—संशय mfn. undoubted, certain, MBh.; R. &c. (also ˚यित, Kād.) · not doubtful, not doubting or suspecting, MBh.; Ragh.…

निःसङ्ग.en: निः—सङ्ग m. absence of attachment, entire concentration, BhP. · निः—सङ्ग mfn. unobstructed, moving freely, MBh.… · unconnected, separated, detached, Kap.… · not attached or devoted, indifferent to (loc.), Prab.; Vedānt.… · free from worldly attachment, unselfish, disinterested, MBh.; Hariv. &c.… · निः—सङ्ग m. N. of a man, Cat.…

निःसङ्गता.en: निः—सङ्ग—ता f. absence of attachment, unselfishness, indifference, Pur. &c.

निःसंज्ञ.en: निः—संज्ञ mfn. senseless, unconscious, MBh.; R. &c.

निःस्पन्द.en: निः—स्पन्द mfn. (cf. निष्-प्˚) motionless, Kathās.; Naiṣ.

निःस्पृह.en: निः—स्पृह mf(आ)n. free from desire, not longing for (loc. or comp.), abstaining from (abl.), Mn.; MBh. &c. (-ता f., Yājñ.)

निःस्व.en: निः—स्व mfn. deprived of one's own, indigent, poor, Mn.; MBh. &c.

निःस्वभाव.en: निः—स्वभाव m. want of property, poverty, Śāntiś. · निः—स्वभाव mfn. ‘unpropertied’, void of peculiarities, Sarvad.…

निरंश.en: निर्—अंश mfn. having no degrees (of latit. or long.)

निरक्ष.en: निर्—अक्ष mfn. having no dice, W. · having no latitude, ib.… · निर्—अक्ष m. the place of no l˚ i.e. the terrestrial equator, Sūryas.…

निरक्षर.en: निर्—अक्षर mfn. not knowing the letters, HPariś.

निरग्नि.en: निर्—अग्नि mfn. having no (consecrated) fire, MBh.

निरङ्ग.en: निर्—अङ्ग mf(आ or ई)n. incomplete, Sāh. · having no resources or expedients, Hit.…

निरञ्जन.en: निर्—अञ्जन mf(आ)n. unpainted, spotless, pure, simple, Up.; MBh. &c. · void of passion or emotion, W.… · निर्—अ/ञ्जन m. N. of Śइव, Śivag.… · of an attendant of Ś˚, Hariv.… · निर्—अ/ञ्जन m. of sev. authors, Cat. (also with यति; ˚nAzwaka n. N. of wk.)… · निर्—अ/ञ्जन n. the Supreme Being, W.…

निरतिशय.en: निर्—अतिशय mfn. unsurpassed (-त्व n.), Hariv.; Pañc. &c.

निरधिष्ठान.en: निर्—अधिष्ठान mfn. having no resting-place or basis, supportless, untenable, MBh.; R. · independent, Śaṃk.…

निरनुनासिक.en: निर्—अनुनासिक mfn. not marked with the आनुन्āसिक, not nasal, Vop.

निरन्तर.en: निर्—अन्तर mf(आ)n. having no interval (in space or time), close, compact, dense, uninterrupted, perpetual, constant (-ता f.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · faithful, true, Pañc.… · abounding in, full of (comp.), R.; Sāh.… · not other or different, identical, MBh.; R. &c.… · not hidden from view, W.…

निरन्तरम्.en: निर्—अन्तरम् ind. closely, tightly, firmly, Ṛt.; Suśr. · constantly, continually, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · immediately, at once, Kām.; Vet.…

निरन्वय.en: निर्—अन्वय mfn. having no offspring, childless, Rājat. · unconnected, unrelated, Mn. viii, 198; 331… · illogical, unmethodical, W.… · not committed in the presence of others, Mn. viii, 332… · without retinue, unaccompanied, Bhaṭṭ.…

निरपवाद.en: निर्—अपवाद mfn. blameless, BhP. · not admitting of any exception (also -क), Pat.…

निरपेक्ष.en: nir—apekza mf(आ)n. regardless of, indifferent to, independent of (loc. or comp.) · desireless, careless, indifferent, disinterested, Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c. (also -क, BhP.)…

निरपेक्षम्.en: nir—apekzam ind. regardlessly, accidentally, MBh.; Daś.

निरर्थक.en: निर्—अर्थक mf(इका)n. useless, vain, unsuccessful, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (अम् ind., R.; Bhartṛ.; -त्व n., Mṛcch.) · unmeaning, nonsensical, MBh.… · (said of a consonant) = -अर्थ, VPrāt., Sch.… · निर्—अर्थक n. (in phil.) a nonsensical objection… · (in rhet.) an expletive.…

निरवद्य.en: निर्—अवद्य mf(आ)n. unblamable, unobjectionable, Up.; MBh. &c. (-त्व n., BhP.) · निर्—अवद्य n. blamelessness, excellence (-वत् mfn., MBh.)… · निर्—अवद्य n. or m. a partic. high number, Lalit.… · निर्-अवद्य -अवयव &c. See निर्, p. 539, col. 3.…

निरवयव.en: निर्—अवयव mfn. having no limbs or members · not consisting of parts, indivisible (-त्व n.), Śaṃk.; Sarvad. &c.…

निरवशेष.en: निर्—अवशेष mfn. without a residue, complete, whole, R. &c.

निराकाङ्क्ष.en: निर्—आकाङ्क्ष mfn. expecting or wishing nothing, desireless, hopeless, Kathās.; Pur. (also ˚क्षिङ्, MBh.) · wanting nothing to fill up, complete (वाक्य), KātyŚr.; Sāh.…

निरात्मक.en: निर्—आत्मक mfn. having no separate soul or no individual existence, BhP.

निराबाध.en: निर्—आबाध mf(आ)n. undisturbed unmolested, secure, MBh.; Hariv.

निराय.en: निर्—आय mfn. having or yielding no income, profitless, W.

निरायास.en: निर्—आयास mfn. not causing trouble or fatigue, easy, MBh. · kind, Divyāv.…

निरालम्ब.en: निर्—आलम्ब mfn. = -अवल्˚ · self-supported, independent… · friendless, alone, Mn.; MBh. &c. (अम् ind., R.; -त्व n., Hcar.)… · निर्—आलम्ब m. N. of a philosopher (worshipping the empty air as deity), Cat.…

परमाणु.en: paramARu m. an infinitesimal particle or atom (30 are said to form a mote in a sun-beam), Yājñ.; Yogas.; MBh. &c. (cf. भृत्य-प्˚) · the passing of a sun-beam past an atom of matter, Pur.… · paramARu n. 1/8 of a ंāत्र्ā, VPrāt.…

परमाणुकारणवाद.en: paramARu—kAraRa-vAda m. the atomistic system of the Vअइśएṣइकs, Śaṃk.

परमात्म.en: 1. paramAtma/ m. a partic. personification, MaitrS. · 2. paramAtma in comp. = ˚त्मन्…

परमात्मक.en: paramAtmaka mf(इका)n. the highest, greatest, MBh.

परमात्मन्.en: paramAtman m. all the heart (only instr. = परमेण चेतसा, col. 1), MBh. · the Supreme Spirit, Up.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (cf. RTL. 37).…

परमानन्द.en: paramAnanda m. supreme felicity · the Supreme Spirit, soul of the universe, MBh.; Bhartṛ. &c.… · N. of sev. authors (also -चक्रवर्तिन्, -दास, -देव, -नाथ, -पाठक, -BawwAcArya, -yogIndra, -सरस्वती, ˚dASrama), Cat.…

परमार्थ.en: paramArTa m. the highest or whole truth, spiritual knowledge, MBh.; Kāv.; Vedāntas. &c. (ibc.; ˚एन, आत्, in reality) · any excellent or important object, W.… · the best sense, ib.… · the best kind of wealth, ib.…

परमार्थतस्.en: paramArTa—tas ind. in reality, really, in the true sense of the word, R.; Kālid. &c.

परमार्थता.en: paramArTa—tA f. the highest truth, reality, Kap., Sch.

परमार्थदर्शन.en: paramArTa—darSana m. N. of a शम्āद्हि, Kāraṇḍ.

परमार्थसत्य.en: paramArTa—satya n. the real or entire truth, L.

परमेश्वर.en: parameSvara m. the supreme lord, Supreme Being, God · N. of Śइव… · of Vइṣṇउ… · of ईन्द्र… · of any eminent prince or illustrious man, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. RTL. 35 &c.)… · a झइन, L.… · N. of sev. authors (˚रीय n. a work of P˚), Cat.… · parameSvara n. (sc. लिङ्ग) N. of a ळिṅग sacred to Śइव, Cat.…

परमेष्वास.en: paramezvAsa m. an excellent archer, (-ता f.), MBh.

परमक.en: mf(इका)n. the most excellent, highest, best, greatest, extreme, MBh.; R. &c. (w.r. पार्˚ and परमिक).

परमेष्ठि.en: परमे—ष्ठि m. a superior or a chief god of the झइनs, Śatr.

परस्.en: पर/स् ind. beyond, further, off, away · in future, afterwards… · (as prep. with acc.) on the other side of, beyond, higher or more than… · (with instr.) id. (also पर/ एना/ or एना/ पर/ः)… · without… · (with abl.) beyond, on the other side of (also एना/ पर/ः)… · exclusive of, except, without… · (with loc.) over, more than (only त्रिंश/ति त्र/यस् पर/ः, three more than thirty i.e. 33), RV.; VS.; AV.; ŚBr.… · (often in comp. with numerals to express a surplus or superiority; cf. prec. and under परः).…

परस्तात्.en: प/रस्—तात् (प/र्˚), ind. further away, further on, towards (opp. to अवस्तात्, अर्वाक्; with gen.) beyond, above, RV. &c. &c. · from afar off, from before or behind, Br.… · aside, apart, ib.… · hereafter, afterwards, later (opp. to पूर्वम्), RV.; &c.…

परस्प.en: पर/स्—प (˚र/स्), mfn. protecting · पर/स्—प n. (VS.) = -त्व/ n. (ŚBr.) protection.…

परस्पर.en: परस्-पर mf(आ)n. (fr. nom. sg. m. of पर + पर; cf. अन्योऽन्य) mutual, each other's, Bhaṭṭ. · pl. like one another, MBh. xii, 2420… · so also ibc. (cf. below)… · परस्-पर rarely ifc., e.g. अविज्ञात-परस्परैः, ‘not knowing each other’, Ragh. xvii, 51.…

परस्परम्.en: परस्-परम् ind. (mostly in the oblique cases of m. sg. ˚अम्, एण, आत्, अस्य) one another, each other, with or from one another, one another's, mutually, reciprocally, Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.

परस्परविरुद्ध.en: परस्-पर—विरुद्ध mfn. opposed to o˚ an˚, Mn.

परस्मै.en: dat., of पर in comp. (cf. आत्मने and Pāṇ. vi, 3, 8).

परस्मैपद.en: परस्मै—पद n. ‘word for another’, the transitive or active verb and its terminations, Pāṇ. i, 4, 99, &c. · (pl.), iii, 4, 82.…

परात्पर.en: परात्—पर mfn. superior to the best, W. · senior to the senior (cf. next)…

परोक्ष.en: परो/—ऽक्ष (˚रो/-), mf(आ)n. beyond the range of sight, invisible, absent, unknown, unintelligible, AV. &c. &c. · past, completed (in a partic. sense, cf. below and Kāś. on Pāṇ. iii, 2, 115)… · (ibc.) in an invisible or imperceptible manner (cf. below)… · परो/—ऽक्ष m. an ascetic, L.… · N. of a son of आनु, BhP.…

परोक्षम्.en: परो—ऽक्षम् (अम्), ind. out of sight, behind one's back, in the absence or without the knowledge of (instr.; later gen. or comp.), ŚBr. &c. &c.

परोक्षेण.en: परो—ऽक्षेण (एण), ind. out of sight, secretly, mysteriously, Br.; Up.

परोक्षात्.en: परो—ऽक्षात् (आत्), ind. secretly, without the knowledge of (instr.), Br. <pb n="589,2"/>

परोक्षे.en: परो—ऽक्षे (ए), ind. behind the back of (gen.), Mṛcch.; Pañc. &c. · one's self not being present, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 115…

परोक्षा.en: परो—ऽक्षा (आ), f. (sc. वृत्ति) a past or completed action, APrāt. · (sc. विभक्ति) a termination of the perfect tense, Kāt.… · N. of a river, VP.…

परोवरीयस्.en: परो/—वरीयस् (˚रो/-), mfn. broader on the outside or at the top, TS.; AitBr.; Kāṭh. · better than good, most excellent of all, ChUp. (-त्व n., Bālar.)… · परो/—वरीयस् n. the highest happiness, ib.…

परश.en: m. a species of gem, BrahmaP.

परशु.en: / m. a hatchet, axe, the axe of a woodcutter · (Naigh. ii, 20) a thunderbolt, RV. &c. &c.… · N. of a king, MBh.… · w.r. for पर्शु, q.v. [cf. Gk. πέλεκυς, πέλεκκον, &c.]…

परशुराम.en: परशु—राम m. ‘णम with the axe’, N. of one of the three ण्āमs (son of झमद्-अग्नि and sixth आवत्āर of Vइṣṇउ, he was a typical <ns>Brāhman</ns> and his history typifies the contests between the भ्रह्मन्s and ख्ṣअत्रियs), Kāv.; Pur.; MWB. xiii, 1; RTL. 110; 270 (also -क) · N. of a prince and of sev. authors (also with गर्जर, देव, मिश्र, मुनि), Cat.…

पराक्रम.en: परा—क्रम m. (sg. and pl.; ifc. f(आ). ) bold advance, attack, heroism, courage, power, strength, energy, exertion, enterprise, MBh.; Kāv. &c. · going out or away, L.… · N. of Vइṣṇउ, L.… · of a warrior on the side of the खुरुs, MBh.… · of a chief of the Vइद्य्ā-द्हरs (associated with Ā-क्रम, Vइ-क्रम and शṃक्रम), Kathās.…

पराग.en: m. (prob. for अप-र्˚), the pollen of a flower, Kāv.; Pur. &c. · dust, Ragh. iv, 30… · fragrant powder used after bathing, L.… · sandal, L.… · an eclipse of the sun or moon, L.… · fame, celebrity, L.… · independence, L.… · N. of a mountain, L.…

परागत.en: प/रा˚गत (प/रा-), mfn. gone, deceased, ib. · come, arrived, Kād.… · covered with, full of (comp.), Śiś.…

परागा.en: परा-√ 1. गा (only aor. -गास्, -गात्), to go away, fly, escape, RV.; AV.

पराजि.en: परा-√ जि Ā. -जयते (cf. Pāṇ. i, 3, 19; pf. -जिग्ये, RV.; p. -जिग्यान, TS.; aor. parAjEzwa, MBh.; fut. -जयिष्ये, ib.; but also P., e.g. Pot. -जयेत्, or -जय्यात्, MBh.; pf. -जिग्यथुर्, RV.; aor. parAjEzIt, MBh.; inf. -जेतुम्, R.; ind.p. -जित्य, ib.), <div n="to"/>to be deprived of, suffer the loss of (acc.), be conquered, succumb, RV. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to submit to, be overcome by (abl.), Pāṇ. i, 4, 26; <div n="to"/>to conquer, win, vanquish, overthrow, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; <div n="to"/>to defeat in a lawsuit, Yājñ. ii, 75.

पराजय.en: परा—जय m. the being deprived of or conquered, loss, defeat (also in a lawsuit), MBh.; Kāv.; Yājñ. · conquest, victory, MBh.; R.; Ragh.… · turning away from, desertion, MW.…

पराजित.en: प/रा—जित (प/रा-), mfn. conquered, defeated, overthrown, cast (in a lawsuit), condemned by law, RV.; &c.

पराङ्.en: ind. outwards, towards the outer world, KaṭhUp.; BhP. · in comp. for, ˚राञ्च्.…

पराचीन.en: पराची/न mfn. turned away or downwards or opposite, averted, VS. &c. &c. · being o˚ or beyond or outside of BhP. averse from, indifferent to (abl.), MBh.… · unfit, improper, Hcar.…

पराण.en: parARa n. (with वायोः) N. of a श्āमन्, L.

परादा.en: परा-√ 1. दा P. -ददाति, (pf. -ददाथ aor. -दास्, -दात् [often as Subj.], -दुर्; Ved. inf. -दै/), <div n="to"/>to give up or over, deliver, throw away, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; <div n="vp"/> give in exchange for, barter against (dat.), RV. viii, 1, 5; <div n="to"/>to exclude from, BhP.

पराप.en: parApa n. (fr. परा + अप्), Pāṇ. vi, 3, 97, Vārtt. 1, Pat. · parApa mfn. (a place &c.) whence water has retired, W.…

पराभू.en: परा-√ भू P. -भवति (fut. -भविष्यति; Ved. inf. -भु/वे), <div n="to"/>to perish, disappear, be lost, succumb, yield, AV.; Br. &c.; <div n="to"/>to overcome, conquer, R.; Kām.; <div n="to"/> (Pass. p. -भूयमान, BhP.) to harm, hurt, injure, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: <div n="vp"/>Caus. -भावयति, to overthrow, destroy, AV.; Br. &c.; <div n="to"/> (Ā.) to vanish, perish, sustain a loss, BhP.

पराभव.en: परा-भव/ m. vanishing, disappearance, dissolution, separation, R. · overthrow, defeat, humiliation, mortification, contempt, injury, destruction, ruin, ŚBr.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · N. of the 40th (or 14th) year in Jupiter's cycle of 60 years, Var. (cf. परावसु)…

पराभाव.en: परा-भाव m. defeat, overthrow, MBh. · humiliation, contempt, L.…

परामृश्.en: परा-√ मृश् P. -मृशति (inf. -मर्ष्टुम् ind.p. -मृश्य), to seize or lay hold of, touch, feel, stroke, handle, clutch, ŚāṅkhŚr.; MBh. &c.; <div n="to"/>to handle roughly, violate (as a woman or a temple), MBh.; R.; <div n="to"/>to point or refer to (acc.), Śaṃk.; Nīlak.; <div n="to"/>to consider, deliberate, Bhām. : <div n="vp"/>Pass. -मृश्यते, to be touched, be referred to or meant, Kāś.; Kull. (w.r. -मृष्˚).

परामर्श.en: परा-मर्श m. seizing, pulling (केश-, by the hair), MBh. · bending or drawing (of a bow), R.… · violation, injury, assault, attack, MBh.; R.; Kād.… · affection (by disease &c.), MārkP.… · remembrance, recollection, Vedāntas.… · referring or pointing t˚, Sāh.… · reflection, consideration, judgement, MBh.; Bhāṣāp.… · (in logic) inference, conclusion, drawing conclusions from analogy or experience, knowledge of the minor premiss in its connection with the major… · N. of wk.…

परामृष्ट.en: प/रा-मृष्ट (प/रा-), mfn. seized or laid hold of, grasped, handled, touched, felt, roughly treated, violated, afflicted (by disease &c.), AV.; MBh. &c. · recollected, considered, referred to, RPrāt.… · borne, endured, W.…

पराया.en: परा-√ या P. -याति, to go away, RV.; AV. : <div n="vp"/>Caus. -याप/यति, to bid go away, Kauś.

परास्.en: parAs (परा- √ 2. अस्) P. parAsyati (impf. parAsyat; pf. parAsa), to throw away or down, cast aside, expose (as a newborn child), abandon, reject, leave, RV.; &c.

परास्य.en: parA/sya or parAsya^ mfn. to be thrown away, ŚBr.

परासु.en: parAsu mfn. one whose vital spirit is departed or departing · dying or dead, MBh.; Kāv. &c.…

परि.en: प/रि ind. round, around, about, round about · fully, abundantly, richly (esp. ibc. [where also परी] to express fulness or high degree), RV. &c. &c.… · as a prep. (with acc.) about (in space and time), RV.; AV.… · against, opposite to, in the direction of, towards, to, ib. (cf. Pāṇ. i, 4, 90; also at the beginning of a comp. mfn.; cf. ib. ii, 2, 18, Vārtt. 4, Pat. and पर्य्-अध्ययन)… · beyond, more than, AV.… · to the share of (with √ अस्, or भू, to fall to a person's lot), Pāṇ. i, 4, 90… · successively, severally (e.g. वृक्षम् परि सिञ्चति, he waters tree after tree), ib.… · (with abl.) from, away from, out of RV.; AV.; ŚBr. (cf. Pāṇ. i, 4, 93)… · outside of, except, Pāṇ. i, 4, 88, Kāś. (often repeated, ib. viii, 1, 5; also at the beginning or the end of an ind. comp. ib. ii, 1, 12)…

परिकर.en: परि-कर परि-कर्मन् &c. See परि-कृ, col. 3. · परि-कर mf(ई)n. who or what helps or assists, W.… · परि-कर m. (ifc. f(आ). ) attendants, followers, entourage, retinue, train (sg. and pl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · परि-कर m. multitude, abundance, Bhartṛ.; Bālar.… · a girth, zone, waist-band, (esp.) a girdle to keep up a garment (˚रम्-√ बन्ध्, or ˚रं-√ कृ, ‘to gird up one's loins, make preparations’, and so परि-कर = आरम्भ, L.), Hariv.; Kāv.; Rājat. &c.… · (in dram.) covert or indirect intimation of coming events in a plot, the germ of the भ्īज, Daśar.… · (in rhet.) a partic. figure in which many significant epithets or adjectives are employed one after the other to give force to a statement, Kpr.; Sāh. &c.…

परिकल्प.en: परि-कल्प ˚पन &c. See परि-कॢप्, p. 592, col. 1. · परि-कल्प m. illusion, Buddh.… · w.r. for ˚कम्प.…

परिकीर्तित.en: परि-कीर्तित mfn. proclaimed, announced, boasted of, said, called, ib.

परिकरबन्ध.en: परि-कर—बन्ध m. the binding on of a girdle in order to begin any work, MW.

परिकल्पन.en: परि-कल्पन n. fixing, settling, contriving, making, inventing, providing, dividing, distributing

परिकल्पना.en: परि-कल्पना f. making, forming, assuming (see रूप-परिक्˚) · reckoning, calculation, Var.…

परिकल्पित.en: परि-कल्पित mfn. settled, decided · fixed upon, chosen, wished for, expected, made, created, imagined, invented, contrived, arranged, distributed, divided (with खण्ड-शः, cut or broken in pieces), Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.…

परिकल्प्य.en: परि-कल्प्य mfn. to be settled &c. · to be calculated, Var.…

परिक्री.en: परि-√ क्री Ā. -क्रीणीते (Pāṇ. i, 3, 18; really more frequent in P., e.g. impf. -अक्रीणम्, AV.; Pot. -क्रीणीयात्, ŚāṅkhŚr.; ind.p. -क्रीय, Gobh.), <div n="to"/>to purchase, buy, barter, gain, acquire, AV.; ŚBr.; Lāṭy.; Gobh. (with instr. or dat. of the price, e.g. शतेन, or शताय, to buy for a hundred, Pāṇ. i, 4, 44); <div n="to"/>to hire, engage for stipulated wages, ŚBr.; ŚrS.; <div n="to"/>to recompense, reward (only p. Ā. -क्रीणान), Bhaṭṭ. · परि-क्री m. N. of an ऐक्āह, ŚrS.…

परिक्लिष्टम्.en: परि-क्लिष्टम् ind. with uneasiness or reluctance, unwillingly.

परिक्षि.en: परि-√ 4. क्षि P. -क्षिणोति, to destroy, BhP. : <div n="vp"/>Pass. -क्षीयते, to waste away, decay, become exhausted, Hit. · परि-√ 2. क्षि P. -क्षेति, to dwell around (with acc.), AitBr. vi, 32.… · परि-क्षि m. v.l. for next, VP.…

परिक्षिप्त.en: परि-क्षिप्त mfn. thrown, thrown about, scattered, surrounded, overspread, MBh.; R. &c. · left, abandoned, W.…

परिखा.en: परि-खा f. (once ibc. ˚ख, BhP.) a moat, ditch, trench or fosse round a town or fort (also applied to the sea surrounding the earth), Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c. · N. of a village in the North country g. पलद्य्-आदि (iv, 2, 110)…

परिखिन्न.en: परि-खिन्न mfn. depressed, afflicted, exhausted, MBh.; R. &c.

परिखेद.en: परि-खेद m. (ifc. f(आ). ) lassitude, weariness, exhaustion, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

परिख्या.en: परि-√ ख्या P. -ख्याति (Subj. -ख्यतम्, -ख्यन्, RV.), to look round, look at, perceive, RV. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to observe, regard, consider, MBh.; R.; <div n="to"/>to overlook, disregard, RV. : <div n="vp"/>Pass. -ख्यायते, to be perceived, ChUp.

परिगणना.en: परि-गणना f. complete enumeration, accurate calculation or statement, Megh.; Kull.

परिगणित.en: परि-गणित mfn. enumerated, calculated, reckoned, BhP. (cf. अ-परिग्˚).

परिगण.en: m. or n. (?), a house, L.

परिग.en: परि-ग mfn. going round, surrounding, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 38, Sch.

परिगृहीत.en: परि-गृहीत mfn. taken hold of on both sides, AV. · surrounded, embraced, enclosed, enveloped, fenced, TS.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c.… · seized, grasped, taken, received, obtained, accepted, adopted, admitted, followed, obeyed, Br.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · opposed, checked, W.… · परि-गृहीत m. g. AcitAdi.…

परिगृह्य.en: 1. परि-गृह्य ind. having taken or seized, in company or along with (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · considering, regarding, W.… · 2. परि-गृह्य mfn. to be taken or accepted or regarded, W.…

परिगृह्या.en: परि-गृह्या f. designation of a partic. kind of Vएदि or sacrificial mound, Kauś. · a married woman, L.…

परिग्रह.en: परि-ग्रह/ m. (ifc. f(आ). ) laying hold of on all sides, surrounding, enclosing, fencing round (esp. the Vएदि or sacrificial altar by means of three lines or furrows), ŚBr.; KātyŚr. &c. · wrapping round, putting on (a dress &c.), assuming (a form &c.), Kāv.… · comprehending, summing up, sum, totality, ŚāṅkhBr.; Mn.… · taking, accepting, receiving or anything received, a gift or present, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · getting, attaining, acquisition, possession, property (ifc. ‘being possessed of or furnished with’), ib.… · household, family, attendants, retinue, the seraglio of a prince, ib.… · a house, abode, Hariv.… · root, origin, foundation, MBh.… · admittance (into one's house), hospitable reception, Mn.; MBh.; R.; Kāraṇḍ.… · taking (a wife), marrying, marriage, Mn.; MBh. &c.…

परिग्रहीतव्य.en: परि-ग्रहीतव्य mfn. to be admitted or supposed, Śaṃk. · to be ruled or controlled, Pat.… · to be taken hold of or got into possession, Vajracch.…

परिघ.en: परि-घ m. (√ हन्) an iron bar or beam used for locking or shutting a gate (= अर्गल), ChUp.; MBh.; Kāv. &c. · (fig.) a bar, obstacle, hindrance, Ragh.; Kathās.… · (once n.) an iron bludgeon or club studded with iron, MBh.; R. &c.… · a child which presents a peculiar cross position in birth, Suśr.… · a line of clouds crossing the sun at sunrise or sunset, Var.; MBh. &c.… · (du.) two birds flying on each side of a traveller (regarded as an omen), Var.… · the gate of a palace, any gate, R.… · a house, L.… · (in astrol.) N. of the 19th ञोग, L.… · a pitcher, water-jar, L.… · a glass pitcher, L.… · killing, striking, a blow, L.… · N. of one of the attendants of श्कन्द, MBh.… · of a छ्āṇḍāल, ib.… · of a virtuous man, Cat.…

परिचय.en: परि-चय &c. पुत्रका.en: (अका), f. = next, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 45, Vārtt. 10, Pat.

पुत्रिन्.en: पुत्रि/न् mf(इ/णी)n. having a son or sons, possessing children (m. and f. the father or the mother of a son or of children generally), RV. &c. &c.

पुद्गल.en: mf(आ)n. beautiful, lovely, handsome, MārkP. · m. the body, Hit. i, 41 v.l.… · (with झइनs) material object (including atoms), Śaṃk.; MWB. 535… · the soul, personal entity, Lalit.… · man, Var.… · the Ego or individual (in a disparaging sense), SaddhP.… · N. of Śइव, MBh. (= देह, Nīlak.)… · a horse of the colour of rock-crystal, Gal.…

पुन.en: mfn. (√ 1. पू) purifying, cleansing (only ifc. cf. किम्-प्˚, कुलम्-प्˚ &c.)

पुनर्.en: पु/नर् ind. back, home, in an opposite direction, RV. &c. &c. (with √ 1. गम्, या, to go back or away; with √ दा, to give back, restore; with √ भू, to turn round; with √ अस् and dat., to fall back upon) · again, once more (also with भूयस्), ib. (with √ भू, to exist again, be renewed, become a wife again, re-marry)… · again and again, repeatedly, ib. (mostly पु/नः प्˚ which with न = nevermore)… · further, moreover, besides, ib. (also पुनर् अपरम्; आदौ-पुनर्-पश्चात्, at first-then-later)… · however, still, nevertheless, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (at the end of a verse it lays stress on a preceding अथ वा, अपि वा, or वा alone; पुनर् अपि, even again, on the other hand, also; कदा प्˚, at any time, ever; किम् प्˚, how much more or less? however; पुनर् — पुनर्, now — now; at one time — at another time).…

पुनरागम.en: पुनर्—आगम m. coming back, return, ŚāṅkhGṛ.

पुनरागमन.en: पुनर्—आगमन n. id., MBh.; R. &c. · being born ag˚, re-birth, Sarvad.…

पुनरादि.en: पुनर्—आदि mfn. beginning afresh, repeated, TāṇḍBr.

पुनरावृत्ति.en: पुनर्—आवृत्ति f. return, re-appearance, re-birth, Yājñ. · repetition, ĀśvŚr.…

पुनरुक्त.en: पुनर्—उक्त mf(आ)n. said ag˚, reiterated, repeated, MBh.; R. &c. (ibc. and अम् ind. repeatedly) · superfluous, useless, Vikr. iii, 7/8; Hcar.… · पुनर्—उक्त n. repetition, useless repetition, tautology, ŚrS.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.…

पुनरुक्तता.en: पुनर्—उक्त—ता f. repetition, (esp.) useless r˚, tautology, Sāh.

पुनरुक्तत्व.en: पुनर्—उक्त—त्व n. repetition, (esp.) useless r˚, tautology, Sāh.

पुनरुक्ति.en: पुनर्—उक्ति f. = -उक्त n., Prāt. · a mere empty word, Vcar.…

पुनरुत्थान.en: पुनर्—उत्थान n. rising again, resurrection, MW.

पुनर्ग्रहण.en: पुनर्—ग्रहण n. repeatedly taking up (with a ladle &c.), KātyŚr. · repetition, ib.…

पुनर्नव.en: पु/नर्—नव (पु/नर्-), mf(आ)n. becoming new or young ag˚, renewed, AV.; Br. &c. (also पुनर्-नव/; cf. पुनर्-ण्˚) · पु/नर्—नव m. a finger-nail (cf. -भव), L.…

पुनर्भव.en: पुनर्—भव mfn. born ag˚, BhP. · पुनर्—भव m. new birth, transmigration, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · a finger-nail, L. (cf. -नव)… · a species of फुनर्-नव्ā with red flowers, L.…

पुनर्भू.en: पुनर्—भू mfn. being renewed, restored to life or youth, RV.; AV. · पुनर्—भू f. a virgin widow re-married, AV. &c. &c.… · re-existence, W.…

पुनर्मन्य.en: पुनर्—मन्य/ mfn. (prob.) again thinking of, remembering, RV.

पुनर्यज्ञ.en: पुनर्—यज्ञ/ m. a repeated sacrifice, ŚBr.

पुनर्वचन.en: पुनर्—वचन n. saying ag˚, repetition, ŚāṅkhBr.

पुर.en: 1. पुर (for 2. See p. 635), in comp. for पुरस्. · 2. पुर n. (for 1. See p. 634, col. 2) (ifc. f(आ). ) a fortress, castle, city, town (a place containing large buildings surrounded by a ditch and extending not less than one Kos in length <pb n="635,3"/>; if it extends for half that distance it is called a खेट, if less than that, a कर्वट or small market town; any smaller cluster of houses is called a ग्राम or village, W.), Mn.; MBh. &c.… · the female apartments, gynaeceum, MBh. (cf. अन्तः-प्˚, नारी-प्˚ &c.)… · a house, abode, residence, receptacle, BhP.; Tattvas.… · an upper story, L.… · a brothel, L.… · ‘the city’ Gk. κατ᾽ ἐξοχήν i.e. फ्āṭअलि-पुत्र or <ns>Patnā</ns>, L.… · = त्रि-पुर, the 3 strongholds of the आसुरs, Kathās.… · the body (cf. 3. पुर्), BhP.… · the skin, L.…

पुरःसर.en: पुरः—सर/ mf(ई)n. going before or in advance · पुरः—सर/ m. a forerunner, precursor, harbinger, attendant, AV. &c. &c.… · ifc. (f(आ). ) attended or preceded by, connected with, MBh.; Kāv. &c.…

पुरःसरम्.en: पुरः—सरम् (अम्), ind. along with, among, after, by means of (comp.), Kathās.; Pañc.; Pur.

पुरस्.en: पुर/स् ind. in front, in advance, forward · (as prep.) before (of place and time), in the presence or before the eyes of (gen. abl. acc. or comp.), RV. &c. &c.… · in comparison with (gen.), Vcar.… · in or from or towards the east, eastward, VS.; Br. &c. (दक्षिणतःपुरः, towards the south-east, MBh.)… · previously, first, first of all, Ratnāv. iii, 7. [cf. प्र पुरा, पूर्व; Gk., πάρος, ‘before’.]… · पुरस्तात्. See p. 634.…

पुरस्कृ.en: पुरस्—√ कृ (P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते), to place before or in front, cause to precede, RV. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to make one's leader, place in office, appoint, MBh.; <div n="to"/>to respect, honour, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; <div n="to"/>to place above all, prefer, choose, attend to, ib.; <div n="to"/>to show, display, R.; Rājat.

पुरस्कृत्य.en: पुरस्—कृत्य ind. having placed in front or honoured &c. · often = regarding, concerning, on account of, about, MBh.; Kāv. &c.…

पुरस्तात्.en: पुर/स्तात् ind. before, forward, in or from the front, in the first place, in the beginning, RV. &c. &c. · in or from the east, eastward, ib.… · in the preceding part (of a book), above, RPrāt.… · (but also) further on i.e. below, Suśr.… · (as prep.) before (of place or time), in front or in presence or before the eyes of (gen. abl. acc. or comp.), RV. &c. &c.… · in comparison with (gen.), Vcar.…

पुरा.en: / ind. (cf. प्र, पुरस्, पूर्व) before, formerly, of old (with न, ‘never’), RV. &c. &c. · in a previous existence, VarYogay.… · (with pres. = pf.) from of old, hitherto, up to the present time (also with स्म cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 122; with न, ‘never yet’), RV. &c. &c.… · at first, in the beginning, Bhartṛ. (opp. to पश्चा, पश्चात्, Pāṇ. v, 3, 33, Kāś.)… · soon, shortly (with pres. = fut.), Kālid.; Naiṣ.… · (as prep., mostly in earlier language, with abl., rarely with dat. or gen.) before… · securely from… · except, beside… · (with pres. = fut. [cf. Pāṇ. iii, 3, 4], once with Pot.) ere, before (sometimes with न or न and यावत् [followed by तावत्], with मा or यदि, MBh.; Kāv. &c.)… · (आ), f. a stronghold, fortress (cf. अग्नि-पुरा and अश्म-प्˚)… · a kind of perfume, L.… · See p. 634, col. 3.…

पुराकल्प.en: पुरा—कल्प m. a former creation, former age (loc. sg. or pl. in the olden time), Up.; MBh. &c. · = prec. MBh.… · the performance of sacrificial acts in former times, AitBr. (pref.)…

पुराण.en: / mf(ई or आ)n. belonging to ancient or olden times, ancient, old (also = withered, worn out, opp. to नूतन, नव), RV. &c. &c. · / m. a खर्ṣअ or measure of silver (= 16 फṇअs of cowries), Mn. viii, 136 (also n., L.)… · / m. N. of a Ṛṣइ, Kāṭh.… · / m. pl. the ancients, MW.… · / n. a thing or event of the past, an ancient tale or legend, old traditional history, AV. &c. &c.… · N. of a class of sacred works (supposed to have been compiled by the poet Vय्āस and to treat of 5 topics [cf. पञ्च-लक्षण]; the chief फुर्āṇअs are 18, grouped in 3 divisions: viz. 1. ण्āजस exalting भ्रह्म्ā [e.g. the भ्रह्म, भ्रह्म्āṇḍअ, भ्रह्मवइवर्त, ंāर्कṇḍएय, भ्हविṣय, Vāमन]; 2. श्āत्त्विक exalting Vइṣṇउ [e.g. the Vइṣṇउ, भ्ह्āगवत, ङ्āरद्īय, घरुḍअ, फद्म, Vअर्āह]; 3. थ्āमस exalting Śइव [e.g. the Śइव, ळिṅग, श्कन्द, आग्नि or in place of it the Vāयु, ंअत्स्य, ख्ūर्म]; by some the P˚ are divided into 4, and by others into 6 groups; cf. IW. 509 &c.)…

पुरातन.en: पुरा-तन mf(ई)n. belonging to the past, former, old, ancient (˚ने ind. formerly, in olden times), Mn.; MBh. &c. · used-up, worn out, Suśr.… · पुरा-तन m. pl. the ancients, Rājat.… · पुरा-तन n. an ancient story, old legend, R.… · a फुर्āṇअ, Hcat.…

पुरोडाश.en: पुरो—डाश/ m. id., AV. &c. &c. (RTL. 367) · any oblation, Mn. v, 23… · the leavings of an offering, L.… · शोम juice, L.… · a prayer recited while offering oblations in fire, Pāṇ., Sch.…

पुरोध.en: पुरो—ध (m.c.) or पुरो—धस्, m. ‘placed at the head’, chief priest of a king, domestic chaplain, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; <div n="P"/> N. of a man, Saṃskārak.

पुरोधा.en: पुरो—√ धा P. Ā. -दधाति, -धत्ते, (Ā.) to place before or at the head, to appoint (esp. to priestly functions), charge, commission, RV. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to propose (as a prize), RV. v, 86, 5; <div n="to"/> (P.) to place foremost, value highly, esteem, honour, be intent upon or zealous for, take to heart, RV.; &c. · पुरो—धा f. charge, commission, (esp.) the rank and office of a फुरोहित, TS.; AV.; Br.…

पुरोनुवाक्या.en: पुरो—ऽनुवाक्या^ f. (sc. ऋच्) an introductory or invitatory verse, AV.; TS.; Br.

पुरोवात.en: पुरो—वात/ m. = -मारुत (ifc. f(आ). ), TS. &c. &c. · the wind preceding a thunderstorm, ChUp.…

पुरोहित.en: पुरो/—हित (पुरो-), mfn. placed foremost or in front, charged, commissioned, appointed · पुरो/—हित m. one holding a charge or commission, an agent… · (esp.) a family priest, a domestic chaplain, RV. &c. &c. (RTL. 352 &c.)…

पुरी.en: (ई), f. a fortress, castle, town, TĀr.; MBh. &c. · N. of a town (the capital of खलिṅग, noted for the worship of झगन्-न्āत्ह or ख्ṛṣṇअ, IW. 244 n. 1)… · the sanctuary or adytum of a temple, Inscr.… · the body, BhP.… · N. of one of the 10 orders of mendicants (said to be founded by disciples of Śअṃकर, the members of which add the word पुरी to their names), W.… · f. See under 2. पुर.…

पुरं.en: acc. of 3. पु/र् or 2. पुर, in comp.

पुरि.en: 1. पुरि loc. of 3. पुर्, in comp. · 2. पुरि f. a town or a river, Uṇ. iv, 142, Sch.… · 1. and 2. पुरि; पुरी. See above.…

पुरिशय.en: पुरि—शय/ mfn. (invented to explain पुरुष) reposing in the fortress or fastness (i.e. the body), ŚBr.; GopBr.

पुर्यष्ट.en: पुर्य्-अष्ट or पुर्य्-अष्˚टक, n. the eight constituent parts of the body, Kull. on Mn. i, 56.

पुर्य.en: पु/र्य mfn. being in a stronghold or fastness, RV. · , पुर्य्-अष्ट. See p. 636.…

पूर्.en: in comp. for 3. पुर् before cons.

पुरीतत्.en: पुरीत/त् m. n. (fr. 3. पुर्, or पुरी + √ तन्?) the pericardium or some other organ near the heart · the intestines, VS.; AV.; ŚBr.; KauṣUp. (cf. परी-तत् and पुलीतत्).…

पुरीष.en: पु/रीष n. (√ पॄ) earth, land, RV. · (esp.) crumbling or loose earth, rubbish (perhaps ‘that which fills up’, as opp. to that which flows off, ‘the solid’ opp. to the fluid), rubble, anything used to fill up interstices in a wall, VS.; TS.; ŚBr.; GṛŚrS.… · feces, excrement, ordure, ŚBr. &c. &c. (ifc. f(ई). , BhP.)… · a disk, orb (e.g. सूर्यस्य i.e. ‘fulness of the sun’ ?), RV. x, 27, 21… · (with आथर्वण) N. of a श्āमन्, ĀrṣBr.…

पुरीषवत्.en: पु/रीष—वत् (पु/र्˚), mfn. furnished with rubbish or loose earth (used for filling interstices), TS.

पुरु.en: / mf(पूर्वी/)n. (√ पॄ) much, many, abundant (only पुरू or पुरु, ˚रू/णि, ˚रूणाम् and sev. cases of f. पूर्वी; in later language only ibc.), RV. &c. &c. (˚रु/, ind. much, often, very [also with a compar. or superl.]; with सिमा, everywhere; with तिर/स्, far off, from afar; purAru/, far and wide; पुरु/ वि/श्व, one and all, every, RV.) · / m. the pollen of a flower, L.… · heaven, paradise, L.… · (cf. पूरु) N. of a prince (the son of ञय्āति and Śअर्मिṣṭह्ā and sixth monarch of the lunar race), MBh.; Śak.… · of a son of Vअसु-देव and शह-देव्ā, BhP.… · of a son of ंअद्हु, VP.… · of a son of ंअनु छ्āक्ṣउṣअ and ङḍवल्ā, Pur.… · [cf. Old Pers. paru; Gk. πολύ; Goth. filu; Angl.Sax. feolu; Germ. viel.]…

पुरुरूप.en: पुरु—रू/प mf(आ)n. multiform, variegated, RV. · forming various shapes, VS.; AV.…

पुरुशिष्ट.en: पुरु—शिष्ट m. N. of a man (cf. पौरुशिष्टि).

पुरुष.en: पु/रुष m. (mc. also पू/र्˚; prob. fr. √ पॄ and connected with पुरु, पूरु ifc. f(आ). , rarely f(ई). ; cf. Pāṇ. iv, 1, 24) a man, male, human being (pl. people, mankind), RV. &c. &c. · a person, (पुमान् पुरुषः, a male person, ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Mn.; दण्डःप्˚, punishment personified, Mn.; esp. grammatical pers.; with प्रथम, मध्यम, उत्तम = the 3rd, 2nd, 1st pers. Nir.; Pāṇ.), an officer, functionary, attendant, servant, Mn.; MBh. &c. (cf. तत्-प्˚)… · a friend, L.… · a follower of the श्āṃक्ह्य philosophy (?), L.… · a member or representative of a race or generation, TS.; Br.; Mn. &c.… · the height or measure of a man (= 5 आरत्निs = 120 आṅगुलs), ŚBr.; Śulbas.; Var.… · the pupil of the eye, ŚBr.… · (also with नारायण) the primaeval man as the soul and original source of the universe (described in the फुरुṣअ-स्ūक्त q.v.), RV.; ŚBr. &c.…

पुरुषकार.en: पुरुष—कार m. human effort (opp. to दैव, fate), Mn.; Yājñ. · manly act, virility, heroism, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · haughtiness, pride, Pat.… · N. of a grammarian, Cat.…

पुरुषतन्त्र.en: पुरुष—तन्त्र mfn. dependent on the subject, subjective (-त्व n.), Śaṃk.

पुरुषत्व.en: पुरुष—त्व n. manhood, manliness, MBh.; Pur.

पुरुषधर्म.en: पुरुष—धर्म m. personal rule or precept, KātyŚr.

पुरुषमात्र.en: पुरुष—मात्र/ mf(ई)n. of the height or measure of a man, ŚBr.; KātyŚr. · पुरुष—मात्र/ n. the size of a man, TS.…

पुरुषमृग.en: पुरुष—मृग/ m. a male antelope, VS.; TS., Sch.

पुरुषमेध.en: पुरुष—मेध/ m. the sacrifice of a man, Br.; MBh. &c. · N. of the supposed author of VS. xx, 30 (perhaps w.r. for पुरु-मेध, q.v.),…

पुरुषरूप.en: पुरुष—रूप n. the shape of a man, AitBr. · पुरुष—रूप mfn. = next, ŚBr.…

पुरुषर्षभ.en: पुरुष—र्षभ (र् for ऋ) m. = -पुंगव, MBh.; R.

पुरुषवत्.en: पुरुष—वत् mfn. accompanied by men, ŚBr.

पुरुषविध.en: पु/रुष—विध (पु/˚), mfn. man-like, having a human form (-ता f.), ŚBr.; TUp.

पुरुषव्याघ्र.en: पुरुष—व्याघ्र/ m. ‘man-tiger’, N. of a demon, ŚBr. · = -शार्दूल, MBh.; R.… · a vulture, L.…

पुरुषसंस्कार.en: पुरुष—संस्कार m. a ceremony performed on a (dead) person, Āpast.

पुरुषसूक्त.en: puruza—sUkta n. ‘the फुरुṣअ hymn’, N. of RV. x, 90 (describing the Supreme Soul of the universe and supposed to be comparatively modern), RTL. 17; 23 &c.

पुरुषाकार.en: puruzAkAra mfn. of human form or shape (-ता f.), Hcat.

पुरुषाकृति.en: puruzAkfti f. the figure of a man, ŚrS.

पुरुषाद.en: puruzAda mf(ई)n. id. · puruzAda m. a cannibal, a णक्ṣअस् (-त्व n.), MBh.; R.; BhP.… · puruzAda m. (pl.) N. of a race of cannibals in the east of ंअद्ह्य-देśअ, Var.…

पुरुषाद्य.en: puruzAdya m. ‘first of men’, N. of Vइṣṇउ, L. · (with झइनs) N. of Āदि-न्āत्ह or of Ṛṣअब्ह (the first आर्हत् of present आवसर्पिṇī).…

पुरुषान्तर.en: puruzAntara n. another man or person, a mediator, interposer, R. (अम् ind. by a mediator, indirectly, Vikr. ii, 16) · another or a succeeding generation, MārkP.… · (-वेदिन् mfn. knowing the heart of mankind, MW.)… · (˚rAtman m. ‘man's inner self’, the soul, L.)… · puruzAntara m. (sc. संधि) an alliance negotiated by warriors chosen by both parties, Kām.; Hit.…

पुरुषान्न.en: puruzAnna n. food for men, Baudh.

पुरुषायण.en: puruzAyaRa mf(आ)n. going to or uniting with the soul, PraśnUp.

पुरुषायुष.en: puruzAyuza n. the duration of a man's life, age of man, Ragh. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 4, 77)

पुरुषार्थ.en: puruzArTa m. any object of human pursuit · any one of the four objects or aims of existence (viz. काम, the gratification of desire; अर्थ, acquirement of wealth; धर्म, discharge of duty; मोक्ष, final emancipation), Mn.; Prab.; Kap. (-त्व n.), Sāṃkhyak. &c.… · human effort or exertion, MBh.; R. &c.…

पूषन्.en: पूष/न् m. (the अ not lengthened in the strong cases, but acc. ˚षाणम्, in MārkP.) N. of a Vedic deity (originally connected with the sun, and therefore the surveyor of all things, and the conductor on journeys and on the way to the next world, often associated with शोम or the Moon as protector of the universe; he is, moreover, regarded as the keeper of flocks and herds and bringer of prosperity; in the भ्र्āह्मṇअs he is represented as having lost his teeth and feeding on a kind of gruel, whence he is called karamBAd; in later times he is one of the 12 Āदित्यs and regent of the ङक्ṣअत्र णेवत्ī or फउṣṇअ; du. ‘फ्ūṣअन् and आर्यमन्’, VP., Sch.) · the sun, Kād.; Bālar.… · (?) growth, increase (cf. पूष-राति)… · the earth, L.…

प्रजाकाम.en: प्रजा/—काम (˚जा/-), mfn. desirous of offspring, AV. &c. &c. · प्रजा/—काम (˚जा/-) m. desire of o˚, ML.…

प्रजाप.en: 1. प्रजा—प mfn. (for 2. See प्र-√ जप्) protecting subjects, Nalac. · प्रजा—प m. a prince, king, L.… · 2. प्र-˚जाप mfn. (for 1. See under प्र-जा) muttering prayers, praying, Nalac.…

प्रजापति.en: प्रजा—पति (˚जा-), m. ‘lord of creatures’, N. of शवित्ṛ, शोम, आग्नि, ईन्द्र &c., RV.; AV. · (˚जा-) a divinity presiding over procreation, protector of life, ib.; VS.; Mn.; Suśr.; BhP. <pb n="658,3"/>… · (˚जा-) lord of creatures, creator, RV. &c. &c. (N. of a supreme god above or among the Vedic deities [RV. (only x, 21, 10); AV.; VS.; Br.] but in later times also applied to Vइṣṇउ, Śइव, Time personified, the sun, fire, &c., and to various progenitors, esp. to the 10 lords of created beings first created by भ्रह्म्ā, viz. ंअर्īचि, आत्रि, आṅगिरस्, फुलस्त्य, फुलक, ख्रतु, Vअसिṣṭह, फ्रचेतस् or धक्ṣअ, भ्ह्ṛगु, ङ्āरद [Mn. i, 34; cf. IW. 206 n. 1], of whom some authorities count only the first 7, others the last 3)… · (˚जा-) a father, L.… · (˚जा-) a king, prince, L.… · (˚जा-) a son-in-law, L.…

प्रजापती.en: प्रजा—पती (˚जा-), f. a matron, lady, Divyāv. · N. of घउतम भुद्द्ह 's aunt and nurse (with the patr. घउतम्ī, the first woman who assented to his doctrines), Lalit.…

प्रजापतिलोक.en: प्रजा—पति—लोक/ m. P˚'s world (situated between the sphere of भ्रह्म्ā and that of the घन्द्हर्वs), ŚBr.

प्रजापतिक.en: प्रजा—पतिक m. endearing form of प्रजापति-दत्त, Pat.

प्रजार्थम्.en: praj˚ArTam and praj˚ArTe (˚jArT˚), ind. for the sake of offspring, MBh.

प्रजाना.en: प्र-जाना f. the place of bringing forth, AitĀr.

प्रज्ञ.en: 1. प्र-ज्ञ mfn. = प्र-ज्ञु, L. · 2. प्र-ज्ञ mf(आ)n. (for 1. See above) wise, prudent, MāṇḍUp.… · (ifc.) knowing, conversant with (cf. निकृति-, पथि-)…

प्रज्ञा.en: प्र-√ ज्ञा P. -जानाति, to know, understand (esp. a way or mode of action), discern, distinguish, know about, be acquainted with (acc.), RV. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to find out, discover, perceive, learn, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: <div n="vp"/>Caus. -ज्ञापयति or -ज्ञपयति, to show or point out (the way), ŚBr.; <div n="to"/>to summon, invite, Lalit. · प्र-ज्ञा f. See col. 2… · प्र-ज्ञा/ f. wisdom, intelligence, knowledge, discrimination, judgement, ŚBr. &c. &c.… · device, design, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.… · a clever or sensible woman, W.… · Wisdom personified as the goddess of arts and eloquence, शरस्वत्ī, L.… · a partic. Śअक्ति or energy, Hcat.… · (with, Buddh.) true or transcendental wisdom (which is three fold, Dharmas. 110), MWB. 126; 128… · the energy of Āदि-बुद्द्ह (through the union with whom the latter produced all things), MWB. 204.…

प्रज्ञप्ति.en: प्र-˚ज्ञप्ति f. teaching, information, instruction, BhP. · an appointment, agreement, engagement, W.… · arrangement (of a seat), Divyāv.… · (with झइनs) a partic. magical art personified as one of the Vइद्य्ā-देव्īs, Kathās. (L. also ˚ती)…

प्रज्ञात.en: प्र-˚ज्ञात mfn. known, understood, found out, discerned, known as (nom.), well-known, public, common, notorious, Mn.; MBh. &c.

प्रज्ञान.en: प्र-˚ज्ञा/न mf(ई)n. prudent, wise, L. · easily known, AV.… · प्र-˚ज्ञा/न n. knowledge, wisdom, intelligence, discrimination, AV. &c. &c.… · a distinctive mark, token of recognition, any mark or sign or characteristic, AV.; MBh.; R. &c.… · a monument, memorial, ŚBr.…
