प्रज्ञानतृप्त.en: प्र-˚ज्ञान—तृप्त mfn. satiated with i.e. full of kn˚, MBh.

प्रज्ञाकर.en: प्र-ज्ञा—कर m. N. of a Buddh. scholar and of Sch. on Nalod.

प्रज्ञात्मन्.en: pra-jYA˚tman (˚jYAt˚), mfn. ‘one whose nature is w˚’, being all w˚, AitĀr.

प्रज्ञामात्रा.en: प्र-ज्ञा—मात्रा f. an element of cognition, organ of sense, KauṣUp.

प्रज्ञावाद.en: प्र-ज्ञा—वाद m. a word of w˚, Bhag.

प्रज्वलन.en: प्र—˚ज्वलन n. blazing up, flaming, burning, Var.; Pratāp.

प्रज्वलित.en: प्र—˚ज्वलित mfn. flaming, blazing, burning, shining, Lāṭy.; MBh.; Kāv. &c. · प्र—˚ज्वलित n. flaming up, blazing, burning, Hariv.…

प्रण.en: mfn. (fr. 1. प्र) ancient, old, Pāṇ. v, 4, 30, Vārtt. 7, Pat.

प्रणख.en: प्र-णख m. or n. (?) the point of the nails, ChUp.

प्रणम्.en: प्र-णम् (√ नम्) P. Ā. -णमति, ˚ते (ind.p. -णम्य) to bend or bow down before (often with मूर्ध्ना, शिरसा &c.), make obeisance to (dat. gen. loc. or acc.), Mn.; MBh. &c.: <div n="vp"/>Caus. -नामयति or -नमयति, (ind.p. -नमय्य), to cause a person (acc.) to bow before (dat.), Kālid.; <div n="to"/>to bow, incline, ib.

प्रणत.en: प्र-˚णत mfn. bent forwards, bowed, inclined, ŚāṅkhBr.; Mn. &c. · bowed to, saluted reverentially, BhP.… · bent towards, offered respectfully, Mālav. (cf. below)… · humble, submissive to (gen. or acc.), MBh.; R.; BhP.… · skilful, clever, W.… · a partic. kind of accentuation, Sāy.… · of a फरिśइṣṭअ of SV.…

प्रणय.en: प्र-णय ˚यन &c. See प्र-णी. · प्र-णय m. a leader, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 142 (ज्योतिषाम्, Nir. ii, 14)… · guidance, conduct, MBh.… · manifestation, display, Mṛcch.… · setting forth (an argument), Jātakam.… · affection, confidence in (loc.), love, attachment, friendship, favour (ibc.; ˚यात् ind., ˚येन ind. and ˚yopetam ind. confidentially, affectionately, openly, frankly), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · desire, longing for (loc.; अन्यथा, ‘for something else’), ib.… · an entreaty, request, solicitation, R.; Vikr.… · reverence, obeisance, L.… · final beatitude, L.…

प्रणव.en: प्र-ण/व See प्र-णु. · प्र-˚ण/व (or प्र/-ण्˚), m. f. (ifc. f(आ). ) the mystical or sacred syllable ओम्, VS.; TS.; ŚBr.; Mn. (ifc. also -क) &c. (-त्व n., RāmatUp.)… · प्र-˚ण/व m. a kind of small drum or tabor = (and prob. w.r. for) पणन, L.…

प्रणाश.en: प्र-˚णाश m. vanishing, disappearance, cessation, loss, destruction, death, R.; Var.; Suśr. &c.

प्रनष्ट.en: प्र-नष्ट mfn. (wrongly written प्र-णष्ट, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 36, Sch.) lost, disappeared, vanished, ceased, gone, perished, destroyed, annihilated, Mn.; MBh. &c. · प्र-नष्ट See प्र-णश्, p. 659.…

प्रणयेन.en: प्र-णयेन ind., confidentially, affectionately, openly, frankly

प्रणाय्य.en: प्र-˚णाय्य mfn. (only L.) dear, beloved, fit, worthy · blameless, desireless… · disapproved, rejected.…

(scil. अग्नि) fire consecrated by prayers or mystical formulas, W.… · प्र/-˚णीत n. anything cooked or dressed (such as a condiment), A.…

प्रणीय.en: प्र-˚णीय mfn. to be led on Pāṇ. iii, 1, 123.

प्रणेतृ.en: प्र-˚णेतृ/ m. a leader, guide, RV. &c. &c. (Ved. with gen. or acc.; Class. gen. or comp.) · प्र-णेतृ a charioteer, Bcar.… · a maker, creator, MBh.; Hariv.… · an author, promulgator of a doctrine, MBh.; Pur.… · a performer or one who plays a musical instrument, L.… · one who applies (a clyster), Car.…

प्रणेय.en: प्र-˚णेय mfn. to be guided or led, docile, obedient, MBh.; Hariv.; Śaṃk. · to be (or being) used or applied, Bālar.; Car.… · to be executed or accomplished, MBh.… · to be fixed or settled, ib.…

प्रतप.en: प्र-˚तप m. the heat of the sun

प्रतार.en: प्र-तार ˚रक &c. See under प्र√ तॄ. · प्र-˚तार m. passing over, crossing (with gen.), MBh.; R.… · deception, fraud, L.…

प्रति.en: 1. प्र/ति ind. (as a prefix to roots and their derivative nouns and other n˚, sometimes प्रती; for 2. See p. 664) towards, near to · against, in opposition to… · back, again, in return… · down upon, upon, on… · before nouns it expresses also likeness or comparison (cf. प्रति-चन्द्र)… · or it forms आव्यय्īब्ह्āवs of different kinds (cf. प्रति-क्षणम्, प्रति-ग्रहम्, प्रत्य्-अग्नि &c.; rarely ifc., e.g. सूपप्रति, a little broth, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 9)… · or as a prep. with usually preceding acc., in the sense of towards, against, to, upon, in the direction of (e.g. शब्दम् प्˚, in the dir˚ of the sound, R.; अग्निम् प्र्˚, against the fire, Mn.; also ˚त्य्-अग्नि ind., Pāṇ. vi, 2, 33, Sch.; रिपुम् प्र्˚, ag˚ the enemy, Mn.; आत्मानम् प्र्˚, to one's self, Ratnāv.)… · opposite, before, in the presence of (e.g. रोदसी प्र्˚, bef˚ heaven and earth, RV.)…

प्रतिकूलम्.en: प्रति—कूलम् ind. contrarily, against, in inverted order, AV. &c. &c.

प्रतिकूलत्व.en: प्रति—कूल—त्व n. (MW.) adverseness, opposition, hostility · perverseness, contumacy…

प्रतिचक्र.en: प्रति—चक्र n. a discus which is a match for any other, MBh. · a hostile army, Nīlak.…

प्रतिच्छाया.en: प्रति—च्छाया f. reflection, likeness, image, shadow, phantom, Hariv.; Śaṃk. · the distorted image of a sick man (indicative of approaching death), Car.…

(in later language usually written वृहत्) lofty, high, tall, great, large, wide, vast, abundant, compact, solid, massy, strong, mighty, RV. &c. &c. · full-grown, old, RV.… · extended or bright (as a luminous body), ib.… · clear, loud (said of sounds), ib.… · बृह/त् m. N. of a ंअरुत्, Hariv.… · of a prince, MBh.… · of a son of शु-होत्र and father of आज-म्īḍह, Hariv.… · बृह/त् m. or n. (?) speech (˚ताम् पति = बृहस्पति), Śiś. ii, 26… · बृह/त् n. height (also = heaven, sky), RV.… · N. of various श्āमन्s composed in the metrical form भ्ṛहत्ī (also with आनेयम्, भरद्-वाजस्य. भारद्वाजम्, वामदेव्यम्, सौरम्), ĀrṣBr.… · N. of भ्रह्मन्, BhP.… · of the Vएद, ib.… · बृह/त् ind. far and wide, on high, RV.… · बृह/त् n. firmly, compactly, ib.… · brightly, ib.…

बृहती.en: बृह/ती (ती), f. See s.v. · / f. fr. बृक/त् N. of a partic. metre of 36 (orig. 8 + 8 + 12 + 8) syllables or (later) any metre containing 36 syllables (ifc. ˚तीक mfn.), RV.; RPrāt.; AV.; Br. &c.… · a symbolical expression for the number 36 ŚrS.… · (pl.) N. of partic. bricks forming part of the sacrificial fire-altar, ŚBr.; Śulbas.… · a partic. Solanum (-द्वय n. two species of it), ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Suśr.… · a part of the body between the breast and backbone, Suśr.… · (du.) heaven and earth, Gal.… · speech (a sense inferred from certain passages)… · a mantle, wrapper, L.… · a place containing water, reservoir, L.… · the lute of ङ्āरद or Vइśव्ā-वसु, L.… · N. of two works.… · N. of sev. women, Hariv.; BhP.…

बृहत्त्व.en: बृहत्—त्व n. greatness, largeness, large extent, MBh.; Hariv.; Kathās.

बृहत.en: m. N. of a son of the 9th ंअनु, Hariv.

बृहतीसहस्र.en: बृहती—सहस्र/ n. a thousand भ्ṛहत्īs, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr. · N. of wk.…

बृहदार.en: बृहद्—आर m. N. of an आसुर, L.

बृहदारण्यक.en: बृहद्—आरण्यक (also बृहद्—आरण्य n., बृहद्—आरण्य˚को/पनिषद् f.) n. N. of a celebrated ऊपनिṣअद् forming the last 5 फ्रप्āṭहकs or last 6 आद्ह्य्āयs of the Śअतपत्ह भ्र्āह्मṇअ

बृहद्रथंतर.en: बृहद्—रथंतर n. du. the श्āमन्s भ्ṛहत् and णत्हṃतर, AitBr.; KauṣUp.; Gaut.

बृहन्त.en: mfn. = बृह/त्, large, great, ŚvetUp. · m. N. of a king, MBh.…

बृहस्पति.en: बृ/हस्-प/ति m. (also written वृह्˚-प्˚; fr. 3. बृह् + पति; cf. ब्रह्मणस्-पति) ‘lord of prayer or devotion’, N. of a deity (in whom Piety and Religion are personified; he is the chief offerer of prayers and sacrifices, and therefore represented as the type of the priestly order, and the फुरोहित of the gods with whom he intercedes for men; in later times he is the god of wisdom and eloquence, to whom various works are ascribed; he is also regarded as son of आṅगिरस्, husband of थ्āर्ā and father of खच, and sometimes identified with Vय्āस; in astronomy he is the regent of Jupiter and often identified with that planet), RV. &c., &c. (cf. RTL. 215) · N. of a prince (great-grandson of आśओक), Buddh.… · of a king of खśम्īर, Rājat.… · of the author of a law-book, IW. 203; 302…

बृहस्पतिसव.en: बृहस्-पति—सव/ m. N. of a festival lasting one day (said to confer the rank, of a फुरोहित on those observing it), Br.; Kāṭh.; ŚrS.; BhP.

बैजवाप.en: बै/जवाप m. (also written वैज्˚) patr. fr. बिजवाप, ŚBr.

बैजवापायन.en: बै/जवापायन m. patr. fr. prec. ib. · N. of an author, Cat.…

बैल्व.en: / mf(ई)n. (fr. बिल्व) relating to or coming from the भिल्व tree, made of भिल्व wood, ŚBr. &c. &c. · covered with B˚ trees, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 67, Sch.… · / m. N. of a man g. aSvAdi… · / n. the fruit of the B˚ tree, L.…

ब्रह्मन्.en: ब्र/ह्मन् n. (lit. ‘growth’, ‘expansion’, ‘evolution’, ‘development’ ‘swelling of the spirit or soul’, fr. √ 2. बृह्) pious effusion or utterance, outpouring of the heart in worshipping the gods, prayer, RV.; AV.; VS.; TS. · the sacred word (as opp. to वाच्, the word of man), the Vएद, a sacred text, a text or ंअन्त्र used as a spell (forming a distinct class from the ऋचस्, सामानि and यजूंषि; cf. ब्रह्म-वेद), RV.; AV.; Br.; Mn.; Pur.… · the भ्र्āह्मṇअ portion of the Vएद, Mn. iv, 100… · the sacred syllable Om, Prab., Sch., (cf. Mn. ii, 83)… · religious or spiritual knowledge (opp. to religious observances and bodily mortification such as तपस् &c.), AV.; Br.; Mn.; R.… · holy life (esp. continence, chastity; cf. ब्रह्म-चर्य), Śak. i, 24/25; Śaṃk.; Sarvad.… · (exceptionally treated as m.) the भ्रह्म्ă or one self-existent impersonal Spirit, the one universal Soul (or one divine essence and source from which all created things emanate or with which they are identified and to which they return), the Self-existent, the Absolute, the Eternal (not generally an object of worship but rather of meditation and-knowledge <pb n="738,1"/>; also with ज्ये/ष्ठ, प्रथम-ज/, स्वय/म्-भु, अ-मूर्त, पर, परतर…

ब्रह्म.en: 1. ब्रह्म m. a priest (see असुर-, कु-, महाब्र्˚) · n. the one self-existent Spirit, the Absolute, R.… · 2. ब्रह्म in comp. for ब्रह्मन्. — Observe that in the following derivatives the nom. n. (भ्रह्म्ă) is used for the impersonal Spirit and the nom. m. (भ्रह्म्ā) for the personal god.…

ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधि.en: ब्रह्म—कर्˚म-समाधि mfn. occupied with or meditating upon the one self-existent Spirit, Bhag.

ब्रह्मकल्प.en: ब्रह्म—कल्प mfn. like भ्रह्म्ā, R. · ब्रह्म—कल्प m. the cosmic period of भ्रह्म्ā, MBh.… · N. of wk.…

ब्रह्मकार.en: ब्रह्म—कार/ mfn. making or offering prayers, RV.

ब्रह्मक्षत्र.en: ब्रह्म—क्षत्र n. sg. and du. <ns>Brāhman</ns>s and ख्ṣअत्रियs, AitBr.; VP.

ब्रह्मगवी.en: ब्रह्म—गवी/ f. a <ns>Brāhman</ns>'s cow, AV.; ŚBr. · du. N. of 2 classes of verses or formulas, Kauś.…

ब्रह्मचर्य.en: ब्रह्म—च/र्य n. study of the Vएद, the state of an unmarried religious student, a state of continence and chastity (also f(आ). , Hariv.), AV. &c. &c. (acc. with √ ग्रह्, चर्, वस्, आ-√ गम्, उप-√ इ, to practise ch˚; cf. -चारिन्)

ब्रह्मचर्याश्रम.en: brahma—ca˚ryASrama m. the period of unmarried religious studentship, MBh.

ब्रह्मचारिन्.en: ब्रह्म—चारि/न् mf(इणी)n. practising sacred study as an unmarried student, observing chastity, RV. &c. &c. · ब्रह्म—चारि/न् m. a young <ns>Brāhman</ns> who is a student of the Vएद (under a preceptor) or who practises chastity, a young Br˚ before marriage (in the first period of his life), AV.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (cf. आश्रम and IW. 192 &c.; RTL. 84 &c.; the N. भ्रह्म-च्āरिन् is also given to older unmarried <ns>Brāhmans</ns>, esp. if versed in the Vएद, and by the थन्त्रs to any person whose chief virtue is continence)… · N. of a घन्द्हर्व, MBh.… · of श्कन्द, L.… · of Śइव, Śivag.…

ब्रह्मज.en: ब्रह्म—ज mfn. sprung from that which is holy (said of ख्āर्त्तिकेय), MBh. · ब्रह्म—ज m. pl. N. of partic. clouds, VP.… · ब्रह्म—ज m. (with झइनs) N. of a class of divinities, L.…

ब्रह्मजज्ञ.en: ब्रह्म—ज—ज्ञ mfn. ‘born from and knowing भ्रह्म्ă’ or ‘knowing what is Br˚-born’ i.e. ‘knowing all things’, KaṭhUp.

ब्रह्मजिज्ञासा.en: ब्रह्म—जिज्ञासा f. the desire of knowing भ्रह्म्ă, Bādar. (cf. IW. 104).

ब्रह्मज्ञ.en: ब्रह्म—ज्ञ mfn. possessing sacred knowledge, knowing the sacred text, spiritually wise, holy (said also of gods, e.g. of Vइṣṇउ, ख्āर्त्तिकेय), MBh.; Bhartṛ.

ब्रह्मज्ञान.en: ब्रह्म—ज्ञान n. divine or sacred knowledge (esp. kn˚ of the universal permeation of the one Spirit as taught by the Vएद्āन्त), spiritual wisdom, Hariv.; Bhartṛ.

ब्रह्मज्य.en: ब्रह्म—ज्य/ mfn. molesting or oppressing <ns>Brāhmans</ns>, AV.; TBr. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 3, Vārtt. 1, Pat.)

ब्रह्मतत्त्व.en: ब्रह्म—तत्त्व n. the true knowledge of भ्रह्म्ă, W.

ब्रह्मतन्त्र.en: ब्रह्म—तन्त्र n. all that is taught in the Vएद, MBh.; Hariv.

ब्रह्मता.en: ब्रह्म—ता f. the state or condition of a <ns>Brāhman</ns>, ‘Brahmanhood’, Pāṇ. v, 1, 136, Sch. · the state or nature of भ्रह्म्ă divine nature, BhP.…

ब्रह्मत्व.en: ब्रह्म—त्व/ n. the office of the <ns>Brāhman</ns> or chief priest, ŚBr.; GṛŚrS.; Hariv. · <ns>Brāhmanhood</ns>, R.; Ratnāv.… · the state of or identification with भ्रह्म्ă, MBh.; Pur.…

ब्रह्मद.en: ब्रह्म—द mfn. imparting religious knowledge, Mn.

ब्रह्मदत्त.en: ब्रह्म—दत्त/ mfn. given by भ्रह्म्ă, TĀr. · g˚ by भ्रह्म्ā, MBh.; R.… · ब्रह्म—दत्त/ m. N. of various men (cf. naqAdi)… · of a man with the patr. छइकित्āनेय, ŚBr.… · of a king (pl. his descendants), MBh.… · of a prince of the फñच्āलs in ख्āम्पिल्य, ib.; R. &c.… · of a king of the श्āल्वs, Hariv.… · of a prince in Vāर्āṇअस्ī, Kathās.… · of a prince in Śर्āवस्त्ī, Buddh.… · (cf. MWB. 420, 1) of a prince in छम्प्ā, ib.… · of a prince in खुसुम-पुर, ib.… · of the 12th छक्र-वर्तिन् in भ्ह्āरत, L.… · of a <ns>Brāhman</ns>, Hariv.; Pañcat.… · of a merchant, Kathās.… · of the father of ख्ṛṣṇअ-दत्त, Cat.… · of sev. authors, ib.…

ब्रह्मनिर्वाण.en: ब्रह्म—निर्वाण n. extinction in भ्रह्म्ă, absorption into the one self-existent Spirit, Bhag.; BhP.

ब्रह्मनिष्ठ.en: ब्रह्म—निष्ठ mfn. absorbed in contemplating भ्रह्म्ă or the one s˚ Sp˚, MuṇḍUp. · ब्रह्म—निष्ठ m. the mulberry tree, L.…

ब्रह्मपथ.en: ब्रह्म—पथ m. the way to भ्रह्म्ă or to भ्रह्म्ā, Up.; BhP.

ब्रह्मपुर.en: ब्रह्म—पुर n. ‘भ्रह्म्ā's town’, N. of a city in heaven, MBh. (-mAhAtmya n. N. of wk.) · of a city on earth, Var.; Hit.… · of a kingdom, Buddh.… · the heart, MāṇḍUp.… · the body, ChUp. (cf. IW. 116, 2)…

ब्रह्मपुरुष.en: ब्रह्म—पुरुष m. an assistant of the भ्रह्मन् or chief priest, KātyŚr., Sch. · a minister of भ्रह्म्ā (also said of the 5 vital airs), ChUp.; GṛS.… · = -राक्षस, L.…

ब्रह्मप्रकृतिक.en: ब्रह्म—प्रकृतिक mfn. emanating from or originating in भ्रह्म्ă (-त्व n.), Śaṃk.

ब्रह्मप्रभ.en: ब्रह्म—प्रभ m. N. of a man, Divyāv.

ब्रह्मप्राप्त.en: brahma—prApta mfn. one who has obtained भ्रह्म्ă, KaṭhUp.

ब्रह्मप्राप्ति.en: brahma—prApti f. obtainment of or absorption into भ्रह्म्ă, MW.

ब्रह्मबन्धव.en: ब्रह्म—बन्धव n. (prob.) the office or occupation of a nominal <ns>Brāhman</ns> (cf. next), AitBr.

ब्रह्मबन्धु.en: ब्रह्म—बन्धु m. an unworthy or merely nominal <ns>Brāhman</ns> (Sāy. ‘a <ns>Brāhman</ns> who omits his शṃद्ह्य्ā devotions’), AitBr.; ChUp.; GṛŚrS. &c. (˚धू f., Gaut.; Gobh.; ˚धु-ता f., MBh.; compar. and superl. ˚धू-तर or ˚धु-तर, ˚धू-तम or ˚धु-तम, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 44, Sch.)

ब्रह्मभाव.en: ब्रह्म—भाव m. absorption in the one self-existent Being or भ्रह्म्ă, MBh., Sch.

ब्रह्मभूत.en: ब्रह्म—भूत mfn. become i.e. absorbed in भ्रह्म्ă, Mn.; MBh.; VP. · ब्रह्म—भूत n. identification with भ्रह्म्ă, VP.…

ब्रह्मभूय.en: ब्रह्म—भूय n. identification with or absorption into भ्रह्म्ă, Mn.; MBh. &c. (-त्व n.) · <ns>Brāhmanhood</ns>, BhP.…

ब्रह्मयोग.en: ब्रह्म—योग/ m. employment of devotion, binding power of devotion, AV. · cultivation of spiritual knowledge, W.…

ब्रह्मयोनि.en: ब्रह्म—योनि f. original source or home in भ्रह्म्ă, TĀr. (-स्थ mfn. ‘abiding in Br˚’ or ‘intent on the means of union with Br˚’, Mn. x, 74) · N. of a place of pilgrimage (also ˚नी), MBh.; Pur.… · of a mountain (= -गिरि), L.… · ब्रह्म—योनि mfn. having one's source or home in भ्रह्म्ă, ŚāṅkhGṛ.… · descended or sprung from भ्रह्म्ā, Ragh.; MārkP.…

ब्रह्मरूप.en: ब्रह्म—रूप m. N. of Vइṣṇउ, Viṣṇ.

ब्रह्मलोक.en: ब्रह्म—लोक/ m. (also pl.) the world or heaven of भ्रह्म्ā (a division of the universe and one of the supposed residences of pious spirits), AV.; &c.

ब्रह्मवद.en: ब्रह्म—वद (or -वल) m. pl. N. of a Vedic school, L. (prob. w.r.)

ब्रह्मवर्चस.en: ब्रह्म—वर्चस/ n. divine glory or splendour, pre-eminence in holiness or sacred knowledge, sanctity, superhuman power, AV. &c. &c.

ब्रह्मवर्चस्य.en: ब्रह्म—वर्च˚स्य mf(आ)n. conferring sanctity or sacred knowledge, Br.; BhP.

ब्रह्मवाद.en: ब्रह्म—वाद/ m. discourse on or explanation of sacred texts, TBr.; BhP. · N. of a ङ्य्āय wk. (also ˚dArTa, m.)… · ब्रह्म—वाद/ mfn. (m.c.) = next, Hariv.…

ब्रह्मवादिन्.en: ब्रह्म—वादि/न् mfn. discoursing on sacred texts, a defender or expounder of the Vएद, AV. &c. &c. (इनी f., Var. <pb n="740,1"/>; ˚दि-त्व n., MBh.) · one who asserts that all things are to be identified with भ्रह्म्ă, a Vएद्āन्तिन्, Śaṃk.…

ब्रह्मवित्त्व.en: ब्रह्म—वित्-त्व n. (fr. next) knowledge of भ्रह्म्ă (the one self-existent Spirit of the Universe), Vedāntas.

ब्रह्मविद्.en: ब्रह्म—वि/द् mfn. knowing the one भ्रह्म्ă, a Vedic philosopher, AV. &c. &c. (also -विद) · skilled in sacred spells or magic, MBh.… · ब्रह्म—वि/द् m. N. of Śइव, RTL. 84…

ब्रह्मविद्या.en: ब्रह्म—विद्या/ f. knowledge of ‘the one self-existent Being’, kn˚ of भ्रह्म्ă, sacred knowledge, ŚBr. &c. &c. (cf. IW. 219) · N. of an ऊपनिṣअद् (cf. below)…

ब्रह्मवृक्ष.en: ब्रह्म—वृक्ष m. the divine tree, भ्रह्म्ă regarded as a tree, Bhag., Sch. · Butea Frondosa or Ficus Glomerata, L.…

ब्रह्मवेद.en: ब्रह्म—वेद m. ‘the Vएद of sacred spells or charms’ the आत्हर्व-वेद, AV.; Anukr.; ŚāṅkhGṛ. &c. · the V˚ of the <ns>Brāhmans</ns> (as opp. to क्षत्र-वेद, q.v.), R.… · knowledge of भ्रह्म्ă, W.… · kn˚ of the Vएदs, ib.…

ब्रह्मसंस्थ.en: ब्रह्म—संस्थ mfn. wholly devoted to भ्रह्म्ă or sacred knowledge, ChUp.

ब्रह्मसम्बन्ध.en: ब्रह्म—सम्बन्ध m. union with the Supreme Spirit, RTL. 136 · = -राक्षस, L.…

ब्रह्मसाम.en: ब्रह्म—साम/ or ब्रह्म—साम/न्, n. N. of a श्āमन् (sung to a text recited by the chief priest or by the भ्र्āह्मṇāच्-च्हṃसिन्), TS.; Br.; ŚrS.

ब्रह्मसू.en: ब्रह्म—सू m. ‘भ्रह्म्ā's son’, N. of ख्āम-देव or of आनिरुद्द्ह (K˚'s son), L.

ब्रह्मसूत्र.en: ब्रह्म—सूत्र n. the sacred thread worn over the shoulder, Yājñ.; MBh. &c. · a श्ūत्र work treating of the knowledge of भ्रह्म्ă (esp. the aphorisms of the Vएद्āन्त philosophy ascribed to भ्āदर्āयṇअ or Vय्āस, also called बादरायण- or vedAnta- or व्यास- or शारीरक-सूत्र, and उत्तर- or ब्रह्म-मीमांसा)…

ब्रह्मसूत्रपद.en: ब्रह्म—सूत्र—पद n. the word or statement of a भ्रह्म-स्ūत्र, Bhag.; Hariv. · ब्रह्म—सूत्र—पद mf(आ or ई)n. consisting of such a word or st˚, Hariv.…

ब्रह्मस्व.en: ब्रह्म—स्व n. the property i.e. lands or money of <ns>Brāhmans</ns>, Caṇḍ.; Pañcar.

ब्रह्मस्वरूप.en: ब्रह्म—स्वरूप mfn. of the nature or essence of the one self-existing Spirit, W.

ब्रह्महत्या.en: ब्रह्म—हत्या/ f. murder of a <ns>Brāhman</ns> (or any crime equally heinous), VS.; &c.

ब्रह्महन्.en: ब्रह्म—ह/न् mf(घ्नी)n. ‘<ns>Brāhman</ns>-slaying’, the murderer of a <ns>Brāhman</ns>, TS. &c. &c.

ब्रह्माक्षर.en: brahmAkzara n. the sacred syllable ओम्, BhP.

ब्रह्मात्मभू.en: brahmAtma-BU m. a horse (cf. brahmANga- and ˚mAgra-BU).

ब्रह्माधिगम.en: brahmADigama m. devotion to sacred study or the Vएद (also ˚मन n., W.)

ब्रह्मानन्द.en: brahmAnanda m. ‘joy in भ्रह्म्ă’, the rapture of absorption into the one self-existent Spirit, RāmatUp. · N. of various men and authors (also -गिरि m., -परम-हंस m., -भारती m., -योगिन् m., -yogIndra m., -सारस्वती m., and ˚दिन्, m.)… · N. of wk.…

ब्रह्मार्पण.en: brahmArpaRa n. the offering of sacred texts, Pañcar. · N. of a magical spell, ib.…

ब्रह्मास्य.en: brahmAsya n. the mouth of भ्रह्म्ā, MBh. · the m˚ of a <ns>Brāhman</ns>, Cat.…

भागक.en: mfn. (ifc.) = भाग, a part, portion, share, Kathās. · m. (in arithm.) a divisor, W.…

भाणक.en: m. (cf. धर्म-भ्˚) a proclaimer, declarer, reciter, MWB. 70

भामा.en: भा/मा (आ), f. a passionate woman, L. · N. of one of the wives of ख्ṛṣṇअ (= सत्य-भामा), Kathās.…

भार.en: / m. भाराय.en: Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to form a load, be a load for (gen.), Kuval.; BhP. · See col. 1.…

भारत.en: भा/रत mf(ई)n. descended from भ्हरत or the भ्हरतs (applied to आग्नि either ‘sprung from the priests called Bh˚s’ or ‘bearer of the oblation’), RV. &c. &c. · belonging or relating to the भ्हरतs (with युद्ध n. संग्राम m. समर m. समिति f. the war or battle of the Bh˚s; with or scil. आख्यान n. with इतिहास m. and कथा f. the story of the Bh˚s, the history or narrative of their war; with or scil. मण्डल n. or वर्ष n. ‘king Bh˚s's realm’ i.e. India), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · inhabiting Bh˚ i.e. India, BhP.… · भा/रत m. a descendant of भ्हरत (also in pl. for भरतास्), RV. &c. &c.… · (with अश्व-मेध), N. of the author of RV. v, 27… · (with देव-वात and देव-श्रवस्), N. of the authors of RV. iii, 23… · fire, L.… · an actor, L. भावज्ञ.en: भाव—ज्ञ mfn. knowing the heart, MW.

भावत्व.en: भाव—त्व n. the state of becoming or being &c., L.

भावरूप.en: भाव—रूप mfn. really existing, real, actual, Śaṃk. · भाव—रूप n. (?) N. of wk.…

मन्त्रार्थ.en: mantrArTa m. ‘the contents or object of a sacred text or a spell’, N. of wk.

मन्त्रोक्त.en: mantrokta mfn. mentioned in a hymn, Vait.

मन्त्रण.en: n. consultation, deliberation, MBh.; R.; MārkP. (also f(आ). , Pañcar.) · advising, counselling in private, W.… · See p. 786.…

मन्त्रि.en: 1. मन्त्रि m. = मन्त्रिन्, a king's counsellor, minister (only acc. pl. ˚त्रीन्), R. · 2. मन्त्रि in comp. for मन्त्रिन्.…

मन्त्रिवत्.en: मन्त्रि—वत् ind. like a counsellor or m˚, Rājat.

मन्त्रित.en: mfn. discussed, deliberated, determined, MBh.; Kāv. &c. · advised, counselled (said of persons and things), ib.… · consecrated with sacred texts, enchanted, charmed, MBh.; R.… · n. counsel, deliberation, plan, ib.… · See p. 786.…

मन्य.en: mfn. (only ifc.; cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 83; vi, 3, 68, Sch.) thinking one's self to be, passing for, appearing as (see कालिम्-, धन्यम्-, नरम्-म् &c.)

मन्यु.en: / m. (L. also f.) spirit, mind, mood, mettle (as of horses), RV.; TS.; Br. · high spirit or temper, ardour, zeal, passion, RV. &c. &c.… · rage, fury, wrath, anger, indignation, ib. (also personified, esp. as आग्नि or ख्āम or as a णुद्र; मन्युं √ कृ, with loc. or acc. with प्रति, ‘to vent one's anger on, be angry with’)… · grief, sorrow, distress, affliction, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · sacrifice, Nalac.… · N. of a king (son of Vइतत्ह), BhP.… · (with तापस), N. of the author of RV. x, 83; 84… · (with वासिष्ठ), N. of the author of RV. ix, 97, 10-12.… · / &c. See p. 786, col. 3.…

मन्वादि.en: मन्व्-आदि N. of partic. थित्हिs (which are anniversaries of the 14 ंअनुs), Inscr.

मनाग.en: w.r. for manApa, Lalit. (see under 2. मन, p. 783, col. 3).

मन्था.en: f. See below · 1. म/न्था form from which comes nom. (m.) म/न्थास् acc. ˚थाम्… · See मथि/न्, p. 777, col. 1.… · 2. म/न्था f. a churning-stick B.… · a mixed beverage, AV.; ŚāṅkhŚr.… · Trigonella Foenum Graecum, L.…

मन्थक.en: mfn. churning, Car. · m. N. of a man pl. his descendants g. yaskAdi (v.l. मथक).…

मन्थन.en: mfn. kindling fire by friction, Nir. iii, 14 · m. a churning-stick, Hariv.… · n. the act of kindling fire by rubbing pieces of wood together, ChUp.; ŚrS.… · the act of shaking, shaking about, agitating, churning (milk into butter), MBh.; Kāv.; Suśr.… · churning out (of आम्ṛत), MBh. (cf. अमृत-म्˚).…

मन्द.en: mf(आ)n. slow, tardy, moving slowly or softly, loitering, idle, lazy, sluggish in (loc. or comp.), apathetic, phlegmatic, indifferent to (dat.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · weak, slight, slack (as a bow), dull, faint (as light), low (as a voice), gentle (as rain or wind), feeble (as the digestive faculty), ib.… · weak i.e. tolerant, indulgent to (loc.), MBh.… · dull-witted, silly, stupid, foolish, KaṭhUp.; MBh. &c.… · unhappy, miserable (L. = कृपण), MBh.; Hariv.… · languid, ill, sick, Mālav.… · bad, wicked, MārkP.… · drunken, addicted to intoxication, L.… · = -मन्द्र, L.… · m. the planet Saturn, Var.… · the (upper) apsis of a planet's course or (according to some) its anomalistic motion, Sūryas.… · N. of ञम, L.… · a stupid or slow elephant, L. (cf. मन्द्र, भद्र-मन्द, मृग-मन्द)…

मन्दा.en: f. a pot, vessel, inkstand, L. · N. of ध्āक्ṣāयṇī, Cat.… · (scil. संक्रान्ति) a partic. astron. conjunction, L.… · (in music) N. of a Śरुति, Saṃgīt.…

मन्दमति.en: मन्द—मति mfn. = -धी, Pañcat.; Hit. · मन्द—मति m. N. of a wheelwright and a lion, ib.…

मन्ध.en: m. a kind of antelope, ṢaḍvBr. (Sch. मन्थ).

मन्मन.en: m. confidential whisper (= karRa-mUle guptAlApa), Kāvyād., Sch. · love or the god of love, ib.…

मन्या.en: म/न्या f. du. and pl. the back or the nape of the neck (musculus cucullaris or trapezius), AV.; VS.; Suśr. · म/न्या m. (!) the middle of an elephant's goad, L.…

मम.en: म/म gen. sg. of 1st pers. pron. in comp.

ममता.en: मम/—ता (मम/-), f. the state of ‘mine’, sense of ownership, self-interest, egotism, interest in (loc.), MBh.; Kāv.; Pur. · pride, arrogance, L.… · N. of the wife of ऊतत्ह्य and mother of ध्īर्ग्ह-तमस्, RV. vi, 10, 2 (Sāy.), MBh.; BhP.…

ममत्व.en: मम—त्व n. = -ता, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (-त्वं √ 1. कृ P. -करोति, to be attached to, with loc. MBh.; to envy, with gen. MārkP.)

ममक.en: म/मक mfn. my, mine, RV. i, 31, 11; 34, 6 (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 3, 3 and मामक).

ममाय.en: Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to envy (with acc.), MBh.

मय.en: 1. मय m. (√ 3. मा) N. of an आसुर (the artificer or architect of the धइत्यs, also versed in magic, astronomy and military science), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · N. of various teachers and authors (esp. of an astronomer and a poet), Cat.… · 2. म/य m. (prob. fr. √ 2. मा) a horse, VS.… · a camel, L.… · a mule, L.… · 3. मय m. (√ 1. मी) hurting, injuring, W.…

मयी.en: म/यी (ई), f. a mare, Lāṭy., Sch.

मयका.en: instr. sg. of 3. म = मया, by me, Bhadrab.

मयट.en: m. = प्रसाद (prob. प्रास्˚) or तृण-हर्म्य, L.

मयन्त.en: म/यन्त (MaitrS.) and म/यन्द (VS.), n. N. of a metre.

मयोभू.en: {{Lbody=158015}} · मयो—भू (ऊ), m. a partic. आग्नि, ŚāṅkhGṛ.…

मयु.en: / m. (prob. fr. √ 2. मा) a खिम्पुरुṣअ (s.v.) or a partic. man-like animal, VS.; TS.; ŚBr. · an antelope, deer, L.…

मयूर.en: m. (prob. fr. √ 2. मा) a peacock, VS.; Lāṭy.; MBh. &c. · a cock, L.… · a species of plant, Suśr. (Celosia Cristata or Achyranthes Aspera, L.)… · a kind of instrument for measuring time, Sūryas.… · a kind of gait, Saṃgīt.… · N. of an आसुर, MBh.… · of a poet, Prasannar.… · (also with भट्ट), of various other writers, Cat.… · of the father of Śअṅकुक, ib.… · of a mountain, MārkP.… · n. a partic. posture in sitting, Cat.… · N. of a town, Buddh.…

मर.en: m. (√ मृ) dying, death (see परि-मर) · the world of death i.e. the earth, AitUp.… · mfn. killing (see नृ-मर)… · m. pl. the inhabitants of hell, Āryabh.… · m. w.r. for नराः, Hariv. 8464.…

मरक.en: m. an epidemic, plague, mortality, Var.; Suśr. · pl. N. of a people, MārkP.…

मरण.en: n. the act of dying, death, (ifc. dying by; ˚णं √ 1. कृ Ā. कुरुते, to die), ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c. · passing away, cessation (as of lightning or rain), AitBr.… · (in astrol.) the 8th mansion, VarBṛS., Sch.… · a kind of poison, L. (prob. w.r. for मारण)… · a refuge, asylum, BhP. (prob. w.r. for शरण).…

मरणज.en: मरण—ज mfn. produced by death, MW.

मरणधर्म.en: मरण—धर्म m. the law of d˚ (instr. with Caus. of √ युज्, ‘to put to d˚’), R.

मरणधर्मन्.en: मरण—धर्मन् mfn. subject to the law of d˚, mortal, Kathās.

मरणान्त.en: maraRAnta and maraRAn˚tika, mfn. ending in d˚, MBh.

मरकत.en: n. an emerald, R.; Var.; Pañcat. &c. · [cf. Gk. σμάραγδος; Lat. smaragdus.]…

मरकतमणि.en: मरकत—मणि m. the em˚ gem, VarBṛS.

मरीच.en: m. the pepper shrub (also -क्षुप), Hariv. · Strychnos Potatorum, L. (v.l. मरिच)… · marjoram, L.… · N. of the father of खśयप, Cat.… · of a son of शुन्द, VP.… · n. black pepper, L.…

मरीचि.en: म/रीचि m. f. (m. only in TĀr.; prob. connected with मरु/त्, q.v.) a particle of light, shining mote or speck in the air, RV.; AV. · ray of light (of the sun or moon), RV. &c. &c.… · (also ˚ची; f. with सोमस्य = moonlight, Hariv.)… · a mirage (= मरीचिका), Kathās. (cf. मरीचि-तोय)… · म/रीचि m. मरु.en: / m. (prob. fr. √ मृ) a wilderness, sandy waste, desert (often pl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · a mountain, rock, MBh.; MārkP.… · ‘the desert-like penance’ i.e. abstinence from drinking, MBh.; Hariv.… · a species of plant, Bhpr.… · a deer, antelope, L.… · N. of a धइत्य (usually associated with ङरक), MBh.… · of a Vअसु, Hariv.… · of a prince (the son of Śīग्ह्र), ib.; R.; Pur.… · of a king belonging to the ईक्ṣव्āकु family, BhP.… · of a son of ःअर्य्-अśव, R.; Pur.… · pl. N. of a country (Marwar) and its inhabitants, TĀr.; R.; Var. &c.… · [cf. Lat. mare (?); Angl.Sax. môr; Germ. and Eng. moor.]…

मरुत.en: m. wind, Śak.<listinfo n="sup"/> · a god, L.… · Bignonia Suaveolens, L.… · N. of various men, MBh.; Hariv.; VP.… · (prob.) the god of war, MānGṛ. ii, 15, 6.…

मरुद्गण.en: मरुद्—गण m. (ifc. f(आ). ) the host or troop of the ंअरुत्s, the host of the gods, MBh.; R.; Hariv.; Bhartṛ. · मरु/द्—गण mfn. being with or attended by the tr˚ of the M˚, RV.… · मरुद्—गण m. or n. (?) N. of a थ्īर्त्ह, MBh.…

मरुन्ध.en: N. of a town, Cat. (cf. मरून्ध and मारुध).

मर्क्.en: (prob. invented to serve as the source of the words below), to go, move.

मर्क.en: 1. मर्क m. an ape, monkey, BhP. · N. of Vāयु, the wind, L.… · the mind, L.… · 2. मर्क/ m. (√ मृच् cf. मर्च् below) seizure i.e. eclipse (of sun), RV. x, 27, 20 (म/र्क), N. of the फुरोहित of the आसुरs (held to be a son of Śउक्र), VS.; TS.; Br.… · a demon presiding over various sicknesses of childhood, PārGṛ.… · N. of a ञक्ṣअ, Cat.… · 3. मर्क m. (accord. to Uṇ. iii, 43 fr. √ मर्च्) the vital breath which pervades the body, L. (others ‘wind’ and ‘body’).…

मर्कट.en: मर्क/ट m. (Uṇ. iv, 81) a monkey, ape, VS. &c. &c. · a kind of bird, ṢaḍvBr. (the adjutant or Indian crane, L.)… · a spider, L.… · a sort of poison or venom, L.… · a mode of coitus, L.… · N. of a man, Pravar.… · मर्क/ट n. an iron monkey-shaped bolt, L.…

मर्त.en: म/र्त m. (√ मृ) a mortal, man, RV.; VS. (in later literature prob. w.r. for मर्त्य) · the world of mortals, the earth, Uṇ. iii, 86, Sch.… · [Gk. μορτός, βροτός; Lat. mortuus, mortalis.]…

मर्तव्य.en: mfn. ‘to be died’, liable to die · n. impers. ‘it must be died’ (˚व्ये सति, death being inevitable; ˚व्ये कृत-निश्चय mfn. determined to die), Mn.; MBh. &c.…

मर्त्य.en: म/र्त्य mfn. who or what must die, mortal, Br.; Kauś. · म/र्त्य m. a mortal, man, person, RV. &c. &c.… · the world of mortals, the earth, L.… · म/र्त्य n. that which is mortal, the body, BhP.…

मर्त्यता.en: मर्त्य—ता f. mortality, human condition (-tAm prAptaH, one who has become man), MBh.; Kathās.

मर्त्यामृत.en: martyAmfta n. the immortality of mortals, Āpast.

मर्द.en: mfn. (√ मृद्) crushing, grinding, rubbing, bruising, destroying (ifc.; cf. अरि-, चक्र-म्˚ &c.) · m. grinding, pounding, violent pressure or friction, MBh.; VarBṛS. (cf. ग्रह-म्˚)… · acute pain (cf. अङ्ग-म्˚)… · dispassion, L.…

मर्दन.en: mf(ई)n. crushing, grinding, rubbing, bruising, paining, tormenting, ruining, destroying, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. candrArka-, समर- and समिति-म्˚) · N. of a king of the Vइद्य्ā-द्हरs… · n. the act of crushing or grinding or destroying, Kāv.; Kathās.; BhP.… · rubbing, anointing, Kāv.; Pañcat. &c. (-शाला f., Siṃhās.), cleaning or combing (the hair; see केश-म्˚)… · friction i.e. opposition (of planets; see ग्रह-म्˚).…

मर्य.en: म/र्य m. (prob. fr. √ मृ) a mortal, man, (esp.) young man, lover, suitor, RV.; VS.; Br. (pl. people; voc. often used as a kind of particle; cf. VPrāt. ii, 16 and भोस्) · a stallion, RV. vii, 56, 16 &c.… · a camel, L. (cf. मय).…

मर्या.en: f. (perhaps orig. something clear or shining; cf. मरीचि and मरुत्) a mark, limit, boundary, L.

मर्याद.en: मर्या-द m. ‘one who sets marks or limits’, an arbiter, umpire (?), AV. v, 1, 8.

मर्यादा.en: f. (doubtful whether fr. मर्या + दा or मर्या + आद [fr. आ √ दा]; fancifully said to be fr. मर्य + अद, ‘devouring young men’ who are killed in defending boundaries) ‘giving or containing clear marks or signs’, a frontier, limit, boundary, border, bank, shore, mark, end, extreme point, goal (in space and time), RV. &c. &c. (षण्-मास-मर्यादया, within six months, VarBṛS.) · the bounds or limits of morality and propriety, rule or custom, distinct law or definition, Mn.; MBh. &c.… · a covenant, agreement, bond, contract, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · continuance in the right way, propriety of conduct, Kāv.; Pañcat.… · N. of a kind of ring used as an amulet, AV. vi, 81, 2… · N. of the wife of आव्āच्īन (daughter of a king of Vइदर्ब्ह), MBh.… · of the wife of धेव्āतित्हि (daughter of a king of Vइदेह), ib.…

मर्श.en: m. (√ 1. मृश्) any substance used to excite sneezing, a sternutatory, Bhpr. (cf. प्रति-मर्श) · counsel, advice, W.…

मर्शन.en: n. touching (esp. a woman), MBh. · inquiring into, examining (= मीमांसा), BhP.… · advising, counselling, deliberating, W.… · explaining, explication, MW.… · rubbing off, removing, ib.…

मर्ष.en: m. (√ मृष्) patience, endurance, L. (cf. अ- and दुर्-मर्ष).

मर्षित.en: मर्˚षित mfn. borne, endured, forgiven, Bh. (-वत् mfn. one who has borne or forgiven, patient, enduring), W. · patient, content, W. (cf. अ-मर्षित)… · मर्˚षित m. patience, W.…

मल.en: म/ल n. (in later language also m.; prob. fr. √ म्लै) dirt, filth, dust, impurity (physical and moral), AV. &c. &c. · (in med.) any bodily excretion or secretion (esp. those of the ध्ह्āतुs q.v., described as phlegm from chyle, bile from the blood, nose mucus and ear wax from the flesh, perspiration from the fat, nails and hair from the bones, rheum of the eye from the brain; cf. also the 12 impurities of the body enumerated in Mn. v, 135), Suśr.; Vāgbh. &c.… · (with Śअइवs), original sin, natural impurity, Sarvad.… · camphor, L.… · Os Sepiae, L.… · म/ल m. the son of a Śūद्र and a ंāलुक्ī, L.… · म/ल n. tanned leather, a leathern or dirty garment (?), RV. x, 136, 2… · a kind of brass or bell-metal, L.… · the tip of a scorpion's tail, L. मलक.en: m. pl. N. of a people, MārkP.

मलिन.en: mfn. dirty, filthy, impure, soiled, tarnished (lit. and fig.), Yājñ.; MBh.; Kāv. &c. · of a dark colour, gray, dark gray, black, Śiś.; Rājat. &c.… · m. a religious mendicant wearing dirty clothes (perhaps) a फ्āśउपत, Viṣṇ.… · N. of a son of थṃसु, VP. मलिनता.en: मलिन—ता f. dirtiness, impurity, Sāh. · moral imp˚, blackness, moral bl˚, MW.…

(√ 3. मा; for 1. मित See √ 1. मि) measured, meted out, measured or limited by i.e. equal to (instr. or comp.), Sūryas.; VarBṛS.; BhP.… · containing a partic. measure i.e. measuring, consisting of (acc.), RPrāt.… · Bhartṛ. मिति.en: 1. मिति/ f. (for 2. See p. 816, col. 1) fixing, erecting, establishing, RV. · 2. मिति f. (for 1. See p. 815, col. 3) measuring, measure, weight, VarBṛS.; ŚārṅgS.… · accurate knowledge, evidence, MāṇḍUp.…

मित्य.en: n. what is to be measured or fixed, (prob.) price, Rājat.

मित्र.en: 1. मित्र/ m. (orig. मित्-त्र, fr. √ मिथ् or मिद्; cf. मेदिन्) a friend, companion, associate, RV.; AV. (in later language mostly n.) · N. of an Āदित्य (generally invoked together with Vअरुṇअ cf. मित्रा-व्˚, and often associated with आर्यमन् q.v.; ंइत्र is extolled alone in RV. iii, 59, and there described as calling men to activity, sustaining earth and sky and beholding all creatures with unwinking eye; in later times he is considered as the deity of the constellation आनुर्āद्ह्ā, and father of ऊत्सर्ग), RV. &c. &c.… · the sun, Kāv. &c. (cf. comp.)… · N. of a ंअरुत्, Hariv.… · of a son of Vअसिṣṭह and various other men, Pur.… · of the third ंउह्ūर्त, L.… · du. = मित्र/-वरुण, RV.… · / n. friendship, RV.… · / n. a friend, companion (cf. m. above), TS. &c., &c.… · / n. (with औरस) a friend connected by blood-relationship, Hit.…

मित्रा.en: (आ), f. N. of an आप्सरस्, MBh. (B. चित्रा) · of the mother of ंअइत्रेय and ंअइत्रेय्ī, Śaṃk. on ChUp.; BhP.… · of the mother of Śअत्रु-ग्ह्न (= सु-मित्रा), L. (W. ई)…

मित्रता.en: मित्र—ता f. friendship (˚tam samprAptaH, one who has become a friend), MBh.; Pañcat. &c. · equalness, likeness with (comp.), Vcar.…

मित्रभ.en: मित्र—भ n. a friendly constellation, Var. · ंइत्र's ङक्ṣअत्र i.e. आनुर्āद्ह्ā, Var.; Śatr.…

मित्रभाव.en: मित्र—भाव m. a state of friendship, friendly disposition, MBh.; Hariv. &c.

मित्रक.en: m. N. of a man, Cat.

मित्राय.en: Nom. Ā. मित्रायते, (prob.) to desire or wish for friend (cf. next).

मिथस्.en: मिथ/स् ind. together, together with (instr.), mutually, reciprocally, alternately, to or from or with each other, RV. &c., &c. · privately, in secret, Mn.; Kālid.; Daś.… · by contest or dispute, BhP.…

मिथु.en: मि/थु ind. (cf. मिथू) alternately, pervertedly, falsely, wrongly, RV. (Padap. & Prāt.), TBr.; Kāṭh.

मिथुन.en: / mf(आ)n. paired, forming a pair · / m. a pair (male and female; but also ‘any couple or pair’, RV. &c. &c., usually du., in later language mostly n.; ifc. f(आ). )… · / n. pairing, copulation, TS. &c. &c.… · a pair or couple (= m.; but also ‘twins’), MBh.… · (also m.) the sign of the zodiac Gemini or the third arc of 30 degrees in a circle, Sūryas.; Var.; Pur.… · the other part, complement or companion of anything, MBh. मिथुनत्व.en: मिथुन—त्व/ n. the state of forming a pair, AV.; &c.

मिथुनीकृ.en: मिथुनी—√ कृ P. -करोति, to cause to pair, cause the union of the sexes, TS.; ŚBr.

मिथुनीभाव.en: मिथुनी—भाव m. copulation, sexual union, BhP.

मिथुनीभू.en: मिथुनी—√ भू P. -भवति (ind.p. -भूय), = -√ अस्, ŚBr.; ChUp.; <div n="to"/>to be joined or arranged in pairs, BhP.

मिथो.en: in comp. for मिथस् (cf. g. स्वर्-आदि).

मिथ्या.en: / ind. (contracted from मिथूया/) invertedly, contrarily, incorrectly, wrongly, improperly, ŚBr. &c. &c. (with Caus., of √ कृ, to pronounce a word wrongly ‘once’ [P.] or ‘repeatedly’ [Ā.] Pāṇ. i, 3, 71; with प्र-√ चर्, to act wrongly, Mn. ix, 284; with प्र-√ वृत्, to behave improperly, MBh. iii, 2414); <div n="vp"/> falsely, deceitfully, untruly, Mn.; MBh. &c. (often with √ ब्रू, वच् or वद्, to speak falsely, utter a lie; with √ कृ, to deny, MBh.; to break one's word, with न-√ कृ, to keep it), R.; <div n="vp"/> with √ भू, to turn out or prove false, MBh.; <div n="vp"/> not in reality, only apparently, Madhus.; <div n="to"/>to no purpose, fruitlessly, in vain, MaitrUp.; MBh. &c. (ibc. often = false, untrue, sham; ंइत्ह्य्ā is personified as the wife of आ-द्हर्म, KalkiP.)

मिथ्याग्रह.en: miTyAgraha m. (miTyAg˚?) improper persistency, useless obstinacy, ib. · (also ˚हण n.) misconception, misunderstanding, A.…

मिथ्याचार.en: miTyA˚cAra m. (miTyAc˚) improper conduct, wrong treatment (in medicine), Suśr. · miTyA—˚cAra mfn. acting falsely or hypocritically, Bhag.… · miTyA—˚cAra m. a rogue, hypocrite…

मिथ्याज्ञान.en: मिथ्या—ज्ञान n. a false conception, error, mistake, Yogas.; Pañcat. (cf. IW. 104)

मिथ्यात्व.en: मिथ्या—त्व n. falsity, unreality, Kap., Sch. · (with झइनs) perversion (as one of the 18 faults) or illusion (as the lowest of the 14 steps which lead to final emancipation), Sarvad.…

मिथ्यादर्शन.en: मिथ्या—दर्शन n. a false appearance, MaitrUp. · = next, L.…

मिथ्याप्रत्यय.en: मिथ्या—प्रत्यय m. f˚ conception, error, illusion, श्āṃक्ह्यs. Sch.

मिथ्याफल.en: मिथ्या—फल n. an imaginary or vain advantage, Bhartṛ.

मिथि.en: m. N. of a son of ङिमि and prince of ंíत्हिल्ā, R. (cf. IW. 511 n. 1).

मिथिल.en: m. N. of a king (the founder of ंइत्हिल्ā) = मिथि, BhP. · pl. N. of a people (prob. the inhabitants of ंइत्हिल्ā), MBh.; VarBṛS.…

मिथिला.en: f. N. of a city said to have been founded by ंइत्हि or ंइत्हिल (it was the capital of Vइदेह or the modern <ns>Tirhut</ns>, and residence of King झनक), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · of a school of law, IW. 302 &c.…

मिद्ध.en: n. sloth, indolence, Lalit.; Divyāv. (one of the 24 minor evil passions, Dharmas. 69).

मिरा.en: f. a limit, boundary, L. (cf. मीर).

मिरिका.en: f. a species of plant, L.

मिश्र.en: / mf(आ/)n. (prob. fr. a lost √ मिश् cf. under मिक्ष्) mixed, mingled, blended, combined, RV. &c. &c. (वचांसि मिश्रा √ 1. कृ, A. -कृणुते, to mingle words, talk together, RV. x, 93, 1) · manifold, diverse, various, TS. &c. &c.… · mixed or connected or furnished with, accompanied by (instr. with or without समम् gen. or comp.; rarely मिश्र ibc., cf. मिश्र-वात), VS. &c. &c.… · pl. (ifc. after honorific epithets = &c.; e.g. आर्य-मिश्राः, respectable or honourable people &c.; often also in sg. ifc. and rarely ibc. with proper names by way of respect, cf. कृष्ण-, मधु-म्˚ and comp. below)… · mixing, adulterating: (cf. धान्यम्˚)… · / m. a kind of elephant, L.… · (in music) a kind of measure, Saṃgīt.… · N. of various authors and other men (also abbreviation for some names ending in मिश्र, e.g. for ंअदन-, ंइत्र-, Vāचस्पति-m˚), Cat.…

मिष.en: m. rivalry, emulation, L. · the son of a ख्ṣअत्रिय and a low woman, L.… · n. false appearance, fraud, deceit (मिषेण or मिषात् or -तस् or ifc. under the pretext of), Kāv.; Kathās.; Rājat.…

मिष्ट.en: See col. 2. · mfn. (prob. fr. मृष्ट) dainty, delicate, sweet (lit. and fig.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · n. a sweetmeat, dainty or savoury dish, ib.…

(Dhātup. xxxi, 4) मीनाति, मीनीते (Ved. also मिना/ति and मिनोति; मी/यते or मीय/ते [Dhātup. xxvi, 28]; मिमीतस्, मिमीयात् [?]; pf. मिमाय, RV.; मीमय, AV.; ममौ, मिम्ये Gr.; aor. अमासीत्, अमास्त Gr.; मेष्ट, AV.; aor. Pass. अ/मायि, Br.; Prec. मीयात्, मासीष्ट Gr.; fut. माता, मास्यति, ˚ते Gr.; मेष्यते, Br.; inf. -मि/यम्, -मिये, RV.; मे/तोस्, Br.; ind.p. मीत्वा, -मीय, -माय, Gr.), <div n="to"/>to lessen, diminish, destroy (Ā. and Pass. to perish, disappear, die), RV.; AV.; Br.; Up.; BhP.; <div n="to"/>to lose one's way, go astray, RV.; <div n="to"/>to transgress, violate, frustrate, change, alter, RV.; AV. : <div n="vp"/>Caus. मापयति aor. अमीमपत्. Gk. μινύω <pb n="818,3"/>; Lat. minuere; Slav. mǐnij; Germ. minniro, minre, minder; Angl.Sax. min.]…

मीन.en: m. (derivation fr. √ 1. मी very doubtful in spite of Uṇ. iii, 3) a fish, Mn.; MBh. &c. · the sign of the zodiac Pisces, R.; VarBṛS.; Pur.… · N. of a teacher of ञोग, Cat.…

मीना.en: f. a stick, L. · N. of a daughter of ऊṣā and wife of खśयप, Pur.…

मीमांस्य.en: mfn. to be thought over or reflected upon, to be examined or considered, Gobh.; KenUp. (cf. अ-म्˚).

मीर.en: m. the sea, ocean, Uṇ. ii, 25, Sch. (L. also ‘a partic. part of a mountain; a limit, boundary; a drink, beverage’).

मीलित.en: mfn. one who has closed his eyes, sleepy (only compar. ˚त/-तर), ŚBr. · closed, obstructed (opp. to मुक्त), PañcavBr.… · closed, unblown, partly opened (as eyes, blossoms &c.), Kāv.; Pur.… · disappeared, ceased to be, BhP.… · met, assembled, gathered together, Rājat.… · (in. rhet.) an implied simile (in which the similarity between two objects is only implied, as in the example: ‘women clothed in white are invisible in the moonlight, therefore they are as bright as moonlight’), Kpr.; Kuval.…

मूत.en: 1. मूत mfn. (for 2. See √ 1. मू) moved (see काम-मूत). · 2. मूत mfn. (for 1. See p. 819, col. 1) bound, tied, woven, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 20… · m. n. a woven basket, TBr.; Kāṭh.; ŚrS.… · m. n. pouring a little थक्र into warm milk, L.… · 1. 2. मूत See under √ 1. मीव् and above.…

मुक.en: m. the smell of cow-dung · mf(आ)n. having the smell of cow-dung, L.…

मुका.en: f. N. of a town, VP.

Pāṇ. iv, 1, 54, 58) the mouth, face, countenance, RV. &c., &c. · the beak of a bird, snout or muzzle of an animal, GṛS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.… · a direction, quarter (esp. ifc. cf. दिङ्-म्˚; mfn. turning or turned towards, facing, cf. अधो-म्˚; also अम्, ind., cf. प्राङ्-मुखम्);… · the mouth or spout of a vessel, KātyŚr.… · opening aperture, entrance into or egress out of (gen. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · the mouth or embouchure (of a river), Ragh.… · the fore part, front, van (of an army), TBr.; MBh.… · the upper part, head, top, tip or point of anything, VS.; Br.; MBh. &c. (Uṇ. iv, 101) N. of a fabulous mountain (regarded as the Olympus of <ns>Hindū</ns> mythology and said to form the central point of झम्बु-द्व्īप; all the planets revolve round it and it is compared to the cup or seed-vessel of a lotus, the leaves of which are formed by the different ध्व्īपs q.v.; the river Ganges falls from heaven on its summit, and flows thence to the surrounding worlds in four streams; the regents of the four quarters of the compass occupy the corresponding faces of the mountain, the whole of which consists of gold and gems; its summit is the residence of भ्रह्म्ā, and a place of meeting for the gods, Ṛṣइs, घन्द्हर्वs &c., when not regarded as a fabulous mountain, it appears to mean the highland of Tartary north of the ःइम्āलय), MBh.; Kāv. &c.

मौन.en: / m. (fr. मुनि) a patr. ĀśvŚr. · pl. N. of a dynasty, VP.… · / n. the office or position of a ंउनि or holy sage, ŚBr.; MBh.… · silence, taciturnity, ChUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (मौनं with √ कृ, or वि-√ धा or सम्-आ-√ चर्, to observe silence, hold one's tongue).…

मौनी.en: (ई), f. N. of the 15th day in the dark half of the month फ्ह्āल्गुन (when a partic. form of ablution is performed in silence), Col.

म्ना.en: (cf. √ मन्, with which म्ना was originally identical) cl. 1. P. Dhātup. xxii, 31; <div n="vp"/> मनति (Gr. also pf. मम्नौ; aor. अम्नासीत्; Prec. म्नायात्, or म्नेयात्; fut. म्नाता and म्नास्यति; inf. म्नातुम्: <div n="vp"/>Caus. म्नापयति aor. अमिम्नपत्: <div n="vp"/>Desid. मिम्नासति: <div n="vp"/>Intens., माम्नायते, माम्नाति, माम्नेति), only in अनु-, आ-, प्रत्य्-आ-, सम्-आ-, परि-√ म्ना.

म्लात.en: , म्लान, म्लायिन्, म्लास्नु See p. 838, col. 1. · / mfn. (leather &c.) made soft by tanning, RV.… · faded, withered, Kāv. &c.…

म्लेच्छ.en: / m. a foreigner, barbarian, non-Aryan, man of an outcast race, any person who does not speak Sanskṛt and does not conform to the usual <ns>Hindū</ns> institutions, ŚBr. &c. &c. (f(ई). ) · a person who lives by agriculture or by making weapons, L.… · a wicked or bad man, sinner, L.… · ignorance of Sanskṛt, barbarism, Nyāyam., Sch.… · / n. copper, L.… · vermilion, L.…

म्लान.en: mfn. faded, withered, exhausted, languid, weak, feeble, MBh.; Kāv. &c. · relaxed, shrunk, shrivelled, Car.… · dejected, sad, melancholy, Daś.… · vanished, gone, Naiṣ.… · black, dark-coloured, Prab.… · foul, dirty, L.… · m. a house frog, L.… · n. withered or faded condition, absence of brightness or lustre, VarBṛS.…

य.en: 1. य the 1st semivowel (corresponding to the vowels इ and ई, and having the sound of the English y, in Bengal usually pronounced j). · 2. य m. (in prosody) a bacchic (˘ ¯ ¯), Piṅg.… · 3. य the actual base of the relative pronoun in declension [cf. य/द् and Gk. ὅς, ἥ, ὅ].… · 4. य m. (in some senses fr. √ 1. या, only, L.) a goer or mover… · wind… · joining… · restraining… · fame… · a carriage (?)… · barley… · light… · abandoning…

यकार.en: य—कार m. the letter or sound य, TPrāt.

यत्व.en: य—त्व n. the being the sound य, TPrāt., Sch.

यतम.en: य—तम/ mfn. (superl.; n(˚मत्). , m. pl. ˚मे; cf. Pāṇ. v, 3, 93) who or which (of many), RV.; AV.; Br. · य-तम य-तर. See under 3. य.…

यतर.en: य—तर/ mfn. (compar.; cf. Pāṇ. v, 3, 92) who or which (of two), RV.; AV.; Br.; Up.

यक.en: / mf(आ/)n. (cf. Pāṇ. vii, 3, 45) = 3. य, who, which, RV.; VS.

या.en: (आ), f. going; a car · restraining, religious meditation… · attaining… · pudendum muliebre… · N. of ळक्ṣम्ī.… · 1. या (collateral form of √ 5. इ) cl. 2. P. (Dhātup. xxiv, 41) या/ति (1. pl. यामहे, MBh.; impf. 3. pl. अयुः, Br.; अयान्, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 111, Sch.; pf. ययौ/, यया/थ, यय/, ययु/ः, RV. &c. &c.; यये, Kāv.; aor. अयासम् or अयासिषम्; Subj. या/सत्, येषम्, यासिषत्, RV.; Br.; Prec. यासिषीष्ठास्, Br.; fut. याता, MBh. &c.; यास्यति, AV.; ˚ते, MBh.; inf. यातुम्, MBh. &c.; Ved. inf. यै/, या/तवे or ˚वै/; ind.p. यात्वा/, Br. &c.; -या/य, -यायम्, ib.), <div n="to"/>to go, proceed, move, walk, set out, march, advance, travel, journey (often with instr. or acc. of the way, esp. with गतिम्, मार्गम्, अध्वानम्, पन्थानम्, पदवीम्, यात्राम्), RV. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to go away, withdraw, retire, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; <div n="to"/> (also with palAyya) to flee, escape, R.; Kathās. (with क्षेमेण or स्वस्ति, to escape unscathed……

यकृत्.en: य/कृत् n. (the weak cases are optionally formed fr. a base यकन् cf. Pāṇ. vi, 1, 63; nom. acc. य/कृत्, AV.; abl. यक्न/स्, RV.; यकृतस्, Suśr.; instr. यक्ना/, VS.; loc. यकृति, Suśr.; ibc. only यकृत्) the liver, RV.; &c. · [cf. Gk. ἧπαρ; Lat. jecur.]…

यक्ष.en: / n. a living supernatural being, spiritual apparition, ghost, spirit, RV.; AV.; VS.; Br.; GṛŚrS. (accord. to some native Comms. = यज्ञ, पुजा, पूजित &c.) · / m. N. of a class of semi-divine beings (attendants of खुबेर, exceptionally also of Vइṣṇउ; described as sons of फुलस्त्य, of फुलह, of खśयप, of ख्हस्ā or ख्रोद्ह्ā; also as produced from the feet of भ्रह्म्ā; though generally regarded as beings of a benevolent and inoffensive disposition, like the ञक्ṣअ in ख्āलिद्āस's ंएग्ह-द्ūत, they are occasionally classed with फिśāचs and other malignant spirits, and sometimes said to cause demoniacal possession; as to their position in the <ns>Buddhist</ns> system See MWB. 206, 218), Up.; GṛS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.… · (with झइनs) a subdivision of the Vयन्तरs… · N. of खुबेर, VarYogay.…

यक्षा.en: (आ), f. N. of a woman, HPariś.

यक्ष्य.en: य/क्ष्य mfn. (prob.) active, restless, RV. viii, 60, 3 (Sāy. = यष्टव्य).

यज.en: m. a word formed to explain यजुस्, ŚBr.

यजा.en: f. N., of a female tutelary being (mentioned with श्īत्ā, Śअम्ā and भ्ह्ūति), PārGṛ.

यजत.en: / mf(आ/)n. worthy of worship, adorable, holy, sublime, RV. · [cf. Zd. yazata]… · / m. a priest (= ऋत्व्-इज्), L.… · the moon, L.… · N. of Śइव, L.… · (with Āत्रेय) of a Ṛṣइ (author of RV. v, 67, 68), Anukr.…

यजति.en: m. N. of those sacrificial ceremonies to which the verb यजति is applied (as opp. to जुहोति), KātyŚr. (cf. Kull. on Mn. ii, 84).

यजन.en: n. the act of sacrificing or worshipping, Mn.; MBh. &c. (तव यजनाय, to worship thee, BhP.) · a place of sacrifice, R.; BhP.… · N. of a थ्īर्त्ह, MBh.…

यजमान.en: य/जमान mfn. sacrificing, worshipping &c. · य/जमान m. the person paying the cost of a sacrifice, the institutor of a s˚ (who to perform it employs a priest or priests, who are often hereditary functionaries in a family), ŚBr. &c. &c. (f(ई). the wife of a Y˚, BhP.)… · य/जमान m. any patron, host, rich man, head of a family or tribe, Pañcat.…

यजमानत्व.en: यजमान—त्व n. the rank or position of a Y˚, Śaṃk.

यजमानक.en: m. = यजमान, a sacrificer or institutor of a sacrifice, Cāṇ.

यजि.en: mfn. sacrificing, worshipping (see देव-य्˚) · m. worship, sacrifice, Pat. on Pāṇ. i, 3, 72… · the root यज्, KātyŚr., Sch.…

यजु.en: m. N. of one of the ten horses of the Moon, L.

यजुर्मय.en: यजुर्—म/य mf(ई)n. consisting of verses of the Y˚-v˚, Br.; Up.; MBh.

यजुर्वेद.en: यजुर्—वेद/ m. ‘the sacrificial Vएद’, the collective body of sacred ंअन्त्रs or texts which constitute the ञजुर्-वेद (these ंअन्त्रs, though often consisting of the prose ञजुस्, are frequently identical with the ंअन्त्रs of the Ṛग्-वेद, the ञजुर्-वेद being only a sort of sacrificial prayer-book for the आद्ह्वर्यु priests formed out of the Ṛग्-वेद, which had to be dissected and rearranged with additional texts for sacrificial purposes; the most characteristic feature of the ञजुर्-वेद is its division into two distinct collections of texts, the थइत्तिर्īय-सṃहित्ā and the Vāजसनेयि-सṃहित्ā q.v.; the former of which is also called ख्ṛṣṇअ i.e. ‘Black’, because in it the शṃहित्ā and भ्र्āह्मṇअ portions are confused; and the latter Śउक्ल i.e. ‘White’, because in this, which is thought the more recen…

यजुष्टस्.en: यजुष्—ट/स् ind. from or in relation to a Y˚, on the authority of the ञजुर्-वेद, ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr.; ChUp.

यज्ञ.en: / m. worship, devotion, prayer, praise · act of worship or devotion, offering, oblation, sacrifice (the former meanings prevailing in Vएद, the latter in post-Vedic literature; cf. महा-य्˚), RV. &c. &c.… · a worshipper, sacrificer, RV. iii, 30, 15; 32, 12… · fire, L.… · = आत्मन्, L.… · Sacrifice personified, MBh.; Hariv.… · (with प्राजापत्य) N. of the reputed author of RV. x, 130, Anukr.… · N. of a form of Vइṣṇउ, Pur.… · of ईन्द्र under ंअनु श्व्āयम्ब्हुव, ib.… · of a son of णुचि and Āक्ūति, ib.…

यज्ञकर्मन्.en: यज्ञ—कर्मन् mfn. engaged in a sacrifice, R. · यज्ञ—कर्मन् n. sacrificial rite or ceremony, KātyŚr.; Mn. &c.…

यज्ञकल्प.en: यज्ञ—कल्प mfn. resembling a s˚, BhP.

यज्ञक्रिया.en: यज्ञ—क्रिया f. sacrificial act or rite, Kathās.

यज्ञदत्त.en: यज्ञ—दत्त m. ‘s˚-given’, N. of a man (commonly used in examples = Lat. Caius), R.; Kathās.; Kaṇ.

यज्ञदत्ता.en: यज्ञ—दत्ता f. N. of a woman (cf. यज्ञ-दत्तक)

यज्ञपात्र.en: यज्ञ—पात्र/ n. a sacrificial vessel, ŚBr.; GṛŚrS. &c.

यज्ञभावित.en: यज्ञ—भावित mfn. honoured with s˚ (as the gods), MW.

यज्ञरूप.en: यज्ञ—रूप/ n. the form or attribute of a s˚, ŚBr.; KātyŚr. (-धृक् m. N. of ख्ṛṣṇअ, Pañcar.) · यज्ञ—रूप/ mfn. having the form of a s˚, MuṇḍUp.…

यज्ञवल्क.en: यज्ञ—वल्क m. N. of a man, Śaṃk.

यज्ञविद्या.en: यज्ञ—विद्या f. skill in s˚, Prab.

यज्ञशास्त्र.en: यज्ञ—शास्त्र n. the science of s˚ (-विद् mfn. familiar with it), Mn. iv, 22.

यज्ञशिष्ट.en: यज्ञ—शिष्ट n. the remnants of a s˚ (˚wASana n. the eating of them), Mn. iii, 118.

यज्ञाङ्ग.en: yajYANga n. ‘s˚-limb’, a part or means or instrument or requisite of a s˚, ŚrS.; Kum. · yajYANga m. the black-spotted antelope, L.… · N. of Vइṣṇउ-ख्ṛṣṇअ, MBh.… · Ficus Glomerata, L.… · Acacia Catechu, L.… · Clerodendrum Siphonantus, L.…

यज्ञार्ह.en: yajYArha mfn. deserving or fit for a s˚ · yajYArha m. du. N. of the आśविन्s, L.…

यज्ञेषु.en: yajYe/zu m. N. of a man, TBr.

यज्ञोपवीत.en: yajYopavIta/ n. the investiture of youths of the three twice-born castes with the sacred thread or (in later times) the thread itself (worn over the left shoulder and hanging down under the right; originally put on only during the performance of sacred ceremonies but its position occasionally changed [cf. प्राचीनावीतिन्, निवीतिन्]; in modern times assumed by other castes, as by the Vअइद्यs or medical caste in Bengal; cf. उपनयन and IW. 192), TBr. &c. &c.

यज्ञक.en: m. endearing form of यज्ञ-दत्त, Pat.

यज्ञाय.en: Nom. P. ˚य/ति, to be diligent in worship or in sacrifices, RV.

यज्ञिय.en: यज्ञि/य mf(आ)n. worthy of worship or sacrifice, sacred, godly, divine (applied to gods and to anything belonging to them), RV.; AV.; MBh.; BhP. · active or eager in worship and sacrifice, pious, devoted, holy, RV.; AV.; TS.; Hariv.… · belonging to worship or sacrifice, sacrificial, sacred, RV. &c. &c.… · यज्ञि/य m. a god, Nir.… · N. of the ध्व्āपर or third ञुग, L.… · Ficus Glomerata, L.…

यज्ञीय.en: mfn. suitable or fit for sacrifice, sacrificial, MBh. (with भाग m. share of a sacrifice v.l. यज्ञिय, Hariv.) · m. Ficus Glomerata, L.… · Flacourtia Sapida, L.…

यष्टव्य.en: m. to be worshipped or adored (n. impers.), MaitrUp.; MBh. &c. · यष्टृ. See p. 840, col. 3.…

यष्टि.en: 1. यष्टि f. (for 2. See p. 848, col. 3) sacrificing, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 110, Sch. (prob. w.r. for इष्टि). · 2. यष्टि/ m. (only L.) or f. (also यष्टी cf. g. बह्व्-आदि; prob. fr. √ यछ् = यम्; for 1. यष्टि See p. 840, col. 3) ‘any support’, a staff, stick, wand, rod, mace, club, cudgel… · pole, pillar, perch, ŚBr. &c. &c.… · a flag-staff (see ध्वज-य्˚)… · a stalk, stem, branch, twig, Hariv.; Kāv.… · (ifc.) anything thin or slender (see अङ्ग-, भुज-य्˚), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · the blade of a sword (see असि-य्˚)… · a thread, string (esp. of pearls; cf. मणि-, हार-य्˚), Kālid.… · a partic. kind of pearl necklace, VarBṛS.… · liquorice, Suśr.… · sugarcane, L.… · Clerodendrum Siphonantus, L.… · any creeping plant, W.…

यत्.en: 1. य/त् mfn. (pr. p. of √ 5. इ) going, moving, RV. &c. &c. (अब्दे यति, in this year, L.) · 2. यत् cl. 1. Ā. (prob. connected with √ यम् and orig. meaning, ‘to stretch’, Dhātup. ii, 29) य/तते (Ved. and ep. also P. ˚ति; p. य/तमान, य/तान and यतान/, RV.; pf. येते, 3. pl. येतिरे, ib. &c.; aor. अयतिष्ट, Br.; fut. यतिष्यते, Br., ˚ति, MBh.; inf. यतितुम्, MBh.; ind.p. -य/त्य, MBh.), (P.) <div n="to"/>to place in order, marshal, join, connect, RV.; <div n="to"/> (P. or Ā.) to keep pace, be in line, rival or vie with (instr.), ib.; <div n="to"/> (Ā.) to join (instr.), associate with (instr.), march or fly together or in line, ib.; <div n="to"/>to conform or comply with (instr.), ib.; <div n="to"/>to meet, encounter (in battle), ib.; Br.; <div n="to"/>to seek to join one's self with, make for, tend towards (loc.), ib.; <div n="to"/>to endeavour to reach, strive after, be eager or anxious fo……

यतन.en: n. making effort or exertion, W.

यतव्य.en: ^ mf(आ)n. (fr. यतु; applied to तनू/) = प्रयत्न-वत्, TS. (Sch. Kāṭh. यातव्य fr. यातु).

यति.en: 1. य/ति m. (for 2. and 3. See col. 2 and p. 845) a disposer, RV. vii, 13, 1 (Sāy. ‘a giver’) · ‘a striver’, an ascetic, devotee, one who has restrained his passions and abandoned the world, Up.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (cf. IW. 131)… · N. of a mythical race of ascetics (connected with the भ्ह्ṛगुs and said to have taken part in the creation of the world), RV. &c. &c.… · N. of a son of भ्रह्म्ā, BhP.… · of a son of ङहुṣअ, MBh.; Hariv.; Pur.… · of a son of Vइśव्āमित्र, MBh.… · N. of Śइव, MBh.… · = निकार or कार, L.… · 2. य/ति (fr. 3. य correlative of त/ति; declined only in pl. nom. acc. य/ति), as many as (= Lat. quot), as often, how many or often, RV. (for 1. and 3. यति See col. 1 and p. 845).… · 3. य/ति f. (for 1. and 2. See p. 841, cols. 1 and 2) restraint, control, guidance, TS.; Br.…

यत्त.en: 1. यत्त mfn. (for 2. See under √ यम्) endeavoured, striven, MBh.; Kāv. &c. · engaged in, intent upon, prepared for, ready to (loc. dat., acc. or inf. with प्रति), MBh.; R.; Hariv.… · on one's guard, watchful, cautious, ib.… · attended to, guided (as a chariot), MBh.…

यत्न.en: m. activity of will, volition, aspiring after, Kaṇ.; Bhāṣāp. · performance, work, Bhar.… · (also pl.) effort, exertion, energy, zeal, trouble, pains, care, endeavour after (loc. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c. (यत्नं with √ कृ, आ-√ स्था, समा-√ स्था, आ-√ धा and loc. or inf., ‘to make an effort or attempt’, ‘take trouble or pains for’; यत्नेन or ˚त्नैस्, ‘with effort’, ‘carefully’, ‘eagerly’, ‘strenuously’ [also यत्न ibc.]; yatnenApi, ‘in spite of every effort’; यत्नैर् विना, ‘without eff˚’; यत्नात्, with or notwithstanding eff˚; महतो यत्नात् ‘, with great eff˚’, ‘very carefully’)… · a special or express remark or statement, ĀpŚr., Sch.… · यत्य. See p. 841, cols. 1 and 2.…

यत्नतस्.en: यत्न—तस् ind. through or with effort, diligently, zealously, carefully, Mn.; R. &c.

यत्नान्तर.en: yatnAntara n. another eff˚ or exertion, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 26.

यत्य.en: mfn. to be striven or exerted, Pat. on Pāṇ. iii, 1, 97.

यत.en: See under √ यम्, p. 845. · / mfn. restrained, held in, held forth, kept down or limited, subdued, governed, controlled &c., RV. &c. &c. (cf. comp. below)… · / n. restraint (?) See यतं-कर/… · the spurring or guiding of an elephant by means of the rider's feet, L.…

यतस्.en: य/तस् ind. (fr. 3. य, correlative of त/तस्, and often used as abl. or instr. of the relative pron.) from which or what, whence, whereof, wherefrom, RV. &c. &c. (य/तो यतः, ‘from whichever’, ‘from whatever’, ‘whencesoever’; यतस् ततः, ‘from any one soever’, ‘from any quarter whatever’; यत एव कुतश् च, ‘from this or that place’, ‘whencesoever’) · where, in what place, AV. &c. &c.… · whither, Kāv.; Var.; Kathās. (यतो यतः, ‘whithersoever’; यतस् ततः, ‘any whither’, ‘to any place whatever’)… · wherefore, for which reason, in consequence where of R.; BhP.… · as, because, for, since, AV. &c. &c. (often connecting with a previous statement)… · from which time forward, since when (also with प्रभृति; यतो जाता, ‘ever since birth’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · as soon as, RV. iii, 10, 6…

यत्र.en: य/त्र ind. (in Vएद also य/त्रा; fr. 3. य, correlative of त/त्र, and often used for the loc. of the relative pron.) in or to which place, where, wherein, wherever, whither, RV. &c. &c. (यत्र यत्र, ‘wherever’, ‘whithersoever’; यत्र तत्र or yatra tatrApi, ‘anywhere whatever’ or = यस्मिंस् तस्मिन्, ‘in whatever’; यत्र तत्र दिने, ‘on any day whatever’; यत्र कुत्र, with or without चित् or अपि, ‘everywhere’ or = यस्मिन् कस्मिन्, ‘in whatever’; य/त्र क्व/ च or यत्र क्व चन, ‘wherever’, ‘in any place whatever’, ‘whithersoever’; यत्र क्व च, ‘anywhere whatever’; yatra kvApi, ‘to any place’, ‘hither and thither’; यत्र वा, ‘or elsewhere’) · on which occasion, in which case, if, when, as, RV. &c. &c. (यत्र तत्र, ‘on every occasion’, यत्र क्व च, ‘whenever’)… · in order that, RV. iii, 32, 14; ix, 29, 5…

यत्रस्थ.en: यत्र—स्थ mfn. where staying, in which place abiding, ib.

यथ.en: for यथा before ऋ and र् = ऋ.

यथर्तु.en: यथ—र्तु ind. acc˚ to the season or any fixed time, AitBr.; GṛŚrS.

यथा.en: य/था ind. (in Vएद also unaccented; fr. 3. य, correlative of त/था) in which manner or way, according as, as, like (also with चिद्, ह, ह वै, इव, ivANga, इव ह, एव, and followed by correl. तथा, तथा तथा, तद्वत्, एवम्, Ved. also एव/), RV. &c. &c. (yaTEtat or yaTEvEtat, ‘as for that’ <pb n="841,3"/>; यथा-तथा or यथा — तेन सत्येन, ‘as surely as’ — ‘so truly’) · as, for instance, namely (also तद् यथा, ‘as here follows’), Up.; GṛŚrS.; Nir.… · as it is or was (elliptically), BhP.… · that, so that, in order that (with Pot. or Subj., later also with fut. pres., impf. and aor.; in earlier language यथा is often placed after the first word of a sentence; sometimes with ellipsis of स्यात् and भवेत्), RV. &c. &c.… · that (esp. after verbs of ‘knowing’, ‘believing’, ‘hearing’, ‘doubting’ &c.; either with or without इति at the end of the sentence), Up.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.…

यथाकर्म.en: यथा—कर्म/ ind. acc˚ to actions, ŚBr.; ŚrS. &c. · acc˚ to circumstances, MW.…

यथाकाम.en: य/था—काम (य/था-), mfn. conformable to desire, ŚBr. · acting acc˚ to wish, Hcat.…

यथाकामम्.en: (-का/मम्, RV.; -काम/म्, ŚBr.) ind. acc˚ to wish, as one likes, at pleasure, easily, comfortably, RV. &c. &c.

यथाकामचार.en: यथा—काम—चार n. action acc˚ to pleasure or without control, ChUp.

यथाकालम्.en: यथा—कालम् (अम्), ind. acc˚ to time, in due t˚, at the right or usual t˚, KātyŚr. &c. &c.

यथाक्रतु.en: य/था—क्रतु (य/था-), mfn. forming such a plan, ŚBr.

यथाक्रम.en: यथा—क्रम (ibc.; Kathās.), यथा—क्र˚मम् (Mn.; Kāv. &c.), or यथा—क्र˚मेण (MaitrUp.; VarBṛS.), ind. acc˚ to order, in due succession, successively, respectively.

यथागत.en: 1. यथा—गत mfn. as gone, as previously gone, MW. · 2. yaTA˚gata (˚TAg˚), mfn. as come, by the way one came, R.; Hariv. &c.… · as one came (into the world), without sense, stupid, L. (cf. -जात, yaTodgata)…

यथागतम्.en: yaTA—˚gatam ind. (MBh.; R. &c.) by the way one came.

यथाग्नि.en: ya/TA˚gni (˚TAg˚), ind. acc˚ to (the size of) the fire, KātyŚr. · acc˚ to the digestive power, Car.…

यथातथ.en: यथा—तथ mfn. conformable to truth or the exact state of the case, right, true, accurate, W. · यथा—तथ n. a detailed account of events, W.…

यथादर्शन.en: यथा—दर्शन ibc., or यथा—दर्शनम्, ind. acc˚ to every occurrence, in every single case, Sāh.

यथादर्शितम्.en: यथा—दर्शितम् ind. as has been shown, Mālav.

यथादृष्टम्.en: यथा—दृष्टम् (Mn.; Kathās.) or यथा—दृष्˚टि (Cat.), ind. as seen or observed.

यथानुरूपम्.en: yaTA˚nurUpam (˚TAn˚), ind. acc˚ to form or rule, in exact conformity, VarBṛS.; Kathās.

यथान्यायम्.en: यथा—न्यायम् ind. acc˚ to rule or justice, rightly, fitly, GṛŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.

यथापूर्व.en: यथा—पूर्व mfn. being as before (-त्व n.), Kāṭh.; Ragh.

यथापूर्वम्.en: यथा—पूर्व/म् (अ/म्), ind. in succession, one after another, RV.; TS.; Br. &c. · as before, as previously, R.; Pañcat.; BhP.…

यथाप्रज्ञम्.en: यथा—प्रज्ञम् ind. acc˚ to knowledge, Cat.

यथाप्राप्त.en: yaTA—prApta mf(आ)n. as met with, the first that is met or occurs, Kād. · in conformity with a partic. state, suitable or conformable to circumstances, R.; Hit.… · following from a previous grammatical rule, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iii, 2, 135…

यथाबलम्.en: यथा—बल/म् ind. acc˚ to power, with all one's might, AV.; MBh. &c. · in relation to p˚, R.… · acc˚ to the (condition of the) army, acc˚ to the (number of) forces, Mn.; Kām.…

यथाबुद्धि.en: यथा—बुद्धि ind. acc˚ to knowledge, to the best of one's judgement, R.

यथाभाव.en: यथा—भाव m. proper condition or relation, Mn.; Kull. on Mn. viii, 95 · conformity to any destined state, destiny, R.… · यथा—भाव mfn. having whatever nature, BhP.…

यथाभिप्रेत.en: yaTA˚Bipreta (˚TAB˚), mfn. as wished or intended or desired See अ-य्˚

यथाभिप्रेतम्.en: yaTA—˚Bipretam (अम्), ind. acc˚ to one's (gen.) desire or wish, Lāṭy.; Pañcat. &c.

यथाभिमत.en: yaTA˚Bimata (˚TAB˚), mfn. as desired, as pleasing or agreeable to each, Hit.; Yogas.; Kathās.

यथाभूतम्.en: यथा—भूतम् ind. in accordance with fact, acc˚ to what has happened, acc˚ to the truth, MBh.; Lalit.

यथायतनम्.en: yaTA˚yatana/m (˚TAy˚), ind. each in his own place or abode, TS.; ŚBr.; Up.

यथायथम्.en: यथा—यथ/म् ind. (fr. यथा + यथा) in a proper manner, as is fit or pr˚, rightly, suitably, fitly · one after another, by degrees, gradually, AV.; TS. &c.…

यथायोगम्.en: यथा—योगम् (KātyŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.) or यथा—यो˚गेन (Kām.), ind. as is fit, acc˚ to circumstances, acc˚ to requirements; in due order, MW.; (अम्), ind. acc˚ to usage, as hitherto, usual, MBh.

यथारुचि.en: यथा—रुचि ind. acc˚ to pleasure or liking, acc˚ to taste, BhP.; Sāh.; Kathās.

यथारूप.en: यथा—रूप mf(आ)n. as constituted, Lāṭy. · of whatever form, of a corresponding form or appearance, extremely beautiful, MBh.; R.… · exceedingly great, R.…

यथार्थ.en: yaTA˚rTa (˚TAr˚), mf(आ)n. accordant with reality, conformable to truth or the true meaning, true, genuine, right (with स्वप्न m. a dream which is fulfilled; with जन्मन् n. a life in the true meaning of the word), Kāv.; Pañcat. &c.

यथार्थम्.en: yaTA—˚rTa/m ibc. or (अ/म्), ind. acc˚ to the aim or object, suitably, fitly, Śr.; GṛŚrS.; Nir. · acc˚ to pleasure or liking, GṛŚrS.; RPrāt.; Drāhy.… · acc˚ to truth or fact, truly, really, MBh.; R. &c.…

यथावत्.en: यथा—वत् ind. duly, properly, rightly, suitably, exactly, RPrāt.; Mn.; MBh. &c. · as, like (= यथा), MārkP.…

यथाविध.en: यथा—विध mfn. of whatever kind or sort (= Lat. qualis), MBh.; Ragh. · of such a kind or sort, such as, MW.…

यथाविधानम्.en: यथा—विधानम् (Pañcar.) or यथा—विधा˚नेन (Yājñ.), ind. acc˚ to prescription or rule.

यथाविधि.en: यथा—विधि ind. id., Kauś.; Mn. &c. (˚धिम्, m.c. Hariv.) · fitly, suitably acc. to the merit of (gen.), R.…

यथाविषयम्.en: यथा—विषयम् ind. acc˚ to the subject or point under discussion, Kāś.

यथाशक्ति.en: यथा—शक्ति (GṛŚrS. &c.) or यथा—शक्˚त्या (MBh.; Hariv. &c.), ind. acc˚ to power or ability, to the utmost of one's power.

यथाशास्त्र.en: यथा—शास्त्र ibc. (Mn.; ChUp.; Śaṃk.) or यथा—शास्त्रम्, ind. (APrāt.; Mn. &c.) acc˚ to precept or rule, acc˚ to the codes of law

यथाश्रमम्.en: yaTA˚Sramam (˚TAS˚), ind. acc˚ to the period of life (see आश्रम), BhP.

यथाश्रय.en: yaT—˚ASraya (yaTASr˚), mfn. as fit or appropriate, Bcar. viii, 15

यथाश्रुत.en: यथा—श्रुत mfn. corresponding to (what has been) heard, agreeing with a report, Kathās. · यथा—श्रुत n. a relative tradition, ChUp.; Śaṃk.…

यथाश्रुतम्.en: यथा—श्रुतम् (अम्), ind. as heard, acc. to report, Mn.; Pur.; Kathās. · acc˚ to knowledge, KaṭhUp.; BhP.… · acc˚ to Vedic precept, Śak. (w.r. for next).…

यथाश्रुति.en: यथा—श्रुति ind. acc˚ to the precepts of the sacred books, Śak.; Cat.

यथासंख्य.en: यथा—संख्य n. ‘relative enumeration’, (in rhet.) N. of a figure (which separating each verb from its subject so arranges verbs with verbs and subjects with subjects that each may answer to each), Kpr.

यथासम्भव.en: यथा—सम्भव mfn. accordant with possibility, as far as possible, compatible, Sāh.

यथासम्भवम्.en: यथा—सम्भवम् (अम्), ind. compatibly, acc˚ to the connexion, respectively, VPrāt., Sch.; BṛĀrUp.; Śaṃk. &c.

यथासुखम्.en: यथा—सुखम् ind. (or ibc. AV.Prāy.) (ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Mn.; MBh. &c.) acc˚ to ease or pleasure, at ease, at will or pl˚, comfortably, agreeably

यथास्थान.en: यथा—स्थान n. (only loc. sg. and pl.) the respective place, the right or proper pl˚, R.; Pañcar. · यथा—स्थान mfn. each in proper pl˚, ŚāṅkhŚr.…

यथास्थानम्.en: यथा—स्थान/म् (अ/म्), ind. acc˚ to pl˚, each acc˚ to the right pl˚, TS.; Br. &c. · instantly, MW.…

यथास्व.en: यथा—स्व mf(आ)n. each acc. to (his, her, their) own, every one possessing his own, MBh.; Suśr. · यथा—स्व ibc. each on (his, her, their) own account, e˚ for himself or in his own way, individually, properly, ŚrS.; Gaut.; MBh. &c.…

यथास्वम्.en: यथा—स्वम् ind. each on (his, her, their) own account, e˚ for himself or in his own way, individually, properly, ŚrS.; Gaut.; MBh. &c.

यथेच्छ.en: yaTecCa mfn. agreeable to wish or desire, Pañcar. · yaTecCa ibc. acc. to wish, at will or pleasure, agreeably. (ib.)…

यथेतम्.en: yaT'eta/m (˚था + 1. eta) ind. as come, ŚBr.; ŚrS.; Bādar.

यथेष्ट.en: yaTezwa mfn. agreeable to wish, desired, agreeable (-त्व n.), Mn.; VarBṛS. &c. · yaTezwa ibc. acc˚ to wish or inclination, at pleasure, agreeably (Pañcat.; Kathās.)…

यथेष्टम्.en: yaTezwam (GṛŚrS.; MBh. &c.) ind. acc˚ to wish or inclination, at pleasure, agreeably · yaTezwam (अम्), ind. in acc˚ to the order of sacrifices, KātyŚr. (in this sense fr. 2. इष्ट)…

यथोक्त.en: yaTokta mf(आ)n. as said or told, previously t˚ or prescribed, above mentioned, Kauś.; Mn. &c. · yaTokta ibc. acc˚ to what has been stated, as mentioned before, in the above-mentioned way (Mn.; MBh.; R.)…

यथोक्तम्.en: yaToktam ind. acc˚ to what has been stated, as mentioned before, in the above-mentioned way (KātyŚr.; Āp.; R. &c.)

यथोक्तेन.en: yaToktena (Mn.) ind. acc˚ to what has been stated, as mentioned before, in the above-mentioned way

यथोदित.en: yaTodita mfn. as said or told previously stated, before mentioned, RPrāt.; Mn. &c.

यथोदितम्.en: yaToditam ind. as mentioned before, acc˚ to a previous statement, Mn.; Pur.; Kathās.

यथोपदिष्ट.en: yaTopadizwa mfn. as indicated, as before stated, R.

यथोपदिष्टम्.en: yaTopadizwam ind. in the manner before mentioned or prescribed, R.; Pāṇ. i, 4, 12.

यथोपदेशम्.en: yaTopadeSam ind. acc˚ to advice or suggestion, acc˚ to precept or instructions, KātyŚr.; Āp. &c.

यथोपाधि.en: yaTopADi ind. acc˚ to the condition or supposition, BhP. Comm.

यदा.en: / ind. (fr. 3. य) when, at what time, whenever (generally followed by the correlatives तदा, ततस्, तर्हि, in Vएद also by आ/त्, आ/द् ई/त्, अ/थ, अ/ध and त/द्), RV. &c. &c. (यदा यदा, followed by तदा or तदा तदा, ‘as often as — so often’, ‘whenever’; यदा — तदा id., with repeated verbs, e.g. Hit. i, 197; yadEva-tadEva, ‘when indeed — then indeed’, Śak. यदा प्रभृति — तदा प्रभृति, ‘from whatever time — from that time forward’, R.; yadEva Kalu — तदा प्रभ्रित्य् एव, ‘as soon as — thence forward’, Śak.; यदा कदा/ च, ‘as often as’, ‘whenever’, RV.; यदा कदा चित्, ‘at any time’, Kauś.; यदा तदा, ‘always’, Naiṣ.; the copula after यदा is often dropped, esp. after a participle, e.g. यदा क्षयं गतं सर्वम्, ‘when all had gone to ruin’, R. यदा is sometimes joined with other relatives used indefinitely, e.g. यो ऽत…

यत्कर.en: यत्-कर यत्-काम, यत्-कारणम् &c. See col. 3. · यत्—कर mf(आ)n. doing or undertaking which, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 21, Vārtt.…

यद्.en: य/द् (nom. and acc. sg. n. and base in comp. of 3. य), who, which, what, whichever, whatever, that, RV. &c. &c. (with correlatives तद्, त्यद्, एतद्, इदम्, अदस्, तद् एतद्, एतद् त्यद्, इदं तद्, तद् इदम्, तादृश, ईदृश, ईदृश्, एतावद्, by which it is oftener followed than preceded; or the correl. is dropped, e.g. yas tu nAraBate karma kzipram Bavati nirdravyaH, ‘[he] indeed who does not begin work soon becomes poor’, R.; or the rel. is dropped, e.g. अन्धकम् भर्तारं न त्यजेत् सा महा-सती, ‘she who does not desert a blind husband is a very faithful wife’, Vet. यद् is often repeated to express ‘whoever’, ‘whatever’, ‘whichever’, e.g. यो यः, ‘whatever man’; या या, ‘whatever woman’; यो यज् जयति तस्य तत्, ‘whatever he wins [in war] belongs to him’, Mn. vii, 96; यद् यद् वदति तद् तद् भवति, ‘whatever he s…

यदन्न.en: यद्—अन्न mfn. eating which food, R.

यदर्थ.en: यद्—अर्थ mfn. having which object or intention, BhP.

यदर्थम्.en: यद्—अर्थम् (अम्), ind. on which account, for which purpose, wherefore, why, MBh.; Kāv. &c. · as, since, because, whereas, ib.…

यदात्मक.en: यद्—आत्मक mfn. having which essence or existence, BhP.

यदृच्छा.en: यद्—ऋच्छा f. self-will, spontaneity, accident, chance (ibc. or ˚च्छया ind. spontaneously, by accident, unexpectedly), ŚvetUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c. · (in gram.) See -शब्द, below… · यद्-ऋच्छा , यद्-गोत्र &c. See p. 844, col. 3.…

यदृच्छया.en: यद्—ऋच्छया ind., spontaneously, by accident, unexpectedly

यद्गोत्र.en: यद्—गोत्र mfn. belonging to which family, ChUp.

यद्देवत.en: यद्—देवत (ŚrS.) or यद्—देवत्य^ (ŚBr.), mfn. having which godhead or divinity.

यद्बल.en: यद्—बल mfn. of which strength or power, MBh.

यद्भूयस्.en: यद्—भूयस् (ibc.) the greatest part (˚सा ind. See col. 2)

यद्वत्.en: यद्—वत् ind. in which way, as (correlative of तद्-वत् and एवम्), MBh.; Kāv. &c.

यद्वद.en: यद्—वद mfn. talking anything, saying no matter what, L.

यद्वृत्त.en: यद्—वृत्त n. anything that has occurred, event, adventure, Hariv.; Kathās. · any form of यद्, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 66.…

यच्छ्रद्ध.en: यच्—छ्रद्ध (for -श्रद्ध) mfn. having which faith or belief, Bhag.

यत्काम.en: य/त्—काम (य/त्-), mfn. desiring or wishing which, RV.

यत्कारणम्.en: यत्—कारणम् ind. for which cause or reason, wherefore, why, MārkP. · as, because, since (also ˚णात्), Pañcat.…

यत्कार्यम्.en: यत्—कार्यम् ind. with which intention, MārkP.

यत्क्रतु.en: यत्—क्रतु mfn. having which resolution, forming which plan, BṛĀrUp.

यत्प्रथम.en: यत्—प्रथम mfn. doing which for the first time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162, Sch.

यन्निमित्त.en: यन्—निमित्त mfn. caused or occasioned by which, MBh.

यन्निमित्तम्.en: यन्—निमित्तम् ind. for which reason, in consequence of which, wherefore, why, R.; MārkP.

यन्मय.en: यन्—मय mf(ई)n. formed or consisting of which, Kāvyād.; Pur.

यद.en: = यद् (only in the form यदम् at the end of an adverbial comp.) g. शरद्-आदि.

यदि.en: य/दि ind. (in Vएद also य/दी, sometimes यदि चित्, यदि ह वै, ya/dI/t, य/द्य् उ, यद्य् उ वै) if, in case that, RV. &c. &c. In the earlier language यदि may be joined with Indic. Subj. or ळेṭ Pot., or Fut., the consequent clause of the conditional sentence being generally without any particle. In the later language यदि may be joined with Pres. (followed in cons˚ cl˚ by another Pres., e.g. यदि जीवति भद्राणि पश्यति, ‘if he lives he beholds prosperity’, or by fut. or by Impv. or by Pot. or by no verb) <pb n="845,1"/>; or it may be joined with Pot. (e.g. यदि राजा दण्डं न प्रणयेत्, ‘if the king were not to inflict punishment’, followed by another Pot. or by Cond. or by Pres. or by Impv. or by fut. or by no verb); or it may be joined with fut. (e.g. यदि न करिष्यन्ति तत्, ‘if they will not do that’, f…

यदीय.en: mfn. relating to whom, belonging to which or what, whose, Inscr.; Rājat.; BhP.

यद्वन्.en: m. pl. N. of a class of Ṛṣइs, Pat.

यदु.en: य/दु m. N. of an ancient hero (in the Vएद often mentioned together with थुर्वśअ [or थुर्वसु] q.v., and described as preserved by ईन्द्र during an inundation; in epic poetry he is a son of ञय्āति and brother of फुरु and थुर्वसु, ख्ṛṣṇअ being descended from ञदु, and भ्हरत and खुरु from फुरु; ञदु is also called a son of Vअसु, king of छेदि, or a son of ःअर्य्-अśव), RV.; MBh.; Hariv.; Pur. · N. of a country on the west of the <ns>Jumnā</ns> river (about ंअत्हुर्ā and Vṛन्द्ā-वन, over which ञदु ruled; according to others the Deccan or Southern peninsula of India), W.… · pl. the people of ञदु or the descendants of king ञदु (cf. यादव), ib.…

यद्वा.en: f. = बुद्धि, perception, mind, intelligence (?), L.

यन्त्र.en: See col. 3. · n. any instrument for holding or restraining or fastening, a prop, support, barrier, RV. &c. &c.… · a fetter, band, tie, thong, rein, trace, Mn.; MBh.… · a surgical instrument (esp. a blunt one, such as tweezers, a vice &c., opp. to शस्त्र), Suśr.; Vāgbh.… · any instrument or apparatus, mechanical contrivance, engine, machine, implement, appliance (as a bolt or lock on a door, oars or sails in a boat, &c.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. कूप-, जल-, तैल-य्˚; ibc. or ifc. often = mechanical, magical)… · restraint, force (˚त्रेण ind. forcibly, violently), MW.… · an amulet, mystical diagram supposed to possess occult powers, Kathās.; Pañcar. (cf. RTL. 203).…

यम्.en: cl. 1. P.
