युव.en: 1. युव/ actual base of the 2nd pers. pron. in the dual number (from which the forms युवा/म्, युवा/भ्याम्, युव/योस्; Ved. also युव/म्, युव/भ्याम्, युव/त्, युवो/स्, are derived). · 2. युव in comp. for युवन्.…

युवा.en: 1. युवा (for 2. See col. 3), in comp. for 1. युव. · 2. युवा f. (for 1. See col. 2) N. of one of आग्नि's arrows, TS.…

युवन्.en: यु/वन् mf(यूनी, or युवती or युवति, q.v.)n. (prob. fr. √ 2. यु) young, youthful, adult (applied to men and animals), strong, good, healthy, RV. &c. &c. · यु/वन् m. a youth, young man, young animal (in Vएद often applied to gods, esp. to ईन्द्र, आग्नि, and the ंअरुत्s), ib.… · (in gram.) the younger descendant of any one (an elder being still alive), Pāṇ. i, 2, 65, &c.… · N. of the ninth year in Jupiter's cycle of 60 years, Jyot.; an elephant 60 years old, Gal.… · [cf. Lat. juvenis, juventa; Slav. junǔ; Lith. jáunas; Goth. juggs <pb n="855,3"/>; Germ. junc, jung; Angl.Sax. geong; Eng. young.]…

युवप्रत्यय.en: युव—प्रत्यय m. a suffix forming the so-called ञुवन् patronymics, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 59 &c. Sch.

युष्म.en: (fr. यु + स्म), the actual base of the 2nd pers. pron. in the pl. number (from which all cases except the nom. यूय/म् are derived, viz. युष्मा/न्, युष्मा/भिस्, युष्म/भ्यम्, युष्म/त्, युष्मा/कम्, in Ved. also acc. f. युष्मा/स्; loc. युष्मे/, and gen. युष्माक; cf. Gk. ὔμμες, fr. ὐσμες).

युष्मद्.en: the base of the 2nd pers. pron. as used in comp. · also considered by native grammarians to be the base of the cases युष्मा/न् &c. (see above).…

युष्मा.en: in comp. for युष्म or युष्मद्.

युष्माक.en: युष्मा/क mf(आ)n. your, yours, RV. (cf. युष्माकम् under युष्म).

यू.en: m. (or f.) soup, pease-soup, broth (= यूष), L.

यूक.en: m. or (more commonly) यूका f. a louse, Mn.; Kathās.; Suśr. &c.

यूका.en: f. a louse, Mn.; Kathās.; Suśr. &c.

यूथ.en: / m. n. (in the older language only n.; fr. √ 2. यु) a herd, flock, troop, band, host, multitude, number, large quantity (ifc. f(आ). ), RV. &c. &c.

यूप.en: यू/प m. (prob. fr. √ युप्; but according to Uṇ. iii, 27, fr. √ 2. यु) a post, beam, pillar, (esp.) a smooth post or stake to which the sacrificial victim is fastened, any sacrificial post or stake (usually made of bamboos or ख्हदिर wood; in R. i, 13, 24; 25, where the horse sacrifice is described, 21 of these posts are set up, 6 made of भिल्व, 6 of ख्हदिर, 6 of फल्āśअ, one of ऊḍउम्बर, one of Śलेṣम्āतक, and one of धेव-द्āरु), RV. &c. &c. · a column erected in honour of victory, a trophy (= जय-स्तम्भ), L.… · N. of a partic. conjunction of the class Āक्ṛति-योग (i.e. when all the planets are situated in the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th houses), VarBṛS.…

येन.en: ind. (instr. of 3. य) by whom or by which, by means of which, by which way, RV. &c. &c. · in which direction, whither, where, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · in which manner, PārGṛ.; Mn.… · on which account, in consequence of which, wherefore, MBh.; R.; Kathās.… · because, since, as, RV.; &c.… · that, so that, in order that (with pres. or fut. or Pot.)…

योगा.en: यो/गा (आ), f. N. of a Śअक्ति, Pañcar. · of फ्īवर्ī (daughter of the फित्ṛs called भर्हिṣअद्s), Hariv.…

योगेन.en: यो/गेन ind., suitably, fitly, duly, in the right manner

योगक्षेम.en: योग—क्षेम/ m. sg. and pl. (in later language also m. du. and n. sg.) the security or secure possession of what has been acquired, the keeping safe of property, welfare, prosperity, substance, livelihood, RV. &c. &c. (generally explained as a ध्वṃद्व meaning ‘acquisition and preservation of property’, cf. क्षेम-योग; ˚मं-√ वह् with dat. = to procure any one a livelihood, support, maintain, Śak.) · the charge for securing property (from accidents), insurance, Mn. vii, 127… · property destined for pious uses and sacrifices, Gaut. xxviii, 46; Mn. ix, 219 (others ‘the means of securing protection, i.e. councillors, family priests and the like’)…

योगज.en: योग—ज mfn. produced by or arising from ञोग or meditation, Bhāṣāp. · योग—ज n. Agallochum, Bhpr.…

योगधारणा.en: योग—धारणा f. continuance or perseverance in meditation, Bhag.; BhP.

योगबल.en: योग—बल n. the force of devotion, the power of magic, supernatural p˚, R.; BrahmaP.; Kathās.

योगभ्रष्ट.en: योग—भ्रष्ट mfn. one who has fallen from the practice of ञोग or self-concentration, ĀpŚr. Comm.

योगमाया.en: योग—माया f. magic, Kathās. · the ंāय्ā or magical power of abstract meditation, BhP.… · the power of God in the creation of the world personified as a deity… · N. of धुर्ग्ā, A.…

योगमार्ग.en: योग—मार्ग m. = -पथ, q.v., Śiś.; Bādar., Sch.

योगयुक्त.en: योग—युक्त mfn. immersed in deep meditation, absorbed in ञोग, MBh.; Pañcat. &c.

योगवत्.en: योग—वत् mfn. connected, united, joined, MārkP. · one who applies himself to contemplation or ञोग, Hariv.…

योगविभाग.en: योग—विभाग m. the disuniting or separation of that which is usually combined, the sep˚ of one grammatical rule into two, making two rules of what might be stated as one, Pāṇ., Sch.

योगशब्द.en: योग—शब्द m. the word ञोग, Sarvad. · a word the meaning of which is plain from the etymology, Kāś.…

योगशास्त्र.en: योग—शास्त्र n. any wk. on the Y˚ doctrine (esp. that of फतñजलि), MBh.; Yājñ. &c. · N. of sev. works.…

योगसेवा.en: योग—सेवा f. the practice or cultivation of religious abstraction, Bhag.; YogatUp.

योगस्थ.en: योग—स्थ mfn. absorbed in Y˚, Bhag.

योगाङ्ग.en: yogANga n. a constituent or part of the Y˚, means of attaining it (generally said to be 8 in number, viz. यम, नियम, आसन, prARAyAma, प्रत्याहार, धारणा, ध्यान, and समाधि, or according to another authority 6, viz. आसन, prARasaMroDa, with the last four as enumerated above), Yogas.; Sarvad.

योगानुगता.en: yogAnugatA f. N. of a खिṃ-नर maid, Kāraṇḍ.

योगान्त.en: yogAnta (in comp.) or yo˚gAntikA, f. (scil. गति) N. of the 7 divisions into which (accord. to फर्āśअर) the orbit of Mercury is divided, VarBṛS.

योगारूढ.en: yogArUQa mfn. absorbed in profound or abstract meditation, NṛsUp.

योगेश्वर.en: yogeSvara m. a master in magical art (said of a Vएत्āल), Kathās. · a master or adept in the ञोग, MBh.; Hariv.; Pañcat. &c.… · a deity, the object of devout contemplation, W.… · N. of ख्ṛṣṇअ, MW.… · of ञ्āज्ñअवल्क्य, Cat.… · of a son of धेव-होत्र, BhP.… · of a भ्रह्म-र्āक्ṣअस, Kathās.… · of various authors and learned men, Cat. &c.… · of wk.…

योगैश्वर्य.en: yogESvarya n. mastery of the Y˚, BhP.

योगस्.en: n. meditation, religious abstraction, Uṇ. iv, 215, Sch. · the half of a lunar month, ib.…

योगाय.en: Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to become ञोग, to be changed into religious contemplation or devotion, Cat.

योगि.en: 1. योगि (mc.) = योगिन् (only in gen. pl. योगीनाम्). · 2. योगि in comp. for योगिन्.…

योगिता.en: योगि—ता f. the being connected with (ifc.), connection, relation, Bhāṣāp. · the state or condition of a ञोग्ī (cf. योगिन्), MW.…

योगित.en: mfn. bewitched, enchanted, mad, crazy, wild, L.

योगिन्.en: mfn. joined or connected with, relating to, accompanied by, possessed of (comp.), KātyŚr.; MBh.; Hariv. · being in conjunction with (e.g. चन्द्र-य्˚), MārkP.… · possessed of superhuman powers, W.… · m. a follower of the ञोग system, a ञोगिन् (usually called ञोग्ī) or contemplative saint, devotee, ascetic, MaitrUp.; Bhag. &c. (cf. RTL. 87)… · a magician, conjurer, W.… · a partic. mixed caste, Cat. (v.l. युङ्गिन्)… · an orange tree, L.… · natron, alkali, L.… · N. of ञ्āज्ñअवल्क्य, Cat.… · of आर्जुन, L.… · of Vइṣṇउ, MBh.… · of Śइव, L.… · of a भुद्द्ह, L.…

योगिनी.en: f. See next. · f. a female demon or any being endowed with magical power, a fairy, witch, sorceress (represented as eight in number and as created by धुर्ग्ā and attendant on her or on Śइव; sometimes 60, 64 or 65 are enumerated), Hariv.; Kathās. &c. (cf. RTL. 188, 189)… · N. of धुर्ग्ā, L.… · (with थ्āन्त्रिकs) a partic. Śअक्ति… · (with <ns>Buddhists</ns>) a woman representing any goddess who is the object of adoration.…

योग्या.en: / (आ/), f. preparation, contrivance, RV. · exercise, practice, (esp.) bodily exercise, gymnastics, drill, MBh.; Kāv.; Suśr.… · (pl.) the straps with which horses are attached to the yoke of a carriage, traces (?), RV. iii, 3, 6… · the earth, L.… · N. of भ्हरṇī, L.… · of the wife of श्ūर्य, L.…

योग्यता.en: योग्य—ता f. suitableness, fitness, propriety, ability, R.; Kathās. &c.

योजक.en: m. a yoker, harnesser, MBh.; BhP. · a user, employer, Kāv.… · an arranger, preparer, contriver, effecter (cf. युद्ध-य्˚)… · N. of आग्नि (as the nuptial fire), Gṛhyās.…

योजना.en: यो/जना (आ), f. application of the sense of a passage, grammatical construction, Śaṃk.

योजनशत.en: योजन—शत n. a hundred ञोजनs, MW.

योजयितव्य.en: mfn. (fr. Caus. of √ 1. युज्) to be joined or connected or furnished with (instr.), Sāṃkhyak., Sch. · to be made use of or chosen or selected, VarBṛS.…

योजित.en: mfn. yoked, harnessed, BhP. · used, employed, applied, performed, MBh.… · undertaken, begun, Yājñ.… · appointed to, charged with (loc.), BhP.… · tied or fastened to, put or placed in (loc.), ib.… · joined, connected, put together, arranged, composed, MBh.; R.… · supplied or furnished with (instr. or comp.), VarBṛS.; Rājat.…

योधमुख्य.en: योध—मुख्य m. a chief warrior, leader, Bhag.

योधवीर.en: योध—वीर m. a hero, warrior, ib.

योनि.en: यो/नि m. f. (in RV. only m.; sometimes also f(योनी). ; fr. √ 2. यु) the womb, uterus, vulva, vagina, female organs of generation, RV. &c. &c. (together with the लिङ्ग, a typical symbol of the divine procreative energy, RTL. 224) · place of birth, source, origin, spring, fountain (ifc. = sprung or produced from), ib.… · place of rest, repository, receptacle, seat, abode, home, lair, nest, stable, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.… · family, race, stock, caste, the form of existence or station fixed by birth (e.g. that of a man, <ns>Brāhman</ns>, animal &c.; ifc. = belonging to the caste of), Mn.; MBh. &c.… · seed, grain (cf. योनी-पोषण)… · a partic. part of a fire-pit, Hcat.… · a mine, L.… · copper, L.… · water, Naigh.… · the regent of the ङक्ṣअत्र फ्ūर्वप्हल्गुन्ī, VarBṛS.… · N. of the sound ए, Up.…

योनी.en: यो/नी (ई), f. N. of a river in Śāल्मल-द्व्īप, VP.

योनिज.en: योनि—ज mfn. produced from the womb, viviparous, MBh.; R. &c.

योनित्व.en: योनि—त्व n. the being an origin or source, NṛsUp.; Kum. · (ifc.) the arising from or being based on Suśr.; Sarvad.…

योनिद्वार.en: योनि—द्वार n. the orifice of the womb, Suśr. · N. of a sacred bathing-place, MBh.…

योन्य.en: / mfn. forming a womb or receptacle, RV.

योषन्.en: यो/षन् f. id., ib. (also applied to the fingers).

योषा.en: यो/षा f. = योषणा, RV. &c. &c. (esp. applied to ऊṣअस्; accord. to Sāy. also ‘a mare’) · (with दारु-मयी) a wooden doll, MBh.…

योषिता.en: f. a woman, wife, MuṇḍUp., Sch.

यौग.en: 1. यौग m. (fr. योग) a follower of the ञोग system of philosophy, L. · 2. यौग Vṛद्द्हि form of युग in comp.…

यौगपद्य.en: यौग—पद्य n. (fr. युग-पद्) simultaneousness, ŚāṅkhŚr.; Sāh.; Pratāp. &c.

यौगिक.en: mf(ई)n. (fr. योग; cf. Pāṇ. v, 1, 102) useful, applicable (अ-य्˚), Kām. · belonging to a remedy, remedial, Suśr.… · connected with or suiting the derivation, having an etymological meaning (यौगिकी संज्ञा f. a word retaining that signification which belongs to it according to its etymology), Pratāp.; Sarvad.… · relating to or derived from the ञोग, Pañcar.…

यौगिकत्व.en: यौगिक—त्व n. accordance (of the meaning of a word) with its derivation or etymology, L.

यौवन.en: n. (fr. युवन्) youth, youthfulness, adolescence, puberty, manhood (also pl. = juvenile deeds or indiscretions; ifc. f(आ). ), AV. &c. &c. · a number of young people (esp. of young women), Pāṇ. iv, 2, 38… · N. of the third stage in the Śāक्त mysteries, Cat.…

यौवनस्थ.en: यौवन—स्थ mfn. being in the (bloom of) youth, arrived at puberty, marriageable, MBh.

र.en: 1. र the 2nd semivowel (corresponding to the vowels ऋ and ॠ, and having the sound of r in ring). · 2. र (in prosody) a cretic (¯ ˘ ¯), Piṅg.… · 3. र mfn. (√ रा) acquiring, possessing, Naiṣ.… · giving, effecting, Śiś.… · m. (only L.) fire, heat… · love, desire… · speed… · n. brightness, splendour (used in explaining an etymology), L.…

रकार.en: र—कार m. the letter or sound र, R.

रा.en: (आ), f. (only L.) amorous play (= विभ्रम) · giving… · gold… · 1. रा or रास् cl. 2. P. (Dhātup. xxiv, 49) रा/ति (Ved. also Ā. राते/; Impv. रिरीहि, ररास्व, ररीध्वम्; p. रराण; 3. sg. र/रते and रासते; pf. ररिम/, ररे/; aor. अ/रास्म Subj. रा/सत् &c. Pot. रासीय; Class. forms are only pr. राति; fut. राता, BhP.; रास्यति, Vop., and inf. rAtave, BhP.), to grant, give, bestow, impart, yield, surrender, RV.; &c.… · 2. रा (ifc.) granting, bestowing, BhP.… · 3. रा/ f., see 3. रै.… · 4. रा See under 3. र.…

री.en: (ई), f. going, motion, L. · 1. री or रि (cf. √ लि) cl. 9. P. (Dhātup. xxxi, 30) रिणा/ति cl. 4. P. (Dhātup. xxvi, 29) री/यते (रिणीते, RV.; Br.; GṛŚrS.; रियति, Dhātup. xxviii, 111; impf. अरिण्वन्, MaitrS.; Gr. pf. रिराय, रिर्ये; aor. अरैषीत्, अरेष्ट; fut. रेता; रेष्यति, ˚ते; inf. रेतुम्), <div n="to"/>to release, set free, let go, RV.; <div n="to"/>to sever, detach from (abl.), ib.; <div n="to"/>to yield, bestow, AV.; <div n="to"/> (Ā.) to be shattered or dissolved, melt, become fluid, drop, flow, RV. : <div n="vp"/>Caus. रेपयति (aor. अरीरिपत्) Gr.: <div n="vp"/>Desid. रिरीषति, ˚ते, ib. : Intens. रेरीयते, रेरयीति, ib.… · 2. री = रै in ऋध/द्-री, q.v.… · 3. री f. See under 3. र, p. 859, col. 3.…

रंहति.en: f. speed, velocity (of a chariot), W.

रंहि.en: र/ंहि f. running, flowing, hastening, speed, velocity, eagerness, impetuosity, RV.; AV.; VS.; ŚBr.<listinfo n="sup"/> · a flowing stream, RV.… · a running horse, courser, ib.… · (accord. to some also, ‘glory, might, power &c.’).…

रक.en: m. the sun gem · crystal… · a hard shower, W.…

रकसा.en: f. a form of leprosy, Suśr.

रक्ष.en: 1. रक्ष/ mf(ई)n. (f(आ). See p. 860) guarding, watching, protecting, serving · a watcher, keeper, Suparṇ.; MBh. &c. (mostly ifc.; cf. क्षेत्र-, गो-, चक्र-र्˚ &c.)… · 2. रक्ष in comp. for रक्षस्.…

रक्षण.en: m. ‘protector’, N. of Vइṣṇउ, MBh. · र/क्षण (र/˚), n. the act of guarding, watching, protecting, tending (of cattle), preservation (‘of’ gen. loc. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.… · a ceremony performed for protection or preservation, MārkP.…

रक्षणी.en: f. a rein, bridle, L. · Ficus Heterophylla, L.…

रक्षणार्थम्.en: rakzaRArTam ind. for the sake of guarding or protecting, MW.

रक्षणीय.en: mfn. to be guarded or preserved or protected from (abl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · to be ruled by (gen. or instr.), R.; Kathās.… · to be guarded against or prevented or avoided, Kathās.…

रक्षा.en: f. the act of protecting or guarding, protection, care, preservation, security, Mn.; MBh. &c. · a guard, watch, sentinel, Mṛcch.; Kām.… · any preservative, (esp.) a sort of bracelet or amulet, any mysterious token used as a charm, BhP.; Suśr.… · a tutelary divinity (cf. महा-र्˚)… · ashes (used as a preservative), L.… · a piece of thread or silk bound round the wrist on partic. occasions (esp. on the full moon of Śर्āवṇअ, either as an amulet and preservative against misfortune, or as a symbol of mutual dependence, or as a mark of respect), MW.…

रक्षि.en: 1. रक्षि (ifc.) guarding, protecting (see पथि-, पशु-, सोम-र्˚). · 2. रक्षि in comp. for रक्षिन्.…

रक्षित.en: / mfn. guarded, protected, saved, preserved, maintained, kept, RV. &c. &c. · / m. N. of a teacher of medicine, Suśr.… · of a grammarian, Siddh.… · of various other men, HPariś.…

रक्षिता.en: f. N. of an आप्सरस्, MBh.

रक्षितव्य.en: mfn. to be guarded or protected or taken care of or kept, Mn.; MBh. &c. · to be guarded against or kept off, Nir. iv, 18.…

रक्ष्य.en: mfn. to be guarded or protected or taken care of Āpast.; MBh. &c. · to be prevented from (abl.), Kathās.… · to be guarded against or avoided, ib.; Rājat.…

रङ्क.en: mfn. niggardly, avaricious, Uṇ. iii, 40 · slow, dull, ib.… · poor, miserable, hungry (e.g. कङ्क-रङ्क, a hungry or half-starved crane), Prab.… · m. a beggar, starveling (preta-r˚), Mālatīm.…

वि.en: 1. वि/ m. (nom. वि/स् or वे/स् acc. वि/म् gen. abl. वे/स्; pl. nom. acc. व/यस् [acc. वीन्, Bhaṭṭ.]; वि/भिस्, वि/भ्यस्, वीना/म्) a bird (also applied to horses, arrows, and the ंअरुत्s), RV.; VS.; PañcavBr., (also occurring in later language). · [cf. 1. व/यस्; Gk. οἰωνός for ὀϝιωνος; Lat. a-vis; accord. to some Germ. Ei; Angl.Sax. ǽg; Eng. egg.]… · 2. वि n. an artificial word said to be = अन्न, ŚBr.… · 3. वि/ ind. (prob. for an original द्वि, meaning ‘in two parts’; and opp. to सम्, q.v.) apart, asunder, in different directions, to and fro, about, away, away from, off, without, RV. &c. &c. In RV. it appears also as a prep. with acc. denoting ‘through’ or ‘between’ (with ellipse of the verb, e.g. i, 181, 5; x, 86, 20 &c.) It is esp. used as a prefix to verbs or nouns and other parts of speech derived from verbs, to express ‘division’, ‘distinction’, ‘distribution’, ‘arrangement’, ‘order’, ‘opposition’, or ‘deliberation’ (cf. वि-√ भिद्, -शिष्, -धा, -रुध्, -चर्, with their nominal derivatives)…

विद्या.en: / f. knowledge (cf. काल-जात-व्˚), science, learning, scholarship, philosophy, RV. &c. &c. विभू.en: वि-√ भू P. -भवति, to arise, be developed or manifested, expand, appear, RV.; TS.; MuṇḍUp.; <div n="to"/>to suffice, be adequate or equal to or a match for (dat. or acc.), ŚBr.; <div n="to"/>to pervade, fill, PañcavBr.; <div n="to"/>to be able to or capable of (inf.), BhP.; <div n="to"/>to exist (in अ-विभवत्, ‘not existing’), KātyŚr.: <div n="vp"/>Caus. -भावयति, to cause to arise or appear, develop, manifest, reveal, show forth, display, ŚāṅkhBr.; MBh. &c.; <div n="to"/>to pretend, feign, Kull. on Mn. viii, 362; <div n="to"/>to divide, separate, BhP.; <div n="to"/>to perceive distinctly, find out, discover, ascertain, know, acknowledge, recognise as (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; <div n="to"/>to regard or consider as, take for (two acc.), Kuval.; <div n="to"/>to suppose, fancy, imagine, BhP.; Pañc…

विभावन.en: वि-˚भावन mfn. causing to appear, developing, manifesting, Hariv. · वि-˚भावन n. causing to appear or become visible, development, creation, BhP. (Sch. = पालन)… · showing, manifesting, Kull. on Mn. ix, 76… · clear perception, examination, judgement, clear ascertainment, Mn.; Vikr.… · (ifc.) reflection on Kathās.… · the act of producing a partic. emotion by a work of art, Sāh.…

विभावना.en: वि-˚भावना f. (in rhet.) description of effects the causes of which are left to be conjectured (or accord. to some, ‘description by negatives, bringing out the qualities of any object more clearly than by positive description’), Vām.; Kāvyād. &c.

विभावित.en: वि-˚भावित mfn. (fr. Caus.) caused to arise or appear &c.

विभावितत्व.en: वि-˚भावित—त्व n. the state of being perceived or judged, W.

विभाव्य.en: वि-˚भाव्य mfn. to be clearly perceived or observed, distinguishable, comprehensible, MBh.; Kāv. &c. · to be attended to or heeded (n. impers. ‘it should be heeded’), MBh.; Kāvyād.…

विभुत्व.en: वि-भु—त्व n. being everywhere, omnipresence, ŚvetUp.; Sarvad. · omnipotence, sovereignty, PraśnUp.; Śak.; Bālar.…

विभूत.en: वि/-भूत mfn. arisen, produced &c. · great, mighty (see comp.)… · वि/-भूत m. = next, Buddh.…

विभूति.en: वि/-भूति mfn. penetrating, pervading, Nir. · abundant, plentiful, RV.… · mighty, powerful, ib.… · presiding over (gen.), ib. viii, 50, 6… · वि/-भूति m. N. of a श्āद्ह्य, Hariv.… · of a son of Vइśव्āमित्र, MBh.… · of a king, VP.… · वि/-भूति f. development, multiplication, expansion, plenty, abundance, Kāv.; Kathās. &c.… · manifestation of might, great power, superhuman power (consisting of eight faculties, especially attributed to Śइव, but supposed also to be attainable by human beings through worship of that deity, viz. अणिमन्, the power of becoming as minute as an atom; लघिमन्, extreme lightness; prApti, attaining or reaching anything [e.g. the moon with the tip of the finger] <pb n="979,1"/>; प्राकाम्य, irresistible will; महिमन्, illimitable bulk; ईशिता, supreme dominion; वशिता, subjugating by magic; and kAmAvasAyitA, the suppressing all desires), ib.…

विभूतिबल.en: वि-भूति—बल m. N. of a poet, Cat.

विभूतिमत्.en: वि-भूति—मत् mfn. mighty, powerful, superhuman, Bhag.; BhP. · smeared with ashes, W.…

विभूरसि.en: वि-भूर्-असि m. (lit. ‘thou art mighty’) a form of आग्नि or the god of fire, MBh.

विभूषण.en: वि-भूषण mfn. adorning, R. · वि-भूषण m. N. of ंअñजु-śर्ī, L.… · वि-भूषण n. (ifc. f(आ). ) decoration, ornament, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · वि-भूषण n. splendour, beauty, Daśar.…

विभ्रंश.en: वि-˚भ्रंश m. diarrhoea, laxity of the bowels (see मन्द-व्˚) · decline, cessation, end, MBh.; Kathās.; Pur.… · disturbance, perturbation (see चित्त-व्˚)… · fall, decay, ruin, MBh.; VarBṛS.; BhP.… · (ifc.) being deprived of, loss, Pur.; Rājat.… · a precipice, MW.…

विभ्रष्ट.en: वि-भ्रष्ट mfn. fallen, sunk, MBh. · disappeared, vanished, gone, lost, R.; MārkP.… · useless, vain, PañcavBr.… · (ifc.) strayed from, Kathās.… · deprived of MBh.; R.… · unsuccessful in TS.…

विभ्रम्.en: वि-√ भ्रम् P. -भ्रमति, -भ्राम्यति, to wander or roam or fly about, roll, hover, whirl, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; <div n="to"/>to reel, quiver, shake, BhP.; <div n="to"/>to roam over, wander through (acc.), MBh.; <div n="to"/>to fall into disorder or confusion, be disarranged or bewildered, MBh.; Hariv. &c.; <div n="to"/>to drive asunder, disperse, scare away, MBh.; <div n="to"/>to move about (the tail), R. : <div n="vp"/>Caus. -भ्रमयति, or -भ्रामयति (Pass. -भ्राम्यते), to confuse, perplex, MārkP.; Hcat.

विभ्रम.en: वि-भ्रम m. (ifc. f(आ). ) moving to and fro, rolling or whirling about, restlessness, unsteadiness, Kāv.; VarBṛS.; Rājat. · violence, excess, intensity, high degree (also pl.), Kāv.; Kathās. &c.… · hurry, rapture, agitation, disturbance, perturbation, confusion, flurry, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · doubt, error, mistake, blunder (with दण्डस्य, ‘erroneous application of punishment’), Mn.; MBh. &c.… · illusion, illusive appearance or mere semblance of anything, Kāv.; Kathās. &c. (cf. -भाषित)… · beauty, grace, Kālid.; Mālatīm.… · feminine coquetry, amorous gestures or action of any kind (esp. play of the eyes), perturbation, flurry (as when a woman in her confusion puts her ornaments in the wrong places), Bhar.; Daśar.; Sāh.… · caprice, whim, MW.…

विमा.en: वि-√ 3. मा P. Ā. -माति, -मिमीते, to measure, mete out, pass over, traverse, RV.; Br.; Kauś.; <div n="to"/>to enumerate, BhP.; <div n="to"/>to ordain, fix, set right, arrange, make ready, prepare, RV.

विमि.en: वि-√ मि P. A. -मिनोति, -मिनुते, to fix, build, erect, RV.; Br.; GṛŚrS.

विमित.en: वि/-मित mfn. fixed, built &c. · वि/-मित n. a square shed or large building resting on four posts (ifc. any hall or building), ŚBr.; ŚrS.; ChUp.…

विमुक्त.en: वि-मुक्त See under 1. वि-√ मुच्. · वि-मुक्त mfn. unloosed, unharnessed &c.… · set free, liberated (esp. from mundane existence), freed or delivered or escaped from (abl. instr., or ifc.; rarely ibc.; cf. -शाप), Mn.; MBh. &c.… · deprived of (instr.), MBh.… · launched (as a ship), R.… · given up, abandoned, relinquished, deserted, ib.; BhP.… · hurled, thrown, MBh.… · emitted or discharged by, flowing from (comp.), Ratnāv.… · shed or bestowed on (loc.), Rājat.… · (a snake) which has recently cast its skin, MBh. viii, 740… · dispassionate, R. iv, 32, 18…

विमुखीकरण.en: विमुखी-करण n. (ifc.) the rendering averse to, Śaṃk.

Ā. -मुञ्चति, ˚ते (Impv. -मुमोक्तु, RV. i, 24, 13), to unloose, unharness (Ā. ‘one's own horses’), unyoke (i.e. ‘make to halt, cause to stop or rest’), RV. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to take off (clothes, ornaments &c.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; <div n="to"/>to release, set free, liberate, ib.; <div n="to"/>to leave, abandon, quit, desert, give up, relinquish, ib.; <div n="to"/>to shun, avoid, MuṇḍUp.; Bhag. &c.; <div n="to"/>to lose (consciousness), Hariv.; <div n="to"/>to pardon, forgive, Gīt.; BhP.; <div n="to"/>to emit, discharge, shed, pour or send forth, MBh.; R.; Pañcat. (with ग्रस्तम्, to set free a seized planet i.e. ‘free it from eclipse’, Sūryas.); <div n="to"/>to throw, hurl, cast (with आत्मानम् and loc., ‘to cast one's self into’, Uttarar.), MBh.; R. &c.; <div n="to"/>to utte…

विमुक्ति.en: वि-˚मुक्ति f. disjunction (opp. to युक्ति), AitBr. · (ifc.) giving up, Kum.… · release, deliverance, liberation, Kāv.; Kathās.; Pur.… · release from the bonds of existence, final emancipation, Kap.; VP.…

विमूढभाव.en: वि-मूढ—भाव m. bewildered state, confusion, MW.

विमूढात्मन्.en: vi-mU˚QAtman mfn. foolish-minded, perplexed in mind, senseless, Bhag.

विमोह.en: वि-मोह m. confusion of the mind, perplexity (also मति-व्˚), Kathās.; BhP. · a kind of hell, VP.…

विमोहित.en: वि-˚मोहित mfn. confused, infatuated, bewitched, beguiled, R.; Kathās. &c.

विमृश्.en: वि-√ मृश् (often confounded with वि-√ मृष्) P. -मृशति, to touch (with the hands), stroke, feel, MBh.; R.; <div n="to"/>to touch (mentally), be sensible or aware of, perceive, consider, reflect on, deliberate about, RV. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to investigate, examine, try, test, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; <div n="to"/> (with inf.) to hesitate about doing anything, Sāh. : <div n="vp"/>Caus. -मर्शयति, to ponder, reflect on, consider, Kāv.; Pañcat.; BhP.

विमृश्य.en: 1. वि-˚मृश्य mfn. to be tried or examined, ib. · 2. वि-˚मृश्य ind. having deliberated or considered (-कारिन् mfn. acting after due deliberation), Hit.…

Dharmas. 59 and 73), ŚBr.; Bhag. &c.… · letting loose, setting at liberty (a thief), Mn. viii, 3, 16… · giving up, abandoning, VPrāt.; MBh.… · letting flow, shedding (of tears), MBh.… · gift, bestowal (of wealth), R.… · discharge (of arrows), MBh.…

विमोक्षण.en: वि-˚मोक्षण mfn. liberating from (ifc.), BhP. · वि-˚मोक्षण n. untying, loosening, VarBṛS.… · liberation, deliverance from (abl. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c. (also ‘from an embryo’, MBh. i, 2369; अण्ड/ऽअ-व्˚, ‘laying eggs’, Pañcat.; असृग्-व्˚, ‘letting blood’, Suśr.)… · taking off, casting away, Śṛṅgār.… · giving up (the ghost), MBh.… · discharging (arrows), R.…

वियुक्तता.en: वि-युक्त—ता f. (ifc.) the being free from, L.

(˚गं √ गम्, to be lost, Mṛcch. ix, 34/35) · giving up, getting rid of, abstention from (comp.), Gaut.… · subtraction, Gaṇit.… · = वि-युति, Bījag.… · a partic. astrological ञोग, Cat.…

वियोजित.en: वि-˚योजित mfn. (fr. Caus.) disjoined, disunited, separated from or deprived of (instr. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.

विरक्त.en: वि-रक्त &c. विरचयितव्य.en: वि-˚रचयितव्य mfn. to be formed or made, Śaṃk.

विरचित.en: वि-˚रचित mfn. constructed, arranged &c. · performed, BhP.… · composed, written, Kālid.; Pañcat.… · put together, spoken, uttered (see comp.)… · put on, worn, Ragh.… · furnished with (instr.), Megh.… · put in, inlaid, set, MW.…

विरचिता.en: वि-˚रचिता f. N. of a woman, Kathās.

N. of a serpent-demon, MBh.… · of a Ṛṣइ, Hariv.… · of a sage under ंअनु छ्āक्ṣउṣअ, ib.… · of a son of ंअनु श्āवर्ṇइ, MārkP.… · of a son of ङ्āर्āयṇअ, MBh.… · of a son of खवि, ib.… · of a son of Vअसिṣṭह, BhP.… · of a son of फउर्ṇअम्āस, MārkP.… · of a son of ध्ह्ṛतर्āṣṭर, MBh.… · वि-रजस् f. a woman who has ceased to menstruate, L.… · N. of धुर्ग्ā, L.…

Pāṇ. i, 3, 83), <div n="to"/>to stop (esp. speaking), pause, cease, come to an end, TS. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to give up, abandon, abstain or desist from (abl.), KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.: <div n="vp"/>Caus. -रामयति or -रमयति, to cause to stop or rest &c., bring to an end, finish, R.; BhP. : <div n="vp"/>Desid. विरमण.en: वि-˚रमण n. ceasing cessation, KātyŚr. · (ifc.) desistence from, Subh.…

(perhaps from विर = विल for बिल + ल, ‘possessing holes’) having interstices, separated by intervals (whether of space or time), not thick or compact, loose, thin, sparse, wide apart, MBh.; Kāv. &c. · rare, scarcely found, unfrequent, scanty, few, Kāv.; Kathās. &c. (cf. वि-सर्ग above) N. of a symbol in grammar (usually marked by two perpendicular dots [:] representing a hard and distinctly audible aspiration <pb n="1001,2"/>; it generally, but not always, occurs at the end of a word, often taking the place of final स् and र्; it is called Vइसर्जन्īय either from its liability to be ‘rejected’ or from its being pronounced with a full ‘emission’ of breath, or from its usually appearing at the ‘end’ of a word or sentence; <ns>Paṇḍits</ns> in some parts of India seem to pronounce a vowel after it, e.g. नरः like नरह, अग्निः like अग्निहि), Prāt.; Pāṇ. &c.…

वै.en: 1. वै (orig. identical with √ 2. वा) cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xxii, 24) वा/यति, to become languid or weary or exhausted, RV. (शोषणे, Dhātup.); <div n="to"/>to be deprived of (gen.), RV. viii, 47, 6; <div n="to"/> P. and (ep. also Ā.), to blow, Āpast.; MBh. · 2. वै/ ind. a particle of emphasis and affirmation, generally placed after a word and laying stress on it (it is usually translatable by ‘indeed’, ‘truly’, ‘certainly’, ‘verily’, ‘just’ &c.; it is very rare in the RV.; more frequent in the AV., and very common in the भ्र्āह्मṇअs and in works that imitate their style; in the श्ūत्रs it is less frequent and almost restricted to the combination यद्य् उ वै; in ंअनु, MBh. and the ख्āव्यs it mostly appears at the end of a line, and as a mere expletive. In RV. it is frequently followed by उ in the combination वा/ उ [both particles are separated, v, 18, 3] <pb n="1020,1"/>; it is also preceded by उ and various other particles, e.g. by इ/द्, अ/ह, उत/; in the भ्र्āह्मṇअs it often follows ह, ह स्म, एव; in later language अपि and तु. Accord. to some it……

व्यास.en: व्य्-आस m. severing, separation, division, Sarvad. · a kind of drawl (as a fault in pronunciation), APrāt.… · extension, diffusion, prolixity, detailed account (instr.; abl. and -तस् ind. in detail, at length, fully), MBh.; Suśr.; BhP.… · width, breadth, the diameter of a circle, Śulbas.; VarBṛS.… · ‘distributing, disjoining’, N. of the फद-प्āṭह or ‘disjoined text’, APrāt.… · ‘arranger, compiler’, N. of a celebrated mythical sage and author (often called Vएद-व्य्āस and regarded as the original compiler and arranger of the Vएदs, Vएद्āन्त-स्ūत्रs &c.; he was the son of the sage फर्āśअर and शत्यवत्ī, and half-brother of Vइचित्र-व्īर्य and भ्ह्īṣम; he was also called Vāदर्āयṇअ or भ्āदर्āयṇअ, and ख्ṛṣṇअ from his dark complexion, and ध्वइप्āयन because he was brought forth by शत्यवत्ī on a ध्व्īप or island in the <ns>Jumnā</ns>; when grown up he retired to the wilderness to lead the life of a hermit, but at his mother's request returned to become the husband of Vइचित्र-व्īर्य's two childless widows, by whom he was the father of the blind ध्ह्ṛतर्āṣṭर and of फ्āṇḍउ; he was also the father of Vइदुर [q.v.] by a slave girl, and of Śउक, the supposed narrator of the भ्ह्āगव……

व्याप्.en: व्य्-√ आप् P. -आप्नोति (rarely Ā. -आप्नुते), to reach or spread through, pervade, permeate, cover, fill, AV. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to reach as far as, extend to, L. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 2, 8) : <div n="vp"/>Pass. व्य्-आप्यते (see व्याप्यमान) : <div n="vp"/>Caus. व्य्-आपयति (see व्य्-आपित) : <div n="vp"/>Desid. vIpsati (see vIpsa).

व्यापक.en: व्य्-आपक mf(इका)n. pervading, diffusive, comprehensive, widely spreading or extending, spreading everywhere (व्यापकं न्य्-√ अस् or न्यासं√ कृ, to put or place or fix or make applicable everywhere, AgP.), KaṭhUp.; MBh. &c. · (in logic) invariably pervading or inherent or concomitant (as an attribute which is always found [as smoke] where some other [as fire] is found), Bhāṣāp.; IW. 62… · (in law) comprehending all the points of an argument, pervading the whole plea, W.…

व्यापिका.en: व्य्-आपिका f. a woman who shows herself everywhere (?), MW.

व्यापकत्व.en: व्य्-आपक—त्व n. pervasion, diffusion, comprehensiveness, invariable concomitance or inherence (in logic), BhP.; Bhāṣāp. &c.

व्यापन.en: व्य्-आपन n. spreading though, pervading, penetration, covering, filling, Sāh.; Sāy. on RV. i, 113, 14.

व्यापित्व.en: व्यापि—त्व n. the state of pervading, pervasion, extensiveness, extent, universality, extension to (ifc.), ĀśvŚr.; MBh.; Vedāntas.

व्याप्त.en: व्य्-आप्त mfn. spread through, pervaded, extended, covered or filled with, thoroughly occupied or penetrated by (as the universe by spirit), filled up, full, ŚvetUp.; Bhag.; R. &c. · comprehended or included under (a general notion), having invariably inherent properties, invariably pervaded or attended or accompanied by (in logic; e.g. धूमो वह्निना व्याप्तः, ‘smoke is invariably attended by fire’), Bhāṣāp.… · occupied, obtained, taken possession of MBh.; Prab.; Pañcat.… · wealthy, rich, AitBr.… · celebrated, famous, W.… · placed, fixed, ib.… · open, outspread, expanded, ib.… · व्य्-आप्त , व्य्-आप्ति. See p. 1037.…

व्याप्ति.en: व्य्-आ^प्ति f. (ifc. ˚तिक) acquisition, attainment, accomplishment, AV.; ŚBr. · pervasion, inherence, inherent and inseparable presence of any one thing in another (as of oil in sesamum seed, heat in fire &c.), universal pervasion, invariable concomitance, universal distribution or accompaniment (e.g. ‘smoke is always pervaded by fire’, or ‘fire is necessarily attended with smoke’, cf. IW. 62), Kap.; Nyāyam., Sch.… · universality, universal rule without an exception, Sarvad.; Vedāntas.… · omnipresence, ubiquity (as a divine attribute), W.…

व्याप्य.en: व्य्-आप्य mfn. permeable, penetrable, capable of being attended by any inherent characteristic, BhP.; Kap., Sch.; Tarkas. · व्य्-आप्य n. that which may be the site or locality of universal pervasion or of an invariably concomitant cause or characteristic (e.g. ‘smoke which is invariably pervaded by fire’), IW. 62… · the sign or middle term of an inference, proof, reason, cause (= साधन, हेतु), L.… · Costus Speciosus or Arabicus, L.…

व्याप्यमान.en: व्य्-आप्यमान mfn. being pervaded or permeated or comprehended or included, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 56.

व्यापत्ति.en: व्य्-आपत्ति f. falling into calamity or misfortune, suffering injury, failure, loss, ruin, death, ŚrS.; MBh. &c. · disappearance, substitution (of one sound or letter by another), RPrāt.…

व्यापृ.en: व्य्-आ-√ पृ Ā. √ 2. -प्रियते, or -पृणुते, to be occupied or engaged in, be busy about (loc.; or with अर्थम् or हेतोस् ifc.), be employed (in any office), MBh.; Kāv. &c.: <div n="vp"/>Caus. -पारयति, to cause to be employed, set to work, keep busy, employ with or in or for (instr. loc., or अर्थम् ifc.), ib. (with करम्, to place or fix the hand, Ragh.; with, हस्तम्, to wave the hand, Bālar.; with विलोचनानि, to fix the eyes upon, direct the glance towards, Kum.; with वाणीम्, to use or raise one's voice, Hcar.)

व्यापार.en: व्य्-आपार m. (ifc. f(आ). ) occupation, employment, business, profession, function (सायकानां व्याप्˚, ‘the business of arrows’ i.e. ‘hitting the mark’; often in comp., e.g. मानस-व्य्˚, ‘occupation of mind’, Vedāntas.; वाग्-व्य्˚, ‘employment of speech’, talk, Hit.; गृह-व्य्˚, ‘occ˚ with domestic affairs’), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · doing, performance, action, operation, transaction, exertion, concern (acc. with √ कृ, ‘to perform any one's [gen.] business’, Kathās.; ‘to render good offices in any affair’, Kum.; ‘to meddle in’ [loc.] Pañcat.; with √ व्रज्, ‘to engage in’ [loc.] Vikr.; with √ या, ‘to be concerned about’, ‘care for’ [gen.]), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · N. of the tenth astrol. mansion, VarBṛS.…

व्यापारवत्.en: व्य्-आपार—वत् mfn. effective, L. (-ता f. the possession of a partic. function, Sāh.)

व्यापारक.en: व्य्-˚आपारक mfn. (ifc.) having an occupation or function, Kusum.

व्यापृत.en: व्य्-आपृत mfn. occupied, busy, engaged, employed or concerned in or with (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · व्य्-आपृत m. a minister, official, Yājñ.,…

व्याम.en: व्य्-आम m. (prob. for वि-याम, q.v.; cf. व्य्-आयाम, सम्-आम) the measure of the two extended arms (= 5 आरत्निs), a fathom, AV.; ŚBr.; GṛŚrS. &c. · diagonal direction, AV.… · disregard, disrespect (?), W.… · smoke (?), L.… · pl. N. of a class of deceased ancestors, VP.… · Costus Speciosus or Arabicus, VarBṛS.…

व्यामिश्र.en: व्य्-आ-मिश्र mfn. mixed together, blended (˚श्रे ind. ‘when both cases are combined’, Pat. on Pāṇ. iii, 2, 111) · manifold, of various kinds, MBh.; R. &c.… · mingled with, accompanied by, provided with (instr. or comp.; -ता f.), MBh.; Hariv.; Suśr. &c.… · troubled, distracted, inattentive, MBh.…

व्यामिश्रे.en: व्य्-आ-मिश्रे ind., ‘when both cases are combined’, Pat. on Pāṇ. iii, 2, 111

व्यामोह.en: व्य्-आमोह m. loss of consciousness, mental confusion, bewilderment, embarrassment, MBh.; Kāv. &c. · (ifc.), error or uncertainty regarding, Kāvyād.; Kull.; ĀpŚr., Sch.…

व्यायाम.en: व्य्-आयाम/ m. dragging different ways, contest, strife, struggle, AV.; MBh. · exertion, manly effort, athletic or gymnastic exercise (e.g., ‘playing with heavy clubs’, ‘drawing a bow with a chain’ &c.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · (ifc.) exercise or practise in MBh.; R.; Suśr.… · (with <ns>Buddhists</ns>) right exercise or training, MWB. 44 (cf. Dharmas. 119)… · ‘drawing out, extending’, a partic. measure of length, fathom (= वि-याम and व्य्-आम), Śulbas.… · a difficult passage, any difficulty (?), L.…

व्यावर्त.en: व्य्-आवर्त &c. See below. · व्य्-आवर्त m. revolving, W.… · encompassing, surrounding, ib.… · separating, selecting, appointing, ib.… · ruptured navel (= नाभि-कण्टक), L.…

व्यावहारिक.en: mf(ई)n. (fr. व्यव-हार) relating to common life or practice or action, practical, usual, current, actual, real (as opp. to, ‘ideal’), Mn.; MBh. &c. · (in phil.) practical existence (opp. to पारमार्थिक, ‘real’, and प्रातिभासिक, ‘illusory’), IW. 108… · sociable, affable, Kām.… · belonging to judicial procedure, judicial, legal, Mn. viii, 78… · m. a counsellor, minister, official, R.… · N. of a <ns>Buddhist</ns> school… · n. business, commerce, trade, BhP.…

व्यावृ.en: व्य्-आ-√ वृ only pr.p. Ā. -वृण्वान, hiding one's self, BhP. i, 11, 38 (B. व्य्-आ-पृन्वान, which accord. to Sch. = व्य्-आ-प्रियमाण). · व्य्-आ-√ वृ only 3. pl. impf. P. vyAvfRvan, ‘they chose’, MBh. (B.) i, 4413 (C. व्यवृण्वन्)…

व्यावृत्.en: व्य्-आ-√ वृत् Ā. -वर्तते (rarely P.), to become separated or singled out from (instr.), RV.; AV.; Br.; <div n="to"/>to become separated or distinct, be distinguished as or in some partic. form of MaitrUp.; <div n="to"/>to turn or wind in different directions, divide (as a road), MBh.; <div n="to"/>to be dispersed (as an army), Hariv.; <div n="to"/>to be opened, Suśr.; <div n="to"/>to turn away from, part with, get rid of (instr. or abl.), Ragh.; Kathās.; <div n="to"/>to diverge from, be inconsistent with (abl.), Sarvad.; <div n="to"/>to go away, depart, Śāntiś.; <div n="to"/>to come back, return, Ratnāv.; Rājat.; <div n="to"/>to turn round, revolve, R.; <div n="to"/>to sink (as the sun), MBh.; <div n="to"/>to come to an understanding or settlement, AitBr.; <div n="to"/>to come to an end, c…

व्यावर्तन.en: व्य्-˚आव/र्तन mf(ई)n. averting, removing (cf. विग्रह-व्यावर्तनी) · excluding, Śaṃk.… · vy-˚Ava/rtana n. turn (of a road), AV.; ChUp.… · coil (of a snake), Kir.… · turning away, Sāh.… · turning round, revolving, encompassing, surrounding, W.…

व्यावर्तित.en: व्य्-˚आवर्तित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made to turn away, made to desist, made to revolve, MW. · exchanged, ib.…

व्यावर्त्य.en: व्य्-˚आवर्त्य mfn. to be removed or excluded or excepted, Kusum.

व्याविवृत्सु.en: व्य्-आविवृत्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to get rid of (abl. or comp.), Sāy.

व्यावृत्त.en: व्य्-आ/वृत्त mfn. turned away from, freed from, rid of (instr. abl., or comp.), AV.; MaitrS.; Kālid. &c. · split asunder, opened, Hariv.; Suśr.… · (ifc.) different from, Kap.… · averted, R.; Kathās.… · distorted, ṢaḍvBr.… · turned back, returned from (abl.), Campak.… · (ifc.) incompatible or inconsistent with, Bhāṣāp.… · thoroughly liberated or emancipated (as the soul), Kap.… · ceased, disappeared, gone, Kum.… · ‘chosen’ or ‘fenced’ (= वृत), L.… · excepted, excluded, W.… · praised, hymned (?), ib.…

व्यावृत्ति.en: व्य्-˚आ/वृत्ति f. turning away, turning the back (see अव्यावृ˚) · rolling (the eyes), Suśr.… · deliverance from, getting rid of (abl.), TS.; Śāntiś.… · being deprived of, separation or exclusion from, Śaṃk.… · exclusion, rejection, removal, Kum.; Kāvyād.; Sāh. (cf. परस्पर-व्य्˚)… · discrimination, distinction, TS.; ŚBr.… · distinctness (of sound or voice), Kāṭh.… · difference, AitBr.; Nyāyas., Sch.… · cessation, end, ĀpŚr.… · a kind of sacrifice, ŚBr.… · screening (prob. for व्य्-आवृति), ib.… · praise, eulogium (?), ib.…

व्यासङ्ग.en: व्य्-आसङ्ग m. excessive attachment, close adherence, Bhartṛ.; Mālatīm. · devotion or addiction to, wish or desire of, longing or passion for (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · connection, Kusum.… · addition, W.… · detachment, separation (in this and the next senses वि is privative), W.… · separate attention, distraction (of thought), Nyāyas.…

व्याहृ.en: व्य्-आ-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to utter or pronounce a sound, speak, say to (acc.), converse with (सह), name (with नामभिस्, to call by name; with प्रश्नान्, to answer questions; with उदाहराणि, to state examples), TBr. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to begin to talk (said of a child), MBh.; <div n="to"/>to confess, avow to (gen.), ib.; <div n="to"/>to utter inarticulate sounds, cry, scream (said of animals), KātyŚr.; <div n="to"/>to sport, enjoy one's self (exceptionally for वि-√ हृ), BhP.; <div n="to"/>to cut off, sever, MBh. vi, 2757 (B. वि-√ हृ) : <div n="vp"/>Desid. -जिहीर्षति, to wish to pronounce or utter, ŚBr.

व्याहरण.en: व्य्-आहरण n. the act of uttering or pronouncing, utterance, speech (मम व्याहर˚णात्, ‘because I say so’), MBh.; BhP.

व्याहार.en: व्य्-आहार m. utterance, language, speech, discourse, conversation, talk about (comp.), Kāv.; Pañcat.; Sāh. · song (of birds), Hariv.; Mālav.… · (in dram.) a jest, joke, humorous speech, Bhar.; Daśar. &c.…

व्याहृत.en: व्य्-आ/हृत mfn. spoken, uttered, said, told, declared, stated, VS. &c., &c. · one who has uttered a sound, R.… · eaten, devoured, Jātakam.… · व्य्-आ/हृत n. speaking, talking, conversation, Kāv.; BhP.… · information, instruction, direction, Pāṇ. v, 4, 35… · inarticulate speech or song (of animals and birds), MBh.; Hariv.…

व्याहृति.en: व्य्-आ/हृति f. utterance, speech, declaration, statement, MBh.; Kālid.; VarBṛS. · (also ˚ती; ifc. ˚तिका), the mystical utterance of the names of the seven worlds (viz. भूर्, भुवर् [or भुवः], स्वर्, महर्, जनर्, तपर्, सत्य [qq.vv.] the first three of which, called, ‘the great Vय्āह्ṛतिs’, are pronounced after ओम् by every <ns>Brāhman</ns> in commencing his daily prayers and are personified as the daughters of शवित्ṛ and फ्ṛśनि), TS.; Br.; RTL. 403; Mn. ii, 76; MBh. &c.… · N. of a श्āमन्, ĀrṣBr.…

व्यु.en: व्य्-√ उ P. -उनोति, to urge on, incite, animate, RV. v, 31, 1.

व्युत्क्रम्.en: व्य्-उत्-√ क्रम् P. -क्रामति, to go apart or in different directions, AitBr.; ŚBr.; <div n="to"/>to overstep, transgress, neglect, Ragh.; <div n="to"/>to go astray, MW.

व्युत्था.en: व्य्-उत्-था (-उद्-√ स्था) P. Ā. -तिष्ठति, ˚ते, to rise in different directions (as light), RV.; <div n="to"/>to turn away from (abl.), give up, abandon, ŚBr.; <div n="to"/>to swerve from duty, forget one's self, MBh.; R.; <div n="to"/>to come back (from sea, cf. व्य्-उत्-√ पद्), Divyāv. : <div n="vp"/>Caus. -थापयति, to cause to rise up &c.; <div n="to"/>to call in question, disagree about (acc.), MBh.; <div n="to"/>to seduce, win over, ib.; <div n="to"/>to set aside, remove, depose (from a place), Kathās.; <div n="to"/>to abandon treacherously, ib.

व्युत्थातव्य.en: व्य्-उत्थातव्य n. (impers.) it is to be desisted from (abl.), Śaṃk.

व्युत्थान.en: व्य्-उत्थान n. rising up, awakening (a partic. stage in ञोग), Vedāntas. · yielding, giving way (in अ-व्य्˚), MBh.… · swerving from the right course, neglect of duties, ib.… · opposition, L.… · independent action, L.… · a kind of dancing or gesticulation, MW.…

व्युत्पत्ति.en: व्य्-उत्पत्ति f. production, origin, derivation (esp. in gram.), etymology, Nyāyam.; Sāh.; Vop. · development, perfection, growth (esp. in knowledge), proficiency (esp. in literature or science), comprehensive learning or scholarship, Nyāyam.; Kap.; Bālar. &c.… · difference of tone or sound (fr. 3. वि denoting variation), VarBṛS.…

व्युत्पत्तिपक्षे.en: व्य्-उत्पत्ति—पक्षे ind. on the side of derivation or etymology (an expression used by Vedic commentators when the accentuation is settled by the affixes and not accord. to the meanings of the words)

व्युत्पन्न.en: व्य्-उत्पन्न mfn. arisen, originated, derived (esp. in gram.), to be explained etymologically (see अ-व्य्-˚) · learned, accomplished, experienced, versed in (instr.), Bhartṛ.; BhP.; Nyāyam., Sch.…

व्युत्पादन.en: व्य्-˚उत्पादन n. etymological explanation, derivation from (abl.), Madhus. · teaching, instruction, VarBṛS., Sch.…

व्युत्पाद्य.en: व्य्-˚उत्पाद्य mfn. capable of being traced back to its root, derivable, Sāṃkhyak. · to be explained or discussed, Nyāyam.…

व्युद्.en: व्य्-√ उद् (or उन्द्), P. -उनत्ति, to spring or gush forth, RV.; <div n="to"/>to sprinkle thoroughly, wet, drench, ib.; AV.

व्युदस्.en: व्य्-उद्-√ अस् P. -अस्यति, to throw about, scatter, Kauś.; MBh.; <div n="to"/>to discharge, emit, Gaut.; <div n="to"/>to cast off, reject, give up, abandon, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

व्युदास.en: व्य्-उदास m. throwing away, giving up, abandonment, MBh. · rejection, exclusion, Sāh.; Kull.… · disregard for, indifference to, W.… · destruction (of an enemy), Śiś. xv, 37… · cessation, end, Nalod.…

व्युप.en: (?) m. one who eats out of his own hands, L.

व्यूह्.en: व्य्-√ ऊह् P. -ऊहति (ep. also ˚ते impf. अव्यूहत, ˚हन्त as if fr. a √ व्यूह्), to push or move apart, place asunder, divide, distribute, TS.; ŚBr.; ŚrS.; ĪśUp.; <div n="to"/>to arrange, place in order, draw up in battle-array, Mn.; MBh. &c.; <div n="to"/>to shift, transpose, alter, AitBr.; ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr.; <div n="to"/>to separate, resolve (vowels, शṃद्हि &c.), RPrāt. · व्य्-√ ऊह् Ā. -ओहते, to forebode, perceive (accord. to others ‘despise’), RV. ii, 23, 16.…

व्यूह.en: 1. व्य्-ऊह/ m. placing apart, distribution, arrangement, R.; VarBṛS. &c. · orderly arrangement of the parts of a whole (cf. चरण-व्य्˚), disposition, Nyāyas.… · military array, an army, host, squadron (various arrays are दण्ड-, ‘staff-like array’; शकट-, ‘cart array’; वराह-, ‘boar array’; मण्डल-, ‘circular ar˚’; अ-संहत-, ‘loose ar˚’; आखेट-व्यूह, ‘hunting array’ &c.), Mn. vii, 187; MBh. &c.… · shifting, transposition, displacement, ŚBr.; ŚrS.… · separation, resolution (of vowels, syllables &c.), RPrāt.… · detailed explanation or description, SaddhP.… · a section, division, chapter, Sarvad.… · form, manifestation (esp. the quadruple manifestation of फुरुṣओत्तम as Vāसुदेव, शṃकर्ṣअṇअ, फ्रद्युम्न, and आनिरुद्द्ह), appearance (often ifc. after numerals, cf. चतुर्-, त्रिर्-व्य्˚), MBh.; BhP.; Sarvad.…

व्ये.en: cl. 1. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxiii, 38) व्य/यति, ते (pf. P. विव्याय, 2. sg. विव्ययिथ Gr.; 2. du. विव्यथुस्, RV.; Ā. विव्ये/, ib. -व्यया/ं चकार, ŚBr.; aor. अव्यत्, अव्यत, RV.; अव्यासीत्, अव्यास्त Gr.; Prec. वीयात्, व्यासीष्ट, ib.; fut. व्याता, ib.; व्यास्यति, ˚ते, ib.; व्ययिष्ये, GṛŚrS.; ind.p. -वी/य, Br. &c.; -व्याय Gr.), <div n="to"/>to cover, clothe, wrap, envelop (Ā. also, ‘one's self’), RV.; TS.; TBr. : Pass. वीय/ते (pr. p. वीय/मान), to be covered &c., TS. : <div n="vp"/>Caus. व्याययति Gr.: <div n="vp"/>Desid. विव्यासति, ˚ते, ib.; <div n="vp"/> Intens. वेवीयते, वाव्येति, vAvyAti, ib.

व्योम.en: 1. व्योम (for 2. See col. 3), in comp. for 2. व्योमन्. · 2. व्योम m. (for 1. See col. 2) N. of a son of धśāर्ह, Pur. (v.l. for व्योमन्).…

व्र.en: / m. (a formula of unknown meaning), AV. xi, 7, 3. For the form व्रा See p. 1043, col. 1.<listinfo n="sup"/> · (accord. to some, ‘that which is confined’).…

व्रज.en: 1. व्रज m. (for 2. See p. 1042, col. 1) a way, road, L. · n. wandering, roaming, W.… · 2. व्रज/ m. (n. only, RV. v, 6, 7; ifc. f(आ). ; fr. √ वृज्) a fold, stall, cow-pen, cattle-shed, enclosure or station of herdsmen, RV. &c. &c.… · / m. N. of the district around आग्र and ंअत्हुर्ā (the abode of ङन्द, of ख्ṛṣṇअ's foster-father, and scene of ख्ṛṣṇअ's juvenile adventures; commonly called Braj; cf. वृजि), Inscr.… · a herd, flock, swarm, troop, host, multitude, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (संग्रामः सव्रजः ‘a fight with many’, MārkP.; व्रजो गिरिमयः, prob. = गिरि-व्रज, q.v., Hariv.)… · a cloud (= मेघ), Naigh. i, 10… · N. of a son of ःअविर्-द्ह्āन, Hariv.; VP.…

व्रजन.en: व्र/जन n. going, travelling (अन्यत्र, ‘elsewhere’), Pañcat. ii, 62/63 going into exile, ib. iii, 268 (v.l. प्र-व्रजन) · a road, way, RV. vii, 3, 2… · व्र/जन m. N. of as one of आज-म्īḍह and brother of झह्नु (considered as one of the ancestors of खुśइक), MBh.…

व्रजित.en: / mfn. gone, proceeded (अन्येन, by another road), ŚBr. · / n. going, roaming, W.…

व्रज्या.en: 1. व्रज्या f. (for 2. See next page, col. 1) travelling, wandering, gait, Nir.; Pāṇ.; Nyāyas., Sch. · march, attack, invasion, L.… · N. of a poem by खविचन्द्र.… · 2. व्रज्या f. division, group (= वर्ग), Sāh.…

व्राज.en: 1. व्राज m. (for 2. See below) going, movement, motion, MW. · 2. व्राज/ m. (for 1. See above) = 2. व्रज/, a troop, host, band (अम् ind. in troops), AV.… · a domestic cock, L.… · 1. 2. व्राज &c. See p. 1042, col. 1.…

व्राजि.en: f. ‘who or what moves (?)’, a gale of wind, W. (cf. ध्राजि).

व्रज्य.en: व्र/ज्य mfn. belonging to a fold or pen, VS.

व्रण.en: m. (exceptionally n.) a wound, sore, ulcer, abscess, tumour, cancer, boil, scar, cicatrix, crack, Mn.; MBh. &c. · a flaw, blemish (also in inanimate objects), MBh.; Hariv.; VarBṛS.…

व्रत.en: / n. (ifc. f(आ). ; fr. √ 2. वृ) will, command, law, ordinance, rule, RV. · obedience, service, ib.; AV.; ĀśvGṛ.… · dominion, realm, RV.… · sphere of action, function, mode or manner of life (e.g. शुचि-व्र्˚, ‘pure manner of life’, Śak.), conduct, manner, usage, custom, RV. &c. &c.… · a religious vow or practice, any pious observance, meritorious act of devotion or austerity, solemn vow, rule, holy practice (as fasting, continence &c.; व्रत/ं-√ चर्, ‘to observe a vow’, esp. ‘to practise chastity’), ib.… · any vow or firm purpose, resolve to (dat. loc., or comp.; व्रतात् or व्रत-वशात्, ‘in consequence of a vow’; cf. असि-धारा-व्रत and आसिधारं व्रतम्), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · the practice of always eating the same food (cf. मधु-व्र्˚), L.… · the feeding only on milk (as a fast or observance according to rule; also the milk itself), VS.; Br.; KātyŚr.…

व्रतधारण.en: व्रत—धारण n. the fulfilling of a religious observance, f˚ of duties towards (with gen. or comp.), Kām.; BṛĀrUp., Sch.; BhP.

व्रतमीमांसा.en: व्रत—मीमांसा/ f. inquiry into or discussion about religious observances, ŚBr.

व्रतलोप.en: व्रत—लोप m. violation of a vow or rel˚ obligation, Vait.; Yājñ. (cf. स्नातक/व्˚).

व्रात.en: &c. See below. · व्रा/त m. (connected with √ 1. वृ, or with व्रत/ and √ 2. वृ) a multitude, flock, assemblage, troop, swarm, group, host (व्रा/तं व्रातम्, in companies or troops; प/ञ्च व्रा/तास्, the five races of men), association, guild, RV. &c. &c.… · the company or attendants at a marriage feast, W.… · = मनुष्य, Naigh. ii, 3… · the descendant of an out-caste <ns>Brāhman</ns> &c. (= व्रात्य), L.… · व्रा/त n. manual or bodily labour, day-labour, ib.…

व्रश्चन.en: व्र/श्चन mfn. who or what cuts, cutting or for cutting, Mcar. · a file or saw or chisel, L.… · the juice flowing from an incision in a tree, Gaut.; Yājñ.… · व्र/श्चन n. cutting, wounding, a cut, incision, ŚBr.; Kāṭh. &c.…

व्रा.en: / f. (fr. √ 1. वृ accord. to some fr. a masc. stem व्र) a heap, host, multitude (mostly व्रा/स्, pl.), RV. (Sāy. i, 121, 2,‘night’, ‘dawn’), AV.; (accord. to some also, ‘a woman, esp. a wanton or lustful w˚’)

व्रात्य.en: व्रा/त्य m. a man of the mendicant or vagrant class, a tramp, out-caste, low or vile person (either a man who has lost caste through non-observance of the ten principal शṃस्क्āरs, or a man of a partic. low caste descended from a Śūद्र and a ख्ṣअत्रिय्ā; accord. to some ‘the illegitimate son of a ख्ṣअत्रिय who knows the habits and intentions of soldiers’; in AV. xv, 8, 1; 9, 1, the ण्āजन्यs and even the <ns>Brāhmans</ns> are said to have sprung from the Vर्āत्य who is identified with the Supreme Being, prob. in glorification of religious mendicancy; accord. to ĀpŚr. व्रात्य is used in addressing a guest), AV. &c. &c. · व्रा/त्य mfn. belonging to the Vरत called ंअह्ā-व्रत (q.v.), PañcavBr., Sch.…

व्री.en: (cf. √ वृ and व्ली) cl. 9. P. and cl. 4. Ā. व्रीणाति, व्रिणाति, or व्रीयते, ‘to choose’ or ‘to cover’ (वरणे), Dhātup. xxxi, 33; xxvi, 31 Caus. व्राययति, or व्रेपयति Gr.: <div n="vp"/>Desid. विव्रीषति, ˚ते: <div n="vp"/>Intens. वेव्रीयते, वेव्रयीति, वेव्रेति, ib.

व्रीडित.en: mfn. ashamed, abashed, modest, MBh.; Kāv. &c. · n. shame, embarrassment, Kir.…

व्रीहि.en: / m. (of doubtful derivation) rice pl. grains of rice (not mentioned in RV., but in AV. named together with यव, माथ, and तिल; eight principal sorts are enumerated by native authorities), RV. &c. &c. · a field of rice, KātyŚr.… · rice ripening in the rainy season, W.… · any grain, L.…

व्रीहियव.en: व्रीहि—यव/ m. du. or pl. (AV.; ŚBr.) n. sg. (MBh.), rice and barley.

श.en: 1. श the first of the three sibilants (it belongs to the palatal class, but in sound as well as euphonic treatment often corresponds to ष्, though in some words pronounced more like स्). · 2. श (ifc.) = शय (see गिरि-, वारि-, वृक्ष-श).… · 3. श m. = शस्त्र, L.… · = शिव, L.… · n. See 2. शम्.…

शकार.en: 1. श—कार m. (for 2. See p. 1045) the letter or sound श, Prāt. · 2. शकार m. (for 1. See under 1. श) a descendant of the Śअकs, a Śअक, Pat. on Pāṇ. iv, 1, 130… · a king's brother-in-law through one of his inferior wives (esp. in the drama represented as a foolish, frivolous, proud, low, and cruel man, such as is शṃस्त्ह्āनक in the ंṛच्च्हकṭइक्ā, he speaks the dialect of the Śअकs i.e. Śākārī, which employs the sibilant ś, exclusively <pb n="1046,1"/>; hence Śअक्āर accord. to some, is for, ‘Śअ-क्āर’, one who uses the letter Śअ), Bhar.; Daś.; Sāh. &c.… · 1. 2. शकार See under 1. श and 3. शक.…

शभेद.en: श—भेद m. N. of a treatise on the proper spelling of words beginning with श्, ष्, or s.

शंस.en: श/ंस m. recitation, invocation, praise, RV. · wishing well or ill to, a blessing or a curse, ib.… · a promise, vow, ib. (नरा/ं श/ंस, RV. ii, 34, 6, prob. = नरा-श्˚, q.v.; ऋजु/र् इ/च् छ/ंस, ii, 26, 1 either, by tmesis, ‘the right praiser’, or ऋजु-शंस as adj. ‘righteous, faithful’)… · a spell, MW.… · calumny, ib.… · श/ंस mfn. reciting, proclaiming, praising, wishing (see अघ-, दुः-श् &c.)…

शंसा.en: श/ंसा (आ), f. praise, flattery, eulogium, Kāv. · wish, desire, W.… · speech, utterance, announcement, R.…

शंसन.en: n. reciting, recitation, praise, L. · report, announcement, communication, R. (applied to Śइव, Hariv. 7425 = वेद-प्रशस्य, Nīlak.)…

शंसित.en: mfn. (often confounded with सं-शित See सं-√ शो) said, told, praised, celebrated, Pañcat. praiseworthy, ib. · wished, desired, longed for, W.… · calumniated, falsely accused, ib.…

शस्.en: 1. शस् mfn. reciting (see उक्थ-श/स्, -शस/). · 1. शस् cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xvii, 78) श/सति (Ved. also -शस्ति and -शास्ति; pf. शशास, MBh.; 3. pl. शशसुः Gr.; fut. शसिता, ib.; शसिष्यति, Br.; Ved. inf. -श/सस्, Br.; ind.p. -शस्य, MBh.), to cut down, kill, slaughter (mostly वि-√ शस्, q.v.)… · 2. शस् See √ सस्.… · 3. शस् (in gram.) the technical case-termination of the accusative plural, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 2… · the थद्द्हित affix शस् (forming adverbs from nouns, esp. from numerals and words expressive of quantity), ib. v, 4, 42 &c. (cf. अल्प-शस्, बहु-शस्, शत-शस् &c.)…

शस्त.en: 1. शस्त/ mfn. (for 2. See under √ शस्) recited repeated, RV. · praised, commended, approved, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · auspicious (cf. अ/-श्˚), AV.; Rājat.… · beautiful, R.… · happy, fortunate, Kathās.… · / n. praise, eulogy, RV.… · happiness, excellence, W.… · 2. शस्त mfn. (for 1. See p. 1044, col. 1) cut down, slaughtered, killed, MBh. iii, 1638.…

शस्त्र.en: 1. शस्त्र/ n. (for 2. See under √ शस्) invocation, praise (applied to any hymn recited either audibly or inaudibly, as opp. to स्तोम, which is sung, but esp. the verses recited by the ःओत्ṛ and his assistant as an accompaniment to the घ्रहs at the शोम libation), VS.; Br.; ŚrS.; ChUp. · reciting, recitation, ŚāṅkhBr.… · 2. श/स्त्र m. (for 1. See p. 1044, col. 1) a sword, L.… · श/स्त्र n. an instrument for cutting or wounding, knife, sword, dagger, any weapon (even applied to an arrow, Bhaṭṭ.; weapons are said to be of four kinds, पाणि-मुक्त, यन्त्र-मुक्त, muktAmukta, and अमुक्त), ŚBr. &c. &c.… · any instrument or tool (see comp.)… · iron, steel, L.… · a razor, L.…

शस्य.en: 1. श/स्य mfn. (for 2. See p. 1061, col. 2) to be recited or treated as a Śअस्त्र, Br. · to be praised or celebrated, Kāv.… · to be wished, desirable, excellent, W.… · श/स्य n. recitation, ŚāṅkhBr.… · good quality, merit, W.… · 2. शस्य mfn. to be cut down or slaughtered or killed, Vop.… · n. corn, grain (more correctly सस्य, q.v.)…

शक्.en: cl. 5. P. (Dhātup. xxvii, 15) शक्नोति (pf. शशा/क, शेकु/ः, RV. &c. &c.; aor. अ/शकत्, AV. &c. [Ved. also Pot. शकेयम् and शक्याम्; Impv. शग्धि, शक्तम्]; fut. शक्ता, or शकिता Gr. <pb n="1044,2"/>; शक्ष्यति, ˚ते, Br. &c.; शकिष्यते, ˚ते Gr.; inf. -शक्तवे, RV.; शक्तुम् or शकितुम् Gr.), <div n="to"/>to be strong or powerful, be able to or capable of or competent for (with acc. dat. or loc., rarely acc. of a verbal noun, or with an inf. in अम् or तुम्; or with pr.p.; e.g. with ग्रहणाय or ग्रहणे, ‘to be able to seize’; वध-निर्णेकम् अ-शक्नुवन्, ‘unable to atone for slaughter’; शके/म वाजि/नो य/मम्, ‘may we be able to guide horses’; vIkzitum na Saknoti, ‘he is not able to see’; पूरयन् न शक्नोति, ‘he is not able to fill’), RV. &c. &c. (in these meanings ep. also शक्यति, ˚ते, with inf. in तुं cf. Dhātup.…

शक.en: 1. शक See सु-श/क. · 2. श/क n. excrement, ordure, dung (cf. शकन्, शकृत्), AV.… · water (v.l. for कश), Naigh. i, 12… · श/क m. a kind of animal, Pañcar. (v.l. शल)… · w.r. for शुक, MBh. xiii, 2835… · 3. शक m. pl. N. of a partic. white-skinned tribe or race of people (in the legends which relate the contests between Vअसिṣṭह and Vइśव्āमित्र the Śअकs are fabled to have been produced by the Cow of Vअसिṣṭह, from her sweat, for the destruction of Vइśव्āमित्र's army; in Mn. x, 44, they are mentioned together with the फउṇḍरकs, औḍरs, ध्रविḍअs, ख्āम्बोजs, झवनs or ञवनs, फ्āरदs, फह्लवs, छ्īनs, खिर्āतs, धरदs, and ख्हśअs, described by, Kull. as degraded tribes of ख्ṣअत्रियs called after the districts in which they reside: according to the VP. iv, 3, king शगर attempted to rid his kingdom of these tribes, but did not succeed in destroying them all : they are sometimes regarded as the followers of Śअक or Śāलि-व्āहन, and are probably to be identified with the Tartars or Indo-Scythians [Lat. Sacæ] who ov……

शकित.en: mfn. (cf. Kāś. on Pāṇ. vii, 2, 17) able, capable (mostly used with न, and giving a pass. sense to the inf., e.g. न शकितं छेत्तुम्, it could not be cut; also impers., e.g. न शकितं तेन, he was not able), MBh.; R.; Kathās.

शक्त.en: mfn. able, competent for, equal to, capable of (instr. gen. dat. loc. acc. of person with प्रति inf., or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c. · = शकित, able to be (with inf. in a pass. sense), Kāś. on Pāṇ. vii, 2, 17… · m. N. of a son of ंअनस्यु, MBh.… · , शक्ति &c. See p. 1044, col. 2.…

शक्ति.en: श/क्ति or शक्ति/ f. power, ability, strength, might, effort, energy, capability (शक्त्या or आत्म-श्˚ or स्व-श्˚, ‘according to ability’; परं शक्त्या, ‘with all one's might’; वित्त-शक्त्या, ‘according to the capability of one's property’; शक्तिम् अ-हापयित्वा, ‘not relaxing one's efforts, exerting all one's strength’), faculty, skill, capacity for, power over (gen. loc. dat., or inf.), RV. &c. &c. · effectiveness or efficacy (of a remedy), ŚārṅgS.… · regal power (consisting of three parts, प्रभुत्व, personal pre-eminence; मन्त्र, good counsel, and उत्साह, energy), Kām. (cf. Ragh. iii, 13)… · the energy or active power of a deity personified as his wife and worshipped by the Śāक्त (q.v.) sect of <ns>Hindūs</ns> under various names (sometimes only three, sometimes eight Śअक्ति goddesses are enumerated, as follow, ईन्द्र्āṇī, Vअइṣṇअव्ī, Śāन्त्ā, भ्रह्म्āṇī, खउम्āर्ī, ङ्āरसिṃह्ī, Vāर्āह्ī, and ंāहेśवर्ī, but some substitute छ्āमुṇḍā and छṇḍइक्ā for the third and sixth of these: according to another reckoning there are nine, viz. Vअइṣṇअव्ī, भ्रह्म्āṇī, णउद्र्ī, ंāहेśवर्ī, ङ्āरसिṃह्ī, Vāर्āह्ī, ईन्द्र्āṇī, ख्āर्त्तिक्ī, and फ्रद्ह्āन्ā: others reckon fifty different forms of the Śअक्ति of …

शक्तिता.en: शक्ति—ता f. (ifc.) power, capacity, faculty, BhP.

शक्तिभेद.en: शक्ति—भेद m. difference of power, MW. · a special capacity, ib.…

शक्तिमत्.en: शक्ति—मत् mfn. possessed of ability, powerful, mighty, able to (inf. or loc.), Mn.; MBh. &c. · possessing a competence, one who has gained a fortune, MW.… · possessed of or united with his शक्ति or energy (as a god), Kathās.… · armed with a spear or lance, Hariv.… · शक्ति—मत् m. N. of a mountain (prob. w.r. for शुक्ति-मत्), MBh.…

शक्न.en: or शक्नु, mfn. kind or pleasant in speech (= प्रियं-वद), L.

शक्य.en: mf(आ)n. able, possible, practicable, capable of being (with inf. in pass. sense, e.g. न सा शक्या नेतुम् बलात्, ‘she cannot be conducted by force’; तन् मया शक्यम् प्रतिपत्तुम्, ‘that is able to be acquired by me’; the form शक्यम् may also be used with a nom. case which is in a different gender or number, e.g. SakyaM Sva-mAMsAdiBir api kzut pratihantum, ‘hunger can be appeased even by dog's flesh &c.’; cf. Vām. v, 2, 25), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · to be conquered or subdued, liable to be compelled to (inf.), MBh.… · explicit, direct, literal (as the meaning of a word or sentence, opp. to लक्ष्य and व्यङ्ग्य), Alaṃkāraś.…

शक्यता.en: शक्य—ता f. possibility, practicability, capacity, capability, Sarvad. (-tAvacCedaka n. = SakyAMSe BAsamAna-DarmaH, L.)

शक्यत्व.en: शक्य—त्व n. possibility, practicability, capacity, capability, Sarvad.

शक्र.en: / mf(आ/)n. strong, powerful, mighty (applied to various gods, but esp. to ईन्द्र), RV.; AV.; TBr.; Lāṭy. · / m. N. of ईन्द्र, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · of an Āदित्य, MBh.; Hariv.… · of the number ‘fourteen’, Gaṇit.… · Wrightia Antidysenterica, L.… · Terminalia Arjuna, L.…

शक्रि.en: m. (only L.) a cloud · a thunderbolt… · an elephant… · a mountain.…

शका.en: श/का (आ), f. a kind of bird or fly or long-eared animal, VS.; TS. (Sch.)

शकट.en: n. (rarely m. of doubtful derivation) a cart, waggon, car, carriage, Nir.; ŚāṅkhŚr. &c. · (with प्राजापत्यम्, or रोहिण्याः cf. रोहिणी-श्˚) the five stars forming the asterism णोहिṇī compared to a cart, Kāv.; VarBṛS. &c.… · (only) a partic. configuration of stars and planets (when all the planets are in the 1st and 7th house), VarBṛS.… · m. n. a form of military array resembling a wedge, Mn. vii, 187… · m. Dalbergia Ougeinensis, L.… · Arum Colocasia, L.… · an implement for preparing grain, MW.… · w.r. for शाकट, q.v.… · N. of a man, g., naqAdi… · of a demon slain by the child ख्ṛṣṇअ, Śiś.… · m. or n. (?) N. of a place, Cat.…

शकल.en: श/कल m. n. (in ŚBr. also श/कर, of doubtful derivation) a chip, fragment, splint, log, piece, bit, TS. &c. &c. (शकलानि √ कृ, with acc., ‘to separate, divide, dissipate’, Ragh.) · a potsherd, Mn. vi, 28… · a spark (in कृशानु-श्˚), Śiś. v, 9… · श/कल n. a half, Sāh. (चन्द्र-श्˚, the half-moon, Kād.)… · a half-verse, Ked.… · the half of an eggshell, Mn.; MBh. &c.… · skin, bark, Divyāv.… · the scales of a fish (cf. शल्क, शल्कल), ib.… · the skull (in कपाल-श्˚)… · cinnamon, L.… · a kind of black pigment or dye, L.… · श/कल m. N. of a man g. gargAdi.…

शकुनी.en: (ई), f. See col. 3 · f. (of शकुन or ˚नि, col. 2) a female bird, MBh.; Hariv.… · a hen-sparrow, L.… · Turdus Macrourus, L.… · N. of a female demon (sometimes identified with धुर्ग्ā) causing a partic. child's disease (sometimes = पूतना, and in this sense also शकुनि), MBh.; Hariv.…

शकुनि.en: शकु/नि m. a bird (esp. a large bird, L. = गृध्र or चिल्ल, accord. to some ‘a cock’), RV. &c. &c. · (in astronomy) N. of the first fixed करण (q.v.), VarBṛS.… · N. of a Nāga, MBh.… · of an evil demon (son of धुḥ-सह), MārkP.… · of an आसुर (son of ःइरṇय्āक्ṣअ and father of Vṛक), Hariv.; Pur.… · of the brother of queen घ्āन्द्ह्āर्ī (and therefore the brother-in-law of ध्ह्ṛतर्āṣṭर and the ंāतुल or maternal uncle of the खुरु princes; as son of शुबल, king of घ्āन्द्ह्āर, he is called शउबल; he often acted as counsellor of धुर्योद्हन, and hence his name is sometimes applied to an old officious relative whose counsels tend to misfortune), MBh.; Hariv. &c. (cf. IW. 380)… · of a son of Vइकुक्ṣइ and grandson of ईक्ṣव्āकु, Hariv.… · of a son of धśअ-रत्ह, ib.; BhP.… · of the great-grandfather of आśओक, Rājat.…

शङ्क.en: 1. शङ्क m. (for 2. See below) fear, doubt (see comp.) · N. of a king, Buddh. (cf. शङ्कन)… · 2. शङ्क m. a bull, L.…

शङ्का.en: f. See below. · / f. (ifc. f(आ). ) apprehension, care, alarm, fear, distrust, suspicion of (abl. loc., or प्रति with acc., or comp.; ब्रह्म-हत्या-कृता शङ्का, ‘the fear of having committed the murder of a <ns>Brāhman</ns>’, R.; पाप-शङ्का न कर्तव्या, ‘no evil is to be suspected’, Kathās.), ŚBr. &c. &c.… · doubt, uncertainty, hesitation, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · (ifc.) belief, supposition, presumption (of or that any person or thing is-), ib.… · a subject started in disputation, MW.… · a species of the धṇḍअक metre, W.…

शङ्खा.en: (आ), f. a kind of flute, Saṃgīt.

शङ्खध्म.en: शङ्ख—ध्म/ m. a shell-blower, one who plays on the conch or horn, VS.; ŚBr.

शती.en: f. Curcuma Zedoaria, Suśr. (often written शठी).

शत.en: / n. (rarely m.; ifc. f(ई). ) a hundred (used with other numerals thus, ekADikaM Satam, or एक-श्˚, a h˚ + one, 101 विंशत्य्-अधिकं शतम् or विंशं श्˚, a h˚ + twenty, 120; शते or द्वे शते or द्वि-शतम् or शत-द्वयम्, 200; त्रीणि शतानि or त्रि-शतानि or शत-त्रयम्, 300; षट्-शतम्, 600; or the comp. becomes an ordinal, e.g. द्वि-शत, the 200th; द्विकं, त्रिकं शतम् = 2, 3 per cent; शतात्पर, ‘beyond a h˚, exceeding 100’; the counted object is added either in the gen., or in the same case as शत, or ibc., e.g. शतम् पितरः or शतम् पितॄणाम् or पितृ-शतम् ‘a h˚ ancestors’; sometimes also ifc. See comp. below; rarely शतम् is used as an indecl. with an instr., e.g. शत/ं र/थेभिः, ‘with a h˚ chariots’, RV. i, 48, 7; rarely occurs a masc. form in pl., e.g. पञ्च-शतान् रथान्, MBh. iv, 1057; and शत n. rarely in comp.…

शतक्रतु.en: शत/—क्रतु (शत/-), mfn. having h˚-fold insight or power or a h˚ counsels &c., RV.; AV.; VS. &c. · containing a h˚ sacrificial rites (ekona-Sata-kr˚, one who has made 99 sacrifices), ŚBr.; BhP. <pb n="1049,1"/>… · शत/—क्रतु m. शतगु.en: शत—गु, mfn. possessed of a hundred cows, Mn.; Gaut. [cf. Gk. ἑκατόμβη].

(cf. श/मि) effort, labour, toil, RV.; VS. · (शमी/) the Śअम्ī tree, Prosopis Spicigera or (accord. to others) Mimosa Suma (possessing a very tough hard wood supposed to contain fire, cf. शयान.en: mfn. lying down, resting, sleeping, Mn.; MBh. &c. · m. a lizard, chameleon, L.…

शय्या.en: f. शर.en: / m. (fr. √ शॄ ‘to rend’ or ‘destroy’) a sort of reed or grass, Saccharum Sara (used for arrows), RV. &c. &c. · an arrow, shaft, MuṇḍUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.… · N. of the number ‘five’ (from the 5 arrows of the god of love), VarBṛS.… · (in astron.) the versed sine of an arc (accord. to Āryabh. also ‘the whole diameter with subtraction of the versed sine’)… · a partic. configuration of stars (when all the planets are in the 4th, 5th, 6th, and 7th houses), VarBṛS.… · the upper part of cream or slightly curdled milk (v.l. सर), ĀpŚr.; Car.… · mischief, injury, hurt, a wound, W.… · N. of a son of Ṛचत्क, RV.… · of an आसुर, Hariv. शरी.en: (ई), f. Typha Angustifolia, L. · See under शर, p. 1056, col. 2.…

शरज.en: शर—ज mfn. born in a clump of reeds, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 16 · शर—ज m. = -जन्मन्, L.… · शर—ज n. ‘produced from sour cream’, butter, L.…

शरवत्.en: शर—वत् mfn. filled with ar˚, Hariv. · (also used in explaining शल्मलि and said to be = कण्टकैर् हिनस्ति, Nir.)…

शरेषीका.en: SarezIkA/ (ŚBr.; R.) or SarEzIkA (R.), f. a stalk of reed; <div n="P"/> (शरे/षीका) an ar˚, MW.

शरण.en: 1. शरण m. (for 2. (fr. √ शृ for श्रि; for 1. See p. 1056) protecting, guarding, defending, RV.; AV.… · / m. N. of a serpent-demon, MBh.… · of a poet, Gīt. (cf. -देव)… · of a king, Buddh.… · / f(आ and ई). (ifc. f(आ). ), shelter, place of shelter or refuge or rest, hut, house, habitation, abode, lair (of an animal), home, asylum, RV. &c. &c.… · / n. refuge, protection, refuge with (शरणं √ गम् or या or इ &c., ‘to go to any one for protection, seek refuge with’ [acc. or gen.]; often ifc.), Mn.; MBh. &c.… · water, L.… · (with इन्द्रस्य) N. of a श्āमन्, ĀrṣBr.…

शरदा.en: f. autumn, L. · a year, L.… · N. of a woman, Rājat.…

शरव.en: m. pl. N. of a people, MBh. vi, 2084 (prob. w.r. for शबर, q.v.)

शरीरदेश.en: शरीर—देश/ m. a part of the b˚, ŚBr.

शरीरपात.en: शरीर—पात m. collapse of the b˚, death, VarBṛ.; Kum. &c.

शरीरप्रभव.en: शरीर—प्रभव m. a begetter, father, R.

शरीरभेद.en: शरीर—भेद m. dissolution of the body, death, AitUp.; Gaut. &c.

शरीरमात्र.en: शरीर—मात्र n. the mere body or person, the body only, MW.

शरीरयात्रा.en: शरीर—यात्रा f. means of bodily subsistence, subs˚, Bhag.; Kathās.

शरीरवत्.en: शरीर—वत् mfn. provided with a b˚, Sarvad. · substantial, TBr.… · शरीर—वत् m. an embodied being, MBh.…

शरीरसम्बन्ध.en: शरीर—सम्बन्ध m. ‘bodily connection’, relation by marriage, ib.

शरीरस्थ.en: शरीर—स्थ mfn. existing in the b˚, Bhartṛ.

शरीरावयव.en: SarIrAvayava m. a part of the b˚, member, limb, Pāṇ. v, 1, 6.

शरीरिन्.en: mfn. having a body, embodied, corporeal, Mn.; Kāv. &c. · (ifc.) having anything as a body, Mn. iv, 243 (cf. ख-स्˚)… · covered with bodies, MBh.… · (ifc.) exercising one's own b˚, BhP.… · living, MW.… · m. an embodied being, creature, (esp.) a man, Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.… · m. the soul, Bhag.; Ragh. &c. शर्म.en: 1. शर्म n. = शर्मन्, L. · 2. शर्म in comp. for शर्मन्.…

शर्वरी.en: f. See below · श/र्वरी f. the (star-spangled) night, RV.… · evening, twilight, L.… · turmeric or Curcuma Longa, L.… · a woman, L.… · N. of the wife of धोṣअ and mother of Śइśउ-म्āर, BhP.… · pl. the spotted steeds of the ंअरुत्s, RV.…

शल.en: / mfn. (connection with above very doubtful) = द्रवण-समर्थ, Nir., Sch. · / m. a staff, TBr.… · a dart, spear, L.… · a kind of animal, Pañcar. (ifc. f(आ). ) a dart, javelin, lance, spear, iron-headed weapon (cf. उप-श्˚), pike, arrow, shaft (also the point of an arrow or spear and its socket), RV. &c. &c. · anything tormenting or causing pain (as a thorn, sting &c.), or (in med.) any extraneous substance lodged in the body and causing pain (e.g. a splinter, pin, stone in the bladder &c.; also applied to the fetus, and, as a branch of med˚, to ‘the extraction of splinters or extraneous substances’), MBh.; R. &c., Suśr.… · a fault, defect, Hariv. शशी.en: f. N. of an आप्सरस्, Kāraṇḍ. · 1. शशी f. See under शश.… · 2. शशी in comp. for शश.…

शास्त्र.en: / n. an order, command, precept, rule, RV.; Kāv.; Pur. · teaching, instruction, direction, advice, good counsel, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · any instrument of teaching, any manual or compendium of rules, any book or treatise, (esp.) any religious or scientific treatise, any sacred book or composition of divine authority (applicable even to the Vएद, and said to be of fourteen or even eighteen kinds [see under विद्या]; the word शास्त्र is often found ifc. after the word denoting the subject of the book, or is applied collectively to whole departments of knowledge, e.g. vedAnta-S˚, a work on the Vएद्āन्त philosophy or the whole body of teaching on that subject; धर्म-श्˚, a law-book or whole body of written laws; काव्य-श्˚, a poetical work or poetry in general; शिल्पि-श्˚, works on the mechanical arts; काम-श्˚, erotic compositions; अलंकार श्˚, rhetoric, &c.), Nir.; Prāt.; Mn.; MBh. &c.…

शास्त्रज्ञत्व.en: शास्त्र—ज्ञ—त्व n. acquaintance with the Ś˚, W.

शास्त्रतस्.en: शास्त्र—तस् ind. accord. to the Ś˚ or accord. to prescribed rules, Mn.; MBh.; R.; Suśr.

शास्त्रदृष्ट.en: शास्त्र—दृष्ट mfn. ‘seen in the Ś˚’, mentioned or prescribed in the Ś˚, according to precept or rule, scientific, Mn.; Kāv. &c.

शास्त्रदृष्टि.en: शास्त्र—दृष्टि f. scriptural point of view, A. · शास्त्र—दृष्टि mfn. = -चक्षुस्, MBh.… · शास्त्र—दृष्टि m. an astrologer, MārkP. (cf. -तत्त्व-ज्ञ).…

शास्त्रयोनि.en: शास्त्र—योनि m. the source of the Ś˚ (-त्व n.), MW.

शास्त्रविधान.en: शास्त्र—विधान n. a precept of the Ś˚, W.

शास्त्रविरोध.en: शास्त्र—विरोध m. opposition to sacred precept, ib. · mutual contradiction of books, incompatibility of different works, ib.…

शास्त्रसिद्ध.en: शास्त्र—सिद्ध mfn. established by the Ś˚, W.

शास्त्रार्थ.en: SAstrArTa m. the object or purport of a book, a precept of the Ś˚ or of any partic. Ś˚, MW.

शास्त्रोक्त.en: SAstrokta mfn. declared or enjoined by the Ś˚, W.

शास्त्रीय.en: mfn. taught in or agreeable to the Śāस्त्रs, belonging to the Ś˚s, conformable to sacred precepts, legal, Sāh.; Śaṃk. &c.

शास्त्रीयत्व.en: शास्त्रीय—त्व n. the fact of being prescribed in the Śāस्त्रs, Mn., Sch.

शास्य.en: शा/स्य mfn. to be punished, punishable, Mn.; Gaut.; Bālar. · to be controlled or governed, MBh.… · to be directed, RV.… · to be corrected, MW.… · w.r. for सस्य, MBh. xii, 2691.…

(cf. above) a chief, W.… · a courtier, counsellor, ib.… · / n. precept, rule, RPrāt.… · instruction (see SizwArTam).…

शिष्य.en: &c.
