शाहि.en: m. N. of a dynasty, Rājat.

शि.en: 1. शि (accord. to some = √ शो) cl. 3. P. शिशाति (Impv. शि/शीहि, शाधि), to grant, bestow, RV. (cf. Nir. v, 23); <div n="to"/>to present or satisfy with (instr.), ib.; <div n="vp"/> cl. 5. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxvii, 3) शिनोति, शिनुते (p. शिषाय, शिष्ये; aor. अशैषीत्, अशेष्ट fut. शेष्यति, ˚ते), <div n="to"/>to sharpen. · 2. शि m. N. of Śइव, W.… · auspiciousness, good fortune, ib.… · peace, composure, calm, ib.… · 3. शि (in gram.) a technical term for the case-ending इ (substituted for जस् and शस् in neuters).…

शित.en: 1. शित/ mfn. (for 2. See p. 1071, col. 2) satisfied, regaled, RV. viii, 23, 13. · 2. शित mfn. (for 1. and 4. See under √ शि and शो) w.r. for सित, ‘bright-coloured, white’.… · 3. शित m. N. of a son of Vइśव्āमित्र, MBh.… · 4. शित/ mfn. (for 1. &c. See p. 1069, col. 3) whetted, sharp, RV. &c. &c.… · thin, slender, weak, feeble, L.…

शिक्ष.en: m. N. of a king of the घन्द्हर्वs, R.

शिक्षा.en: f. See below. · f. desire of being able to effect anything, wish to accomplish, Kir. xv, 37… · learning, study, knowledge, art, skill in (loc. or comp.; शिक्षया or ˚क्षाभिस्, ‘skilfully, artistically, correctly’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · teaching, training (held by <ns>Buddhists</ns> to be of three kinds, viz. अधिचित्त-शिक्षा, training in the higher thought; अधिशील-श्˚, tr˚ in the higher morality; अधिप्रज्ञा-श्˚, tr˚ in the higher learning, Dharmas. 140), instruction, lesson, precept, ŚāṅkhBr.; TUp. &c.… · chastisement, punishment, Nyāyam., Sch.… · the science which teaches proper articulation and pronunciation of Vedic texts (one of the six Vएद्āṅगs q.v.), Prāt.; MuṇḍUp. &c.… · modesty, humility, diffidence, W.… · (?) helping, bestowing, imparting (see शिक्षा-नर/)…

शिक्षित.en: mfn. learnt, studied, practised, Baudh.; Kāv. &c. · taught, instructed or trained or exercised in (acc. loc., or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · docile, W.… · skilful, clever, conversant, ib.… · modest, diffident, ib.… · n. teaching, instruction, BhP.…

शिक्षिता.en: (आ), f. N. of a woman (see शैक्षित)

शिक्षितव्य.en: mfn. to be learnt from (abl.), ĀśvŚr., Sch. · to be instructed or taught, W.…

शिक्ष्य.en: mfn. to be learnt or taught, W.

शिख.en: m. N. of a serpent-demon (mentioned together with अनु-शिख, q.v.), PañcavBr.

शिखा.en: (आ), f., see below · शि/खा f. (of doubtful derivation; prob. connected with √ 1. शि, ‘to sharpen’) a tuft or lock of hair on the crown of the head, a crest, topknot, plume, ŚBr. &c. &c.… · a peacock's crest or comb, MBh.; Hariv. &c.… · a pointed flame, any flame, ib.… · a ray of light, Kum.; Kathās.… · a sharp end, point, spike, peak, summit, pinnacle, projection, end or point (in general), MaitrUp.; Kāv.; VarBṛS.… · the end or point or border of a garment, Śak.… · the point or tip of the foot, L.… · the nipple, L.… · a branch which takes root, any branch, L.… · a fibrous root, any root, L.… · the plant Jussiaea Repens, L.… · the head or chief or best of a class, L.… · the fever or excitement of love, L.… · a partic. part of a verse or formula (the crest of the verse compared to a king), RāmatUp.…

शिखण्डी.en: (ई), f., see below. · f. (of शिखण्ड, g. gOrAdi) a lock on the crown of the head, L.… · Abrus Precatorius, L.… · yellow jasmine, L.…

शिखर.en: &c. See col. 3. · mfn. pointed, spiked, crested, Megh.; Kathās.… · m. n. a point, peak (of a mountain), top or summit (of a tree), edge or point (of a sword), end, pinnacle, turret, spire, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · m. erection of the hair of the body, L.… · the arm-pit, L.… · a ruby-like gem (of a bright red colour said to resemble ripe pomegranate seed), L.… · (?) the bud of the Arabian jasmine (cf. -दशना)… · N. of a mythical weapon (अस्त्र), R.… · a partic. position of the fingers of the hand, Cat.… · N. of a man, Kathās.… · n. cloves, L.…

शिथिल.en: / mf(आ)n. (collateral form of prec.) loose, slack, lax, relaxed, untied, flaccid, not rigid or compact, TS. &c. &c. · soft, pliant, supple, Pañcat.… · unsteady, tremulous, MBh.… · languid, inert, unenergetic, weak, feeble, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · careless in (loc.), R.… · indistinct (as sound), L.… · not rigidly observed, W.… · loosely retained or possessed, abandoned, shaken off, ib.… · / (अम्), n. a loose fastening, looseness, laxity, slowness, MW.… · a partic. separation of the terms or members of a logical series, ib.…

शिथिली.en: (ई), f. a kind of tawny-coloured ant (said to be a variety of the white ant), L. · in comp. for शिथिल.…

शिथिलीकृ.en: शिथिली—√ कृ P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते, to make loose, loosen, relax, slacken, weaken, impair, remit, abandon, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

शिन.en: m. N. of a man, Pravar.

शिनि.en: m. N. of various men (of a son of शु-मित्र, of a son of घर्ग, of the father of श्āत्यक, &c.; शिनेर् नप्तृ, ‘grandson of Ś˚’, N. of श्āत्यकि, one of the फ्āṇḍउ chiefs), MBh.; Hariv.; Pur. · (ibc.) the race of Śइनि (see below)… · pl. N. of a class of ख्ṣअत्रियs, Uṇ. iv, 51.…

शिम्.en: (= √ 1. शम्) cl. 4. P. शि/म्यति, to cut up, prepare (a sacrificial victim), TS.; Kāṭh.

शिम.en: शि/म m. a cutter up or preparer (of sacrificial food), TS.

शिरस्.en: शि/रस् n. (prob. originally शरस् = करस्; and connected with करङ्क, q.v.) the head, skull (acc. with √ दा, ‘to give up one's head i.e. life’; with √ धृ, or √ वह्, ‘to hold up one's head, be proud’; with Caus. of √ वृत् or with उप-√ स्था, ‘to hold out the head’, ‘acknowledge one's self guilty’, see SiropasTAyin; instr. with √ ग्रह्, √ धा, √ धृ, वि-√ धृ, √ भृ, √ वह्, or √ कृ, ‘to hold or carry or place on the head, receive deferentially’; instr. with √ गम्, अभि-√ गम्, प्र-√ ग्रह्, √ या, प्र-णम् [√ नम्], नि-√ पत्, प्र-णि-√ पत्, ‘to touch with the head, bow or fall down before’; loc. with √ कृ or नि-√ धा, ‘to place on one's head’; loc. with √ स्था, ‘to be on or stand over a person's head, stand far above [gen.]’), RV. &c. &c. · the upper end or highest part of anything, top, peak, summit, pinnacle, acme, MBh.; Kāv. &c.…

शिर.en: 1. शिर m. = शिरस्, the head, MBh.; Pañcar. &c. · the root of Piper Longum, L. (v.l. सिर)… · Betula Bhojpatra, L.… · a Boa, L.… · a bed, couch, L.… · 2. शिर in comp. for शिरस्.…

शिरःकपाल.en: शिरः—कपाल n. ‘head-bowl’, the skull, MBh.; Hariv.; Suśr.

शिरस्य.en: 1. शिरस्य Nom. P. ˚यति = शिर इच्छति, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 61, Sch. · 2. शिरस्य mfn. = शिर इव, g. SAKAdi… · belonging to or being on the head (= शीर्षण्य), Pāṇ. vi, 1, 61, Vārtt. 2, Pat.… · m. ‘the hair of the head’, or ‘clean hair’, L.…

शिरोमुख.en: शिरो—मुख n. sg. the head and face, ĀśvGṛ.

शिरोरोग.en: शिरो—रोग m. any disease of the head, Suśr.

शिरोव्रत.en: शिरो—व्रत n. a partic. religious observance, MuṇḍUp.

शिरि.en: m. (only L.; cf. Uṇ. iv, 142) a murderer, killer · a sword… · an arrow… · a locust.…

शिल.en: 1. शिल m. (L. also n.; for 2. See col. 2) gleaning, gathering stalks or ears of corn (accord. to Kull. on Mn. x, 112 शिल = aneka-DAnyonnayana i.e. ‘gleaning more than one ear of corn at a time’, opp. to उञ्छ = ekEka-DAnyAdi-guqakoccayana), Mn.; MBh. &c. · m. N. of a son of फ्āर्य्āत्र, Ragh.… · 2. शिल (for 1. See col. 1), in comp. for शिला.…

शिलक.en: m. N. of a man, ChUp.

शिला.en: / f. (perhaps connected with √ 1. शि) a stone, rock, crag, AV. &c. &c. · red arsenic, Suśr.… · camphor, L.… · the lower mill-stone, L.… · the lower timber of a door, L.… · the top of the pillar supporting a house, L.… · a vein, tendon (for शिर, q.v.), L.… · N. of a river, R.… · of a woman, Cat.…

शिलाघन.en: शिला—घन mfn. firm or hard as a stone or rock, Ragh.

शिलापुत्र.en: शिला—पुत्र m. ‘a little rock’, a grindstone, L. · a torso, KapS.…

शिलापुत्रक.en: शिला—पुत्रक m. a grindst˚, MW. · a torso, BṛĀrUp., Sch.…

शिलि.en: m. Betula Bhojpatra, L. · f. the lower timber of a door, W.…

शिलिन.en: m. N. of a man, ŚBr., Sch.

शिल्प.en: शि/ल्प n. (of doubtful derivation) the art of variegating, variegated or diversified appearance, decoration, ornament, artistic work, VS.; Br.; Hariv.; Kathās.; BhP. · any manual art or craft, any handicraft or mechanical or fine art (64 such arts or crafts, sometimes called बाह्य-कला, ‘external or practical arts’, are enumerated, e.g. carpentering, architecture, jewellery, farriery, acting, dancing, music, medicine, poetry &c. [cf. IW. 185]; and 64 अभ्यन्तर-कला, ‘secret arts’ e.g. kissing, embracing, and various other arts of coquetry), ŚāṅkhBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.… · skill in any art or craft or work of art, ingenuity, contrivance, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · any act or work (also m.), BhP.… · ceremonial act, ceremony, rite (also m.), MW.… · form, shape, Naigh. iii, 7 (cf. सु-शिल्प)…

शिल्पा.en: शि/ल्पा (आ), f. a barber's shop, L.

शिव.en: / mf(आ/)n. (according to Uṇ. i, 153, fr. √ 1. शी, ‘in whom all things lie’; perhaps connected with √ श्वि cf. शवस्, शिश्वि) auspicious, propitious, gracious, favourable, benign, kind, benevolent, friendly, dear (˚व/म् ind. kindly, tenderly), RV. &c. &c. · happy, fortunate, BhP.… · / m. happiness, welfare (cf. n.), R. v, 56, 36… · / m. liberation, final emancipation, L.… · ‘The Auspicious one’, N. of the disintegrating or destroying and reproducing deity (who constitutes the third god of the <ns>Hindū</ns> थ्रिम्ūर्ति or Triad, the other two being भ्रह्म्ā ‘the creator’ and Vइṣṇउ ‘the preserver’; in the Vएद the only N. of the destroying deity was णुद्र ‘the terrible god’, but in later times it became usual to give that god the euphemistic N. Śइव ‘the auspicious’ [just as the Furies were called Εὐμενίδες ‘the gracious ones’], and to assign him the office of creation and reproduction as well as dissolution; in fact the preferential worship of Śइव as developed in the फुर्āṇअs and Epic poems led to his being identified with the Supreme Being by his exclusive worshippers [called Śअइवs]; in his character of destroyer he is sometimes called ख्āल ‘black’, and is the……

शिशिरा.en: (आ), f. a partic. drug (= रेणुका), L. · a kind of Cyperus, L.…

शिशु.en: शि/शु m. (fr. √ 1. शू = श्वि) a child, infant, the young of any animal (as a calf, puppy &c.; also applied to young plants, and to the recently risen sun; often ifc.), RV. &c. &c.<listinfo n="sup"/> · a boy under eight years of age, W.… · a lad under sixteen, ib.… · a pupil, scholar, ib.… · N. of श्कन्द, MBh.; R. श्राद्ध.en: mf(ई)n. (fr. श्रद्-धा) faithful, true, loyal, believing, HPariś.; SaddhP. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 2, 101) · relating to a Śर्āद्द्ह ceremony, Cat.… · n. a ceremony in honour and for the benefit of dead relatives observed with great strictness at various fixed periods and on occasions of rejoicing as well as mourning by the surviving relatives (these ceremonies are performed by the daily offering of water and on stated occasions by the offering of फिṇḍअs or balls of rice and meal [see पिण्ड] to three paternal and three maternal forefathers i.e. to father, grandfather, and great grandfather; it should be borne in mind that a Śर्āद्द्ह is not a funeral ceremony [antyezwi] but a supplement to such a ceremony; it is an act of reverential homage to a deceased person performed by relatives, and is moreover supposed to supply the dead with strengthening nutriment after the performance of the previous funeral ceremonies has endowed them with eth……

ष.en: 1. ष the second of the three sibilants (it belongs to the cerebral class, and is sometimes substituted for स्, and more rarely for श्, and occasionally interchangeable with ख्; in sound it corresponds to sh in the English word shun; many roots which begin with स् are written in the ध्ह्āतु-प्āṭह with ष्, prob. to show that their initial स् is liable to be cerebralized after certain prepositions). · 2. ष mfn. (only L.; for 3. ष See below) best, excellent… · wise, learned… · m. loss, destruction… · loss of knowledge… · end, term… · rest, remainder… · eternal happiness, final emancipation… · heaven, paradise… · sleep… · a learned man, teacher… · a nipple… · = कच… · = मानव… · = सर्व… · = गर्भविमोचन… · n. the embryo… · (accord. to some) patience, endurance.… · 3. ष mfn. = षष् ifc. (in पञ्च-ष, q.v.)…

Pāṇ. vii, 1, 75; there occurs also nom. acc. du. सक्थ्यौ/ [RV. x, 86, 16; AV. vi, 9, 1] formed fr. a fem. base सक्थी/), the thigh, thigh-bone · the pole or shafts of a cart (du. euphemistically ‘the female organ’), RV.; &c.…

सगर.en: 1. स/—गर (स/-), mfn. (for 2. &c. See below) accompanied by praise (fr. गर, √ 1. गॄ; said of the fires), VS. (Sch.; accord. to others, ‘swallowing’, ‘devouring’, fr. गर, √ 2. गॄ). · 2. स-गर mfn. (fr. 7. स + गर, ‘poison’, √ 2. गॄ; for 1. स-गर See above) containing poison, poisonous (n. ‘poisonous food’), R.; BhP.… · स-गर m. ‘provided with moisture’, the atmosphere, air, RV.; TS.; Kāṭh. (cf. Naigh. i, 3)… · N. of a king of the solar race, sovereign of आयोद्ह्य्ā (son of भ्āहु; he is said to have been called श-गर, as born together with a poison given to his mother by the other wife of his father; he was father of आसमñज by खेśइन्ī and of sixty thousand sons by शु-मति; the latter were turned into a heap of ashes by the sage खपिल [see भगीरथ], and their funeral ceremonies could only be performed by the waters of घṅग्ā to be brought from heaven for the purpose of purifying their remains <pb n="1125,2"/>; this was finally accomplished by the devotion of भ्हग्īरत्ह, who having led the river to the sea, called it श्āगर in honour of his ancestor: शगर is described as having subdued the Śअकs, ञवनs, and other barbarous tribes; pl. ‘the sons of शगर’), MBh.; R. &c. (IW. 361)…

सगु.en: स—गु mfn. along with cows, ĀpŚr.

(pr. p. of √ 1. अस्) being, existing, occurring, happening, being present (सतो मे, ‘when I was present’; often connected with other participles or with an adverb, e.g. नाम्नि कृते सति, ‘when the name has been given’; तथा सति, ‘if it be so’; also ibc., where sometimes = ‘possessed of’, cf. सत्-कल्पवृक्ष), RV. &c. &c. · abiding in (loc.), MBh.… · belonging to (gen.), ŚBr.… · living, MuṇḍUp.… · lasting, enduring, Kāv.; RV. &c. &c.… · real, actual, as any one or anything ought to be, true, good, right (तन् न सत्, ‘that is not right’), beautiful, wise, venerable, honest (often in comp. सनातन.en: सनात/न mf(ई, m.c. also आ)n. eternal, perpetual, permanent, everlasting, primeval, ancient, ŚBr. &c. &c. · सनात/न m. N. of भ्रह्म्ā, L.… · of Vइṣṇउ, Bhaṭṭ.… · of Śइव, L.… · a guest of deceased ancestors, one who must always be fed whenever he attends Śर्āद्द्हs, L.… · N. of a Ṛṣइ (in MBh. and later ‘a mind-born son of भ्रह्म्ā’), TS. &c. &c.… · of a king, Buddh.… · (with शर्मन् and गो-स्वामिन्) of two authors, Cat.… · सनात/न m. pl. N. of partic. worlds, Hariv.…

सनाय.en: Nom. P. ˚यति (only in dat. sg. of pr. p. सनायते/ [accord. to some w.r. for स/नाय ते] RV. i, 62, 13) ‘to be from of old’ or ‘linger, tarry’.

सनग.en: स/नग m. N. of a teacher (of. सनक), ŚBr.

सनन्द.en: स-नन्द m. (i.e. 7. स + न्˚) = सनन्दन, BhP.

सनन्दन.en: स—नन्दन m. ‘having joy’, N. of one of the 4 or 7 mind-born sons of भ्रह्म्ā (said to have preceded खपिल as teachers of the श्āṃक्ह्य phil.; cf. सनक), MBh.; Hariv.; Pur. · of a pupil of Śअṃकर्āच्āर्य and another author, Cat.…

सनाभ.en: स—नाभ m. a near kinsman, uterine brother, BhP.

सनाभि.en: स/—नाभि (स/-), mfn. having the same nave or centre (as the spokes of a wheel or the fingers of the hand), RV. (cf. Naigh. ii, 5) · connected by the same navel or womb, uterine, of kindred blood, a blood-relation… · स/—नाभि m. f. an uterine brother or sister (accord. to some = स-पिण्ड, ‘a kinsman as far as the seventh degree’), RV.; AV.; Mn.; BhP.… · स/—नाभि m. having a navel, naveled, TS.… · resembling, like, equal to (gen. or comp.), Bālar.; Vcar.; Vās.…

सनाम.en: स—नाम mf(आ)n. having the same name as (gen.), MBh.

सनाल.en: स—नाल mfn. furnished with a stalk, MBh.

सनियम.en: स—नियम mf(आ)n. restricted, limited (-त्व n.), Kap. · one who has undertaken a religious observance, Vikr.; Kir.…

सनारु.en: m. N. of a teacher, ŚBr.

सन्त.en: m. = संह-तल, L. · N. of a son of शत्य, MBh.…

संतोष्टव्य.en: सं-˚तोष्टव्य mfn. to be satisfied or gratified (n. impers.), Śaṃk.; Sarvad.

संनिकर्ष.en: सं-निकर्ष m. drawing near or together, approximation, close contact, nearness, neighbourhood, proximity, vicinity (ए, ‘in the vicinity of, near’, with gen. or comp.; आत्, ‘from the neighbourhood or proximity of’), Nir.; GṛŚrS.; MBh. &c. (-ता f., Kusum.) · connection with, relation to, (in phil.) the connection of an ईन्द्रिय or organ of sense with its Vइṣअय or object (this accord. to the ङ्य्āय, is the source of ज्ञान, and is of two kinds, 1. लौकिक, which is sixfold, 2. अ-लौकिक, which is threefold, MW.), Śaṃk.; Sarvad.… · a receptacle, repository, BhP.… · सं-निकर्ष mfn. near, at hand, Hariv.…

संनिकृष्ट.en: सं-निकृष्ट mfn. drawn together or near, contiguous, proximate, near, imminent, MBh.; R. &c. · one who takes up the same or a similar position, Kathās.… · सं-निकृष्ट n. nearness, vicinity (˚ष्टे ind. ‘in the neighbourhood of’, with gen. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.…

संनिकृष्टे.en: सं-निकृष्टे ind., ‘in the neighbourhood of’, with gen. or comp.

संनिधा.en: सं-नि-√ धा P. Ā. -दधाति, -धत्ते, to put or place down near together, put down near or into, deposit in (loc.), place or put upon, direct towards (with or without दृष्टिम्, ‘to fix the eyes upon’; with मनस्, or हृदयम्, ‘to fix or direct the mind or thoughts’), TS. &c. &c.; <div n="to"/>to place together, collect, pile up, MBh.; <div n="to"/> (Ā.) to appoint to (loc.), PraśnUp.; <div n="to"/> (Ā.) to be present in, be found with (loc.), Daś.; <div n="to"/> (Ā. or Pass. -धीयते) to be put together in the same place, be near or present or imminent, Kāv.; Kathās. &c.: <div n="vp"/>Caus. -धापयति, to bring near, make present or manifest, represent, BhP. : <div n="vp"/>Pass. of Caus. -धाप्यते, to appear or become manifested in the presence of (gen.), ib.

संनिधान.en: सं-निधान n. juxtaposition, nearness, vicinity, presence (ए, with gen. or ifc., ‘in the presence of, near’; आत्, with gen., ‘from [one's presence]’; ˚न-तस् ifc. ‘towards’), R.; Hariv. &c. · presence = existence (cf. अ-स्˚), Rājat.… · placing down, depositing, W.… · a place of deposit, receptacle, gathering-place, rallying-point, MBh.; Bhartṛ.; BhP.… · receiving, taking charge of ib.…

संनिधि.en: सं-निधि m. depositing together or near, KātyŚr.; Sāh. · juxtaposition, nearness, vicinity, presence (औ, with gen. or ifc., ‘in the presence of, near’; इम्, ‘near to, towards’; id., with √ कृ, वि-√ धा or √ बन्ध् and loc., ‘to take one's seat or place or abode in’), ĀśvŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.… · visibility, existence (cf. अ-स्˚), Kusum.… · receiving, taking charge of W.…

संनिहित.en: सं-निहित mfn. deposited together or near, contiguous, proximate, present, close, near, at hand, MuṇḍUp.; MBh. &c. · deposited, fixed, laid up (see हृदय-स्˚)… · prepared to, ready for (dat.), Śak.… · staying, being, W.… · सं-निहित m. a partic. आग्नि, MBh.…

संनिपत्य.en: सं-˚निपत्य ind. having flown or fallen down &c. · immediately, directly (see comp.)…

संनिपात.en: सं-निपात m. falling in or down together, collapse, meeting, encounter, contact or collision with (instr.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · conjunction, aggregation, combination, mixture, Prāt.; ŚrS.; MBh. &c.… · (also with मैथुने) sexual intercourse with (loc.), Āpast.; MBh.… · a complicated derangement of the three humours or an illness produced by it, Suśr.… · a partic. manner of wrestling, VP.… · falling down, descent (see लक्षण-स्˚)… · utter collapse, death, destruction, MBh.… · (in astron.) a partic. conjunction of planets, VarBṛS.… · (in music) a kind of measure, Saṃgīt.…

संनिभ.en: सं-निभ mfn. like, similar, resembling (ifc.; often pleonastically with names of colours, e.g. pItAruRa-s˚ = pItAruRa), MBh.; Kāv. &c.

संनिविष्ट.en: सं-निविष्ट mfn. seated down together, encamped, assembled, MBh.; R.; Kathās. · fixed in or on, sticking or resting or contained in (loc. or comp.), Up.; MBh. &c.… · being on (a road or path loc.), MBh.; R.… · dependent on (loc.), R.… · entered deeply into, absorbed or engrossed in MW.… · contiguous, neighbouring, present, at hand, W.…

संनिवेश.en: सं-निवेश m. entering or sitting down together, entrance into, settlement (acc. with √ कृ or वि-√ धा, ‘to take up a position, settle down’), Kāv.; Suśr. · seat, position, situation (ifc. ‘situated in or on’), Suśr.; Kālid.; Vās.… · station, encampment, abode, place, Kāv.; Kathās.… · vicinity, W.… · an open place or play-ground in or near a town (where people assemble for recreation), L.… · assembling together, assembly, crowd, Prasannar.… · causing to enter, putting down together, W.… · insertion, inclusion, Hcat.… · attachment to any pursuit, MW.… · impression (of a mark; see लक्षण-स्˚)… · foundation (of a town), Cat.… · putting together, fabrication, construction, composition, arrangement, Kāv.; Pur.; Sāh.… · Construction personified (as son of थ्वṣṭṛ and णचन्ā), BhP.…

संन्यस्.en: सं-न्य्-√ अस् P. -अस्यति (rarely -असति), to, throw down together, place or put or lay together, ŚBr.; <div n="to"/>to impose, put or lay upon, intrust or commit to (gen. or loc.), Mn.; MBh. &c.; <div n="to"/>to put or lay down, deposit, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; <div n="to"/>to lay aside, give up, abandon, resign (esp. the world i.e. become an ascetic or शṃन्य्āसिन्), Mn.; MBh. &c.

संन्यसन.en: सं-न्यसन n. throwing down, laying aside, giving up, resignation, renunciation of worldly concerns, Bhag.

संन्यस्त.en: सं-न्यस्त mfn. thrown down, laid aside, relinquished, abandoned, deserted, MBh.; Kāv. &c. · encamped, R.… · deposited, intrusted, consigned, ib.…

संन्यास.en: सं-न्यास m. (ifc. f(आ). ) putting or throwing down, laying aside, resignation, abandonment of (gen. or comp.), MBh.; R.; Sarvad. · renunciation of the world, profession of asceticism, Mn.; MBh. &c.… · abstinence from food, L.… · giving up the body, sudden death, W.… · complete exhaustion, Suśr.… · deposit, trust, R.; Mṛcch.… · contract, agreement, Kathās.… · stake, wager, MBh.… · Indian spikenard, L.…

संन्यासिन्.en: सं-न्यासिन् mfn. laying aside, giving up, abandoning, renouncing, AṣṭāvS. · abstaining from food, Bhaṭṭ.… · सं-न्यासिन् m. one who abandons or resigns worldly affairs, an ascetic, devotee (who has renounced all earthly concerns and devotes himself, to meditation and the study of the Āरṇयकs or ऊपनिṣअदs, a <ns>Brāhman</ns> in the fourth Āśरम [q.v.] or stage of his life, a religious mendicant; cf. RTL. 53, 55 &c.), Up.; MBh.; Pur.…

संन्यासित्व.en: सं-न्या˚सि-त्व n. abandonment of worldly concerns, retirement from the world, MW.

सप.en: स/प m. (cf. शे/प and प/सस्) the male organ of generation, TBr.; ĀśvŚr.; MaitrS.

सपर्य.en: 1. सपर्य Nom. P. ˚य/ति (prob. fr. a lost noun सपर्), to serve attentively, honour, worship, adore, RV.; AV.; <div n="to"/>to offer or dedicate reverentially, RV. x, 37, 1; <div n="to"/>to accept kindly, Kauś. · 2. सपर्य^ mfn. (of doubtful meaning), RV. x, 106, 5…

सपत्न.en: स—प/त्न See s.v. · स-प/त्न m. (fr. 1. स-प/त्नी below) a rival, adversary, enemy, RV.; &c.…

सपर.en: स—पर n. a partic. high number, MBh.

सपरिकर.en: स—परिकर and स—परिक्रम, mfn. attended by a retinue, Pañcat.

सपरिश्रय.en: स/—परिश्रय (स/-), mfn. with an enclosure, ŚBr.

सपलाश.en: स—पलाश mf(आ)n. = -पर्ण, AitBr.; GṛŚrS. · together with a फल्āśअ tree, MW.…

सपिण्ड.en: स—पिण्ड &c. See s.v. · स-पिण्ड m. ‘having the same फिṇḍअ’, a kinsman connected by the offering of the फिṇḍअ (q.v.) to certain deceased ancestors at the Śर्āद्द्ह (q.v.; the kinship is through six generations in an ascending and descending line, or through a man's father, father's father, father's grandfather; mother, mother's father, mother's grandfather; son, son's son, son's grandson; daughter, daughter's son &c.; and also includes father's mother, father's grandmother &c., also father's brothers and sisters, mother's brothers and sisters, and several others), GṛŚrS.; Gaut.; Mn. v, 60; MBh. &c. (RTL. 285; 286 IW. 248; 266).…

सपुत्र.en: स—पुत्र mf(आ)n. having (or accompanied by) a son or children (also said of animals), ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c. · adorned with child-like figures, Hariv.…

सपुरुष.en: स—पुरुष mfn. together with men or followers, PañcavBr.

सपुष्प.en: स—पुष्प mfn. having (or adorned with) flowers, flowering, Viṣṇ.; Kāv.

सपूर्व.en: स—पूर्व mf(आ)n. along with the preceding (letter or sound), TPrāt. · having or possessed by ancestors, Rājat.…

सप्रतिष्ठ.en: स/—प्रतिष्ठ (स/-), mfn. together with the receptacle, ŚBr.

सप्रत्यय.en: स—प्रत्यय mf(आ)n. having trust or confidence, trusting in (loc.), Kāv.; Kathās. · certain, secure, sure (with वृत्ति f. ‘sure means of subsistence’), MBh.… · = next, MW.…

सप्रपञ्च.en: स—प्रपञ्च mfn. with all belonging thereto or connected therewith, BhP.

सप्रभ.en: स—प्रभ mfn. having the same lustre or appearance (-त्व n.), MBh.; VarBṛS. · possessing splendour, brilliant, MW.…

सप्रभाव.en: स—प्रभाव mf(आ)n. possessing power or might, powerful, Kathās.

सप्रभृति.en: स—प्रभृति mfn. beginning in the same, way · स—प्रभृति m. the same or a like beginning, PañcavBr.; ŚāṅkhBr. (cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 84).…

सप्रमाण.en: स—प्रमाण mf(आ)n. having proof or evidence, authentic, MW. · having the law on one's side, having a right or title, entitled, R.…

सप्रसाद.en: स—प्रसाद mfn. accompanied with favour or kindness, propitious, gracious (अम् ind.), Kād.; Pañcat.; Kathās.

सप्राण.en: sa/—prARa (स/-), mfn. having breath, living, TS.; R.; BhP.

सप्त.en: ifc. (cf. त्रि-षप्त/, त्रि-सप्त/) and in comp. for सप्त/न्, seven · mfn. = ˚तम/, L.… · m. N. of Vइṣṇउ, Viṣṇ. iii, 44 (where सप्त महा-भाग may be two words; cf. सप्त-महा-भ्˚).…

सप्तदश.en: सप्त—दश/ mf(ई)n. the 17th, ŚBr.; ĀśvGṛ.; VarBṛS. &c. · connected with 17, plus 17 ŚBr.… · consisting of 17 TS.; VS.; Br. &c.… · connected with or analogous to a श्तोम which has 17 parts, TBr.; VS.; ĀśvŚr.… · having 17 attributes (said of a कुल or family), MW.… · pl. 17 (= -दशन्), MBh.… · सप्त—दश/ m. (scil. स्तोम) a श्तोम having 17 parts, VS.; TS.; Br.; ĀśvŚr.… · N. of a collection of hymns, MW.… · सप्त—दश/ n. a group or collection of 17 ŚrS.… · N. of a श्āमन्, VP.…

सप्तदशक.en: सप्त—दशक mfn. consisting of 17 (संख्याने ˚शक, ‘supposing the number to be 17’), BhP.

सप्तद्वीपा.en: सप्त—द्वीपा f. N. of the earth, MW.

सप्तपद.en: सप्त/—पद (˚त/-), mf(आ)n. making the 7 steps (described above), AV.; PārGṛ. · consisting of 7 फ्āदs, TS.; Br. &c.…

सप्तमातृ.en: सप्त/—मातृ (˚त/-), mfn. having 7 mothers, RV. · सप्त/—मातृ f. collective N. of the 7 mothers, L.…

सप्तविध.en: सप्त/—विध (˚त/-), mf(आ)n. 7-fold, of 7 kinds, ŚBr.; MaitrUp.; Śulbas. &c. (˚ध/ता f., ŚBr.)

सप्तह.en: सप्त—ह n. N. of a श्āमन् (also with जमद्-अग्नेस्), Br.

सप्ताङ्ग.en: saptANga mfn. consisting of 7 members or parts, Up.; Mn. &c.

सप्तार्चि.en: saptArci m. fire (= next), R.; MārkP.

सप्तति.en: / f. 70 (with the counted noun in apposition or in gen. pl. or ibc. or ifc.), RV.; AV.; ŚrS. &c.; 70 years, Mn.; Suśr. · N. of wk. (= सांख्यकारिका)… · du. 2 seventies, W.… · pl. many sev˚, ib.…

सप्तधा.en: / ind. in 7 parts, 7-fold, TS. &c. &c.; 7 times, Ragh.

सप्तम.en: / mf(ई/)n. the 7th, VS.; TS.; ŚBr. &c. · [cf. Zd. haptatha; Gk. ἕβδομος; Lat. septimus; Lith. sèkma-s; Slav. sedmǔ &c.]…

सप्तमी.en: (ई), f., see below. · f. (of सप्तम/ above) the 7th थित्हि or lunar day of the fortnight (on which day in the light fortnight there is a festival in honour of the 7th digit, of the moon; often ifc. See गङ्गा-स्˚, जयन्तीस्˚), ŚrS.; MBh.; VarBṛS. &c.… · the 7th case i.e. the locative or its terminations, Nir.; VPrāt. &c.… · the potential or its terminations, Kāt.… · a partic. ंūर्च्हन्ā, Saṃgīt.…

सप्तल.en: m. N. of a man g. naqAdi

सफ.en: स-फ mfn. (7. स + फ) together with the sound or letter फ् (-त्व n.), TāṇḍBr. · स-फ m. N. of various men, ĀrṣBr.… · स-फ n. N. of various श्āमन्s, (-त्व n.), ib. &c.…

सफल.en: स-फल mf(आ)n. together with fruits, having or bearing fruit or seed, fruitful (as a tree), PārGṛ.; MBh.; Kathās. · ‘having seed’ i.e. possessing testicles, not emasculated, R.… · having good results, productive, profitable, successful (with √ कृ, ‘to fulfil’, ‘keep a promise’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · together with the result, VarBṛS.…

सबल.en: स/—बल (स/-), mfn. powerful, strong, RV. &c. &c. · together with strength or power, L.… · accompanied by a force or army, MBh.; R.… · together with भल (ख्ṛṣṇअ's eldest brother), BhP.… · स/—बल m. N. of a son of ंअनु भ्हउत्य, Hariv.… · of a son of Vअसिṣṭह (and one of the 7 Ṛṣइs), MārkP.… · of one of the 7 Ṛṣइs under ंअनु श्āवर्ṇअ, ib.…

सबीज.en: स—बीज mf(आ)n. with seed or germ (lit. and fig.), containing seed or germ (-त्व n.), MBh.; Kap.; VP.

सभय.en: स—भय mf(आ)n. fearful, apprehensive (अम् ind.), Kāv.; Kathās. &c. · riskful, dangerous, Lalit.…

सभाग.en: स—भाग mfn. (for सभा-ग See under सभा) having a share (see comp.) · common, universal, Buddh.… · corresponding, answering, ib.… · सभा—ग/ mfn. (for स-भाग See above) going into an assembly or council, ŚBr.; ChUp.…

सभूत.en: स—भूत mfn. attended by demons, Kum.

सभा.en: / f. (of unknown derivation, but probably to be connected with 7. स; ifc. also सभ, n.; cf. Pāṇ. ii, 4, 23 &c., and एक-सभ/) an assembly, congregation, meeting, council, public audience, RV. &c. &c. · social party, society, good society (see comp.)… · Society (personified as a daughter of फ्रज्āपति), AV.… · a place for public meetings, large assembly-room or hall, palace, court of a king or of justice, council-chamber, gambling-house &c., ib.… · a house for lodging and accommodating travellers, Mn.; MBh.; &c.; an eating-house (see महा-स्˚).… · [cf. Goth. sibja; Germ. sippa, Sippe; Angl.Sax. sibb; Eng. god-sib, gossip.]…

सम्.en: 1. सम् or स्तम् cl. 1. P. समति or स्तमति, to be disturbed (accord. to some ‘to be undisturbed’; cf. √ शम्), Dhātup. xix, 82; <div n="to"/> cl. 10. P. समयति or स्तमयति, to be agitated or disturbed, Vop. · 2. स/म् ind. (connected with 7. स and 2. सम, and opp. to 3. वि, q.v.) with, together with, along with, together, altogether (used as a preposition or prefix to verbs and verbal derivatives, like Gk. σύν, Lat. con, and expressing ‘conjunction’, ‘union’, ‘thoroughness’, ‘intensity’, ‘completeness’ e.g. सं√ युज्, ‘to join together’; सं-√ धा, ‘to place together’; सं-धि, ‘placing together’; सं-√ तप्, ‘to consume utterly by burning’; सम्-उच्छेद, ‘destroying altogether, complete destruction’; in Ved. the verb connected with it has sometimes to be supplied, e.g. आ/पो अग्नि/म् यश/सः स/ं हि/ पूर्वी/ः, ‘for many glorious waters surrounded आग्नि’; it is sometimes prefixed to nouns in the sense of 2. सम, ‘same’; cf. समर्थ), RV. &c.;…

सम.en: 1. सम mfn. (connected with 7. स and with 2. सम/ and समान; cf. समह, used as pron.: declined like सर्व, e.g. समस्मै, RV. vi, 51, 6) any, every, RV. · [cf. Gk. ἁμός, ἀμός; Goth. suma; Angl.Sax. sum; Eng. some.]… · 2. सम/ mf(आ/)n. (prob. originally identical with prec.; cf. समान) even, smooth, flat, plain, level, parallel (कर्ण-स्˚, ‘on a level with the ear’; भूमि- or भूमेः समं-√ कृ, ‘to make level with the earth’), RV. &c. &c.… · same, equal, similar, like, equivalent, like to or identical or homogeneous with (instr., e.g. मया सम, ‘like to me’; or gen., rarely abl.), like in or with regard to anything (instr. gen. loc., or -तस्, or comp.; समं-√ कृ, ‘to make equal, balance’), ib.… · always the same, constant, unchanged, fair, impartial towards (loc. or gen.), ib.…

समा.en: , (आ), f. a year, see समा p. 1153 · स/मा f. (of 2. सम above) a year, RV. &c. &c. (also सम n. in पाप-स/म, पुण्य-स्˚, सु-ष/म)… · a half-year, AV.… · season, weather, AitBr.; Kauś.; Nir.… · a day, MW.… · See p. 1153, col. 2.…

समम्.en: सम/म् (अ/म्), ind. in like manner, alike, equally, similarly, RV. &c. &c. · together with or at the same time with or in accordance with (instr. or comp.), ŚBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.… · just, exactly, precisely, Mn.; VarBṛS.; BhP.… · honestly, fairly, R.… · 1. समम् &c. See 2. सम, p. 1152.… · 2. सम्-√ अम् Ā. -अमते, to ask eagerly, solicit, win over, RV.; <div n="to"/>to fix or settle firmly, ib.; <div n="to"/>to ally or connect one's self with, AV.…

समकाल.en: सम—काल m. the same time or moment, W.

Ā. -दधाति, -धत्ते, to place or put or hold or fix together, ŚBr.; MBh. &c.; <div n="to"/>to compose, set right, repair, put in order, arrange, redress, restore, MBh.; Hit.; <div n="to"/>to put to, add, put on (esp. fuel on the fire), AV.; ŚBr.; R.; <div n="to"/>to kindle, stir (fire), ŚBr.; <div n="to"/>to place, set, lay, fix, direct, settle, adjust (with अस्त्रम्, ‘to adjust an arrow’; with गर्भम्, ‘to impregnate’; with सवितुः, ‘to lay in the sun’; with दृष्टिम्, चित्तम्, चेतस्, मतिम्, मनस्, ‘to direct or fix the eyes or mind upon [loc.]’; with मतिम्, ‘to settle in one's mind, resolve’, ‘make up one's mind’ [followed by इति]; with आत्मानम्, or मनस्, ‘to collect the thoughts or concentrate the mind in meditation &c.’; without an acc. = ‘to be absorbed in meditation or prayer…

समाधि.en: सम्-आधि m. putting together, joining or combining with (instr.), Lāṭy. · a joint or a partic. position of the neck, Kir.… · union, a whole, aggregate, set, R.; Hariv.; Ragh.… · completion, accomplishment, conclusion, Kum.… · setting to rights, adjustment, settlement, MBh.… · justification of a statement, proof, Sarvad.… · bringing into harmony, agreement, assent, W.; RPrāt.… · intense application or fixing the mind on, intentness, attention (˚धिं-√ कृ, ‘to attend’), MBh.; R. &c.… · concentration of the thoughts, profound or abstract meditation, intense contemplation of any particular object (so as to identify the contemplator with the object meditated upon; this is the eighth and last stage of ञोग [IW. 93]; with <ns>Buddhists</ns> शम्āद्हि is the fourth and last stage of ध्ह्य्āन or intense abstract meditation [MWB. 209]; in the ख्āरṇḍअ-व्य्ūह several S˚ are enumerated), Up.; Buddh.; MBh. &c.…

समाधिस्थ.en: सम्-आधि—स्थ mfn. absorbed in m˚, Pañcat.

समाधित्सु.en: सम्-˚आधित्सु mfn. (fr. id.) wishing to set right or prove, Nyāyas., Sch.

सामग्री.en: f. (fr. सम्-अग्र) totality, entirety, completeness, (esp.) a complete collection or assemblage of implements or materials, apparatus, baggage, goods and chattels, furniture, effects, Rājat.; Kathās.; Sarvad. · a means for (का ते सामग्री, ‘what means have you at your disposal?’), Hit.…

सामञ्जस्य.en: n. (fr. सम्-अञ्जस) fitness, propriety, equity, justice, R. (B.), Sch. (अ-स्˚, Vedāntas., Sch.)

सामन.en: 1. सामन mf(आ)n. (for 2. See under 2. सामन्) rich, affluent, abundant (others ‘common, universal’), RV. iii, 30, 9. · 2. सामन/ mfn. (for 1. See under 1. सामन्) quiet, calm, RV. x, 85, 9.…

सामन्य.en: 1. सामन्य mfn. (for 2. see col. 2) friendly, favourable (in अ-स्˚, q.v.) · 2. सामन्य^ mfn. (for 1. see col. 1) skilful in chanting or singing, RV.; Bhaṭṭ.…

सामय.en: 1. सामय (Nom. fr. सामन् or fr. artificial √ साम्; for 2. sAmaya See col. 3) cl. 10. P. सामयति (aor. अससामत् or असीषमत्), to conciliate, appease, pacify, tranquillize, Dhātup. xxxv, 27. · 2. sAmaya mfn. (for 1. See col. 1) connected with or suffering from disease, Śaṃk.…

सामग.en: साम—ग/ or साम—गा/, m. a <ns>Brāhman</ns> who chants or recites the S˚, RV. &c. &c.;

सामतस्.en: साम—त/स् ind. from or concerning श्āम chants, ŚBr.

सामत्व.en: साम—त्व/ n. state or condition of (being) a S˚, ŚBr.

सामवेद.en: साम—वेद/ m. ‘Vएद of chants’, N. of one of the three principal Vएदs (see वेद) · it contains a number of verses or stanzas nearly all of which [except about 78] occur in the Ṛग्-वेद and which, modified in various ways, are chanted, mostly, by the ऊद्ग्āत्ṛ priests at शोम sacrifices… · the शṃहित्ā of the श्āम-वेद consists of two parts… · the first, called Āर्चिक [or फ्ūर्व्āर्चिक or छ्हन्दो-ग्रन्त्ह], contains 585 verses disjoined from their proper sequence in the Ṛग्-वेद and arranged in 59 धśअतिs or decades, which again are subdivided into फ्रप्āṭहकs and आर्द्ह-प्रप्āṭहकs… · the second, called ऊत्तर्āर्चिक or ऊत्तर्ā-ग्रन्त्ह, contains 1225 verses, also chiefly from the Ṛक्-सṃहित्ā, but less disjointed than in the first part, and arranged in nine फ्रप्āṭहकs with आर्द्ह-प्रप्āṭहकs, mostly, however, grouped in triplets…

सामशब्द.en: साम—शब्द m. the sound of a chanted S˚, Gaut.; GṛS.

साम्न.en: mf(ई)n. relating to श्āमन्s, IndSt. · , ˚नी. See p. 1205, col. 2.…

सामर्थ्य.en: n. (fr. सम्-अर्थ) sameness of aim or object or meaning or signification, belonging or agreeing together (in aim, object &c.), adequacy, accordance, fitness, suitableness, Pat.; Hariv.; Suśr. &c. · the being entitled to, justification for (loc. or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.… · ability to or capacity for (inf. dat. loc., or comp.; acc. with √ कृ, ‘to do one's utmost’; with √ भज्, ‘to take pains’, ‘exert one's self’), ib.… · efficacy, power, strength, force (आत्, or -तस् or -योगात्, ‘through the force of circumstances’, ‘by reason of’, ‘in consequence of’, ‘on account of’, ‘as a matter of course’), ib.… · the force or function or sense of a word, Kusum.…

सामान.en: Vṛद्द्हि form of 2. समान in comp.

सामानाधिकरण्य.en: n. (fr. samAnADikaraRa) common office or function, Hit. · the condition of relating to the same object or residing in the same subject, Sarvad.… · grammatical agreement, identity of case, relation, correlation (opp. to वैयाध्˚), Pāṇ., Sch.…

सामान्य.en: mf(आ)n. equal, alike, similar, MBh.; Śak. · shared by others, joint, common to (instr. with and without सह, or comp.), Yājñ.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.… · whole, entire, universal, general, generic, not specific (opp. to वैशेषिक), Suśr.; VarBṛS.… · common, common-place, vulgar, ordinary, insignificant, low, MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · (अम्), n. equality, similarity, identity, MBh.; Suśr. &c.… · equilibrium, normal state or condition, Nīlak.… · universality, totality, generality, general or fundamental notion, common or generic property (ibc. instr., or abl., ‘in general’, as opp. to विशेष-तस्, ‘in particular’), Kaṇ.; Jaim.; Sarvad.… · public affairs or business, W.… · (in rhet.) the connection of different objects by common properties, Kpr.; Kuval.…

सामान्या.en: (आ), f. a common female, prostitute, L.

सामान्यम्.en: (अम्), ind. after the same manner as, like (comp.), Kālid. · jointly, in general, in common, Mn. vii, 56.…

सामान्यतस्.en: सामान्य—तस् ind. equally, similarly, according to analogy, BhP.; KapS.; Sāṃkhyak. · in general, generally, Kaṇ.; Suśr.; BhP., Sch.…

सामान्यत्व.en: सामान्य—त्व n. the state of generality, Kusum.

सामान्यलक्षण.en: सामान्य—लक्षण n. a generic definition or sign, a definition comprising many individuals, a specific characteristic, W. · N. of various works.…

सामान्यवचन.en: सामान्य—वचन mfn. expressing a common property, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 55 · expressing a general or a wider notion, ib. iii, 4, 5… · सामान्य—वचन n. a substantive (as opp. to its attribute), Sāy.…

सामासिक.en: mf(ई)n. (fr. सम्-आस) comprehensive, concise, succinct, brief, Mn.; BhP. · relating or belonging to a शम्āस or compound word, Pat.… · m. or n. a compound word, Bhag.…

सामि.en: / ind. (g. स्वर्-आदि) too soon, prematurely (with √ मुष्, ‘to steal in anticipation’), MaitrS.; TS.; Br. · incompletely, imperfectly, partially, half (often in comp. with a p.p. Pāṇ. ii, 1, 27), ib. &c. &c.… · [cf. Gk. ἡμι-, ἥμισυς, Lat. sēmi, sēmis.]…

सामीप्य.en: mfn. (fr. समीप) neighbouring, a neighbour, MBh. · n. neighbourhood, nearness, proximity (in space and time), Sāṃkhyak.; Sāh.; BhP.… · nearness to the deity (as one of the four states of beatitude; cf. सालोक्य), MW.…

(fr. सम्-उद्र) relating to the sea, oceanic, marine, Kauś.; Suśr.; MBh. &c., Vāgbh. · declared or related by शमुद्र, MW.… · m. a mariner, voyager, sailor, Yājñ.… · the son of a खरṇअ and a Vअइśय्ā (who lives from the produce of the sea), L.… · a kind of gnat, Suśr.… · patr. of छित्र-सेन, MBh.… · (pl.) N. of a people, R.… · n. sea-salt, Car.… · a cuttle-fish bone, L.… · du. (with अग्नेः) N. of two श्āमन्s, ĀrṣBr.… · m. n. (?) N. of a peculiar kind of rainwater (which falls in the month Āśवयुज or Āśविन), Suśr.… · 2. सामुद्र n. (fr. स-मुद्र) an impression or mark on the body, L.…

साम्पराय.en: mfn. (fr. sam-parAya) required by necessity or calamity, VarYogay. · relating to war or battle, warlike, MW.… · relating to the other world or to the future, ib.… · m. the passage from this world into another, Up.; MBh. &c.… · need, distress, calamity, MBh.… · a helper or friend in need, ib. i, 723 (Nīlak.)… · contention, conflict, Śiś.… · the future, a future life, L.… · inquiry into the future, MW.… · investigation (in general), ib.… · uncertainty, ib.…

साम्प्रत.en: mfn. (fr. सम्-प्रति) seasonable, fit, proper, correct (cf. अ-स्˚), Lāṭy.; Sarvad. · belonging to the present time, present (not past or future) comp.…

साम्य.en: n. (fr. 2. सम) equality, evenness, equilibrium, equipoise, equal or normal state (acc. with √ नी, ‘to bring to that st˚’, ‘calm’), MBh.; Kāv. &c. · likeness, sameness, identity with (instr. with and without सह, or gen., or loc., or comp.), MuṇḍUp.; MBh. &c.… · equality of rank or position, Mn.; Yājñ.; VarBṛS.… · homogeneousness (of sounds), Vop.… · measure, time, MBh.… · equability towards (loc. or प्रति), impartiality, indifference, Bhag.; Kum.; BhP.… · justice (साम्यम्-√ कृ, ‘to act justly towards [loc.]’), MBh.… · v.l. for शल्या, Kāvyād. i, 39.…

साम्राज्य.en: सा/म्राज्य n. (fr. सम्-राज्) complete or universal sovereignty, empire, dominion over (gen. loc., or comp.), RV. &c. &c. · सा/म्राज्य mfn. relating to sovereignty, TS.… · / (˚ज्य/, m.), a universal sovereign, RV. viii, 25, 17 (accord. to g. कुर्व्-आदि, ‘the son of a un˚ s˚’.)…

साय.en: 1. साय/ n. (prob. fr. √ सो See अवसाय, अवसान; but cf. 2. साय, col. 3) the close of day, evening (सायं-√ कृ, ‘to spend the evening, make a stay’), RV. &c. &c. · Evening personified (as a son of फुṣप्āर्ṇअ and धोṣā or as a son of ध्ह्āत्ṛ and खुह्ū), BhP.… · [cf. accord. to some, Lat. sērus.]… · 2. साय m. सायतन.en: sA/yatana mfn. together with the place of abode &c., TS.

सायुध.en: sAyuDa mf(आ)n. furnished with arms, armed, MBh.

सार.en: 1. सार m. (fr. √ सृ) course, motion (see पूर्व-स्˚) · stretching out, extension, Kālac.… · mfn. driving away, destroying, Bālar. ii, 60/61… · 2. सा/र m. n. (ifc. f(आ). ; perhaps to be connected with 1. सार above; prob. fr. a lost root meaning ‘to be strong’) the core or pith or solid interior of anything, RV. &c. &c.… · firmness, strength, power, energy, AV. &c. &c.… · the substance or essence or marrow or cream or heart or essential part of anything, best part, quintessence (ifc. = ‘chiefly consisting of or depending on &c.’ [cf. पर] e.g. धर्म-सारं जगत्, ‘the world chiefly depends on justice’; तूष्णीं-सार mfn. ‘chiefly silent’; सारत् सारम्, ‘the very best’), AitBr. &c. &c.… · the real meaning, main point, MW.… · a compendium, summary, epitome (often ifc. in titles of books)…

See col. 1.…

सारिणी.en: (इणी), f. a brook, channel, Vcar. · N. of various plants (Alhagi Maurorum, Paederia Foetida &c.), L.…

सार्य.en: mfn. that which may be dropped or omitted (in pronunciation), MāṇḍŚ. · See p. 1208, col. 1.…

सारा.en: सा/रा (आ), f. a kind of plant (= कृष्ण-त्रिवृता), L. · खुśअ grass, L.…

सारी.en: सा/री (ई), f., see under सारि and सारी (next p.) · f. a kind of bird (= सारिका; cf. विट्-स्˚), L.… · a chessman, piece at backgammon &c. (-शरी)… · a kind of plant (= सप्तला), L.… · a frown, L.… · See above.…

सारतम.en: सार—तम mfn. the very best (-त्व n.), Śaṃk. on ChUp.

सारिष्ठ.en: mfn. the very best or most excellent (-त्व n.), Śaṃk. · See p. 1208, col. 3.…

(fr. स-रथ) a charioteer, driver of a car, coachman (forming a mixed caste, commonly called <ns>Sārthī</ns>, and supposed to have sprung from a ख्ṣअत्रिय father and <ns>Brāhman</ns> mother), RV. &c. &c. · any leader or guide (see नौ-, वाक्य-स्˚)… · a helper, assistant (see कर्म-स्˚)… · the son of a शरत्ह (q.v.), MW.… · the ocean, ib.… · N. of a town, Lalit.…

सिन्धु.en: सि/न्धु m. and f. (prob. fr. √ 1. सिध्, ‘to go’) a river, stream (esp. the ईन्दुs, and in this sense said to be the only river regarded as m. See -नद, col. 2), RV. &c. &c. · सि/न्धु m. flood, waters (also in the sky), RV.; AV.… · ocean, sea, RV. &c. &c.… · a symbolical term for the number 4 (cf. 1. समुद्र), Gaṇit.… · N. of Vअरुṇअ (as god of the ocean), MW.… · the moisture of the lips, Kum.… · water ejected from an elephant's trunk (= वमथु), L.… · the exudation from an elephant's temples, L.… · the country around the ईन्दुs (commonly called Sindh; pl. ‘the inhabitants of Sindh’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.… · a king of Sindh (?), Cat.… · N. of Vइṣṇउ, RV.; MBh.… · white or refined borax (= श्वेत-टङ्कण), L.… · = सिन्धुक, L.… · (in music) a partic. ण्āग, Saṃgītas.… · N. of a king of the घन्द्हर्वs, R.…

सिन्धुदेश.en: सिन्धु—देश m. the country of Sindh, Cat.

सिम्.en: 1. सिम् ind. g. cAdi. · 2. सिम् (in Vedic gram.) a technical term for the eight simple vowels (viz. अ, आ, इ, ई, उ, ऊ, ऋ, ॠ).…

सिर.en: m. = 1. शिर, the root of Piper Longum, L.

सिरा.en: f. (fr. √ सृ) a stream, water, RV. i, 121 (cf. Naigh. i, 12; often written शिरा) · any tubular vessel of the body, a nerve, vein, artery, tendon &c., Suśr.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.… · a vein-like channel or narrow stream of river water, VarBṛS.… · lines which cross each other like veins, ib.… · a bucket, baling-vessel, L.…

सिव.en: or सिवक, m. one who sews or stitches, a sewer, stitcher, L.

सेवक.en: . See 2. सेव्˚ s.v. · 1. सेवक mfn. (for 2. See col. 2) dwelling in, inhabiting (comp.), MBh.… · practising, using, employing (comp.), Kāv.; Kathās.… · revering, worshipping (mostly comp.), Yājñ.; BhP.… · m. a servant, attendant, follower, R.; VarBṛS.; Rājat.… · a votary, worshipper, Hariv.; Pañcar.… · 2. सेवक m. (fr. √ सिव्; for 1. सेवक See col. 1) one that sews, a sewer, L.… · a sack, L.…

सेवन.en: . See 2. सेव्˚ s.v. · 1. सेवन n. (for 2. See col. 2) the act of frequenting or visiting or dwelling in or resorting to (comp.), Kāv.; Pañcat.; BhP.… · waiting upon, attendance, service, Mn.; MBh. &c.… · honouring, reverence, worship, adoration (also f(आ). ), Kāv.; VarBṛS. &c.… · sexual enjoyment, intercourse with (comp.), Mn. xi, 178… · devotion or addiction to, fondness for, indulgence in, practise or employment of (gen. or comp.), Mn.; R. &c.… · 2. सेवन n. (for 1. See col. 1) the act of sewing, darning, stitching, Suśr.; Vop.; ĀpŚr., Sch.… · a sack, L.…

सिसृक्षु.en: mfn. wishing to let flow or emit, MBh. · wishing or purposing to create, Mn.; MBh. &c.…

सी.en: 1. सी a word used in learning letters (?), Divyāv. · 2. सी (either invented to account for सीता below or a lost root meaning) ‘to draw a straight line’…

सीता.en: f. (less correctly written शीता; cf. सीम/न्, सीर) a furrow, the track or line of a ploughshare (also personified, and apparently once worshipped as a kind of goddess resembling Pomona; in RV. iv, 57, 6, श्īत्ā is invoked as presiding over agriculture or the fruits of the earth; in VS. xii, 69-72, श्īत्ā ‘the Furrow’ is again personified and addressed, four furrows being required to be drawn at the ceremony when the above stanzas are recited; in TBr. she is called सावित्री, and in PārGṛ. इन्द्र-पत्नी, ‘the wife of ईन्द्र’; in epic poetry S˚ is the wife of ण्āमचन्द्र and daughter of झनक, king of ंइत्हिल्ā, capital of Vइदेह, who was otherwise called श्īरद्ह्वज; she was named श्īत्ā because fabled to have sprung from a furrow made by झनक while ploughing the ground to prepare it for a sacrifice…

सीत्य.en: mfn. ploughed, Pāṇ.; L. · n. corn, grain, L. [cf. prob. Gk. σῖτος].…

सीम्.en: ind. (originally acc. of a pron. base and connected with स as कीम् with क) him, her, it, them (employed for all genders, numbers and persons [cf. इद्; ईम्, and Gk. μιν, νιν]; and often weakened into a generalizing and emphasizing particle, which may become an enclitic particle after a pronoun or preposition, = περ or cunque, often translatable by ‘ever’), RV.

सीम.en: 1. सीम (only in loc. सीमे) a boundary, limit, Inscr. · 2. सीम in comp. for सीमन् (or sometimes a mere shortened form of 1. सीमा).…

सीमा.en: 1. सीमा f. (ifc. f(आ). ) parting of the hair (see सुसीम) · a boundary, landmark, Mn.; MBh. &c.… · rule of morality (see comp.).… · 2. सीमा f. pl. = सिमा, ŚBr., Sch.…

सीर.en: सी/र m. n. (for derivation See सीता) a plough, RV. &c. &c. · सी/र m. an ox for ploughing, draught-ox, Kauś.… · the sun, Nir. ix, 40… · Calotropis Gigantea, L.…

सीस.en: n. (of doubtful derivation) lead (also used as money), VS. &c. &c. · the leaden weight used by weavers, VS.… · mf(आ)n. leaden, of lead, VS.; LāṭyŚr.…

सु.en: 1. सु cl. 1. P. Ā. सवति, ˚ते, to go, move, Dhātup. xxii, 42 (Vop. स्रु). · 2. सु (= √ 1. सू) cl. 1. 2. P. (Dhātup. xxii, 43 and xxiv, 32; सवति, सौति, only in 3. sg. pr. सौति and 2. sg. Impv. सुहि) <div n="to"/>to urge, impel, incite, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; <div n="to"/>to possess supremacy, Dhātup.… · 3. सु cl. 5. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxvii, 1) सुनो/ति, सुनुते (in RV. 3. pl. सुन्व/न्ति, सुन्विरे/ [with pass. sense] and सुष्वति; p. सुन्व/त् or सुन्वान/ [the latter with act. and pass. sense] ib.; pf. सुषाव, सुषुम &c., ib.; MBh.; p. in Vएद सुषुव/स् and सुष्वाण/ [the later generally with pass. sense; accord. to Kāś. on Pāṇ. iii, 2, 106, also सुषुवाण with act. sense]; aor. accord. to Gr. असावीत् or असौषीत्, असोष्ट or असविष्ट; in RV. also Impv. सो/तु, सुत/म्, and p. [mostly pass.] सुवान/ [but the spoken form is स्वान/ and so written in SV., सुव्˚ in RV.]; and 3. pl. असुषवुः, AitBr.; fut. सोता, ib.; सोष्यति, KātyŚr.; सविष्यति, ŚBr.; inf. सो/तवे, सो/तोस्, RV. : Br.; सोतुम् Gr.; ind.p. -सु/त्य, Br.; -सूय, MBh.), <div n="to"/>to press out, extract (esp. the juice from the शोम plant for libations), RV.;……

सुत.en: 1. सुत/ mfn. impelled, urged, ŚBr. · allowed, authorized, ib.… · 2. सुत/ mfn. pressed out, extracted… · / m. (sg. and pl., once n. in ChUp. v, 12, 1) the expressed शोम juice, a शोम libation, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; ChUp.; BhP.… · 3. सुत mfn. begotten, brought forth… · m. (ifc. f(आ). ) a son, child, offspring (सुतौ du. = ‘son and daughter’), Mn.; MBh. &c.… · m. a king, L.… · N. of the 5th astrological house, VarBṛS.… · N. of a son of the 10th ंअनु, Hariv.…

सुता.en: (आ), f. See below. · f. (ifc. f(आ). ) a daughter, Mn.; MBh. &c.… · the plant Alhagi Maurorum, L.…

सुकर.en: सु—क/र mf(आ)n. easy to be done, easy for (gen.) or to (inf.), RV.; Mn. &c. · easy to be managed, tractable (as a horse or cow), L.… · easily achieving, Vop.… · सु—क/र m. a good-natured horse, L.… · सु—क/र (अम्), n. doing good, charity, benevolence, ib.…

सुकरत्व.en: सु—कर—त्व n. easiness, feasibleness, Sarvad.; Nīlak.

सुकृत.en: सु—कृत/ n. a good or righteous deed, meritorious act, virtue, moral merit (-तस् ind.), RV. &c. &c. · a benefit, bounty, friendly aid, favour, R.; Pañcat. &c.… · the world of virtue, heaven, AV.; TS.; TBr.… · fortune, auspiciousness, W.… · reward, recompense, ib.… · mfn. well done or made or formed or executed, RV.… · well arranged, adorned, made good (with मति f. ‘a well-taken resolution’; with अनर्थ m. ‘an evil turned to good’; किम् अत्र सुकृतम् भवेत्, ‘what would be best done here?’), RV. &c. &c.… · treated with kindness, befriended, MW.… · well-conducted, virtuous, fortunate, ib.… · (said to be) = स्वक्˚, TUp.… · सु—कृत/ m. N. of a फ्रज्ā-पति, VP.… · of a son of फ्ṛत्हु, Hariv.…

सुकृता.en: सु—कृता f. N. of a river, VP.

सुकृति.en: सु—कृति f. well-doing, good or correct conduct, Pañcat. · acting in a friendly manner, kindness, MW.… · virtue, ib.… · the practice of religious austerities, ib.… · सु—कृति mfn. righteous, virtuous, Cat.… · सु—कृति m. N. of a son of ंअनु श्व्āरोचिṣअ, Hariv.… · of one of the 7 Ṛṣइs in the 10th ंअन्व्-अन्तर, ib.; BhP.… · of a son of फ्ṛत्हु, VP.…

सुकेशन्.en: सु—केशन् m. N. of a man, PraśnUp.

सुख.en: सु—ख/ &c., see सुख/ s.v. · / mfn. (said to be fr. 5. सु + 3. ख, and to mean originally ‘having a good axle-hole’; possibly a Prākṛt form of सु-स्थ, q.v.; cf. दुःख) running swiftly or easily (only applied to cars or chariots, superl. सुख/-तम), easy, RV.… · pleasant (rarely with this meaning in Vएद), agreeable, gentle, mild (comp. -तर/), VS. &c. &c.… · comfortable, happy, prosperous (= सुखिन्), R.… · virtuous, pious, MW.… · / m. N. of a man g. SivAdi… · (scil. दण्ड) a kind of military array, Kām.… · (अम्), n. ease, easiness, comfort, prosperity, pleasure, happiness (in m. personified as a child of ध्हर्म and शिद्द्हि, MārkP.), joy, delight in (loc.; सुखम्-√ कृ ‘to give pleasure’; महता सुखेन, ‘with great pleasure’), the sky, heaven, atmosphere (cf. 3. ख), L.… · / n. water, Naigh. i, 12…

सुखादि.en: सु—खादि/ mfn. (for suKAdi See p. 1221, col. 3) wearing beautiful bracelets or rings (said of the ंअरुत्s), RV. · suKAdi mfn. (for सुखादि See p. 1220, col. 3) beginning with pleasure, pl˚ &c. (see suKa-duHKAdi).…

सुक.en: सु/क (for शु/क), a parrot, AV. i, 22, 4.

सुखा.en: (आ), f. (in phil.) the effort to win future beatitude, piety, virtue, Tattvas. · (in music) a partic. ंūर्च्हन्ā, Saṃgīt.… · N. of the city of Vअरुṇअ, VP.… · of one of the 9 Śअक्तिs of Śइव, L.…

सुखम्.en: सुख/म् (अ/म्), ind. (also एन, आत्) easily, comfortably, pleasantly, joyfully, willingly (with inf. = ‘easy to’ e.g. स भविष्यति सुखं हन्तुम्, ‘he will be easy to kill’; सुखम् — न पुनर् ‘, rather — than’ e.g. सुखम् असून् अपि संत्यजन्ति न पुनः प्रतिज्ञाम्, ‘they rather renounce life than a promise’; कदली-सुखम्, ‘as easily as a खदल्ī’), VS.; &c.

सुखदुःख.en: सुख—दुःख n. du. pleasure and pain, joy and sorrow, KauṣUp.

सुखदुःखादि.en: suKa—duH˚KAdi mfn. (pl.) pl˚ and p˚ and the other (opposites; see द्वंद्व), Mn. i, 26

सुखप्रसव.en: सुख—प्रसव mfn. bringing (or having brought) forth easily or happily, Śak. (v.l.) · सुख—प्रसव m. = next, Cat.…

सुखप्रसवन.en: सुख—प्रसवन n. easy birth or parturition, Kṛṣṇaj.

सुखप्राप्त.en: suKa—prApta mfn. one who has attained happiness, MW.

सुखरूप.en: सुख—रूप mfn. having an agreeable appearance, Ml.

सुखलव.en: सुख—लव m. a little pleasure, VarBṛS.

सुखश्रव.en: सुख—श्रव mfn. sweetly sounding, pleasant to hear, Ragh.

सुखसङ्ग.en: सुख—सङ्ग m. attachment to pleasure, Bhag.

सुखसाधन.en: सुख—साधन n. means of obtaining pleasure, Bhām.

सुखसाध्य.en: सुख—साध्य mfn. easy to be accomplished or attained, Bhartṛ.; Śaṃk. · easy to be cured, Suśr.… · easy to be conquered or subdued, Hit.…

सुखात्मक.en: suKAtmaka mf(इका)n. consisting of pleasure, MW.

सुखानुभव.en: suKAnuBava m. perception or consciousness of pl˚, W.

सुखार्थ.en: suKArTa m. anything that gives pleasure, Mn. vi, 26

सुखार्थम्.en: suKArTam ind. for the sake of ease or pl˚. (Gaṇit.)

सुखार्ह.en: suKArha mfn. deserving of happiness, VarBṛS.

सुखोपाय.en: suKopAya m. an easy means, BhP. · (एन instr. ‘easily’, ‘without pains or trouble’, Pañcat.)… · suKopAya mf(आ)n. easy to be obtained, Pañcat.…

सुखित.en: mfn. pleased, delighted, comforted (अम् ind.), Kāv.; Kathās. &c. · n. happiness, MW.…

सुखी.en: mfn. (prob.) one who loves pleasure, Vop. iii, 61.

सुख्य.en: 1. सुख्य mfn. belonging to pleasure, pleasurable, MW. · 2. सुख्य Nom. P. ˚यति (see √ सुख्).…

सुग.en: 1. सु-ग/ mf(आ)n. (i.e. 5. सु + 2. ग; √ गम्) going well or gracefully, having a graceful gait, W. · easily passed, easy to traverse, RV.; AV.; TBr.; Lāṭy.… · easy of access, Kathās.; Hcat.… · easy to obtain, RV.; TS.; Pañcat.… · easily understood, intelligible, MW.… · सु-ग/ n. a good path… · easy or successful course, RV.; VS.… · faeces, L.… · 2. सु-ग mfn. (i.e. 5. सु + 3. ग; √ गै) singing well or beautifully, BhP.…

सुगत.en: सु—गत mfn. going well, VarBṛS. · one who has fared well, Hit.… · well-bestowed, MW.… · सु—गत m. a भुद्द्ह (-त्व n.), Kathās.; Jātakam., Introd.… · सु—गत m. a <ns>Buddhist</ns>, Bud˚ teacher, Hcat.…

सुगन्धि.en: सु—ग/न्धि (or -गन्धि/) mfn. sweet-smelling, fragrant, RV.; MBh.; Hariv. &c. · virtuous, pious, MW.… · सु—ग/न्धि m. a perfume, fragrance, MW.… · the supreme Being (= paramAtman), ib.… · a lion, L.… · a sort of Mango, L.… · a sort of Cyperus, L.… · Ocimum Pilosum, L.… · the root of Scirpus Kysoor, L.… · सु—ग/न्धि n. sandal, L.… · N. of various perfumes or fragrant plants (accord. to L. = एलवालुक; = कशेरु; = गन्ध-तृण &c.), Bhpr.…

सुघोष.en: सु—घोष mfn. making a loud noise, very noisy, MBh. · having a pleasant sound, R.… · सु—घोष m. a pleasant sound or cry, W.… · N. of the conch of ङकुल, Bhag.… · of a भुद्द्ह, Lalit.… · of an आग्र-ह्āर (q.v.), Kathās.… · a partic. form of a temple, Hcat.…

सुचरित.en: 1. सु—चरित mfn. well performed (see comp.) · सु/—चरित n. (सु/-; sg. and pl.) good conduct or behaviour, virtuous actions, VS. &c. &c.… · 2. सु—चरित mf(आ)n. well-conducted, moral, virtuous, Mn. ix, 261… · सु—चरित m. (with मिश्र), N. of an author, Cat.…

सुचरिता.en: सु—चरिता (आ), f. a virtuous or faithful wife, L.

सुज्ञ.en: सु—ज्ञ mf(आ)n. knowing well, conversant or familiar with anything, Kum.

सुज्ञान.en: सु—ज्ञान n. easy perception or intelligence, KaṭhUp. · good knowledge, Kām.… · N. of various श्āमन्s, ĀrṣBr.… · सु—ज्ञान mf(आ)n. possessing good knowledge, Kām. (cf. Siddh. on Pāṇ. iv, 1, 54)… · easy to be known or understood, Vām. ii, 1, 3…

सुतप्त.en: सु/—तप्त (सु/-), mfn. very hot, much heated, ŚBr. &c. &c. · purified by heat (as gold), MBh. <pb n="1224,1"/>… · greatly harassed or afflicted, Hit.… · very severe (as a penance), Mn. xi, 239…

सुतर.en: सु—तर mfn. easy to be crossed, RV.; MBh. · easily passed (as a night), RV.…

सुतराम्.en: सु—तराम् See s.v. · सु-तराम् ind. (fr. 5. सु + तराम् = तरम्) still more, in a higher degree, excessively (सुतराम् न, ‘still less’; न स्˚, ‘very badly’; मा स्˚, ‘in no way’, ‘by no means’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.…

सुतेजा.en: सु—तेजा (?) f. Polanisia Icosandra (perhaps -तेजस् is meant), L.

सुदत्र.en: सु—द/त्र mfn. granting good gifts, RV.

सुदा.en: सु—दा/ mfn. giving bountifully, munificent, RV.

सुदान.en: सु—दान n. a rich or bounteous gift, Subh.

सुदुराचार.en: सु—दुराचार mfn. very ill-conducted, very badly behaved or wicked, a profligate, W.

सुदुर्दर्श.en: सु—दुर्दर्श mfn. very d˚ to be discerned or seen or observed, unpleasant or intolerable to the eye, R., Sch.

सुदुर्लभ.en: सु—दुर्लभ mfn. very difficult to be attained, very scarce or rare, MBh.; R. &c. · very difficult to or to be (inf.), MBh.…

सुदुष्कर.en: सु—दुष्कर mfn. very d˚ to be done, most arduous, MBh.; Bcar.; BhP.

सुदूर.en: सु—दूर mfn. very remote or distant (-दूरात्, ‘from afar’; -दूरात् सुदूरे, ‘very far away’), MuṇḍUp.

सुदृढ.en: सु/—दृढ (सु/-), mfn. very firm or hard or strong, AV. · very tenacious (as memory), Kām.… · well secured or locked, Kṛṣṇaj.…

सुदेव.en: सु—देव/ m. a good or real god, RV.; ŚBr. · (accord. to some) ‘sporting well’, a potent or highly erotic lover (in this meaning fr. √ दिव्, ‘to play’, and opp. to वि-देव, ‘impotent, unerotic’), RV. x, 95, 14; AV. xx, 136, 12… · सु—देव/ mfn. having the right gods, protected by them, RV.; TS.… · destined for the r˚ gods, VS.; TBr.… · सु—देव/ m. N. of a ख्āśयप, TĀr.… · of a <ns>Brāhman</ns>, MBh.… · of a general of आम्बर्īṣअ, ib.… · of a son of ःअर्य्-अśव and king of ख्āśइ, ib.… · of a king of Vइदर्ब्ह, R.… · of a son of आक्र्ūर, Hariv.… · of a son of फउṇḍर Vāसुदेव, ib.… · of a son of छñचु, ib.… · of a son of छम्प, BhP.… · of a son of धेवक, VP.… · of a son of Vइṣṇउ, BhP.… · of a poet, Cat.…

सुदेवा.en: सु—देवा (आ), f. N. of the wife of आरि-ह (also called Āṅगेय्ī), MBh. · of the wife of Vइकुṇṭहन (also called ध्āśāर्ह्ī), ib.…

स्नातक.en: m. one who has bathed or performed ablutions (i.e. a <ns>Brāhman</ns> who, after performing the ceremonial lustrations required on his finishing his studentship as a भ्रह्म-च्āरिन् under a religious teacher, returns home and begins the second period of his life as a घ्ṛह-स्त्ह See समावर्तन; three kinds of श्न्āतकs are named, 1. a विद्या-स्न्˚, q.v., 2. a व्रत-स्न्˚ [who has completed the vows, such as fasting, continence &c., without the Vएदs], 3. a विद्या-व्रत-स्न्˚ or उभय-स्न्˚ [who has completed both Vएदs and vows], the last is the highest; in a wider sense there may be 9 श्न्āतकs See Mn. xi, 1), ŚBr.; GṛS.; Gaut.; Mn. iii, 4 &c. (IW. 296).

स्म.en: , स्मा, (or ष्म, ष्मा), ind. a particle perhaps originally equivalent to ‘ever’, ‘always’; <div n="P"/> and later to ‘indeed’, ‘certainly’, ‘verily’, ‘surely’ (it is often used pleonastically, and in earlier language generally follows a similar particle [esp. ह, न], or relative, or prep. or verb, while in later language it frequently follows इति, न and मा/ [cf. 1. मा/]; it is also joined with a pres. tense or pres. participle to give them a past sense [e.g. प्रविशन्ति स्म, ‘they entered’]; this use of स्म is also found in the भ्र्āह्मṇअs and is extended to वेद and आह cf. स्वन.en: / m. (ifc. f(ऊ). ) sound, noise (in the older language applied to the roar of wind, thunder, water &c.; in later l˚ to the song of birds, speech, and sound of any kind, cf. Naigh. i, 11), RV. &c. &c. · a partic. आग्नि, MBh.… · (स्व/न), roaring water, VS.; TBr.… · / mfn. ill-sounding, L.…

स्वनुष्ठित.en: स्व्-अनुष्ठित mfn. well observed, duly practised or performed, R.; BhP.

स्वन्त.en: स्व्-अन्त mfn. having a good end, terminating well, MBh.; Ragh.; Kathās. · auspicious, fortunate, MBh.…

स्वपन.en: / mfn. sleepy, drowsy, VS. · / n. the act of sleeping, dreaming, sleep, Kāv.; Suśr.… · numbness (of the skin), Suśr.…

स्वप्न.en: स्व/प्न m. (once in R. n. ifc. f(आ). ; for स्व्-अप्न See p. 1281, col. 1) sleep, sleeping, RV. &c. &c. · sleepiness, drowsiness, Caurap.… · sleeping too much, sloth, indolence, Mn. ix, 13; xii, 33… · dreaming, a dream (acc. with √ दृश्, ‘to see a vision, dream’), RV.; &c.… · स्व्-अ/प्न mfn. (for स्वप्न See p. 1280) = next (accord. to some), RV. i, 120, 12; viii, 2, 18.…

स्वप्नज.en: स्वप्न—ज mfn. produced in sleep, dreamt, Megh.

स्वप्नदर्शन.en: स्वप्न—दर्शन n. dream-vision, vision in a dream, Hariv.

स्वप्नप्रपञ्च.en: स्वप्न—प्रपञ्च m. the illusions of sleep, the world spread out like a dream, MW.

स्वप्नवत्.en: स्वप्न—वत् ind. (risen) as (from) a dr˚, BhP.

स्वप्नवृत्त.en: स्वप्न—वृत्त mfn. occurring in a dr˚, Ragh.

स्वप्नशील.en: स्वप्न—शील mfn. disposed to sleep, sleepy, drowsy, W.

स्वप्नस्थान.en: स्वप्न—स्था/न n. the site or locality of a dream, ŚBr. · a bed-chamber, Kathās.… · स्वप्न—स्था/न mfn. sleeping, dreaming, NṛsUp.…

स्वप्नाध्याय.en: svapnADyAya m. ‘dr˚-chapter’, N. of the 68th फरिśइṣṭअ of the आत्हर्व-वेद and other works.

स्वप्नान्त.en: svapnAnta/ m. a state of sleep or dreaming, ŚBr.; R.

स्वप्नावस्था.en: svapnAvasTA f. a state of dreaming (applied to life as an illusion), W.

स्वप्नाय.en: Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to wish to sleep, be sleepy, MBh.; <div n="to"/>to resemble a dream, BhP.

स्वप्न्य.en: स्व/प्न्य n. a vision in a dream, AV.

स्वाप.en: m. sleeping, sleep, Suśr.; Kathās.; BhP. · dreaming, a dream, Prab.; BhP.… · sleepiness, sloth, W.… · the sleep of a limb, numbness, Suśr.… · loss of sensation, ignorance, L.… · &c. See p. 1280, col. 3.…

स्वापक.en: mfn. (fr. Caus.) causing to sleep, soporiferous, soporific, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 67, Vārtt. 2, Pat.

स्वर्ग.en: स्वर्—ग , see below. · / (or सुवर्ग/), mfn. going or leading to or being in light or heaven, heavenly, celestial (with लोक/ m. or pl. = ‘the world of light, heavens’), AV. &c. &c. <pb n="1281,3"/>… · / m. heaven, the abode of light and of the gods, heavenly bliss, (esp.) ईन्द्र's heaven or paradise (to which the souls of virtuous mortals are transferred until the time comes for their re-entering earthly bodies; this temporary heaven is the only h˚ of orthodox <ns>Brāhmanism</ns>; it is supposed to be situated on mount ंएरु q.v.; acc. with √ गा, आ-√ स्था, or आ-√ पद्, ‘to go to heaven’, ‘die’), RV. only x, 95, 18; AV. &c. &c.… · a partic. ऐक्āह, ŚāṅkhŚr.… · N. of a son of the णुद्र भ्ह्īम, VP.… · &c. See p. 1281, col. 2.…

स्वर्गकाम.en: स्वर्ग—काम mfn. desirous of heaven, Br.; Up.

स्वर्गगमन.en: स्वर्ग—गमन n. going to h˚, death, MBh.; R. &c.

स्वर्गच्युत.en: स्वर्ग—च्युत mfn. fallen or descended from h˚, Cāṇ.

स्वर्गद्वार.en: स्वर्ग—द्वार n. heaven's gate, Āpast. · N. of a थ्īर्त्ह, MBh.… · of Śइव, ib.…

स्वर्गनरक.en: स्वर्ग—नरक n. pl. the h˚ and hells, JaimUp.

स्वर्गपर.en: स्वर्ग—पर mfn. desirous of heaven, W.

स्वर्गप्रधान.en: स्वर्ग—प्रधान mfn. having heaven as the best, Bcar.

स्वर्गलोक.en: स्वर्ग—लोक m. (also in pl.) the celestial world, ईन्द्र's h˚, ĀśvGṛ.; MBh. &c. · स्वर्ग/—लोक (स्वर्ग/), mfn. belonging to or dwelling in, h˚, ŚBr.; KaṭhUp.…

स्वर्गसाधन.en: स्वर्ग—साधन mfn. means of attaining h˚, MW.

स्वर्गसुख.en: स्वर्ग—सुख n. the bliss of heaven, MBh.

स्वर्गस्थ.en: स्वर्ग—स्थ mfn. ‘dwelling in h˚’, dead, R.

स्वर्गापवर्ग.en: svargApavarga m. du. h˚ and emancipation, Bcar.

स्वर्गार्थम्.en: svargArTam ind. for the sake of h˚, Bc.

स्वर्ग्य.en: ^ mfn. = prec. VS. &c. &c. · occupying or dwelling in heaven, MārkP.… · ^ n. (with सेतु-षामन्) N. of a श्āमन्, IndSt.…

स्वर.en: , स्वरण &c. See p. 1285. · स्व/र or स्वर/, m. (ifc. f(आ). ) sound, noise, RV. &c. &c.… · voice, Mn.; MBh. &c.… · tone in recitation &c. (either high or low), accent (of which there are three kinds, उदात्त, अनुदात्त qq.vv., and स्वरित, col. 3), a note of the musical scale (of which seven [rarely six or eight] are enumerated, 1. निषाद; 2. ऋषभ; 3. गान्धार; 4. षड्ज; 5. मध्यम; 6. धैवत; 7. पञ्चम [described as resembling respectively the notes of an elephant, bull, goat, peacock, curlew or heron, horse, and Koil <pb n="1285,2"/>; and designated by their initial letters or syllables thus, नि; ऋ; ग; ष; म; ध; प], but the order is sometimes changed, षद्ज being placed first, and निषाद last), Prāt.; ŚrS.; Saṃgīt.; MBh. &c.… · a symbolical expression for the number ‘seven’, VarBṛS.…

स्वर्ण.en: m. (contracted from सु-वर्ण) a partic. आग्नि, Hariv. · n. gold (as a weight = one खर्ṣअ of gold), Yājñ.; Kāv.; Kathās. &c.… · a kind of red chalk, R.… · a kind of plant (accord. to L., ‘a kind of herb’, = गौर-सुवर्ण ‘the thorn-apple’, ‘a kind of cocoa palm’, and ‘the flower of Mesua Roxburghii’), BhP.…

स्वर्य.en: See p. 1285, col. 3. · ^ mf(आ, Ved. ई)n. resounding, roaring, crashing, loud, RV.… · beneficial to the voice, Suśr.…

स्वल्प.en: स्व्-अल्प mf(आ)n. very small or little, minute, very few, short (एन, ‘in a short time’), Mn.; MBh. &c.

स्वल्पक.en: mf(इका/)n. very small or minute or short, AV.; &c.

स्वश.en: m. pl. N. of a people (prob. w.r. for खश), Buddh.

स्वसृ.en: स्व/सृ f. (of doubtful derivation) a sister (also applied to closely connected things of the fem. gender, as to the fingers, the waters &c.), RV.; &c. · [cf. Gk. ἔορ; Lat. soror; Lith. sesů́; Goth. swistar; Germ. Schwester; Eng. sister.]…

स्वस्ति.en: स्व्-अस्ति/ n. f. (nom. स्वस्ति/, ˚ति/स्; acc. स्वस्ति/, ˚ति/म्; instr. स्वस्ति/, ˚त्या/; dat. स्वस्त/ये; loc. स्वस्तौ/; instr. स्वस्ति/भिस्; also personified as a goddess, and sometimes as खल्ā cf. स्वस्ति-देवी), well-being, fortune, luck, success, prosperity, RV.; VS.; ŚBr.; MBh.; R.; BhP. · स्व्-अस्ति/ (इ/), ind. well, happily, successfully (also = ‘may it be well with thee! hail! health! adieu! be it!’ a term of salutation [esp. in the beginning of letters] or of sanction or approbation), RV.; &c.…

स्वस्तिक.en: m. a kind of bard (who utters words of welcome or eulogy), R. · any lucky or auspicious object, (esp.) a kind of mystical cross or mark made on persons and things to denote good luck (it is shaped like a Greek cross with the extremities of the four arms bent round in the same direction; the majority of scholars regard it as a solar symbol; that is, as representing a curtailed form of the wheel of the Solar Vइṣṇउ, consisting of four spokes crossing each other at right angles with short fragments of the periphery of the circle at the end of each spoke turning round in one direction to denote the course of the Sun; accord. to the late Sir A. Cunningham it has no connexion with sun-worship, but its shape represents a monogram or interlacing of the letters of the auspicious words सु अस्ति/ [स्वस्ति] in the आśओक characters; amongst झइनs it is one of the 24 a……

स्वस्त्ययन.en: स्वस्त्य्—अयन n. sg. and pl. (ifc. f(आ). ) auspicious progress, success, Jātakam. · blessing, benediction, congratulation (with Caus. of √ वच्, ‘to ask for a blessing’), AV. &c. &c.… · a ंअन्त्र recited for good luck or the recitation of such a ंअन्त्र, W.… · a means of attaining prosperity, Jātakam.… · a vessel full of water borne in front of a procession, L.… · स्वस्त्य्—अयन mf(ई)n. bringing or causing good fortune, auspicious (˚तम, superl.), TBr. &c. &c.…

स्वातन्त्र्य.en: n. (fr. स्व-तन्त्र) the following one's own will, freedom of the will, independence (आत् and एन, ‘by one's own will, of one's own free choice, voluntarily, freely’), Lāṭy.; MaitrUp.; MBh. &c.

स्वादित्य.en: स्व्-आदित्य/ mfn. any one befriended by the Āदित्यs, RV. · स्व्-आदित्य/ n. the favour or protection of the Āदित्यs, ib.…

स्वाभाविक.en: mf(ई)n. (fr. स्वभाव) belonging to or arising from one's own nature, natural, native, spontaneous, original, peculiar, inherent (-त्व n.), Up.; MBh. &c. · m. pl. N. of a <ns>Buddhistic</ns> school (cf. Buddhac. ix, 48; 51).…

स्वाभाविकेतर.en: svABAviketara mf(आ)n. not natural or inherent, Sāh.

स्वाभाव्य.en: mfn. self-existent, existing spontaneously (said of Vइṣṇउ), MBh. · n. own peculiarity, own nature, Śaṃk.…

स्वामित्व.en: स्वामि—त्व n. (MBh.) ownership, mastership, lordship of (gen. or comp.)

स्वामिभाव.en: स्वामि—भाव m. ownership, mastership, lordship, R.

स्वाम्यर्थम्.en: स्वाम्य्—अर्थम् ind. for a master's sake, MW.

स्वाम्य.en: n. mastership, lordship, ownership, dominion or power over any one, Mn.; MBh. &c.

स्वार.en: &c. See p. 1285, col. 3. · / m. sound, noise (of a snorting horse), RV.… · tone, accent, RPrāt.… · the श्वरित accent, TPrāt.… · / mfn. relating to sound or accent, MW.… · having the श्वरित accent… · / n. a श्āमन् ending with the श्वरित accent, VS.; PañcavBr.; Lāṭy.…

स्वाराज्य.en: स्वा/राज्य n. (fr. स्व-राज्) independent rule, uncontrolled dominion, sovereignty (accord. to some ‘ईन्द्र's heaven’, fr. 2. स्वा-राज्; also इन्द्रस्य स्वाराज्यम् N. of a श्āमन्), TS. &c. &c. · union with भ्रह्म, identification with the self-refulgent, state of self-effulgence, MW.… · स्वा/राज्य mfn. procuring sovereignty or heaven, PañcavBr.…

स्वाराज्यकाम.en: स्वाराज्य—काम mfn. desirous of sovereignty or heaven, ŚāṅkhBr.

स्वास्थ्य.en: n. (fr. स्व-स्थ) self-dependence, sound state (of body or soul), health, ease, comfort, contentment, satisfaction, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

स्वाहा.en: स्व्-आ/हा ind. (prob. fr. 5. सु and √ अह्; cf. दुर्-आहा) hail! hail to! may a blessing rest on! (with dat.; an exclamation used in making oblations to the gods; with √ कृ [ind.p. -का/रम्, or -कृत्य] and acc. ‘to pronounce the exclamation श्व्āह्ā over’), RV. &c. &c. · स्व्-आ/हा f. an oblation (offered to आग्नि, ईन्द्र &c.) or Oblation personified (as a daughter of धक्ṣअ and wife of आग्नि; she is thought to preside over burnt-offerings; her body is said to consist of the four Vएदs, and her limbs are the six आṅगs or members of the Vएद; she is represented also as a wife of the णुद्र फśउ-पति), RV.; &c.…

स्वाहाकार.en: स्व्-आहा—कार/ m. (ifc. f(आ). ) utterance of or consecration by uttering Sv˚ (also as a deity presiding over the फ्रय्āज), ŚBr. &c. &c.

स्वित.en: स्व्-इत/ n. = सुवित, welfare, luck, VS.

स्विन्न.en: / mfn. sweating, perspiring, VS. &c. &c. · sweated, treated with sudorifics, Suśr.… · seethed, boiled, Hariv.; MārkP.…

स्वेद.en: स्वे/द m. (ifc. f(आ). ) sweating, perspiring, sweat, perspiration (pl. ‘drops of p˚’), RV. &c. &c. · a sudorific, Car.; Suśr.… · warmth, heat, L.… · warm vapour, steam (see comp.)… · स्वे/द mfn. sweating, perspiring, toiling, W.… · &c. See col. 1.…

स्वेदज.en: स्वेद—ज mfn. sweat-produced, engendered by heat and moisture, generated by warm vapour or steam (said of insects and vermin), AitUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.

स्विषु.en: स्व्-इषु/ mfn. having good or swift arrows, RV.

स्वरा.en: (आ), f. N. of the chief wife of भ्रह्म्ā, L.

स्वरसम्पन्न.en: स्व/र—सम्पन्न (स्व/र-), mf(आ)n. melodious, harmonious, ŚBr. · having a melodious voice, R.…

स्वरान्त.en: svarAnta mfn. ending in a vowel, VPrāt. · having the श्वरित accent on the last syllable, ṢaḍvBr.…

स्वरित.en: mfn. caused to sound, BhP. · sounded, having an accent, accentuated, Lāṭy.… · having श्वरित accent, Vait.; Prāt.; Pāṇ.… · added, admixed (-त्व n.), Naiṣ.… · m. n. the श्वरित accent (a kind of mixed tone, produced by a combination of high and low tone, and therefore named in Pāṇ. i, 2, 31 सम्-आहार, the high and low tones being called उद्-आत्त, ‘raised’ or ‘acute’, and अन्-उदात्त, ‘low’ or ‘grave’; the Sv˚ corresponds to the Greek circumflex and is of four kinds, viz. क्षैप्र [as in व्य्-आ/प्त for वि/-आप्त], जात्य [as in क्व^ for कु/अ], प्रश्लिष्ट [as in दिवी/व for दिवि/ इव], or अभिनिहित [as in ते/ ऽब्रुवन् for ते/ अब्रुवन्]; it is marked in RV. by a small upright stroke above a syllable; and when produced by an उदात्त immediately preceding is sometimes called ‘a dependent श्वरित’, and, when it properly belongs to a word, an ‘independent श्वरित’), ĀśvŚr.; Prāt.; Pāṇ.…

ह.en: 1. ह the thirty-third and last consonant of the ङ्āगर्ī alphabet (in फ्āṇइनि's system belonging to the guttural class, and usually pronounced like the English h in hard; it is not an original letter, but is mostly derived from an older घ्, rarely from ध् or भ्). · 2. ह m. (only L.) a form of Śइव or भ्हइरव (cf. nakulISa)… · water… · a cipher (i.e. the arithmetical figure which symbolizes o)… · meditation, auspiciousness… · sky, heaven, paradise… · blood… · dying… · fear… · knowledge… · the moon… · Vइṣṇउ… · war, battle… · horripilation… · a horse… · pride… · a physician… · cause, motive… · = पाप-हरण… · = सकोप-वारण… · = शुष्क… · ा (also आ, f.) laughter… · (अम्), n. the Supreme Spirit… · pleasure, delight… · a weapon… · the sparkling of a gem… · calling, calling to the sound of a lute…

हकार.en: ह—कार m. the letter or sound ह, MW.

हत्व.en: ह—त्व n. the state of the letter ह, ib.

हा.en: (आ), f. coition · a lute… · f. abandonment, desertion, L.… · 1. हा ind. an exclamation expressive of pain, anger, astonishment, satisfaction &c. (= ah! alas! oh! ha! often before or after a voc. case, also repeated हा-हा cf. 1. हहा above, or followed by other particles, esp. धिक्, हन्त, कष्टम् &c.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.,… · 2. हा (not always separable fr. √ 3. हा) cl. 3. Ā. (Dhātup. xxv, 7) जि/हीते (p. जि/हान [q.v.]; pf. जहिरे/, AV.; aor. अहास्त, RV. &c.; fut. हाता Gr.; हास्यते, Br.; MBh.; inf. -हातुम्, ib.; ind.p. हात्वा Gr.; -हा/य, RV.), <div n="to"/>to start or spring forward, bound away, give way to (dat.), RV.; <div n="to"/>to spring or leap upon (?), RV. x, 49, 5; <div n="to"/>to go or depart or betake one's self to have recourse to (acc.), Nalod. <pb n="1296,2"/>; <div n="to"/>to fall or come into any state, Kir. : <div n="vp"/>Pass. हायते (aor. अहायि) Gr.: <div n="vp"/>Caus. हापयति (aor. अजीहपत्), ib. : <div n="vp"/>Desid. जिहासते, ib. : <div n="vp"/>Intens. जहायते, जाहाति, जाहेति, ib.…

हंस.en: 1. हंस/ m. (ifc. f(आ). ; accord. to Uṇ. iii, 62 fr. √ 1. हन्, ‘to go?’) a goose, gander, swan, flamingo (or other aquatic bird, considered as a bird of passage; sometimes a mere poetical or mythical bird, said in RV. to be able to separate शोम from water, when these two fluids are mixed, and in later literature, milk from water when these two are mixed; also forming in RV. the vehicle of the आśविन्s, and in later lit˚ that of भ्रह्म्ā; ifc. also = ‘best or chief among’), RV. &c. &c. · the soul or spirit (typified by the pure white colour of a goose or swan, and migratory like a goose; sometimes ‘the Universal Soul or Supreme Spirit’, identified with Vइर्āज्, ङ्āर्āयṇअ, Vइṣṇउ, Śइव, ख्āम, and the Sun; du. ‘the universal and the individual Spirit’; accord. to Sāy. resolvable into अहं स, ‘I am that’), Up.; MBh.; Hariv. &c.…

हत.en: &c. See col. 2. · / mfn. struck, beaten (also said of a drum), smitten, killed, slain, destroyed, ended, gone, lost (often ibc. = ‘destitute of’, ‘bereft of’, ‘-less’), RV. &c. &c.… · injured, marred, hurt, wounded (lit. and fig.), MBh.; Kathās.… · struck off (as a head), R.… · knocked out (as an eye), ib.… · hit by (instr. or comp.), Kāv.; Kathās.… · whirled up, raised (as dust), Śak.… · visited or afflicted or tormented by, struggling with, suffering from (instr. or comp.), ŚBr.; ChUp.; MBh. &c.… · (in astron.) touched, come into contact, VarBṛS.… · violated (sexually, as a woman), MBh. viii, 2037… · ruined, undone, hopeless, miserable, wretched (of persons and things; cf. comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.… · worthless, useless, ib.… · defective, Sāh.… · cheated, deceived, Kuval.…

हादि.en: m. or f. a spider (= लूता), L.

ह्री.en: 1. ह्री cl. 3. P. (Dhātup. xxv, 3) जिह्रेति (जि/ह्रियत्, MaitrS.; pf. जिह्राय, Ragh.; जिह्रयां-चकार, ˚याम्-आस, Gr.; aor. अह्रैषीत्, ib.; Prec. ह्रीयात्, ib.; p. ह्रयाण, See अ-ह्र्˚; fut. ह्रेता, ह्रेष्यति Gr.), <div n="to"/>to feel shame, blush, be bashful or modest, be ashamed of any one (gen.) or anything (abl.), Kāv.; Kathās. : <div n="vp"/>Caus. ह्रेपयति (aor. अजिह्रिपत्), to make ashamed, cause to blush, confound, put to shame (also fig. = ‘surpass, excel’), ib. : <div n="vp"/>Desid. जिह्रीषति Gr.: <div n="vp"/>Intens. जेह्रीयते (p. ˚यमाण, SaddhP.), जेह्रयीति, जेह्रेति, to be greatly ashamed, ib. · 2. ह्री/ f. shame, modesty, shyness, timidity (also personified as daughter of धक्ṣअ and wife of ध्हर्म), VS.; &c.…

ह्वृ.en: or ह्वॄ (cf. √ ह्वल्, √ ध्वृ) cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xxii, 23) ह्व/रति (in RV. also ह्व/रते; and accord. to Dhātup. xxxi, 21 also ह्वृणाति; pf. जह्वार, ˚वर्थ, ˚वरुः Gr.; aor. अह्वार्षीत्, ह्वार्षीत्, ह्वार्, ह्वारिषुः, VS.; Br.; Kāṭh.; Prec. ह्वर्यात् Gr.; fut. ह्वर्ता, ह्वरिष्यति, ib.; inf. ह्वर्तुम्, ib.), <div n="to"/>to deviate or diverge from the right line, be crooked or curved, bend, go crookedly or wrongly or deviously, stumble, fall down, VS. &c. (see above) : <div n="vp"/>Caus. ह्वारयति (aor. जिह्वरः, ˚रतम्; जुहुरः, जुहूर्थाः, जुहुराण/), <div n="to"/>to cause to go crookedly, lead wrong or astray, RV.; <div n="to"/> (Ā.) to go wrong or astray, ib. : <div n="vp"/>Desid. जुह्वूर्षति Gr.: <div n="vp"/>Intens. जाह्वर्यते, जाह्वर्ति, ib.
